dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams kye lo rgyus deb phreng /2༄༅/ /sa sdonga'i 'buro bo'i gdu rabs laso 'phros pa'i 'brag sda chan pa spa rangs byung ba brjad pa dang sa gsal ma lang /lpo rong zla ba dar rgyas kyis brtsams//phyicirnge debaphrengadang 11/cirngesnga la rgyus pha rgan 'dus pa drang gtam/ a myes rma chen bod kyi rig gzhung zhib 'jug khang si/sa spar bskrun zhus/2009

dkar chagagleng brjod/ 9'brog sde chen po spyod rong gi byung rabs lo rgyus/ 17byedad bcud kyi bkod pa dang yul mi'i 'tsho las 17spo lha nga khul gyi gnas chen/ 20lpo rong gi rtswa thang dang rang 'byung skyed tshal/ 29sgo rong rje dbon gyi byung rabs dang rje dpon gyi ring lugs/ 31spyod rong rje dbon gyi byung rabs dang yul ming thogs tshul/ 31dus phyis 'bur ba'i gdung rgyud/ 44spo rong rje dbon gyi skor ngag rgyun gyi lo rgyus dang mtshar gtam/ 49slo rong rje dbon gyi ring lugs dang 'dzin skyong / 56spo mo nga spyi khyab/ 57shel dkar rdzong / 58lpo rong tsho brgyad kyi skor/ 59 gtong lhang) gnyer las gsum/ 62sngo/da gzhis khag lnga/ 62rta zam gsum gyi sko ra/ 633

'brog sde chen po slo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /dbo na ma lag bcu gsum/ 63〉〉sa gzhis khag gsum/ 63'brog sde sgo rong pa'i lo 'khor rtsis rgyag tshogs 'du dang dus chen khag 65gdan sa chen po spo rong dpal mo chos sdings/ 98chodas sdings dbo na pa'i gnas bshad/ 100chodas sdings dbo na pa'i lha khang khag gi rnam grangs dang nang rten gyi tho gzhung / 105lha khang khag gi nang rten skor kyi lo rgyus/ 107lha khang khag gi nang rten gyi lha ra/ 109chos srung chen po bkra shis 'od 'bar/ 119ngo lugs mar me'i brtags pas bla ma 'dems tshul/ 123bo lugs sprul sku'i skor/ 124chos sdings ri ldebs kyi rdo r+sha sa yig cha dang po/ 132chos sdings ri ldebs kyi rdo rkos yig cha gnyis pa/ 134bod du dus phyis spo rong dgon pa'i gnas stangs dang 'tsho bzhugs the rong pa'i dran tho/ 136dge 'dun pa'i zhal grangs/ 140spo rong dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus khag cig 143

snyadab dpon gyi gnas chen dpal khyad mtsho'am lha mtsho srin mtsho/ 143spo rong pa dang sger lung shar/ yab gzhis lha klu/yab gzhis g.yu lnga/ga bcas kyi skor/ 145'brog sde spo rong pa'i khyad chos 'dren pa/ 1567rgyal ba'i rnam thar nas lung drangs pa'i skabs de'i spo rong gi gnas stangs/ 158spo rong rje dbon dang dbus gtsang sde gzar/ mi dbang 1/ lha bsku da nams lha bas rgyas bcas kyi skor/ 164spo rong dang 'brel ba'i mche'i yig rnying khag gi brjod don/ 172chu lug (1703) lor 7rgyal ba drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtshos spo rong rje dbon la bstsal ba'i she bam/ 172me 'brug (1736) zla 8 tshes 24 la 7rgyal dbang bdun pa chen pos spo rong rje dbon la stsal ba'i she bam /ltab dril ang lnga pa/ 175sa lug (1739) 'e/ra mi dbang stu/ lha ba bsku/da nams stobs rgyas rdo ros pe'i les dzad rong rje dbon la bstsal ba'i she bam tham sbyar/ 176chu mo phag (1743) 'o/ra 'o/ lha ba bsku/da nams stobs rgyas kyis spo blo nga rje dbon la bstsal ba'i she bam/ 179lcags stag zhib gzhung nang spo rong rje dbon khong rkang 'don ji yod skor/ 1835

'grog sde chen po slo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /sa lug ((1859 'am 1919)nyi sku/ra spo blogang 'asnga ga sde tsho lnga'i zha lnga zhib gsher gyis gtan la phab pa'i yig cha'i skor/ 184lcags lug lor spo rong rje dbon nas rgyal ba rgod tshang pa'i sgrub gnas bar 'aX ga chu bzang la ba355 ba'i gtan tshigs/ 187kha chu'i dpyad shog 'dra gnyis grwa ngag dbang nas nyar/ zhes pa/ 189lcags 'brug 1940 lor 7rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po'i yang srid khri phebs kyi mdzad sgor rang dpon rje dbon chen the/ dbu bzhugs kyis/ rang khungs mdzad chen rgyal gzhas/gzhas mi dang nyer mkho mo gas gang cir lnga babo da par/ 195spo rong dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus khag khungs gtugs yig cha dang myong can mi sna khag gi tho bkod par/ 199byes 'byor spo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/ 203spo rong rje dbon glo yul du bros byol phebs 'phral yul mi ser skya phon che zhig rang mgo rang thon gyis btsan byol du gyar bzhin dbo na pa'i rten gasdo sku gas bal yul du gdan zhu thub pa'i skor/ 203ngo mtshar ba'i gtam/(1) 208ngo mtshar ba'i gtam/(2) 209gsung 'bum do grangs drug skyid grong du me sreg btang ba'i skor/ 212ngo mtshar ba'i gtam/(3) 2156

lnga mtshar gyi gtam/(4) 217lnga mtshar ba'i gtam/(5) 219dgon pa'i 'dus sde nam zhig grol zhing rten gtso rin po che snang skyid dasgo na par bzhugs bathodal gyi spo phro nga mi mang nas zhabs zhu dang gsung 'bum sogs bod gzhung la phul ba'i cadar/ 220spo rong mi mang gis rang khongs grwa chos grags ḍi kun dang slob naso dgongs zhus kyis dkon gnyer slar gso bgyis pa'i skor/ 226rten gtso rin po che spo ro/nga bkra shis rdo rje'i nang du gdan zhus kyis dpal mo chodas sdings 'dus sde slar gso thub pa'i skor/ 228bal yul du cad dodang paṇa chen gyi gdan sa dpal mo chodas sdings gsar bzhengs/ 230the mo nga chos snu gas zhes snga mo'i spo rong spyi tshogs la gzhir bzhag gis the rong skyid sdug tshugs skor/ 233skabs de'i spo gro nga chos tshogs kyi rgyun las dang dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa zhal grangs bcas kyi stodar/ 334lo 'khor gcig gi nang spo rong ser skya thun mong nas chos phyogs kyi las rim zhu bya'i lha ra/ 236phyi lo 1991 lor byes 'byor the rong pa'i dud grangs kyi skor/ 239bal yul du ngo dong paṇa chen gyi gdan sa rten dang brten pa 7

'brog sde chen po skyo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /bcas pa slar gasdus) skor/ 244ngo mtshar ba'i gtam/(6) 252phyi lo 2000 zla 2 tshes 11 nyin dge bshes pad+ma rdo rje lags dang bal yul spo rong ser skya lhan 'dzoms kyis chosags 'du rgyas pa zhig tshogs pa'i cirgag tho/ 260ngo mtshar ba'i gtam/(7) 266bo dong paṇa chen gyi gdan sa the mo nga dpal mo chodas sding sa gsar bzhengs legs grub kyi mdzad sgo gzab rgyas bskyangs pa/ 268spo rong gi skor sger skul 'bri rtsom khag cig 274bo dong mchog sprul gyi rnam thar snying bsdus/ rdzong dkar chos sde'i grwa thub bstan ngag dbang gis bris/ 288spo rong rje dbon gyi skor snga phyi'i lo rgyus/ spo rong rje dbon sku bag kun bzang byams pas bris/ 292gzhis byes gnyis su snu nga chodar nga'i mi tshe/ btsan sdudal thodad mi mang spyi zur spo rong rgan chen pa dbang phyug rdo rjes bris/ 298yang yang gi dri bar gsal bshad/ 307'brel yod 'dra dpar khag 317 mo〉 snga dus spo rong mnga' zhabs kyi sa khra/ 378 'brel yod bka' gtan she bam khag 375

gle nga brjod/'erdo rgyus 'di nas rags tsam mkhyen rtogs thub rgyur/ snga dus cadad khri skosnar bcu gsum gyi nang gses/ la lha da lho pa'i khongs gtogs chos khag brgyad du dbye ba'i 'brog sde chen po spo rong / bod gangs can gyi mkhas pa'i khrod du 'chad rtsod dang lhag par rtsom la mngon par bstod pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang po bo dong paṇa chen dang gang gis phyag btab pa'i gdan sa khag /༷/la de'i chos rgyal du bkur ba sa skyong 'bur ba'i gdung rabs dang gang gi ring lugs/ bod chos ldan gyi zhing khams su bud med la bla chen du ches cher bkur ba bsam sdings rdo rje phag mo bla rabs kyi byung khungs/ mnga' ris paṇa chen gyis mdzad cing sgyu ro/nga rje dbon gyis 'khrab sdusal du gtod pa'i bod kyi gna' sngo re gzhas chen rgyal gzhas sogs lo ngo brgya phrag bdun brgal ba'i 'o/ rgyus dang / de bzhin wa da kyi chos brgyud bka' rnying bo bon sdudags kyi byung rabs lo rgyus kyi gnas khyad par can/dper na/ dpal mo thang gi dpal thang du: brtan ma bcu gnyis dam la btags:bod yul kha la'i la thog tu: gangs dkar sha med dam la btags: zhes gter yig khag nang gsal ba'i slob dpon chen po'i rdzu 'phrul gyi gnas dang / skyid pa nyi ma rdzong / be rtse 'dod yon rdzong / sbas phug ma mo rdzong / la phug pad+ma rdzong / glang sgo klu bdud rdzong / g.yag ru dang ser lung sogs rje btsun mi la'i gnas/ phyi 'o/ 1049 'o/ra dge bshes chen sngo na/ tra bas phyag btab 9

'grog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /ci nga de rjes rgya gar gyi mkhan chen 'bum phrag gsum pas e chodas sde zhes bo dong pa'i gdan sa chen por gtod pa de nas mched pa'i dpang lo tsā ba slo gros brta na pa sogs bo dong lo paṇa rim byon dang rwa lo tsā ba dang rnam grol rtsangs rdo dmar/ rdor gling bar 'brog chu bzang sogs grub dbang mang po 'i gdul zhing / 7rgyal ba sku 'phreng dang po rje dge 'dun grub pa'i zhabs kyis bcags shing bo dong paṇa chen gyis rje nyid la thams cad mkhyen pa zhes pa'i mtshan gnas phul yul gdan sa dpal mo chos sdings sogs bo dodang pa'i dgon ma lag bcu bzhi/ bal bza' khri btsun dang jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha/ mkhan chen 'bum phrag gsum pa sogs rgya bod lo paṇa du mas zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs pa 〈snags 'o rgyus kyis phyug pa'i gnas yul zhig yin rung / blo pham zhig la/ yul phyo gas 'di'i gna' bo'i mnga' thang dang grags pa'i lo rgyus mang sngo zhig snga dus shig nas nyams mabo tshugs te/ deng 'o/ rgyus mi nyung ba zhig rgan ngag gachodan 'jags kyis lam nas 'thud pa las khungs gtugs yig rnying ches dkon pa dang / de bzhin wa dong paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum dang de min bstan chos mang ngo zhig mi rabs nas mi rabs su lha khang nang mchodad pa'i rten la bsgrigs pa las zhal phye tsam yang byung e yod snyam pa'i rgyu mtshan mang po zhig la brten nas/ deng spyi tshogs nang gna' bo'i gnas phyogasamo sto 'di'i sko ra grags pas khyab pa lta ci tha snyad 'bod tshul la'ang lhad phog gis ming 'dzol thebs pa dper na/ bo dong dang bu ston 'dzol/ bo lugs dang bu lugs 10

gleng brjod/'dzol/ spo rong dang spu hreng 'dzol/ rje dbon la rje dpon nam byi dpon du 'ardo la gyi sku da pa ma zad la las ni shes bzhin sgro btags 'bri dpon zhes khyad gsod kyis bris pa'ang malnga nga chos su mchis pa mkhyen gsal red/kho bo bdag nang chodas la slob gnyer bgyis pa zhig min yang 'dir skabs babs brjod gzhi dang thad /ra 'brel ba chags pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis nang chodas lha ra lung 'dren gyi lam nas tshig gsum zhus pa ham bshad du mi dbosgongs pa mkhyen/bod kyi lo rgyus la mkhas pa/ i 'dzin si mi thid mchog gis mdzad pa'i bstan dzar+shas/ 7717thar/62117 76588 8〉 stu bu ba2 571 smo zhes pa'i nang khong gis the tshom med pa'i gsal bshad 'di 'dra zhig gnang 'dug /dbyin ska da nas rags tsam don bsgyur zhus na/ (jigasal rtogs ma thub pa'i rgyu mtshan mang sngo zhig la brten nas bod kyi mkhas pa'i khrod du jo nang phyogs las rnam rgyal dang /bo dong phyo gas las rnam rgyal gnyis ngo bo gcig tu 'acadal ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis phyis su dge lugs pa'i mkhas pa chodas nge dong phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis dbu ma gzhan stong gi bzhed pa 'do da par 'dzol/ de'i rkyen pas bo dong rang nyid kyi khyad chodas legs par ldan pa'i chodas rgyun de'ang mkhyodags myur nyams rgud phyin nyi zhes dang / da dung 'grel brjod gnang don/ pa(go 'dzol dang dus sbrel gyi mtshungs pa mang lnga zhig la brten nas cad thodang pa dang lnga nang pa phan tshun 'jo la nyen gyi rgyu mtshan mang du mchis pas/ginyi dper na/ gnyis gas dus 'kho ra (ka la tsakra tan tra ) dang rjodar ba yan lag drug (sa dhan ga yo ga ) nyams 11

'brog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /len byed pa'i khyad chos dang ldan la/ gnyis lnga'i gdan sa bod gtsang khul du 'khod pa/ dad ldan rjes 'jug pa'ang gang 'tshams shig thun mong du gyur pa/lhag par du/ phyogs las rnam rgyal zhes pa'i mtshan gyi tha snyad gcig gyur la brten khong gnyis ngo wa gcig yin par 'dzol/ jo nang phyogs las rnam rgyal (1308 /386) gyi chos rgyun ni dol po pa shes rab rgyal mtshan nas mched )ming gzhan stong gi bzhed pa 'dod/ 'di las ldog ste tshang mas ((sems la nges dgos rgyu zhig ni lhu/ dong paṇa chen (1376—1451) gyi chos rgyun ni bu ston rin chen grub dang bla ma dam pa bsku/da nams rgyal mtshan nas mched pa zhig las dol po shes rab rgyal mtshan nas mched pa zhig min/gnyi zhes dang / yang ((bo dong paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i dbu phar gnyis kyi 'grel pa'i nang khong gi lta grub ni yongs grags dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i mtshan nyid (pra sa nan gi ka ) zhes rang sdong gi ba'ed pa g.yo med du 'dod mkhan zhig red nyi ce sa 'khod/ ((skabs der khong gi dgongs pa dang ches mthun pa'i mkhas dbang gzhan khag ni rje tsong kha pa dang mkhas grub rje/de bzhin skabs de'i sa skya pa'ang red/nyi ces kyang gsungs/ mkhas dbang 'jin si mi thid mchog gis lo mang zhib 'jug mdzad 'bras rtsache'i bstan bcos 'di'i nang wa wa nga sku gas nyams rgud 'a gro bzhin pa'i chos brgyud stodar rang re phal pa'i kha rgyun dang mi mtshungs shing go myong tsam yang med pa'i lo rgyus phra rab ji snyed cig pomachis pa rnams kho bo bdag gis zhal mjal thub pa skal bzang du gyur yang yig tshogs che bas 'dir ma bkod/12

gleng brjod/phyi lo 1959 lor bod du dus 'gyur rjes bo dong paṇa chen gyi gdan sa dpal mo chodas sdings dgon pa'i rten gtso/ 'jigs bral nga 'dra ma dang / gang gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum de nyid 'dus chen ngo da 130 brgal ba sogs bal yul sa thog tu gdan zhu thub pa dang de rjes gsung 'bum cha tshang ldi li bod khang nas dpar slog gis 'dzam gling gtsug lag slob gnyer khang gang sar khyab spel byung ba la brten nas/ sngo da kyi rig gzhung la nyams zhib pa mkhas mang rgya mtsho lta bu'i thugs snang bal 'khod spo rong pa lha sde mi sde'i phyogs su phrogs/phyi lo 1987 'e/ra nged rang spel kob bod khyim nas dgongs zhus kyis bal yul du sger gyi tshong las la zhugs pa'i skabs grags can dbyin yul gyi gtsug lag snyadab gnyer khang tse/ga se 'o/raṇa dang / kem stere je yis gtsos phyi rgyal gyi gtsug lag slog gnyer khang mi nyung ba zhig nas bo dong chos rgyun dang spo rong gi lo rgyus la nyams zhib pa mang po dang mjal bas khong tshor skad sgyur gyi go skabs thob pa dang lhan cig de snga gshib myong med pa'i bal 'khod spo rong pa ser skya bgres gzhon mang po zhig dang zhal mjal lhod gshib kyi bo skabs bzang po thob/ de bzhin bzang po'i zhor la ja chang zhes pa ltar nged rang la'ang bod kyi 'o/ rgyus spyi dang sgos su skye sa'i pha yul gyi skor mi dman tsam rtogs thub pa'i go skabs thob/ mi ring bar nged rang la'ang lo rgyus bsdu rub byed rgyu'i do snang zhig rnyed pa ma zad so/ so'i pha yul gyi lo rgyus shig 'bri thub na ci ma rung snyam pa'i sems 'gul zhig kyang thebs/ 'on kyang da lta'i rang re'i spyi tshogs 13

'brog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /nang lo rgyus 'bri skal bla dawa na dang mkhas dbang rnam pa las mi dmangs phal pas lo rgyus 'bri srol med cing bri mi chog pa lta bu'i gnya' chag pa'i rmongs tshul zhig yod pa des bdag gi 'dun pa de'ang rgyun ring de mur lus/ bdag gi lag g.yas mtheb mdzub nas 'jus te ka mad 'bri klog gi dge rgan zur khang lpo bo skal bzang lags dam pa dang / sim la'i chos dge dge bshes blo bzang mthar phyin lags sogs kyi bsna /'a drin la brten nas sngo da yig gi gnas tshad la mi dman tsam yod khul yang lo rgyus 'bri spobs 'deng min rgyun ring de mur lus/de rjes phyi lo 1997 lor 7gong sa mchog nas gus kyi bu gcig kho na las med pa bu chung bsod nams don grub nyid bo dong bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi chung srid du ngo sa 'dzin gnang rjes bdag gi mi tsher rang bzhin 'gan ljid cig 'khris song snyam pas/ de 'phral slo gnyis spangs te lo rgyus 'di'i las gzhi brtsams/ lo rgyus khungs gtugs yig cha yod med la gzhigs nas rtsom sgrig 'di bzhin sa bcad gsum du dbyes te bkod pas rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams dgyes su gsol/ skabs 'dir smra bar 'dod pa ni/ gang du sus mdzad bstan bcos ni shin tu dkon/ /'khrul med sbas ba'i gter yig ni ga nas yod/ /shes bzhin lhad 'debs rang bzo ni ngas mi shes/ /bgres dang bgres mo'i ngag rgyun gyi dran pa'i gter/ /rab tu phyug pa'i mi rabs 'gas) bdag la mjal/ /da ni 'di ko rtsa brlag las skyob pa'i ched/ /mi 'jig nargo 'gros su bkod rgyu'i go skal de/ kho bo bdag la thob pas ni spro sems 'khol/

gleng brjod/rang nus gang lcogs lhad med cig bris khul yang / /ma shes rmongs pas nor 'khrul 'ga' mchis srid na/ /gzur gnas mkhyen ldan rnams kyi spyan sngar bshags/ /bal yul mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi 'dabs rol nas gus rmongs zla ba dar rgyas kyis bod rgyal 'o( 2135 snron zla'i tshes 4 phyi lo 2008zla 7 tshes 6 bzang por mjug bsdoms zhus/lo rgyus 'di la yig rnying dang ngag rgyun gyi rogs skyor mdzad po gsham gsal rnoms la thugs rje che+o zhu/la rgyus la phyug pa spa rang khang dkar spa ba byang chub/ khang dkar bu dan grub tshe ring / khang dkar bu bsam grub/ lpo rong sku bag kun bzang byams pa/ grwa kre nub pa dang a khu 'jam dbyangs/ rgan tshe ring rdo rje/ gzhis bzhugs grwa skal bzang grags pa/ spyi khyab bu dngos grub/ mkhar 'or lcam chung blo bzang rnam grol lags/ rdzong dga' tshe dbang rab rgyas/ sgo drug a ma lhag pa/ a ya pad+ma/ dbang grags pad+ma tshe ring / rgyal gzhas la mkhas pa g.yag pa rdo rje bza' tshang / gcen po rje drung / rgan chen pad rgyal/ spyi khyab dbyangs can bcas sa dmigs bkar thugs rje che zhu yul/bo dong chos rgyun dang spo rong par bka' drin zla med tshe ring dam chos dam pa/dgung lo 88 du phebs kyang dbang rig gsal zhing dran pa rdo phung ltar brtan pa'i lo rgyus kyi bang mdzod dkon gnyer ngag dbang / dgon pa'i sbyin bdag gtong 15

'brog sde chen po spo rong be+e byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /phod can ma mar li se kon phelaḍa (95 787//23 501062/7) kho bos bzos pa'i shog snyigs dang skad cig gi gtum spyod la rgyus nges kyis sun 'tsher mi mdzad par rgyab skyodar kho na'i dpung gro gas bdag gi nang mi bu phrug dang / lhag par chung srid rin snga che dang bza' zla skal bzang chos sprodan/ bu mo rnam rgyal lha la dkar dang bo mag bkra shis dngos grub/ bdag la slob ston gyi sbyin pa dang deb 'di dpar skrun mdzad po mkhas dbang bkra shis tshe ring lags dang a myes rma chen cadad kyi rig gzhung zhib 'jug khang / bzhugs sgar bod kyi dpe mdzod khang / dpe mdzod 'gan 'dzin dge bshes lhag rdor lags nas dpe mdzod du gces nyar mdzad pa'i 7mi dbang pho lhas spo rong rje dawa na la bstsal ba'i she bam lta klog gi mthun 'gyur gnang bar thugs rje che zhu/ bdag gis le lo'i gnyid bsad cing baphyo na 'grus kyi ra ba'i nang 'jug mkhan 27 20637051 ma// dang / skabs dus snyadab stodan zhu yul 21 05699275bu'i(15 0ba'i de bzhin bo dong chos brgyud la ༷rdog gcig rkang 'a1dron pa ba bu'i0613021070ba/thalabacas dang / zin bris la zhu dag mdzad po rdzong chos slob dawa na byams pa bzod pa lags dang 'o/ rgyus la mkhas pa lte 'thung dbang phyug lags/ spar rtsar zhu dag thengs gcig chab ngoms bstan pa nyi ma lags nas gnang ba dang / de ba 'di'i dpar skrun 'gro gron la rogs skyor sbyor mkhan/ sud si grel wo' khen mo gas tshogs (2/50/07ba 5shi 237/'i pu) dang sud si mkhar sku ra lcam chung blo bzang rnam grol lags/ spo mo nga dbang grags pa d+ma bcas so//16

1 'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung rabs lo rgyus/1 1 snod bcud kyi bkod pa dang yul mi'i 'tsho las/'dzam gling go la'i'aphred thig 2845sa dang gzhung thig 86—002 yas mas kyi 'dzin mar 'khod pa'i 'ange ga sde chen po spo rong ni rgya mchod nas mi ṭar 4 000 brgal ba'i sar mi sde chags pa'i yul gru malnga shos shig yin/ dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i nang bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi nang gses/ la stod lho pa'i khri skor gyi khongs su gtogs shing / phyis su chos rgyal chen wa spo rong rje dbon zhes mtshan sku/ngas su grags pa gang nyid kyi chab 'bangs su gyur pa'i nang khrims rang btsan gyi 'brog sde chen sngo zhig yin/ sa khyon ni/ dkyus la rta lam drug dang / 'phred la rta lam byed bzhir grags pa yin/ sa ma'argams dbye stangs ni/ chu mo phag gam phyi 'o/ 1743 'o/ra sa skyong mi dbang pho lha bas bstsal ba'i she bam nang gsal ltar na/ ((shar skyed chad la nas bul rong /skya byang ze brgyud/ lha rgod pa/ lho khri 'od ze brgyud sba ri skya rag /ngal rgyal mthong la ze brgyud/ nub tsha'o rong nyung lung ze brgyud/ byang gtsang po ldal brgyud ga ces 'kho da pas/ go bder bshad na/ shar phyogs sa mtshams ni lha rtse nye khul du/ skyed chad la nas/ skya byang ri ze brgyud lha rgod bar dang / lho phyogs sa mtshams ni/ khri 'od ri ze brgyud sba ri skya rag la nas/ gnya' lam mthong lar 'phrad/ nub phyogs sa mtshams ni rdzong dga' dang sa sbrel/ nyung

'brog sde chen po/ spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /lung ze brgyud tsha'o rong du 'phrad/ byang phyogs sa mtshams ni ma gtsang gtsang po ltal brgyud yin par nges so/ /yul mi rnams kyi 'tsho las ni phal che ba 'brog las dang tshong las yin/ smad khul du kha shas zhing 'brog sbrel ma yang yin/ sha mar bal dang phyu ra pags pa/ byang gi tshwa dang g.yag rnga sogs/ bal sngotsware yul dang bod dbus su/ spus bsgyur ja 'byu ras gos lcags/ la sogs phyi zog sna tshogs 'dren/ zhes pa ltar ro//'brog sde spo rong pa'i lho nub sa mtshams phal che ba mdzes sdug ldan pa'i hi ma la ya'i gangs ris dkar mdzes dung rgi 'phreng ltar bskor yod/ mtho tshad mi ṭar 8013 lon pa'i gangs ri pho lha rgan chen nam shi sha sbang ma ni/ 'dzam gling nang skad grags che zhing mtho tshad rgya mtsho nas mi ṭar 8000 brgal ba'i gangs ri bcu bzhi'i nang nas gcig yin/ gangs ri 'di la 'bod ming mi 'dra ba gnyis thogs tshul skor lo rgyus khyad mtshar zhig 'dug pas/ snga dus pho lha rgan chen zhes sngo ra khul gyi yul lha'i bsti gnas yin par grags/ rjes su gangs ri 'di rgyud char 'tshubs dang gangs 'tshubs kyis rkyen pas zhing 'brog gnyis gar gyong gun chen pos dgun dus gangs 'tshubs kyis 'brog pa'i sems can rnams shi shar gtong / dbyar dus zhing pa'i ston thog rnams sbang mar btang bas na/ shi sha spang ma zhes ming ngan thogs par grags/ ri 'di'i 'dzegs yul lpo rong lhordogazhung khul nas yin stabs nye 'khris 'brog sde spyi dang lhag par/ ser lung dang /be+e rtse gnyis kyi dpal 'byor la phan rlabs chen po yod/ de min spo rong lho nub 18

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung rabs lo rgyus/༷ gas su gangs ri gzhan mang po yod pas/ yongs grags gangs ban chen dang / rta so gangs/ g.ya' phu gangs sogs yod/ spo rong yul ljongs kyi dbus su sa phyogs ga nas bltas kyang mngon mthong che ba'i gangs ri gtsang lha'am yul mi tshos po gtsang lha 'bod pa zhig kyang sku da/ 'o/ lha rgan chen ni gnya' lam gtsang po'am bal yul du rto ṭi ko shi (860 650361) zhes pa'i chu bo'i 'byung khungs yin/de bzhin g.yang phu gangs nas thon pa'i nag rdor ra/ zhes pa'i chu phran dang zur mtsho'i phu nas lnga na pa'i ྅/nga chu sogs bsgril te mthar mkhar rta'i rong brgyud bal yul du a run na dhi (475bsa'i661) zhes pa'i chu bo 'di yin/ gangs ban chen nas thon pa'i lha chu dang / rta so/ gangs nas thon pa'i rta chu gnyis la/ lha chu rta chu/ zhes 'bod pas dpal khyad mtsho 'gengs pa yin/ de bzhin po gtsang lha dang /chodas sdongs ri 'bug sogs nas thon pa'i chu phran zhig yod pas kyang dpal khud mtsho 'gongs rnga/ yin/ gso/la 'debs bar chad lam sel nang / /dpal mo thang gi dpal thang du:ོ brtan ma bcu gnyis dam la btags:ོ bod yul kha la'i la thog tu:ོ gangs dkar sha med dam la btags:ོ zhes 'kho da pa'i gnas spyi dang lhag par dpal thang 'di dag 'brog sde spo rong ba'i rtswa thang gi gras shig yin pa ma zad dpal thang gi thod du brtan ma'i bla mtsho dpal khud mtsho'am yul mi tshos lha mtsho srin mtsho zhes 'bod pa yul 'dir yod/ bod yul kha la'i la thog ces pa'i kha la ni spo rong dang rdzong dga'i sa mtshams su yod/ chod ba dpon chen pos brtan ma bcu gnyis dam la btags yul gyi brtan khang gi lha btsugs kyang mtsho 'di'i nye 19

'grog sde chen po skyo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /'gram du ((ra yang kha ga zhes pa'i ri rtser mjal rgyu yod/ bod kyi sa khra'i nang mtsho chen 'di dag mngo na gsal dod po'i sa rtags shig kyang yin stabs 'di rgyud 'brog sde ba spo rong pa'i chags yul lham mer shes thub kyi yod/ 'di'i nye 'dabs su/ dkar ru 'od 'khyil/ zhes pa'i mtsho chung zhig yod pa ni snga dus su ngang pa khri phrag gi tshang dang de bzhin nya la sku gas pa'i srog chags sna tshogs sku/da pa'i mtsho zhig yin pas ma zad mchos 'di tshwa mcho yin stabs sa khul 'di'i bul lta ga gi thon khungs shig yin/ mas chung 'di dag sngo ra bla ma'i srung skyob 'og yod/ de'i nye 'dabs su/ khe/la sman mtsho/ zhes pa'i masnu chung zhig sku/da pa'i khyad chos ni gnag lug sems can la zha zhes pa'i na tsha zhig phog gi sku da pa de'i bcos su mtsho 'di'i chu brgal na sman bcos mchog tu gyur pa yin par grags/ der brten 'brog pa tshos 'o/ ltar so so'i gnag lug sems can rnams thengs gcig mtsho 'gram du 'khrid de mtsho chu brgal srol sku/da/ dpal khyad mdzarware nye 'dabs su rgya lam nas mngon gsal dod pos mjal thub pa'i ri bo ((dpa' ri'am dbab ri gi zhes pa'i gnas shig kyang yod/ dgun stod du sngo ra bla ma 'dir byon nas gangs rud dang gangs lam gyi+o bgegs sel zhabs rim mdzad 10la yod 'dug1 2 spo rong khul gyi gnas chen/ sgyu 9 spo rong khul du bka' rnying bo bon sogs kyi gnas mang du yod pas/ spo rong gi nub mtshams su rol pa'i mcho chen dpal khud mtsho chags yod/ sngon tshe gangs 20

'grog sde chen po po rong gi byung rabs lo rgyus/dkar ma slob dasngo/na chen po'i drung nas cadas te dpal khyad mtsho nang du gab pas na slob dpon gyis mtsho bskol nas gangs dkar ma sha med rus krang du btang ste ngam la btags gnas 'di yin/ de bzhin 'di'i nye 'khris ((ra yang kha nyi zhes pa 'i sar slob dpon chen sngo sa brtan ma bcu gnyis dam 'asnga/gas mdzad pa'i brtan khang gi lha btsugs gsum deng sang yang mjal rgyu yod/ dpal khyad thang gi lho nub khul du rje btsun mi la'i gnas/ ma grags pa nang gi sngo nga drug ste/ mchodang lung khyung gi rdzong / skyid pa nyi ma rdzong / khu byug dben pa rdzong / shel phyag chu shing rdzong /be rtse 'dod yon rdzong / rtsig pa rkang mthil rdzong bcas mjal rgyu yod par bshad/yul mi tshos khul 'di'i skyid pa nyi ma rdzong dang / khrin gyi skyid phug nyi ma rdzong gnyis 'dzol te mi la'i rkyang mgur gyi gnas 'dir yin pa brjod srol yod pa ni mi bden no snyam/ dpal khud thang gi byang phyogs kyi ri sked khul du rje btsun mi la'i sgrub phug gzhan mang du mjal rgyu yod pa'i gsang ba'i rdzong drug ste/ rgya brag nam mkha' rdzong / stag phug seng ge rdzong / sbas phug ma mo rdzong / la phug pad+ma rdzong / glang sgo klu bdud rdzong / khro rgyal rdo rje rdzong bcas rdzong drug gi khongs nas sbas phug dang la phug /glang cad gsum khul 'dir yod pa ra 'phrod cing gzhan gsum yang nye 'khris su yod dam snya ma/ sbas phug ma mo rdzong du lug rdzi zhig chos la bskul te rdzi bo ras pa byung / la phug pad+ma sngo nga du wa na lnga phyug po'i pha rgan nad pa chos la bsku la te gshen sgom ras pa byung / be rtse 'dod yon rdzong gi nye 'khris 'brog sde zhig tu rje btsun gyis rgan mo 'chi ba'i ro las kyis ras chung par mi rtag 'chi chos 21

'grog sde chen po wo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /gsungs/ 'dir grong pa 50 tsam gyi yul sde yod/ brag sne kun bzang chos 'phel gyis mdzad pa'i rnam grol rtsangs rdo dmar ba'i gdung rabs nang be rtse dang de'i khu' ge yul ljongasaskor 'di 'dra bkod de/ ((gnas ri de'i steng nas phyogs gang sar bltas kyang dpal mo thang zhes dpal khul gyi thang chen yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus na nub gnya' shing ri'i ngo sa la dpal gtor zhes g.ya' brag gi ri la dpal gtor snying gzugs dbal can la shug pa'i dkar rgyan lta bu rang byung gis mdzes pa/ de'i shod du rdo dmar ba'i bla mtsho dkar ru 'od 'khyil dang / mtsho mgor dpal o rgyan chen 'o/sa byin gyis brlabs shing thugs smon gnang ba'i gnas ngan song sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor dbyar dus ni'u seng sman ljongs me tog sna tshogs bkra ba dang / nyer mchod lta bu'i bkod pa rang byon du yod pa byin rlabs can dang /de'i phyogs rnams su mtsho dang mtsho chung / chu dang chu phran la sogs par dbyar dus su 'dab chags khrung khrung ngang ngur la sogs pas mgrin dbyangs yid la 'thad pa lhang lhang du sgrogs shing / 'bri g.yag /ra lug rta dang / mis bdag tu ma bzung ba'i rta rgod dang / ri dgas sems can mang po bag phebs ngang du gnas pa'i sku ga chags rnams kyis khengs shing / nub kyi ri rgyud yongs rdzogs gangs ris 'phreng ba bzhin du bstodar ba'i nang rje mi la'i sgrub gnas skyid pa nyi ma rdzong /glang sgo klu bdud rdzong / la phug pad+ma rdzong dang / de dang thag mi ring bar bo dong ( phrepa rin chen brtson 'grus rdo rje 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi gdan sa rje dge 'dun grub kyi zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas pad+ma chos 22

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung rabs lo rgyus/sdings la sogs byin rlabs can mang du bzhugs pa'i yul ljongs mdzes sdug ldan pa de ltar yod/gi ces gsal/ de'i nye 'dabs su ser lung zhes pa'i grong pa 86 tsam gyi yul sde zhig yod/ 'dir rje btsun mi las bu ras chung par g.yag ru'i nang nas se ra phab pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis bu'i khengs pa btul sa'i gnas de yin/ser lung zhes pa'i yul ming yang de nas thogs/ dpal thang gi byang phyogs ri sul zhig gi ldebs su g.yag ru zhes pa'i gnas shig yod pa der/ spo g.yag ru zhes pa'i yul lha'i lha tshugs shig yod/ yul mi tshos brjod don/ gnas 'dir rje btsun mi las bu ras chung par g.yag ru'i rdzu 'phrul bstan sa de red ces u tshugs kyis bshad kyi 'dug pas/ de 'dra e yin dran/ gang lags zhe na/ mi la'i rna ma mgur nang / ((lam bar g.yag ru zhig 'dug pa la/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas ras chung pa g.yag ru 'di khyer cig gsungs pas/ ras chung pa'i yid la nga'i bla ma 'di res 'ga' zhig ni gang gis kyang dgos pa med gsung ba bzhin mdzad/res 'ga' ni khyi rgas kyin zhe sdang che/ mi rgas kyin 'dod pa che zer ba'i dpe de byed par 'dug /g.yag ru 'dis ci byed snya ma/ 'di za ni mi nyan/ bor thong zhus pas/ dngos po 'di tsam gyis 'ching bar mi 'gyur zhing / dgos pa'i dus yod pa yin gsungs nas rje btsun rang gis bsnams te/ dpal thang gi dkyil byi'u tsam gyi yib sa'ang med pa zhig tu/ nam mkha' sprin med la sprin nag 'dus/ ser ba chen po rlung drag pos bskyod nas babs pa las/ ras chung par bla ma la lta ba'i glags tsam yang ma byung bar dbu gtums nas bzhugs/ ser ba cung zad 23

'grog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /zhi ba dang / rje btsun btsal bas ma rnyed de cung zad bzhugs pas/ sa malnga sa zhig na g.yag ru de 'dug pa'i thad du rje btsun gyi gsung gcig byung ba dang / de'i sar byon nas da ci 'di rje btsun gyis bsnams sku/da pa yin snyam lag tu blangs pas/gasku 'gul ma nus par ldan pa sa la sbyar nas g.yag ru'i nang la bltas pas/g.yag ru cher ma sku nga zhing rje btsun chung du ma song bar me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin yangs cha dang bcas te g.yag ru'i dog sa na bzhugs nas ras chung pa la mgur 'di gsungs so/nyi zhes ba nas gsal lto gas thub/ g.yag ru'i ri mtshams su g.yag ru rnyed pa dang de mi las bur 'khyer bcug nas dpal thang dkyil du byi'u tsam yang yib sa med pa'i thang gshongs de ni be rtse 'dod yon rdzong gi kha gtad du chags pa'i dus da lta'ang ser lung du 'bod pa'i gnas 'di yin pa galha na mi za/dpal khud mtsho'i shar byang phyogs su la phug pad+ma rdzong gi gnas yod/'dir grong pa nyung shas las med/ gnas 'dir rje btsun gyis bon chos la dad pa'i pha rgan phyug po zhig nad gzhi drag khrodas mnar nas 'chi la nye bar rdzu 'phrul gyis bcos/ ra lug dang g.yag brgya phrag dmar mchod gtong la nye ba bkag nas thabs kyis bcos te 'khe ra bcas chos la bskul/ la phug ni 'asnu bzhugs 7skyabs rje dga' khri gling mchog sprul rin po che'i yab la phug 'bar ro'i bu mordzo tshe dbang bzang po dang yum skal bzang chos sgron gnyis kyi 'khrungs yul yin/'dir bon dgon rnying pa zhig yod pas/ dgon pa 'dir bon lugs ldebs ris 24

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung rabs lo rgyus/khyad du 'phags pa mang sngo sku da pa rnams rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs gtor bshig tu ma mo nga bar deng sang mjal rgyu yodad/ dpal khud mtsho'i shar phyogs nye 'dabs su chodas sdings zhes pa'i gnas der bo wa nga paṇa chen gyis phyag btab pa'i gsang 'dus pho brang gi gdan sa dpal mo chos sdings yod/ dgon 'di dang sbrel ba'i bo lugs dgon pa ma lag bcu bzhi rnams spo rong chod brgyad kyi yul sde gang sar yod pas rgyas pa zur du gzigs/ dpal khud mtsho'i byang phyogs su gter ston bya mang po chen po'i gdan sa byang chub gling yod/ de nas kyang byang phyogs su spe rong chags pa'i khongs su bar 'brog ces par 7rgyal ba rgod tshang pa'i gdan sa bar 'brog byang chub gling ngam rdor gling pa zhes pa'i dgon pa tsa chen zhig yod/ gdan sa 'di'i bla ma bar 'khyodag chu bzang rin dze che zhes pa'i grub dbang mdzadag ni deng bal yul du bzhugs gnas 'kho da pa 'di rang yin/grul ba ring mo'i mchodad rten/ go mur gyi la rgyab dpal khud mtsho'i nye 'khris su khri tsho zhes par snga mo'i mchod rten snying gog cig da lta'ang mjal rgyu yod /yul mi tshos 'di la grul ba ring mo'i mchod rten brjod pa yin/ 'di'i lo rgyus ni snga dus su khul 'dir mi 'bor che zhing grong tsho/ la phug /go mur/ grul/brgya mur/ khri tsho/ glang sgo sogs sku da pa dang / lan cig grul ba'i khyi ra ba zhig gis ri dgas kha shas brag ldebs shig tu codig nas khyis bkag /sgang nas khyi ra ba nyid kyis bkag bskyil byas kyang ri dwags ma rnyed pas/ de nas khyi ras 25

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /ri dwags kyi phyogs su rdo ril chen po zhig 'phen skabs rdo ril brjid pa'i dbang gis rang nyid kyang mnyam du lhungs te srog shor/ shi ma thag khyi ra ba de ro langs gzugs po ring po zhig tu gyur pas ming la grul ba ring mo zhes thogs par grags/ ro langs des khul de'i grong sde / grul dang / dud grangs brgya skor yod pa'i brgya mur/ glang sgo klu bdud bcas yul sde gsum la gnod pa tshabs chen gyis yul mi rnams la la yul gyar ba dang la la rang srog shor ba bcas kyis lung pa stong du bcug /de rjes grul ba ring mo chos sdings phyogs su thon pas chos sdings su dpal mo chos sdings dgon gyi ye shes mchod rten gyi gser tog dang spo gzi non nam bkra shis 'od 'bar gyi rten khang gi me long gi 'od ma bzod par la phug phyogs su thon/ la phug yul de spug pas 'thibs pas ma mthong / go mur phyogs su thon pas rang nyid kyi tse ga mas sgrib pa lta bus ma ma1nang bas na mthar yul mi snu sa rnam grol rtsangs kyi bla ma rdo dmar ba mchog la snyan bskul gyis ro langs 'dul bar gdan drangs pas/ bla mas ro langs la 'phreng ba bzhus te btul/ de nas bla mas ro langs kyi lus po dum bur gtubs nas thug lha ra byas te mi mang la za bcug pas/ rgan mo zhig gi thug pa'i nang mdzub chung gi sen sha khregs po zhig byung ba rgan mos za ma thub par mo rang gi kur tse'i nang blugs pa de slar ro langs tshabs chen zhig tu gyurwatsho nas gce da pa chen po byas/ de nas bla ma rdo dmar bas ro langs de dpal khud mtsho'i 'gram du 'cham rgyag gin 'khrid/ bla mas g.yas skor skyodan dus ro langs 26

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung rabs lo rgyus kyis kyang bla ma'i lad zlos kyi g.yon skor rgyag par grags/ de mtshams nas bla mas ro langs kyi snying khar rang nyid kyi bsnams phur btab nas btul/ ro lang sa kyi gzugs po sa 'og tu sbas te de'i steng du mchodad rten zhig bzhengs par grul ba ring mo dam la btags pa'i masnu da rten zhes deng mjal rgyu sku da pa'i gnas shig yin/ brag sne kun bzang lags kyis mdzad pa'i ((rnam grol rtsangs rdo dmar ba'i gdung rabs lo rgyus deb ther pad+ma rā ga'i do shal nyi zhes pa'i nang / thodang gsal gyi rdo dmar bla ma ni ((rnam grol rtogs ldan sku na tan mgon po nyi zhu ba yin par bshad/ de bzhin ((yang dpal khud srin mtsho'i 'dabs kyi khri tsho zhes par 'brug pa ring mo ro langs nas (mchan/ grul ba ring mo zer )skye 'gro rnams la gnod pa ci che byung skabs rje des phur pa ro langs kyi lus la btab ste btul ba bcas/nyi gsal/ gong gsal phur pa 'di ni deng se ra byes su se ra'i phur mjal zhes sku ngas grags phur pa 'di'i gras gsum yod pa'i ya gyal zhig yin/ 'e rgyus 'bud tsam 'dren na/ sngar skyid grong du grub thob 'dar phyar bas sa paṇa chen por dpung 'degs kyis mu stegs 'phrog byed dga' bo gnam la 'phur ba'i grib ma gar yod la phur pa btab nas mu ste gas pa sar rnyings te pham par mdzad pa'i phur pa 'di'i gras gsum yod pa rnams rdo dmar ba'i mus srad dgon du bzhugs pa las ((kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge'i bsnams phur rbas slog phur pa zhu ba de mus srad pa'i gdan sa nas rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i nang rtogs ldan yon tan mgon sngo/sa kun mkhyen blo gros rin chen

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /dbus su phebs skabs gnang ste se ra byes grwa tshang gi rta mgrin khang du bzhugs te se ra'i phur mjal zhes phyi lo 1959 ma shar bar rang cag tshang mas mjal yul du sku da pa skad grags can de yin/ rtogs ldan sku na tan mabo na po'i bsnams phur thog btul zhu ba dang / grub sprodab 'dar phyar ba'i bsnams phur bcas/ mus srad nas bzhugs gnas ༷ shugs gnang ste rnam sku la brag sner bzhugs pa yin/ga zhes 'kho da/bya mang po'i chos pa dbang wa byas 'don pa/ dpal khud mtsho dang bya mang po'i nye 'khris su gyang ro zhig mjal rgyu yod/ gyang ro 'di'i gan sa bdag skor rje btsun mi la dang 'brel ba'i bshad srol snyan po zhig yod/ mi la skyid pa nyi ma rdzong du bzhugs skabs da lta gyang ro yin pa'i gnas der spyodas pa mthu nus can zhig bzhugs kyi yod 'dug khong gi mtshan la/ bya mang 16) chos pa dbang wa byas 'don pa brtsodad/ chos pa 'di la mtshan ngan 'di 'dra zhig thodags stangs ni/ chos pa des dus dang rnam pa kun tu gser zangs las bskrun pa'i galta ra chas nang gtsang zhing yid du cadang ba'i gtor ma btang nas yi dgas la gtor sbyin galta nga gi yod 'dug /skabs shig nas yi dwags de tshos chos pa de'i gtor ma la dga' mos mi byed cing gnas gzhan zhig du brel 'tshubs ngang bskyod kyi yod 'dug /rgyun ring brtag pa bgyis 'bras yi dgas de tsho skyid pa nyi ma rdzobakā du rje btsun mi la'i gtor ma la brngams te bskyod pa shes/ chos pa de'i dgongs par/ nged kyi gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i gtor ma las lhag pa mi la'i gtor 28

'brog sde chen po sgo rong sga byung rabs lo rgyus/ma de ci 'dra zhig yod dam snyam nas/ nyin zhig chos pa des rang nyid kyi sku lus der bzhag ste phug ron zhig la sprul nas mi la'i gtor ma gtong sar phebs pas/ mi la'i gtor ma ni zu bo rjen pa dang gtor gzhong ni rdo leb yin par gzigs/ ya mtshan skyes te yun tsam lta shin bzhugs pas mi las phug ron la/ khyed rang khyim du myur du log ma gtogs khyed kyi mig ril g.yas pa ni pho rog gi sa bton grub song gsungs/ chos pa de ma thag tu rang khyim du log pas rang gi gzugs steng du pho rog 'dzoms te mig ril g.yas pa bton zin nas med par gzigs/ de rjes chos pa'i mtshan la dbang po byas 'don pa zhes thogs par grags/1 3 spo rong gi rtswa thang dang rang 'byung skyed tshal/snga dus gnag lug 'tsho yul rtswa thang mu mtha' med pa lta bu'i rgya khyon la 'jag ces pa'i rtswa yi skyed tshal phi ṭi gsum tsam lon pa des rtswa thang ltem mer khebs pa'i nang lug khyu 'dzul skabs rwa co tsam las lug gi gzugs po mi mngon pa'i snod bcud phun sum tshogs pa'i mdzes nyams 'di 'dra yod 'dug /lton mtshams 'jag rtswa brngas zin rjes kyang rtswa lhag gis sa steng du gdan bting pa lta bu'i phol phol yod pa yang grags/ spo rong khul du rang bzhin du skyes pa'i sman rtswa dang sngo tshal mang po yod par/ spang spos/ dbang lag /spa ma/ gro ma/ bsangs dga' ldan mkhan pa dang / tshur zhes pa'i tshos kyi skyur tshwa/ gzi'u 29

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /gos zhes pa'i tshos dmar po/ snya lo zhes pa'i tshos rtswa ser po/ de bzhin me tog ug chos/ spang rgyan/ dres ma/ rgod po ra cog dang / bzas su rung ba'i rang bzhin sngo tshal/ zu bo/ rngo rne ral/ gro ma/ ser sha/ dung sha/ zangs sha/ 'dzim bu/ chu sha'am mog ro sogs yod/ rang bzhin du 'tsho ba'i ri dgas sems can/ rkyang / spyang ki/ gna' ba/ dbo ba/ gla ba/ wa/ dred ser/ dred mong / 'phyi ba/ g.yi/ ab ra/ ri phra nga / gsang rgan mo gas yod/ de bzhin rang bzhin gyi sa chongs/ sa dkar/ sa dmar/ sa sngon bcas kyis dgon pa lha khang dang rang khyim sogs kyi mdzes rgyan ston pa yin//

2 spo rong rje dbon gyi byung rabs dang rje dbon gyi ring lugs/2 1 spo rong rje dbon gyi byung rabs dang yul ming thogs tshul/byung rabs/ spo rong rje dngo na gyi gdung rab sa lo rgyus la shin tu bka' drin che ba'i skyid grong brag dkar ba rig 'dzin chos kyi dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i ((chos ldan sa skyong 'bur ba mi rje'i gdung rabs lo rgyus dri med be+eḍūr+ya'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/nyi zhes rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i lcags 'brug phyi lo 1820 lor brtsams pa'i rnam thar nang rje dbon nyid thog mar spo rong du byon khungs dang byon stangs sdudags phyi lo'i dus rabs bcu bzhi'i mjug tsam la lho bdag si tu chos kyi rin chen gyi sku dus yin pa dang / rje dasngo na nyid bod kyi mi'u gdung drug gi ya gyal gser ldong ser po zhes pa las mched pa'i ((gdung rgyud cig bod chen po'i yul mdo khams smad ga nas dre na pa dang de nas mched pa'i gdung rgyud cig ((bod dbus skyid shod kyi yul phran gnam gi zhes pa'i dpon zhig yin par bgad/ spo rong khul du yongs grags kha rgyun zhig yod pa ni/ spo rong rje dasngo na gyi lnga ga ma'i byon khungs khams dzad bo rong zhes pa nas yin pa dang / dpon de'i mtshan la ( (ka gnam nyi zhes brjod kyi sku/ da par bshad na/ gong gi skyid sna da kyi yul phran gnam zhes pa ni lha sa'i thag nye 'jang dang chu shul sogs nye bar gnam zhes pa 'di yin/ ka gnam ni khams stod spo bo ru sde pa mang po yod pa'i nang nas grags che ba bod chos rgyal lha btsan ngo'i

'brog sde chen po hro rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /gdung rgyud gri gum btsan po'i sras bya khri'i brgyud/ ྅ bo maḥganam sde pa'am gaḥganam rgyal po yin na lo rgyus gdung rabs yig ngag gnyis po'i 'dodad tshul bar tha ga shin tu ring bar mngon no/ /'on te/ spo rong zhes pa'i yul ming thogs stangs khams spo wa rong la thug cing dpon de'i mtshan la ka gnam du 'bod pa'i yongs grags spe rong pa'i ngag rgyun dang / gong gi khams stod spo bo gro nga gi maḥganam sde pa zhes pa'i lo rgyus gnyis shin tu 'brel chags pas/spo wa'i maḥganas sde pa ngo da kyi chodas rgyal lha btsan po'i gdung rgyud du grags kyi yod na chos rgyal gyi gdung rabs dang 'bur ba'i gdung dbar 'brel ba yod med kyi dpyad pa bya 'os shig yin/ mi rabs nas mi rabs kyi 'byung khungs 'dren skabs dus tshod kyi bar thag ring po yong srid pa zhig red snyam/spo rong gi dga' ba'i gzhas zhes bya ba rtsed sna bcu gsum pa'i rim pa gsal ba'i me long las/ gangs can gyi ljongs su chos ldan rgyal po'i zol du bsam bzhin du sdudan pa'i bdag cag gi lha na pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal sngo bzhin mngal skyodan gyis ma gos par yum gyi rtsibs logs g.yas nas 'bur te 'khrungs pa'i gdung chen gangs ljongs kyi mi'u gdung drug gi ya rgyal mchong ldong smug dze zhes sku ngas su grags pa sku'i 'khrungs yul khams lha bo rong nas yin zhes /gsal/ mo 9spo rong rje dbon nam 'bur pa'i gdung du sku 'khrungs shing shel dkar chos sde'i mkhan po mdzad myong ba rje nam mkha' 'od zer dang / rje nam mkha' rin 32

sgo rong rje dbon gyi byung rabs dang rje dbon gyi ring lugs/chen rnam gnyis kyi rnam thar shin tu bsdus pa shel dkar chos 'byung legs bshad nor bu'i me long skal bzang mgrin rgyan nang / rje nam mkha' 'od zer ni/ mi nyag ldong gi rigs las 'brog yar ba brgya dasngo/na pa'i sras su sku 'khrungs/zhes dang / rje nam mkha' rin chen ma ni/ ldong rigs pa brgya dpon pa'i zhal ngo rgyal phu g.yu nyer du 'khrungs/ zhes gsal/chos ldan sa skyong 'bur pa mi rje'i gdung rabs lo rgyus dri med baiḍūr+ya'i 'phreng ba'i nang / spyir ldong dang me nyag /dmar dang / zhang zhung / (rma dang zhang zhung /) se dang ha shang ('a zha ) sogs rus chen bzhi dang / brgyad dang / bathod brgyad la sogs pa sku da par grags pa las/ 'dir ni ldong yin cing / de la yang gser ldong ser po/ mchong ldong spug po/ dung ldong dkar po sdudags du ma zhig yod pa'i nang nas gser lnga nga ser po yin chod/ /zhes gsal/bod kyi rus chen bzhi ste bse 'a zha/ stong sum pa/ ldong mi nyag /rma zhang zhung yin/ de yang ldong mi nyag zer ba 'di mdo khams chu bzhi sgang drug gi mi nyag rab sgang min par sa paṇa sku gshegs sa byang ngos mi nyag gam/ sga dang ha la shan ri bo yod pa'i sga mi nyag (13020 )ces deng a mdo mtsho sngon po'i byang shar du yod pa de yin/ mi nyag rgyal rgod ces rgya nag sung rgyal rgyud la kha gtad gcog mkhan gyi rgyal phran zhig yin la/ 'ba' rom bka' brgyud pa'i snga rabs bla ma khag cig dbu blar bsten/ mthar sog po ching gi se tan gyis dbang so/ga tu thodar skabs rgyal rgyud dang 'bangs mi mang ngo bod nang sim 'dzul

'brog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /byas/ de khongs la stod byang pa'i khri dpon nam byang bdag kyang dpa' bo mi nyag rgyal rgod kyi gyud pa yin sgo ra dpal ldan chos kyi bzang pos mdzad pa g.yas ru byang pa'i rgyal rabs rin po che bstar ba'i nang gsal/ des na sgo rong rje dbon nam 'bur pa'i gdung yang khams mi nyag min par sga mi nyag nas mched dam snyam na da dung dpyad par 'tshal/yang kha rgyun gzhan zhig la ((tre mjug spo chags nyi zhes pa zhig sku da pas/ de'i 'byu don ni/ gna' dus su/ deng sang gi yul sde/ la stod/ kre ba dang / spo rong sogs su 'brog pa thar thor kha shas las ri klung phal che ba grong med lung stodang lta bu yin par grags/ de rjes dus rabs bcu gsum pa dang bcu bzhi yas mas nang / khams tre+e lha/ra/ zhes pa nas dpon zhig gangs dkar ti se gnas mjal la phebs skabs deng gi ྅ rong gi yul ljongs phyogs mtha' gangs ris bskor zhing rtswa thang gi rgya khyon mig rgyang brgal ba sogs dpon gyi phebs lam du 'khel bas der thugs zug ste sgar chags/ 'on kyang dus yun gang 'tshams song rjes yul de'i nye 'khris su dpon gyis 'di las lhag pa'i yul gzhan zhig gzigs pas/ der gnas spos te sgar btab/ rang nyid kyi byon khungs khams tre hor nas yin stabs yul de la'ang te hor zhes dang dpon rang nyid gyi mtshan la tre+e ba dpon zhes thogs par grags/ tre+e hor zur chanye ste tre+e ba zhes 'bod/ tre ba dpon gyi mi rgyud deng sang yang mjal rgyu yod /bo nga gsal ni ngag rgyun bshad srol kho na yin/ don dngos kre ba ni bod

spo rong rje dbon gyi byung rabs dang rje dbon gyi ring lugs/dbus gtsang khul 'brog sde rnying khungs kre nag ces kre ba dang nag tshang gnyis yin/ de yang kre ba dpon gyi gdung ni kre ba khro gnam dkar po zhes snga mo bskal pa smu thog bon gyi dus tshod nas gleng rgyu sku da pa zhig red 'dug /lo rgyus rgyas pa kre ba'i yig cha mang po da lta'ang bal yul sogs mi tshang so so'i lag na /r+sha da skad 'dug na dpyad zhib 'tshal/ mdo khams tre+e hor khams pa yang snga dus yig cha rma nga che ba'i nang kre bo dang / tre bo/ tre+e ho bcas bris pa mang la phyis dus rabs bcu bzhi bco lnga'i nang skre hor zhes bris pa mang /de nas dus yun gang 'tshams rjes/ khams dzad bo rong / zhes pa nas dpon zhig yul der phebs/ dpon 'dis tre ba dpo na gnas spos pa'i mjug tu yul der sgar btab pas na/ yul ming spo rong dang / dpon gyi mtshan la sa rong rje dbon zhes thogs/ rgyu mtshan 'di la brten nas ((tre mjug spo chags nyi zhes kha rgyun du 'jags par grags/ de bzhin bod nub byang gang sar khams yul gyi ming / stod 'ba' ba dang stod 'bong pa'am 'brong pa/ a masnga zer ba sogs kyi byung rabs kyang gcig pa min nam snyam/ yang skabs de'i spo rong gi 'brog pa rnams mgo med thar thor dang nang khul 'khrugs rtsod che ba sogs kyi gnas bab la gzigs nas dpon gyis rang nyid kyi skabs bab gdul bya yin par dgongs te der gzhis 'khod/ 'brog sde yar rgyas la phan rlabs che ba'i mdzad pa bskyangs/ skabs de'i 'brog pa rnams bon chos la dad pa byed cing ngo na lugs kyi lha gsol dang dmar mchod kyi sku la rgyun zhig 1959

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long bar du'ang ma nyams par bsdad yod/ de nas rim pas chos srid gnyis kyi mdzad pa rgya cher spel bas na yul mi tshos yul gyi dalnga na du mnga' gsol/ mtshan la lha rong rje dpon zhes dpon nyid kyi byon khungs 'dren pa nas mtshan gsol/rje dpon gyi mdzad bzang la brten nas kong po dang tsā ri/ kre ba sogs yul gyu gzhan gyi 'brog pa dang zhing pa'ang spo rong khul du gnas spos te 'byor/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis dus da lta'ang spo rong pa re 'ga'i grong ming kong po dang re 'ga'i grong ming tsā ri/ re 'ga' kre nub pa sogs yod mus yin/yul ming thogs stangs skor lo rgyus gzhan zhig kyang yod pa ni/ brag dkar bas mdzad pa'i lo rgyus nang / khul der 'brog yar pa dang / mar pa/ stod pa dang / smad pa sogs 'brog sde bco brgyad tsam sku da pa'i nang tshan spong 'brog ces pa dang / mo nga 'awa ga ces pa gnyis rgya che bas mnga' 'bangs su bskyangs pas na spyodang rong zhes yul ming thogs par gsungs/ ngag rgyun gyi 'o/ rgyus ni rje dbon nyid kyi byon khungs khams spo bo rong zhes pa nas yin pas na spo rong zhes thogs par grags/ bod kyi yig snying khag gi nang spo dang spong gnyis ka gsal bas 'di gnyis 'dam khar bzhag na sems/'bur ba'i gdung rgyud/ spo rong rje dbon ni bod kyi mi'u gdung drug gi ya gyal zhig yin pas/ brag dkar ba rig 'dzin chos kyi dbang phyug gis mdzag ( pa'i spo rong 'bur ba'i gdung rabs nang ((gser ldong ser po nyi zhes pa nas mched pa dang yang mnga' ris paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa'i rgyal gzhas kyi lo rgyus 36

spo rong rje dbon gyi byung rabs dang rje dbon gyi ring lugs/nang ((chos ldong smug po nyi zhes 'khod 'dug pas gang ltar ((ldong ga gi gdung rgyud cig yin par gdon mi za/ 'bur ba zhes pa'i don ni ldong rje thog ma ri/da ma yi mngal gyi dri mas ma gos par rang cag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang ngo bzhin du ma yi rtsibs zur nas 'bur rer 'khrungs pas na 'bur ba'i gdung bsnyu da pa yin/yang / pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyis bzhengs pa'i ding ri glang skor gyi gnas bshad nang skabs de'i spo rong gi rgyal po dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus shig mchis pas/ 'di la gzhigs na spo rong du 'bur ba'i gdung rabs ma phebs gong khul der yul dpon zhig sku da par snang / ding rir pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyis phyag btab pa'i dgon ming la ding ri gla bskor dang / yang ding ri glang skor zhes dathodan ming thogs tshul mi 'dra ba gnyis mchis pas/ 'di'i skor khungs gtugs yig cha ma rnyed kyang daspo na gnyer rim dar gyi gnas bshad ngag rgyun du 'jags pa sgra dag gsal gsum de 'dra go rgyu 'dug /dgung lo 72 phebs pa'i ding ri ba bu rdor lags kyis gsungs don/ rtsa ba'i phyag dpe'i nang kha gsal yod nges kyang bshad srol la pha dam pa sangs rgyas ding rir phebs rjes pha'i mtshan snyan phyogs gang sar khyab pa la brten nas skabs de'i spo rong gi rgyal pos kyang pha'i zhabs su gtugs te ba snyen bkur zhabs zhur lan mang bcar yang phas rgyal sngo/ la kha ya ma gnang / lan gcig spo rong gi rgyal po thugs pham zhing phyir log phebs khar/ phas rgyal po la/ khyed dad log ma byed ang / khyed kyi phul ba'i

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /zang zing gi 'bul ba nged la dgos pa med/ 'on te khyed kyi sems can khongs nag ngo'i dri mas ma gos pa'i sems can spu mdog dkar sngo dkar rkyang zhis yod pas de 'phol te nged la gnang rogs gsungs/ spoḥngang gya'/ pos rang khongs gnag lug sems can yongs su rdzogs pa re re bzhin gzigs pas nag ༷༅sa dri mas ma gos pa'i dud 'bo zhig ye nas ma rnyed/ mthar ba khyu'i khongs nas glang phrus dkar po dkar rkyang zhig rnyed pa de pha la phul bas/ phas dgyes bzhes mdzad cing glang des pha'i dgon pa bzhengs pa'i skabs dang de rjes sgrub par gnas pa'i dge 'dun pa brgya phrag la dbyar dgun med par 'thung chu 'or 'dren bgyis pa dang / dus chodad sti nga pa nam yin la dgon par stodar ba brgyab pa mo gas la brten nas dgon ming ding ri glang skor zhes thogs par bshad/ de rjes glang de'i ming la'ang chu glang byang chub sems dpa' zhes thogs par grags/ deng skyabs rje 'khrul zhig rin po che'i dben gnas thub bstan chos gling du bcol bzhugs yod par grags pa'i ding ri glang skor gyi nang rten khongs/ ding rdo sbug po dang sba yi 'khar rgyug /glang gi mche ba sogs yod par grags pas/ glang gi mche ba de ni gong zhus chu glang byang chub sems dpa'i mche ba yin par bshad/de bzhin spo rong gi glang de ni sngon tshe bco ma ldan 'das sangs ma rgya sa gong dag pa'i skye ba lnga brgya dang ma dag pa'i skye ba lnga brgya bzhes pa'i khongs nas ma dag pa'i(7skye ba gcig yin par bshad/ dge sbyong wā shin dra dharma ma tis (skyabs rje rdza rong zhwa de'u 'khrul zhig 38

spo rong rje dbon gyi byung rabs dang rje dbon gyi ring lugs/rin po ches ) mdzad pa'i bod yul la stod ding ri glang skor gyi nang rten byin can khag gi 'o/ rgyus/ dad pa'i sa wa na las ((nang rten lnga pa glang gi tshems ring bkrel can 'di ni/ dpal khud kyi spe rong rgyal po btsan thag ces pa de pha dam ja 4 dang mchod yon 'brel bas/ skabs shig na rgyal lnga des gser dngul mo gas 'bul ba mang sngo phul bas/ dam pa'i zhal nas gser dang bong ba mnyam/ dngul dang bye ma 'dra gsungs nas ma bzhes pas/ rgyal sngo de dad pa cung zad 'o/ga pa dam pa'i mngon shes kyis mkhyen nas rgyal po dad pa log gam gasde/ngas pas/rgyal pos cung zad log lags zhus pas/ pha dam pas 'o na khyod rang gi phyugs zang zing gi khrod na spu nas nag med pa'i sems can zhig 'dug pa de kho bor phul dang gsungs/ rgyal po slar 'o/ga ste rta phyugs kyi rigs thams cad la gzigs kyang ma rnyed cing / chab sgo'i ba glang gi khrod na glang dkar po sgu nag nag med pa zhig 'dug pa de phul bas dam pa dgyes nas kho 1rwa re 'bul ba'i skal ba 'di yin gsungs/ de'i skabs su glang skor gyi ri khrod rnams su sgrub pa po brgya dang brgyad bzhugs pa rnams la glang byang chub sems dpa' des dbyar gyi dus su chu dang / dgun gyi dus su chab rom phul/ zhor la glang skor gyi gtsug lag khang khor yug dang bcas pa la zhabs skor re phul nas 'ong / de yang chu dang chab rom 'gel lo tsam las sgrub pa twa re re'i bug sgo'i drung du ru cos brda byas te gcig la'ang ma chad par phul bar grags/ glang skor gyi ri la rtswa a wa ju ti 'ja' 'od lnga ldan/ rtswa dus sasum sangs rgyas sogs sku da pa glang 39

'bros sde chen po spo rong bi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /des zos/ mthar glang de grongs pa'i tshems la ring bsrel rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam par khyodan pa chu glang byang chub sems dpa'i tshems su grags/ yul gyi ming la rjes su glang skor zhes thogs pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de ltar lags so/nyi chenatra/ gatra/05/ phyi lo 1970 nang a ri'i nyams zhib pa/ lhar ba ra nim ri a dzi dza (2216318sa11114212) zhes pa zhig gis ding ri'i skor nyams zhib byed skabs glang skor dgon pa'i nang rten skor skabs de'i dkon gnyer gyis gtsos rgyus nges che ba mang 1rware sa nas gnas bshad legs par bsgrigs pa zhig yod du grags kyang ma rnyed/ lo rgyus 'di la gzhigs na spo rong du 'bur ba'i gdung rabs ma byon gong khul der yul dpon zhig sku da par snyam/ gang lags zer na/ dus rabs bcu gcig nang byon pa'i pha dam pa sangs rgyas dang dus rabs bcu bzhi'i nang byon pa'i 'bur ba'i gdung rabs dus mnyam min/gla bskor zhes pa'i dbo na ming thogs tshul ni pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyis sngo na tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi bya rgod phung po'i ri nas 'phen par grags pa'i rdo de 'chodal bar phebs pa'i dus/ ding rir yul skor la phebs skabs gla ba ma bu drug gis rdo zhig la ril ma'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba dang skor ba byed/ de nas gla ba drug po'ang gcig gcig la 'thims te gla ba gcig tu gyur/ mthar gla ba'o ( gcig po de'ang rdo de la 'thims pas na sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis rgya gar nas 'phen pa'i rdo de ra 'phrod pa las gla bskor zhes ming thogs par bshad/40

spo rong rje dbon gyi byung rabs dang rje dbon gyi ring lugs/dge sbyong wā shin dra dharma ma tis (skyabs rje rdza rong zhwa de'u 'khrul zhig rin po ches ) mdzad pa'i bod yul la skod ding ri glang skor gyi nang rten byin can khag gi lo rgyus dad pa'i sa bon las ((nang rten gnyis pa ding rdo smug po ce sa pa 'di ni/ pha dam pa sangs rgyas skye ba dpag med kyi spyodan ro la du sangs rgyas dga' sbyangs rgyal sngo/ zhes bya ba la dad pa thob pas/ sangs rgyas des kyang ma 'ongs par sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i 'khor du lung bstan te skye ba bzhes pa'i dus der/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i drung du byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas byang dzawab sems dpa' mi pham mgon sngo/ zhes bya bar gsol te/ bod mtha' 'khob kyi sems can gdul bar lung bstan pa la/ rdo mthing ril nag po'am/ding rdo smug por grags pa 'di bya rgod phung po'i ri nas sangs rgyas kyis phyag mdzub gsum gyi rtse ru bsnams te ma 'ongs par mi pham mgon po khyodad kyis bod mtha' 'kho ba gdul ba'i gnas der babs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes 'phang bar mdzad pas de ma thag tu shing zhes sgra shig grags skad kyis sangs rgyas kyis kyang khyod kyis 'gro don skyong ba'i gnas der ding ri bya'o gsungs par grags pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yul gyi ming la ding ri zhes thog pa dang / rdo la'ang ding rdo spug wa zhes gasdudal bar mdzad/ 'di ni pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyi thugs dam gyi rten/ma mkha' 'bo rgya mtshos byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdo 'di rgya gar gyi yul du dam pa sangs rgyas kyis paṇ+ḍi ta'i skye ba lan bdun bzhes te/ de dag so sos bod kyi yul du lan re byon pa las/ dang po'i skabs su bod rtsi shing nags tshal 41

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /gyis gtams/ gnyis par sha rkyang spra spre sogs ri dgas kyis gang / gsum par mi min 'dre min ma sangs kyis dbang / bzhi par mi grong ca le ba la rje gnya' khri btsan po lha yul nas byon/ lnga par jo shāka rnam gnyis byon/ drug par dpal gyi bsam yas bzhengs/ bdun par ston chen rnams grub mtha' la rtsod pa'i skabs su rgya gar lho phyogs kyi rgyud rtsa ra sing nga'i gling du paṇ+ḍi ta ka ma la shī la'i sku'i skye ba bzhes te/ sngon sangs rgyas kyi lung bstan pa'i rdo 'di 'tshol du 'dzam gling gsum gnyis zhabs kyis bcags te phebs kyang ma rnyed/mthar la stod rgyal gyi khri'am/ rtsibs ri zhes pa'i gnas rir zhabs skor lan bdun mdzad de/ rtsibs ri mtho ba rnam gsum zhes pa'i gnas su bzhugs dus mkha' 'gro nyi zla'i gshog pa can gyis bu khyod la sangs rgyas kyis gnang ba'i rdo byin rlabs can ni/ g.yas ri dar dkar brkyangs pa 'dra/ /sayo na ri dar smug 'khyil ba 'dra/ /rgyab ri seng chen 'gyings pa 'dra/ /mdun ri maṇ+ḍal phul ba 'dra/ /gtsang chab sngon mo yon chab phul 'dra'i gnas kyi mdun na 'dug ces lung bstan pa dang / dam rnga/'i gzigs snang la glang skor gyi ri de yin par dgongs nas glang lha ra du phebs pa'i nub mo mkha' 'bo nyi zla'i gshog pa can gyis rdo 'di rnyed sla ba'i phyir ding ri'i ri lung thams cad la kha ba phab ste /dpe ra na dkar yol nang du 'o ma blug pa ltar skya ldem mer yod pa'i snga dro gtsugato tor sgang du gsung gtor gnang dus chu'i shar gyi zhing rdo rje thog zer bar phya( ba gcig tsam gyis khebs pa'i sa la kha ba med par gzigs pas/ pha gcig dam 42

sgo rong rje dbon gyi byung rabs dang rje dbon gyi ring lugs/pa/sa sangs rgyas kyi sa gnang ba'i rdo de pha gir med dam dgongs nas gam du phebs pas/ ri dgas gla ba ma bu bdun gyis ril ma'i maṇ+ḍal rdo 'di'i phyed tsam nub par phul te skor ba rgyag shin 'dug pa las/ gla ba bdun po de rnams kyang gcig la gcig rim par thim ste/ mtha' ma de'ang rdo 'di la thim/ dam pa sa nga'i dgon pa'i ming la gla skor du gdags dgongs te tshur bzhes nas nang rten du bzhugs su gsol bas mtshon te/ sngon sangs rgyas shākya thub pas lung bstan pa'i byang sems mi pham mgon ngotsware sku'i skye ba bdun pa rgya gar gyi slob dawa na chen lnga ka ma la ci/ la ste/ bod du 'gro mabo /na dam pa sangs rgyas zhes su grags pa de ltar lags/ rdo 'di la sngon ma bcad pa'i ri mo 'di med kyang /bod kyi rgyal po mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyal zhu ba de ding ri glang skor gyi gnas mjal la phebs pa'i tshe/ rgyal pos sangs rgyas kyis gnang ba'i rdo yin min brtag pa'i phyir phyag tu bzhes te/ rdo 'di bden pa yin na ngas zhal ba'i steng du 'phangs pas mar gong gris gshags pa ltar byed tshal du gyur cig rdzun pa yin na me rdo rdos brdungs pa ltar gyur cig ces dmod bor te 'phangs pa na/mar gong gris gshags pa ltar gyur te/ de ma thag tu dkon gnyer 'chi med 〈sna gros zhes pa des rgyal 11 gnas gzigs la phebs pa ma gtogs nang rten med par bzo ru ma phebs zer nas dum bu gnyis po lag pas blangs te sngar bzhin sbyar bas da lta gris bcad nas slar yang sbyar ba'i tshul dngos yod 'a di lta bu byung ba lags/ rdo 'di la mjal snang gsum yod pa las/ dkar po dung mdog 43

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /ltar mjal na phyi ma'i lam bzang / nag wa sol mdodag ltar mjal na phyi ma'i lam ngan/ smug po mchodang mdog tu mjal na tshe 'dir nor longs spyod mnga' thang 'phel/ skal ldan las 'phro can la tshe chu dngos su 'bab/ rtse gcig tu smon lam btab na 'dod don gang yang mi 'grub par med do/gnyi /zhes gsal/2 2 dus phyis 'bur ba'i gdung rgyud/brag dkar ba rig 'dzin chos kyi dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i spo rong 'bur ba'i gdung rabs nang skabs de'i 'tsho bzhugs rje dbon/ mi'i rje wa tshe dbang rnam par rgyal ba'am/ tshe dbang rnam rgyal zhu ba de yin par bshad/ rje dasnga na 'di rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu mo glang 1793 lor 'khrungs shing lcags 'brug 1820 lor brag dkar bas 'bur ba'i gdung rabs mdzad dus 'chod bzhugs yin 'dug de rjes kyi mi rabs gcig gi lo rgyus ye nas ma rnyed pas rtsa brlag tu phyin pa min nam snyam/ gsham gsal nye dus rje da11na mi rabs gsum gyi lo rgyus dang de min thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i spe rong pa'i yul lung goms gshis sogs dang / rje dbon gyi ring lugs dang 'brel ba'i chab srid bcas kyi che ra/ 'di bas lo mang don gnyer chen pos 'tsho bzhugs spo rong pa bgres song su mjal dang lhag par du rgyus nges myong can khang dkar lha lags sgyubyang chub/ dkon gnyer ngag dbang / tshe ring dam chos/ g.yag pa rdo rje bza'e tshang / khang dkar bu bsam grub/ khang dkar bu don grub tshe ring / grwa chos 44

spo rong rje dbon gyi byung rabs dang rje dbon gyi ring lugs/grags/ grwa kre nub pa/ a khu 'jam dbyangs/ spyi khyab dngos grub/ rgan chen pad rgyal/ gcen po rje drung / sgyu nga dga' tshe dbang rab rgyas/ dbang grags pad/ tshe ring / spo rong sku bag kun bzang byams pa/ mkhar 'or lcam chung blo bzang rnam sgrol/ sgo drug a ma lhag pa/ spe rong a ya pad+ma/ spe rong pa sangs sogs kyi drung du yang yang gtugs pa'i 'bras bu zhig yin/skabs 'phral 'khyog srang zhu rgyur/ dbus gtsang spyi zur dwang shar yon tan rgya mtsho lags nas 2 006 lor phyogs sgrig dpar skrun bgyis pa'i/ ((la stod shel ding khul gyi byung rim nyi zhes pa'i deb kyi shog grangs 161/162la sgo rong rje dbon dang spo rong skor rags tsam gleng 'dug pa'i nang / yongs grags spo rong rje dbon la ((spo rong 'bri dngo na nyinyi zhes sems can 'bri yi dpon du go ba dang / yang skabs re ((spo rong byi dakhrodan gi zhes sems can tsi ci'i dpon du go ba'i sdeb sbyor la mkhas tshul mdzad 'dug pa ni yig rnying ji 'dra zhig la khungs gtugs kyang mi bden pas/ dpar skrun rjes ma zhig la nor bcos mdzad na spyi zur mchog gis mdzad rjes 'byung 'gyur lo rgyus gzigs pa po rnams la thugs phan gsos pa'i khyad du smras pa yin/spo gro nga rje dbon nam mkha' g.yul rgyal (/860 /922yas mas) kyi bdag mor ldog gzhung lha ri rtse ba'i sras mo zhig bskus/ rje dbon 'di la sras po gnyis dang sras mo/ gasde/ma byung bas/ sras rgan pa lha sras dam pa/ sras gzhon pa nam mkha' ngag dbang 'jigs med/ sras mo rgan pa dasngo na 31 bu 'khrid/ sras 45

'bros/ sde chen po/ spo rong yi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /mo gzhon pa dare na mo rig 'dzin sku gas 'khrungs/ sra sa mo rgan pa dpon mo bu 'khrid skabs de'i spo rong gnyer pa khang dkar bu bkra shis kyi mna' mar bzhes/de la sras 'jigs med phun chogags zhu ba dang / mtshan ma nges pa gzhan zhigasras mo pad+ma lags zhu ba bcas 'khrungs/ sras mo pad+ma lags skabs de'i spo rong drung yig phan phyi dbang phyug gi mna' mar bzhes pa kho bo bdag gi skyed ma 6spu.e/sngo rong rje dbon lha sras dam pa'i (/884 /928yasams) bdag mor rta nag lho gling pa'i sras mo zhig bsus/ de la sras mo bu 'dren lags zhu ba gcig 'khrungs/ sras mo bu 'dren lags sngo ra bla ma'i bdag mor gnang / de la sras mo/ blo bzang rnam bo/la lags zhu ba zhig 'khrungs pa mkhar rta 'or pa'i mna' mar gnang bas / khong ni deng skabs sud sir gzhis 'khod 'or pa'i lcam chung lags zhu ba 'di yin/ gsham du rtsis dpon lung shar dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus skabs kha gsal bkod yod pa ltar rje dbon 'di bzhin chos srid gnyis thad nas sku sku na che la chab 'bangs la thugs brtse che zhing chos srid kyi mdzad rjes chen po bzhes thub mkhan zhig byung yang sku'i ljon pa yun ring ma brtan/spo rong rje dbon nam mkha' ngag dbang 'jigs med (/886—1955yasams)kyi bdag mor mkhar rta 'or pa'i sras mo chung sgrol lags zhu ba bsus/ sras tsha mang dag cig chung dus nas sku tshe ma brtan/ 'chos bzhugs sras mo kho na bozhi byung ba ni/ sras mo ngag dbang / sras mo skal bzang bu 'khrid/ sras mo bde hūṃ 6

spo rong rje dbon gyi byung rabs dang rje dbon gyi ring lusas/chen mtsho rgyal bcas gsu ma yab yum gcig pa dang / de min rje dbon gyi zhal ta ma 'brog pa'i bu mo/ pa sangs zhes pa dang mnyam mthun gyis sras mo rnam rgyal sgro'i ma bcas bzhicad/ /rje da bon nam mkha' ngag dbang 'jigs med 'di la rigs myug 'dzin pa'i sras gnyis tsam 'khrungs kyang byis dus she nas sku tshe ma brtan par brten dus 'di nas bzung sgo rong 'bur ba'i gdung rgyud kyi zam chad pa/ yin/ bshad srol la spo rong 'bur ba'i gdung rgyud chad na bod la dus ngan shar yong zer bas rje dbon mtha' ma 'di nyid phyi lo 1955 lor zhing gshegs rjes bod la dus 'gyur chen po byung /spo rong rje dbon gyi srang mo 'bring ba skal bzang bu 'khrid lags sngar srol rgyun 'aci na gyis sgam ma〉kyig btsun dgon du chos zhugs mdzad/ sras mo gzhan gnyis la rje dawa na ma gshegs gong phyi lo 1953 lor lha sa nas yab gzhis g.yu thog gi sras kun bzang byams pa lags sku bag tu bzhes/ rje dawa na sku bag kun bzang byams pa lags kyi bdag mo ra dang chodag nas sras mo/ bgres gachodan gnyis dang dus 'gyur rjes sras mo skal bzang bu 'khrid lags skya babs bcas bdag mo gsum byung yang rje dbon 'di la'ang sras mo gcig las rgyud 'dzin sras ma 'khrungs/ sras mo gcig po ni deng sud sir gzhis 'khod pad+ma bde chen zhu ba 'di yin/sras mo pad+ma bde chen lags dang gzhis rtse bsod nams she resatha gnyis la'ang sras mo bzhi las sras ye nas ma 'khrungs/ rjes su sras mo skal bzang 47

'grog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /bu 'khrid lags dang smar khams a pho ngag byams lags gnyis 'phrad de sras gnyis dang sras mo gsu ma bcas 'khrungs/ sras mo skal bzang bu 'khrid lags deng a ri'i khrodaraṭa lanaṭa khul du gzhis 'khod kyis rang gi sras tsha rnams kyang sku na sdudan pa bcas rje dacadan shul 'dzin pa mdzub mo btsugs yul yod pa zhig 6spun/ 'tsho bzhugs rje dngo na sku bag nam mkha' kun bzang byams pa lags (rang rtsom zur du gzigs ) ni dus 'gyur sngon phyi lo 1948 nas 1951bar bka' sbug dbyin slob senaḍa a gha se shin 'grims zin pa'i 'dab gshog gnyis ldan zhig yin par brten dus 'gyur rjes phyi lo 1960 lor bal yul du sud si rgya gram dmar po'i gro gas tshogs thog mar 'dzugs skabs bal yul 'jog khel wa da mi'i gzhis chags gsar 'dzugs kyi las don la thugs 'gan chen sngo bzhes/ phyi lo 1962 lor bal yul nas bod mi skyabs bathe la ba sud si gzhis chags su thog mar len skabs kun bzang byams pa lags gzhis chags kyi dbu 'dzin dang gsung bsgyur chabs cig tu phebs/ de rjes rang nyid bal yul du phebs rgyu'i wi sa bal gzhung nas gzhan dbang 'og bkag 'doms bgyis par brten byon ma thub/ rang nyid kyi nang mi bu phyag rnams sud sir zla bsgril yong ba'i thabs shes ma gnang ba med kyang dus yun saji 'tshams nar 'gyangs su lus ring rkyen ngan bar chad lta bus sku bag mchog la sud si lcam lu si ya ther ḍo dha ḍo dang zhal 'phrad de khong gnyis lhan 48

tho rong rje ston phyi byung rabs dngasnga dbon phyi ring lugs/du bzhugs/ gnas tshul 'di'i lha ra snga dus nas 'jo khel du gzhis 'khod dzad rong dkon gnyer ngag dbang gis gsungs don/ ((spo rong sku ngos thabs shes ma gnang ba med/ sku ngo la thugs khag med/nyi ces brjod/ sud si lcam la'ang sras mo gsum las sras ye nas ma 'khrungs/ dus 'di nas bzung dre rong rje dbon gyi shul 'dzin kha 'thor du phyin pa lta bu chags/ sras mo ngag dbang lags snga dus nas bzhugs sgar dha ram sa lar ྅kyi tshe ma zin/ sras mo bde chen mtsho rgyal lags ྅/ rkyang gis deng ko le lhal gzhis chags khongs bzhugs na/sa yin/3 3 spo rong rje dbon gyi skor ngag rgyun gyi lo rgyus dang mtshar gtam/de snga bod mi phal che ba'i kha rgyun du yod pa'i spo rong rje dbon stodar yongs grags mtshar gtam khyad mtshar de 'dra mang dag cig sku da pa'i lha ra 'dir rags tsam gleng rgyur/ bshad sredal 'dra min kha shas 'dug kyang sku ngas grags che thodas ni 'di 'dra ste/ spo rong rje dbon gyis sde pa gzhung la bka' bstsal ba/ zhes sogs yod/ de yang lan gcig spo rong rje dbon (('am bu nyi zhes pa zhig gis yul bskyangs/ rje dbon 'di'i dgongs par/ rang nyid yul gyi dpon du 'khod si gang legs kyang 'phral phugs kyi bde rtsar sde pa gzhung nas kyang ngos 'dzin gyi bka' gtan zhig ma lnga ba na 'grigs thabs med pa gzigs nas thabs shes kyi dgongs pa 'di 'dra zhig bzhes so/ /nged rang 'brog dasngo/na kha mdog zhan 49

'brog sde chen po spo rong bi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long / la lha sa'i sku drag gi rnam 'gyur mi shes mkhan zhig gis bcos med rang gar phyin na las don bsgrub rgyu dka' bas de las sngo bas zol gyi rnam pa zhig 'khrabs te sde pa gzhung gi sku drag la gtugs na nam zhig ngo mtshar ba'i grub 'bras shig thob bam snyam/ des na nyin zhig gza' skar dge ba'i dus shig la rje dbon gyis yul mi rnams bskongs/ yul lha gsol zhing thugs spyodan zab mo dang bcas gtam 'di 'dra zhig gsungs so/ /de ring nged 'kho ra bcas rang re'i chos srid kyi bya ba gal che zhig bsgrub ched bod kyi rgyal sa lha sar chas pa yin/ khyed yul mi rnams kyis kyang bya ba lam 'gro yong ba'i smon lam rgyob cadag ang zhes zhabs 'khopre+or kha shas dang lug khyu gcig ded de thon no/ /spyir rje dbon 'am bu 'di nyid chos srid la mkhyen pa rab tu rgyas pa'i skye bo zhig yin yang / de nyin dgos dbang che gzigs kyis bsam bzhin du jo la gyi chas 'di 'dra zhig bcas so/ /sku lus la rgya nag gi bo sa chen skud 'thag gi gos slog cig bzhes/de'i sked rags g.yag gi glo thag gis bcings/ phyag g.yas su ma ṇi lag skor bsnams/ sku sked du yog shing zhig sbrags/ phebs la ma la dpon g.yog 'khor bcas snga dro ma ṇi 'dren/ nyin gung 'brog glu len/ dgong dro rtsid pa yogs shing phebs/lha sar phebs ma thag zhing thang zhig tu sbra gur phub ste sgar mdzad/ me kha gso ched zhing bdag gnas mo'i sar me zhig slong bar phebs/ gnas rmi+os me me skyogs gang phul ba rang gi phyag rjen gos kyi phu thung gis lcibs te bzhes/ 50

spo rong rje dbon gyi byung rabs dang rje dbon gyi ring lugs/gnas mos gos log 'tshig gi red zhus par cang mi byed gsungs/ gos log de mes mi 'tshigs pa'i gos chen skud 'thag ces pa de yin par grags/ de na// nyin shas rjes sde pa gzhung gi bka' shag tu bcar/ bka' shag gis rje dalnga na /byed du kha gdan zhig bting ste bzhugs su bcug par rje dbon gyis/ bdag rang 'u ga tshad thug kyang rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi ste nga du mi sde da ces ma bzhugs/ kha gdan gyi tshab tu 'bol gdan mthug sngo zhig bting bar de'i steng du dngo na nyams chen sngo/sa bzhugs/ de nas bka' shag gis zhu don gang yod gsungs par/ rje dbon gyis ((spo rong rje dbon gyis sde pa gzhung la bka' stsa la ba nyi zhes pa'i snyan zhu zhig phul/ bka' blon gyis 'am bu'i am phrag nang gi gan lde ljid po de gzigs nas 'di gang ngam gsungs par/ 'di rtsibs rdo yin zhus/ gang gi ched gsungs par/ rje dbon gyis/ go thos la sde pa gzhung gi sku drag gi rtsibs ma gcag ched rtsibs rdo dgos kyi yod zer bas de'i ched yin zhus/ bka' blon dgongs pa 'tshoms te bka' skyon dang bcas nyes chad gser srang gsum sgrubs dgo sa gsungs/ rje dbon gyis/ srang gsum srang ba zhi bdag gis mi shes/ gser dgos na 'di bzhes shig ces gser gan lde gang phul badz+ra bka' blon shin tu dgyes/ de nas khyed kyi zhu don gyi snying po gang yin gsungs par/ sems can 'tsho yul gyi sa cha tog tsam dbo sa zhus/ji tsam dbo sa gsungs par/ phur pa gar rgyag gi sa zhig byung na 'grigs zhus/nyin shas rjes shog gsungs/ gzim chung nas phyir thon ma thag rje dngo na gyis 51

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /zhi mi zhig skas 'dzigs nas thur la babs pa gzigs pas/ rje dbon gyis kyang zhi mi'i lad zlos kyis dbu stod sngon du byas te skas 'dzegs babs khul gnang /der yod drung 'khor gnyis kyis gzigs te/ de 'dra phebs na 'babs ril thebs yong zhes rje dbon gyi phyag g.yas gasku na gnyis nas bskyor te phebs rogs zhus/ phyi gro la du sku da pa'i gzhung zhabs dang rje dbon gyi zhabs phyi sogs kyi mthong tshul la rje dbon gyi g.yas gasku na sde pa gzhung gi drung 'khor gyis bskyodar nas gus zhabs chen lnga sa phebs skyel zhus par mngon/ de lta bu'i rnam spyod la brten nas bka' shag gi dgongs par/ 'brog pa'i mi rgan 'gro lug sa gang yang mi shes mkhan 'di lta bu zhig la phur pa gar rgyag gi sa cha sprad par nyen kha gang yod/ sprad pas 'thus zhes rje dbon gyis zhus don ltar bka' gtan ba3405/rje dbon gyis/ da ko rje 'o re'i bsam don lhan gyis grub song zhes dgyes snang chen pos 'dzum dmul zhing / da ni 'dir mi sdod mgyogs par log 'gro zhes rang yul du chas/skabs der la stod khul du mi 'bor nyung zhing 'brog sa'i rtsa thang yangs shing rgya che ba yo lang zhig bdag med lta bu yod pa de yun ring nas rje dbon gyi thugs su brnags yod pa ltar/ skabs don gyi las gzhi 'di 'dra zhig brtsamanas mo/ /ri lung rtswa chu gar bzang la dbyar dgun ston gsum du 'brog sde'i gnog lug 'tsho yul gyi khyu sa spo gin rjod shin la sbra gur phub pa'i mtsher shul du phur 52

sgo rong rje dbon gyi byung rabs dang rje dbon gyi ring lugs/rjes 'jog gin 'jog shin/ mthar gtan tshigs dgongs don yul gru phur rje sa kyi khengs pa mdzad de yul gyi bdag por gyur/de nas lo shas rjes rje dbon gyis slar bka' shag mdun du bcar/ da lan gyi zhu don la/ sngar stsal ba'i sa cha de/ yang na che drags/ yang na chung drags pa'i dka' ngal 'dug pas/ der brten yang na tog tsam phyir bzhes mdzod yang na tog tsam 'alnga la pa zhu zhus/ ci 'dra zhes bka' phebs par/ bdag rang gcig sngo ra che drags/ 'brog sde sku ngas la chung drags zhus/ 'thol pa ji tsam dathodas gsungs par/ brgya slang kha sbub tsam byung na 'grigs zhus/ bka' shag gi dgongs par sla nga brgya kha sbub pa'i sa tshad zhu gi 'dug dathodangs nas zhus don ltar bka' gtan bstsal/ rang yul du byon nas rje dbon gyis la stod khul du yod pa'i brgya mchod slang nga'i la zhes yan rang khongs su bzhes / ((brgya tsho nyagazhes pa dang ((slang nga'i la nyi zhes pa gnyis tshig bsdus yin pa'i 'grel bshad kyis brgya tsho slang nga'i la yan chad dbang du 'dus mo //yang / dus gcig na/ 'brog pa spo mo nga pas sde pa gzhung la mar khral phul ba'i mar ltang rdog ril gyi khog tu rdo ril bcug yod pa'i rnyog gzhi langs te bka' rtsad tshabs chen zhig phebs pa na/ rje dacadan rang nyid lha sar bcar nas 'grel bshad 'di 'dra zhig brgyab ste rnyedag gzhi 'jam par grags/a tsi a tsi/ nor 'khrul 'di 'dra zhig phyin 'dug /dbo ngas su gsol/bdag tsho 'brog pa la gna' dus nas lam srol bzang po 'di 'dra zhig yod pas 53

'brog sde chen po hro rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /des rkyen pas mar khral tshab tu mar phud swā/ra 'dug pas mar phud slog na mar tshab bsgrigs pas chog zhus/ ji 'dra zer bka' phebs par/ 'brog glu 'di 'dra zhig bzhes so///dbyar phag snying nyin zhag bdun gyi mar/ /mar ser po bcud kyi nying khu de/ bcud mi nyams rdo la bcol ba yin/ /de lta bu'i mar phud 'gro yul ni/skyabs dkon mchog gsum gyi mar me dang / /chos bka' 'gyur klog pa'i dge 'dun sde/ rang dga' ston rten 'brel dus la yin/ /spyod lug ltar glen pa'i 'brog pa chodas/ gun ma shes mar gyi snying po phul / /bcud rdo la bcol ba'i mar phud de/ /'phral nyid du bdag la phyir chodag zhu/ /mar mar rkyang bdag gis phul bas chog /zhus pas/ sde pa gzhung gi bang mdzod nang 'ange ga pa spo rong pas phul ba'i mar khral bed spyod zin te mar ltang gi khog nas thon pa'i rdo ril kha shas las lhag med stabs rtsod lha ga 'joms pa'o//rtsom pa po'i mchan/ gong gsal brgya tsho zhes pa ni spo rong tsho brgyad kyi nang gses brgya tsho 'di yin/ slang nga'i la zhes pa ni yongs grags stod gzhas/ gram mtsho slang nga'i la de/ /nyi zla yar dang mnyam pas/ /pho rog nag chung bzhin du/ /g.yas bskor brgyab nas 'o/ga 'gro/ /zhes pa'i la 'di rang yin/ brgya snu dang gram tsho'am drang so gnyis la phar tshur gyi lung pa yin pas brgya tsho slang nga yang zer/ phur pa gar rgyag gi sa khungs ni phal che ba 'brog sa zhe cig yin/ sa khyon shin tu che bas/ shar skyed chad la nas skyab rag tshoni to brgyud lto ngal rgyal la nas gnya' lam mthong la brgyud nub tsha bo rong zhes rdzong dga' dang 'phrad pa yin/ byang khyodags sa mtshams ni ma gtsang gtsang po gar 'phrad yin/54

spo rong rje dbon gyi byung rabs dang rje dbon gyi ring lugs/gong gsal rje dbon gyi 'otho rgyus ni rgan ngag gazlo na 'jags kyi lam nas bshad rgyun du dar ba'i spo mo nga rje dbon skor yongs grags 'o/ rgyus shig yin pas skabs re dngos yod nga/nga mtshungs shing skabs re mtshar gtam lta bu yod na/ 'di pas lpo rong pa dang de mi ni nye 'brel gzhan mang por gtugs te lo rgyus 'di'i lha ra 'dri rtsad byas 'bras/ cha tshang ba dang khungs lung ldan pa zhig mkhyen mkhan gcig kying ma rnyed/ rags tsam gsung mkhan mang po mjal/ bshad so/la mi mthun pa yang kha shas snang / der brten skabs 'dir gus nas lo rgyus a ma gzhi la bzhag ste snyan cha dang go bde sku nga ched rang khyo ma phran bu mi byed thabs med la dgongs su gsol/

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /3 spo rong rje dbon gyi ring lugs dang 'dzin skyong /rje dbon ring lugs kyi go rim 'dzin stangs ni/ spo rong rje dbon rang nyid 'bur ba'i gdung rgyud 'dzin pa'i chos srid gnyis kyi dasngo na zhig ste/ mtshan gyi rnam grangs du mas 'thodad pa'i/ sa skyong mi'i rje'am/ chos rgyal chen po/ yongs khyab che shos ni spo rong rje dbon/ zhes byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa zhig bsam bzhin mi'i zol du skabs bab gdul bya bskyang ba'i ched yul 'dir byon par grags/ rje dbon gyi sras bgres pa gdung 'dzin skya rtsar mnga' gsol ba dang sras 'bring ba ser rtsabo dong chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i gdan sa lhu rong dpal mo chos sdings dang mngon dga' chos sde gnyis kyi mkhan sngo ra mnga' gasku la byed kyi sku/da/ de bzhin sras mo 'bring ba cesas zhugs gsan bsam gyis sgam mchor+shag btsun dgon gyi mkhan 11ra mnga' gsol ba yin/ lpo rong gi 'brog sde chen po 'dzin skyong byed stangs ni deng dus dmangs gtso'i ring lugs dang 'dra bo yod/ 'dzin skyong 'thus gtsang dang thob thang dang las 'gan gyi gzhi cangakhyab che yong thabs 'brog sde yongs rdzogs chos khag brgyad du dbye ste tsho khag re nas rgan po gnyis re rang khungs mi mang nas 'dems dathodas kyi sku da/ de 'dra'i rgan po bcu drug tshogs pa'i tshogs 'du zhig gis 'o/ ngo gsum rer thengs re 'pho len byed pa'i spo rong spyi khyab kyi 'os gzhi blta na pa yin /so/sa gzhi 'di nas spo ro/nga pa'i spyi khyab rje dbon rang gis thad bsko gnang ba yin/spyi khyab kyi las 'gan ni rje dathodan chen wa'i chos srid kyi mdzad par blo 'dur bka' 56

spo rong rje dbon gyi ring lugs dang 'dzin skyong /slob 'bul rgyu dang gzhung dmangs dbar mthud sbyor gyi zam pa lta bu yin no/ /de'i 'og sgo rong pa'i lo re'i dus mchod khag srung brtsi dang phyi nang gi rtsis rgyag sogs lha sgri ga byed sngo gnyer las khag gsum khungs so sku/ nas 'dems sgrug gis so/ gcig ci byed sgo'i las rim bya spu gnon gyi sgrigs tshugs yodad/ spo rong chod brgyad kyi skya sa'i rgyal sa'am lte gnas de sbra chen yin/ ser sa'i ste gnas sam gdan sa de chos sdings yin/ spo rong rje dbon sku sger la zhabs gras su/ spo rong bu dga'/ zha drug pa/ zhal ta ma bcas yod/ de'i kho ngas nas rje dbon gyi drung yig gam dpon yig pa dang / chibs dpon/ de bzhin dus gzings skabs yul du zhi 'jags bzo ched nyen srung pa'am rkyen btul ba lha/gas kyang 'dam pa yin/ lo 'khor gcig gi nang spo rong tsho brgyad mnyam rub kyis dang / yang chod khag so mo nas dus mchod srung brtsi dang phyi khral dang nang khral rtsis rgyag sku gas kyi tshogs 'dzoms byed rgyu mang dag cig sku da pas/ spyi ba'i las wa na 'di tsho 'thus gtsang legs grub yong ched thog ma'i ma rtsa spo rong rje dbon rang nyid nas stsal ba'i spo rong spyi khyab las khungs dang de'i 'og gtong sgo'i gnyer las khag gsum bcas dmangs gatho'i ring lugs yin pa gang zhig la bya spu gnon gyi las rim dpe bzang cadas pa byung ba gsham gsal ltar yin/3 1 spo rong spyi khyab/sgo rong spyi khyab ni spo rong tsho brgyad kyi rgan po bcu drug gis lo yun gsum rer 57

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /thengs re lhan tshogs kyis dmangs gtso'i lam nas 'os gzhi'i sa bon bton pa nas mthar rje dbon rang nyid kyis mi gcig 'dems kyi yod 'dug /rje dbon dang spyi khyab lhan 'dzoms la rgyal rlon lhan 'dzoms brjo da kyi yod 'dug3 2 shel dkar rdzong /spo rong rje dbon gyi mi ser du gyur pa spo rong tsho brgyad dang / bod gzhis khag bzhi dang chos gzhis khag gsum bcas pa nang khrims rang btsan yin/ dper na/khrims 'gal chung tsag rigs yul sde so so'i rgan po lhan rgyas nas thag gcod byed pa yin/ des ma 'thus pa'i rigs sbra chen du rgyal blon lhan 'dzoms la zhu gtugs byas te thag gcod pa yin/ ha cang 'tshabs che'i khrims 'gal mi gsod jag bskul sogs kyi rigs shel dkar snyu nga du gtugs dgos pa yin/ calaba'i sa gnas khrims sgo rang btsan du gyur yod kyang sde ba gzhung dang lhag par bod gzhung dga' ldan 'o/ brang la snga dus nas tha snyad 'dra min gyi khral rigs sna tshogs rkang 'gro lag 'don ji 'bab dga' gus lhur len gyis zhus pa ma zad/ dmag 'khrug dang dus gzir skabs sogs la sde pa gzhung la 'khos bab dpung 'degs kyi zhabs zhu lhar len zhus pa ni 'dir 'khod sku/ rgyus gzhan khag nas rtogs thub/ mdor na gzhung dga' ldan pho brang la chos srid gnyis kyi dbu 'dzin bla na med par bkur ba'i shel dkas rdzong 'og gi mi ser zhig yin/ shel dkar rdzong du 'tsho 'dzin nam gtso drag gsum dang tsho dpon gsum gyi 'gan 'og khral tsho drug yod/ gtso drag gsum ni/ spe 58
