spo rong rje dbon gyi ring lugs dang 'dzin skyong /rong rje dbon/ shel dkar/ mtsho sgo bcas gsum dang / hrū dpon gsum ni shing ri tsho dpon/ sa skya tsho dasngo na/ tshwa mda' tsho dpon bcas gsum yin/ gzhung khra05 'bul 'bab la zhib bsher dang mtha' bsdoms cala'adzin gyi yig khag la gtso drag gsum gyi sa rtags 'kho da dbo sa pa yin/3 na sa rong tsho brgyad ni/dpal khud lho'am lho gzhung pa/ dpal khud byang ngam byang 'bug pa/ zur mcho/nam 'brog gam nang gog /brgya chos bcas lnga dang / dmigs bsal mi ser brgya dpon pa/ chags pa/ phan phyi bcas ga3/ma bsnan pas 3ོ5ོ brgyad yin/ ༷/la tsho re la rgan sngo gnyi sa re bcas rgan sngo bcu drug rang khungs nas 'dems pa yin/spo rong tsho brgyad kyi nang gses sku nga tsho khag1 lho gzhung pa/ ser lung / be rtse/ zhabs dga'/ zam zur/ khul 'dir dkar ru 'od 'khyil da nga 'kho la sman mcho bcas mtsho chung gnyis yod/da byang 'bug pa/ zhabs dga'/ ngo sku na/ 'bor mo / khyu stodag bcas yod/khul 'dir lpo rong rje dbon gyi gna' bo'i bzhugs sgar sbra chen dang / bo snga nga paṇa chen gyis phyag btab pa'i gdan sa dpal mo chos sdings bcas yod/ chos sdings dang sbra chen dbar rgyang thag ki lo mi ṭar 20 tsam las med/ chos sdings dang sbra chen gnyis rje dbon se ra skya so so'i lte gnas yin/ (rgyas pa zur du gzigs)

'brog sde chen po skyo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /ga zur mtsho/ 'dre lhas/ dgon mda' dmar/ phreng dkar/ bum khang /glang chung /4 brgya tsho/ ko ri/ la lung / spob/ kha che/ be chu/ maṇa thang sgang / rwa 34nga /lda nam 'brog /shi 'bu/ spang 'bug /lhod bu gling / la bu gling / sngo gdong / rnam rgyal gling /6 brgya dpon/ 'di brgya dpon lha lung pa'i mnga' khongs yin/7 chags pa/ lung dkar/ lte rgyu/ nya gang / 'di gsum lung dkar gyi mnga' khongs yin/8 phan phyi/ yul 'og /gyes tshang / 'di gsum phan phyi sbra chen gyi mnga' kho ngas yin/9 spo rong rtswa nyo ba/ gong gsal spo rong khral sgo hrū brgyad khar/ spo rong rje dbon dang sbra chen gnyer pa gnyis kyi khyu sar ༷/la phyogs gzhan nas yong ba'i sger pas rtswa rin sprad de khyu sa nyos par/ rtswa nyo ba zer/ khong tsho grwa khral las de min gyi khral chag yang yin/ dus 'gyur mtshams rtswa nyo ba'i khyu sa gsham gsal ltar yin/dpal khud mtsho'i nub khul du/ nub sked 'bod pa'i phyogs der/ sta chu thon khungs ri rtse nas drangs te/ sha bo/ skyid sbug /gangs sbug /tshochu ga yar/ skabs sbo/ gshan chung / che nga lhas/ de nas lho phyo gas sas/60

spo rong rje dbon gyi ring lugs dang 'dzin skyong /sngo chung / zhur che/ zhur chung / dbyen po/ stag so/ dbyar ru khog chung / lu ma ring po/ sa shig pa/ (rta tshugs gnyis pa ) rta 'gugs pa/ de nas rta chu lnga na rjes/ spo rong a ne+e dgon pa/ de'i mdun du/ lhas ma mo / ma mo am cog pa/ kho g.yag ྅ mo / spyod mo am snyu ga pa/ dpa' gdong / ngang mchos/ zhabs dga'i snga mo / ltag rwa/ mdun rwa/ yangs 'gug /glod rwa/ lu ma skyed 'o// dpa' ri/ (yul mi chodas dpab ri zhes 'asngo da ) ra yang kha/ (yul mi tshos la yangs kha zhes 'bod ) dpa' ri sku rgyab/ tshe rgyal lhas/ rtsa lam/ yar drangs/ mar drangs/ garma'i kyu lu/ spo rong sbra chen gyi ri'i rgyab ngos su/ bla mtsho dkar po/ (yul mi tshos glang mtsho dkar po zhes 'asngo da ) yul snye / brag nag rab gsal/ma bu'i gdang khungs/ gser gsum/ g.yar sa/ brog ngo gnya' ma/ sbra chen/ sde'u/ (rta tshugs dang po ) nyi gdong / 'ja'u sbag kha/ dga' lo che'i chu/ gnyer skog /gad 'gug dkar ngo / rdza chung phu na/ rwa tshang lhas/ dga' 'o/ che/ spo g.yag ru/ lha 'dre bshags sa/ gzur rwa/ steng gsham/ steng phu/ 'dodags rwa/ gram wa che/ a ni ka khyud/ sked lhas/slab la/ rdza rwa/ bcas sa //khul 'dir mtsho kha 'kho ra gsum zhes 'brog sde gsum sku da pa ni/ la phul /bya mang po/ go mur bcas gsum / de'i 'khris su rdo dmar ba'i gdan sa brag sne sku da/ la phyag dang bya mang po gnyis rdzong dga'i khongs yin/61

'brog sde chen po spo rong bi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /go mur gyi rdzong 'go rdzong dga' yin yang nang dpon spo rong khongs yin pa ma zad dpal sna/ chos sdings su grwa khral rgyugs pa dang dgon pa'i chos gzhis yin/ la phug pa bla brang 'og pa dang / brag sne ba ser byes 'og pa yin/3 4 gtong sgo'i gnyer las gsum/lpo rong rje dbon 'og dus mchod srung brtsi dang rtsis rgyag spro skyid sogs la rgyu sbyor gtong sgo dang go sgrig byed mkhan gnyer pa khag gsum yod pa ni/ chos sdings gnyer pa/ sbra chen gnyer pa/ mngon dga' gnyer pa bcas yin/ sbra chen ni spo rong rje dbon gyi bzhugs gnas 'khod pa'i chod brgyad kyi rgyal sa de yin/ chos sdings dang mngon dga' gnyis spo rong khul du bo dong lugs kyi sdom gtsang gdan sa gnyis yin/ gnyer las so sor chodag ma'i thebs rtsa ra sbra chen gnyer par ma rtsa lug 1500/2000 bar dang chos sdings gnyer par lug 1000 malngaran dga' gnyer par ngo da gzhis rgya che bstsal sku da 'dug/de bzhin spo rong spyi khyab la'ang gtong lharware ma rtsa ra lug 300 lhag tsam sku da sku la 'dug3 5 bod gzhis khag lnga/ 1 (rje dbon mnga' khongs bod gzhis lnga sku da pa ni/ gling shar/ stod mi/ tshub lung / mngo na dga'/ gram mtsho'am drang so dga' ldan bcas lnga yin/62

spo rong rje dbon gyi ring lugs dang 'dzin skyong /3 6 rta zam gsum ni/ len po res kyi 'gan 'og tu yod pa'i spo mo nga khul gyi rta zam gsum ni/ shel dka 8 nas brag skya bar rta zam gcig /brag skya nas sde'u bar rta zam gcig /sde'u nas rdzong dga' bar rta zam gcig bcas so//3 7 dgon ma lag bcu gsum/ bo dong chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i dgon ma lag bcu gsum yod de sdom gtsang pho dgon gnyis te dpal mo chos sdings dang mngon dga' chodas sde/ sdom gtsang mo dgon gcig ste sgam mchog btsun dgon/ ser khyim pho dgon bdun te/ nub lung lha gdong dgon/ sku la gdong chos sde/ gram mtsho tsho lnga dgon/ dgon mda' phu gartsib ri rlon mtsho dgon/ ding ri lha gdong dgon/ mnga' ris mngon dga' bcas bdun yin/ ser khyim btsun dgon gsum te/ nub lung byang cadang dgon/ spo rong btsun dgon/ bya rog sprodang btsun dgon (pho mo 'dres ma ) bcas dgon ma lag 13 yin/ phyis su na bkra ngagon pa'ang spo blosang khongs su gtogs/3 8 chos gzhis khag gasde/ma/chos gzhis gsum yod pas skyid grong gnas shar dang la ldebs gnya' zhes pa gnyis dpal mo chos sdings kyi chos gzhis dang mngon dga' ru yod pa'i lho ba dang / 'bog pa gnyis mngon dga' chos sde'i chos gzhis yin/63

— — 'angoXsdu+o /sdu ༷sa14 / byebye twe k+ṣiṃ ṭī///sdu / /bye rdo ོ༷ ༷/ ༷ /so/ ma pa ༷ /bye/ spyi hūm̐ ri zi / / ṣ+ṭi bsdu nga pa rdo twe rdo ༵ /sngon bcom // ṭ+wāṃ dro/ sbyoraX tsu ne+e bye ṭ+wāṃ / byung )

spo rong rje dbon gyi ring lugs dang 'dzin skyong /3 9 'ango ga sde spo rong pa'i 'o/ 'kho ra rtsis rgyag chogags 'du dang dus chen khag1 nag chen/ dbyar bod zla 6 pa'i nang 'o/ gsum la thengs re spo rong tsho ba/1da sbra chen du 'du 'dzoms kyis nang khral rtsis rgyag zhib bsher dang spyi khyab 'os 'dems byed pa yin/ de rjes rta rgyug dang mda' rtsed me rtsed sogs 'gran sdur dang bcas dbyar skyid ces nyin grangs bcu tsam ring mtho dman bar gsum gyon chas gzab mchodar dang bcas dga' spro'i dpal la rol pa yin/da nag chung / dbyar bod zla snyo nag chen min pa'i lo ltar spo rong tsho khag so so'i sa gnas su lhan 'dzoms kyis gzhung khral dang nang khral rtsis rgyag dang rtsed 'gran bcas kyi dbyar skyid gtong ba yin/3 dgun tshogs/ dgun bod zla 12 pa'i nang 'o/ ltar spo rong tsho brgyad mngon dga' ru lhan 'dzoms kyis gzhung 'bul spo rong mar khral dang zangs zangs ko khral shel dkar lcags khral sogs rtsis rgyag byed pa yin/ de rjes las bsdoms gtsang bsgril gyi dga' ston sprod skyid la mo la pa bcas dus yun bsdoms zla ngo gcig tsam 'gor ba yin/4 ban ༷/gas lha mchad/dgun tshogs bo la khar wa da zla 1 tshes 15 nyin spo rong rje dbon 'khor bcas dang phra na gyi ma〉sgrod dasngo/na a ya bcas nam 'askra/ga tu/ rta skyongs/ zhes pa'i ri ho ra yul lha pa lha btsan chen sngo rta ri re 'am slob dpon chen pos bka' balha sa rjes gsang mtshan rdo rje 'bar brta zhes pa'i lha btsugs shig yod pa 65

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /der byedan/ de nas rje dbon nyid dang mchod dawa na gnyis kho na las gzhan su zhig med par lha btsugs de'i nang du snga lo bcug pa'i rdza bum de zhal phye nas 'char lo'i dus babs bzang ngan brtag pa byed/ de rjes lug gcig dmar mchod 'bul ba sogs gna' dus kyi srol rgyun thun mo/nga ma yin pa zhig phyi lo 1959 bar ma nyams rgyun 'dzin yod pa'i skor dgung lo 87 phebs pa'i bal 'khod spo rong a ya pad+mas gsung gsal/ ((de nyin nged rang lha chas gyon pa yin/ 'u/sa la gos chen thig ma/ mgo la sog zhwa/ zhabs zon spre lham/g.yas su mda' zhu sag thag /g.yon du gri dpa' dam/ lag g.yas su shang lang dang lag g.yon du rnga chung 'khyer ba yin/ dang thog snga lo bcug pa'i rdza bum de rje dbon dang a ya thun mo nga gis gsang bas zhal phye ste 'char lo ji yong gi ltas brtag pa byed pa yin/ snga lo'i rdza bum 'a brus brgyangs pa kha phye nas ltas kyi brtag pa byed stangs ni/ bcug pa rang 'jags yod na bzang / /gang med stong pa'ang de bzhin bzang / rta sbang yod na rta khral che/ /g.yag sbang yod na nor la zhan/ ṭam ka yod na dngul gron che/ /skra dkar yod na rgan la zhan/ skra nag yod na gzhon la zhan/ /byis blo yod na bu phrug la zhan/ de bzhin skabs re sems can gyi rkang rjes 'dra min gsal bas de la gzhigs te brtag pa byed rgyu mang po yod/ 44 de nas shang lang bkrol zhing yul lha gasku la ba yin/ shang lang thos pa tshorang grol zhes shang lang de bkrol pa tsam gyis yul lha mnyes pa'i nus pa yod par 66

sgo rong rje dbon gyi ring lugs dang 'dzin skyong /grags/ skabs der bskang gso'i 'don pa 'di 'dra zhig 'don pa dran/ khu khu/da rang byon pa gang nas byon/ /da rang tse/ rgyan ༷/la nas byon/ /chibs su rkyang chung kha dkar chibs/ /rkyang kha dkar gar 'cham ling se ling / lha lug ྅ dmar zungs su 'bul/ /lha g.yag zhol po rgyan du 'bul/ lha rta ngang pa chibs su 'bul/ sogs (rgyas pa zur du gzigs)kyi lha mcho da grub rjes/ dmar mchod 'bul ba yin/ dmar mchod ma byas bo nga mchodad dpo na nas bon lugs mchod pa'i man ngag 'don skabs mchod lug de bzhin rang dbang med pa lta bu'i mchod dpon nas gang bshad kyi rnam 'gyur byed kyi yod 'dug /dper na/ mgo bo g.yugs brjod na/ mgo thod g.yug pa dang / rkang lag g.yugs brjod na/ rkang pa g.yug pa mo gas bkodad pa btang tshad rang dbang med par byed kyi yod 'dug/lug gi srog ga cod mkhan ni a ya rang nyid min la bshan pa yang min par/ spo rong pa'i khongs nas khyu sa gzhir bzung rgyan rgyag gis yul mi rus gtsang zhig dgos pa yin/ des dang thog lnga chugs gyi mdun du gos chen 'ja' ma'i kha gdan zhig bting / de'i steng du lug stede bzhag nas khog stod du lag pa rgyus te lug gi snying rtsa bcad de srog len pa yin/ dmar mchod zin rjes lug ro'i lag pa gnyis dang rgyu ma/ bcin khug bcas nas 'char lo'i skor ltas gsum gyi brtag pa byed rgyu yod/ 'di ltar ste / dmar mchod zin pa'i lug ro de gan rgyal du 'jo ga pa yin/ lug phrorware lag gnyis dus yun gang 'tshams shig ker rer langs sdod pa de/ ga ler re re bzhin zags pa yin pas/ ltas 67

'grog sde chen po slo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /su/ lag g.yas spyodan la zags na gnyen lag yin pas ltas ngan/ lag gasku/na sngon la zag na dgra lag yin pas ltas bzang / de bzhin/ skabs re lug mo'i rgyu stodad rgyu smad gasku 'gul byed pa'i ltas sku da/ rgyu stod 'gul na stodad nas dmag gi nyen kha sku/da/ rgyu smad 'gul na smad phyogs nas dmag gi nyen kha/ rgyu ma ma 'gul na dmag nyen med par brtsi/ bcin khug de skabs re bcin pas khengs pa dang skabs re stong pa yin pa'i ltas yod/ bcin pa yod na char chu dkon/ bcin pa med na char chu bzang ba'i ltas yod/lha mchod zin rjes spo rong rje dbon dang mchod dpon nyis 'dzoms kyis slar rdza bum de 'bru dkar gtsang mas kha bkang / de'i khar ṭam dkar gcig bcug /de la mar gyis yal kha brgyab/ de dag rdo leb g.yam mas bkab ste lha btsugs nang rjes lo bar bcug pa yin/ 'di'i mchodad dasngo na la a ya zhes gna' dus nas rus brgyud kyi grong pa zhig yin 'dug pas dus da lta'ang bal yul khul du gnas 'khod dgung lo 87 phebs pa'i a ya pad+ma dang kho ba'i bu a ya rlo bzang sogs 'tsho bzhugs yod/ de nyin mchod dpon la sku yon gyi mtshon ched spo rong pa khyu sa re nas mar ltang re/ bal ltang re/ rtsam pa 'bo gang re dang / de'i khar rang mos kyis dar lcog dang tshwa sogs 'bul srol yod/rta zhes gsungs/ tsho :5 bar 'brog rta skyong du bon lugs lha mchod kyi bskang gamo /༄༅༅/ /khu khu/ phyogs phyogs mtshams gcig ya gi na/ /nyi ma nub byang ya 68

sgo rong rje dbon gyi ring lugs dang 'dzin skyong / gi na/ /yul gcig gtsang stod khrom yul na/ /shi phu pha ri gnam lung na/ /ri dmar ya gi srin po'i ri/ /lung dmar ma gi btsan gyi yul/ /gangs dkar ya bi lha yi mkhar/ /g.ya' lung ma gi btsan gyi yul/ khu/ /lha sprin smug po khyi re ri/ /na bun skyi bun thibs se thibs/ /g.yu mtsho dung mtsho khyil li li/ /g.yu yi sbal lha nga shigs se shig khu/ /de 'dra'i gnas mchog dam pa na/ /zangs kyi sku mkhar ldems se ldems/ /g.yu yi ba gam lams se lam/gser sgo dung sgo khrigs se khrigs/ /sku mkhar de yi nang shad na/ /lha btsan chen po rta ri re khyung bzhugs/ /yab ni mtsho rgyal sgam po la/ /yum ni mtsho rgyal rgyal mo yin/ /gnyis po srid gcig sprul pa'i sras/ /lha btsan po rta ri re khyung / khu/ //sku mdog dkar po zhi ba'i chas/ /dar dmar ber chen sku la gsol/ /rin chen gser sked sked bcing lcags/ /lcags lham yu thung zhabs la gasku la/ /dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs bcing / /dbu la dar gyi 'gying grod gsol/ /rin chen gser g.yus rgyan gyis spras/ /gri rgod ngar ldan sked la gzer/ /phyag g.yas lha mdung mdzes ring bsnams/ /g.yon pas btsan gyi zhags pa bsnams/ /stag dong g.yas la gzig shubs gasku/na/ /bse yob khra bo khyi ri ri/ /chibs su ngang pa 'gab ser chibs/ /zab gdan rta sga ye re re/ /bse gdan dngul zhib khro lo lo/ g.yu yi gong smad khyug se khyug /byu ru'i mthur mdang si li li / /'jig rten skyes pa'i cha lugs can/ /'khor du lha btsan 'bum gyis skor/ /khyed kyi sku yi sprul pa ni/ /mi hreng dmar po 69

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /shar ra ra/ /khyed kyi gsung gi sprul pa ni/ /lha sgra so sgra di ri ri/ /khyed kyi thugs kyi sprul pa ni/ /rlung 'tshub nag po khyil li li/ /ri khyi sngon po rol du 'khrid/ /lha btsan sku yi lcam gcig ma/ / zang btsun mdzes ma lha yi lcam/dar dkar na bza' sku la gsol/ /gser g.yu rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /g.yas pa'i mdang dar gasku na gter bum/ /chibs su rlung rta sngon po chibs/ /'khor du klu phran 'bum gyis bskor/ /lha btsan/ shar gyi sgo ba ni/ yul gcig sgo gsum la phu na/ /klu btsan chen po dril bu mdang/ /chibs su sngon po gdong skya chibs/ /lha btsan lho yi sgo ba ni/ /yul gcig shi phu lung chags na/ /sga ran chen wa lha yi btsan/ /chibs su ngang skya zag pa chibs/ /lha btsan nub kyi sgo ba ni/ /yul gcig rta li la phug na/ /brag ral gangs brag na/ /brag ral skyes bu rmu yi btsan/ /chibs su mog po gdong tshur chibs/ /lha btsan byang gi sgo pa ni/ /yul gcig ban 'brog sne lung na/ /bdud btsan chen po g.ya' ga rlung / /chibs su ༷ nag snying dkar chibs/ /lha btsan g.yas kyi bka' nyan pa/ /yul gcig ral dmar thong gsum la/ /grib btsan chen po sgo ba zhabs/ /chibs su kham nag zhur rngo/ chibs/ /lha btsan g.yon gyi bka' nyan pa/ /yul gcig g.yu lung zed phug na/ /lha btsan chen po ne+e tsho skyong /chibs su ngang pa shel ring chibs/ /lha btsan gsol gyi bka' nyan pa/ /stsal gcig khrag nag phu sgang na/ /was dmar brag btsan zhes su grags/ /chibs su rta dmar zhur po chibs/ /lha btsan bka' yi cha snyan pa/ /yul gcig spang 70

sgo rong rje dbon gyi ring lugs dang 'dzin skyong /lung thod gsum na/ /skyes bu wal dka' brag gi btsan/ /chibs su zag dmar stag khyi chibs/ /kun kyang rang rang 'khor gyis bskor/ /rang rang rgyan dang na 74za' gsol/ /g.yas na stag dong khra sngo sa rgyan/ /gasku/na na gzig shubs thig le btags/ /gri sgo da ngar ldan sked la gzer/ /bse phub khra bo rgyab tu khur/ /phyag g.yas ru mchosan dmar lnga 'phyar/ /g.yas pas mda' sgra kho la 'o/ 'o// /g.yon pas gzhu kyim mi li li/ /bar du ru dar mkha' ltar dngas/ /khrab sgo ba dan 'phyar ra ra/ /btsan zhags dmar po khug se khyug /bdud zhags nag po na ra ra/ /lha btsan 'bum gyis sna drangs pa'i/ /gri btsan 'bum sde srog la 'gyed/ /klu btsan mang dze sngo nyar 'gyed/ /nam la dus bzhi cha lha mas mdzad/ /dbyar gsum thog ser sna yang 'dren/ /ston gsum sha bdud sna yang 'dren/ /dgun gsum pho zer sna yang 'dren/ /dpyid gsum bdud dmag sna yang 'dren/ /nam la dus bzhi cha lha mas mdzad/ /gang dang gang du rgyugs pa'i tshe/ /ri klung med pa ser bas 'geng / /sdig chen dgra bo 'dul phyir du/ /khu khu ling ling gegs su gasku la/ kyi/ /bcadas bzang ldan pa gtsang mas mchod/ /sha khrag dmar chen galta ra mas mchod/ /sngon mo/ nas bzed 'byu yis mchod/ /dza gad bdud rtsi'i phud kyis mchod/ /srog rtsa'i lam nas drangs pa yi/ /sman dang rak+ta phud kyis mchod/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg la sogs/ /'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa 'bul/ /mda' dar ltong dmar rten du 'dzugs/ /lha rta ngang pa chibs su 'bul/ /lha g.yag ze dkar rten du 'bul/ /lha lug ngo dmar

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /zungs su 'bul/ /snga bcol legs pa'i gtang rags 'bul/ /phyi bcol las kyi zhu don mdzod/ /da bcol las kyi nan tan mdzod/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa gnyen po srungs/ /dam pa chos kyi bstan pa srungs/ /rnal 'dre ra bdag rgi srung ma mdzod/ /skyes pa rnams kyi dgra lha mdzod/ /nyin du sgang nas bya ra mdzod/mtshan du mdun nas mel tshe malnga da/ /sgang nas bya ra nyid kyis mdzod/ gshongs nas mel tshe nyid kyis mdzod/ /legs pa brgya dang nyid kyis sprodad/ /nyes pa stong dang nyid kyis mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phri na las sgrubs/ /sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma la/ /bstan pa bsrung ba zhal bzhes pas/ /gsang mtshan rdo rje 'bar ba btags/ /bka' dang dam la khyod ma 'da'/ /rnal 'byedar bdag cag sgrub pa po'i/ /tshe dang longs spyod gegs byed pa'i/ /sdug cing sdang sems ldan pa'i dgra/ /bshos gtsang 'di dang dus gcig kha hi//6 chos sdings gtor rgyagalo ltar bod zla 2 gnyis pa'i nang spo rong rgyal slon 'khor bcas dang chos sdings gnyer pa/ sbra chen gnyer pa bcas bo dong gdan sa dpal mo chos sdings su 'du 'alhu mas kyis dbo/na par bsnyen bkur zhu ba dang dge 'dun pa rnams nas tho/ lugs kyi gar 'cham dang gtor rgyag gzab rgyas bcas bstan srid zhabs brtan la brtson pa yin/ dus chen de'i skabs kyi rgyu sbyor gtong sgo chos sdings dang mnya/sbra chen gnyer pa'i 'gan yin/ dus chen grub rjes rgyal blon/zhabs gras 'khor bcas bzhugs gral la 'kho da de gna' srol 'grims shar zhes 'brong rwa dang 72

sgo rong rje dbon gyi ring lugs dang 'dzin skyong /g.yag ru'i nang nas mchod chang 'ur skad chen pos gong rim bzhin zhus chang phor nang thigs pa tsam ma lus pa bzhes dgos yin pas/ gal te phor mthil du thigs chang lus tshe nyes pa srang re gtong srol bcas mnga' thang dang nyams bzang che ba'i gna' srol gyi dus chen zhig red 'dug7 sbra chen bka' 'gyur dag 'don/lo ltar bod zla 6 pa'i nang sbra chen du dpal mo chos sdings kyi dge 'dun pa rnams 7zha chen dze/ zhes g.yag rtsid las grub pa'i sbra gur chen snga mi grangs stong shongs pa zhig yod pa der 'du 'dzoms kyis 7rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che dag 'don dang bstan srid kyi zhabs rim gnang srolayod/ de'i rgyu sbyor gtong sgo sa rong rje dbon nam gzhung rkyang dang / spyi khyab/ chos sdings dang sbra chen gnyer pa bcas thun mong gis gtong ba yin/8 spo rong khul gyi lo gsar dus chen/spo rong du bod lo dang rgyal 'o/ zhes lo gsar snga rjes gnyis galta nga ba yin/ lo gsar ma ran gong zla ngo gcig tsam ྅ na nas dud 'phyags zhes khang pa'i mdo sbug bar gsum gtsang ma bzo ba yin/ de nas zhal gro zhes bo zhib las baX sa pa'i bzo lta 'dra min gyi kha zas mar dang yang na snum la brngos te bzo ba yin/bod lo ni/ bod zla bcu gcig gi nyer dgu'i nyin dgu thug 'thung / a ma jo mo zhes spag gi mi gzugs shig la gya nom pa'i nor skal dang zas skal bcas bskur te rang khyim nas brdzongs pa yin/ bod lo zhes yul mi tshos bod zla bcu

'brog sde chen po slo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /gnyis pa'i tshes gcig nyin 'e/ gsar galta nga srol sku/da/ tshes gcig la mchodad mjal dang lhag par du sbra chen pa rnams spo rong rje dbon gyi sar bcar te 'brog pa'i thon skyed thud mar dang sha sogs kyi 'bul tshan bcas rten 'brel zhu srol sku da/ de rjes bod zla dang po'i tshes gcig la bod rgyal lo zhes lo gsar gtong srol yod/ mi dmangs byings nas rgyal 'o/ 'di ha cang rgyas rjodas med kyang /skabs 'dir spa rong rje dbon gyi ngos nas sbra chen yul mi rnams la nyin 'khyedangs gsol lha na zhig bshams sku/la sku/da/rdzo gna' rtsed rdo sgor gyi 'gran sdur/rgyal lo'i tshes gcig nyin spyod mo nga rgyal lha na 'khor bcas nas bod kyi gna' mo'i 'gran rtsed rdo sgor ram rdza sgor zhes pa'i 'gran rtsed cig rtse srol yod/ rdo sgor zhes pa rdo sgor mo dang rdza sgor zhes pa rdza rdo sgor mo la brten nas ming thogs par grags/ 'gran rtsed 'di ni lo ngo stong phrag kha shas sngon nas dar ba'i bod kyi rig gzhung rnying shos shig yin par bshad/ rdo sgor gyi 'gran rtsed la rtse 'gran pa phyogs gnyis su dbye bas/ phyogs rer rtsed 'gran pa bzhi'am lngas 'thus pa yin/ spo rong du rje 'bangs dbar rtsed 'gran byed skabs/ spo rong rje dbon ྅kyi 'khor dang zhabs gras sdudags phyogs gcig tu byas/ spo rong spyi khyab dang rgan smra/ sogs phyogs gzhan du byas te 'gran ba3cir byed pa yin/ )1 'gran rtsed 'di'i rtsed chas su/ dkar ril lam si ru zhes do dkar po bzo lta 'bur ril che chung phor tshad tsam zhig yod/ 'gran rtsed bya yul ni thang 74

sgo rong rje dbon gyi ring lugs dang 'dzin skyong /gshongs shig gi dkyil du dkar tshang zhes ri mo lha ra sgor bskums khru gnyis tsam gyi rgya khyon la dkyil du dkar ril de rtse mo mthong tsam bar dkar khung nang sbas te 'jog pa yin/ rtsed 'gran pa rnams kyi lag tu rdo sgor ram rdza lha ra zhes rdo leb sgor mo che chung mtho gang lhag tsam byas pa re yod/rtsed 'gran byed stangs ni/ rtsed 'gran pa rnams dkar tshang nas bskums khru nyer lnga tsam gyi sar bang thig ces sa dkar gyi thig cig sku da sar bang bsgrigs/ de rjes 'go 'dzugs sus byed rgyan rgyag rjes/ phyogs gnyis kyi rtsed 'gran pa tsho re re bzhin re mos kyis mo so'i rdo lha ra dkar ril gyi lhu gas su 'phen pa yin/dmigs yul gcer bo ni sku so'i rdo sgor dkar ril gyi phyogs su 'phen nas dkar ril dkar khung nang nas phyir 'don byed rgyu de yin/ gal te dkar ril dkar khung nas phyir 'don thub kyi med na so so'i rdo sgor de dkar ril dang sbyar ba'am yang na dkar ril gyi 'khris su gang nye slebs thabs bya rgyu de yin/ gal te rtsed 'gran pa zhig gis dkar ril dkar khung nas bton te rang nyid kyi rdo sgor dkar khung du bskyal thub na/ kha gtad des kha gtad kyi rdo sgor de gtor thab sa byed rgyu yin/ mdor na dkar khung sus 'dzin thabs yin/ mtha' balha mas su/ phyogs so so'i rdo skor rnams dkar ril dang nye rgyang gi tshad gzhal te spyi snyoms rgyang tshad ston nas dkar khung dang nye shos slebs pa'i ༷ gas der rgyal kha stodab pa yin/ rgyal kha thob mkhan la bya dga' chang dkar re re dang bstod glu phul ba las thob shor che ba'i rgyan rtsed mi chog par grags/

'grog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /10 spe mo nga sbra chen dang zhwa chen wa /yul 'dir zhwa chen sngo zhes g.yag rtsid kyi sbra gur nag sngo chen khrod zhig sku da/ zhwa chen 'di gna' dus su spo mo nga rje dasngo na gyi bzhugs sgar yin par grags/ phyis su rje dawa na gyi 'o/ brang bzhengs rjes yul mi'i dus mchod sogs tshogs yul chodags/ khang du gyur/ sbra chen zhes yul ming thogs tshul yang sbra gur 'di la brten nas yin/ sbra gur 'di'i che tshad mi grangs chig stong brgal ba shongs shing bzo bkod la mdo phu bar gsum yod pas/ phu ru phying bal gyi gur chung phub pa ni rje daphra na dang bla dawa na rnam pa'i gzim chung / bar du dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya maṣ+ṭharware gas khang / ma〈sna ru gnyer las khang dang thab tshang sku gas yod/sbra gur 'di'i lcags ri'i steng du yul lha dar cog dkar po zhes pa'i rten khang dang de'i nang du g.yang sgam phad tshe rag pa zhes sogs yod 'dug /de bzhin zhwa chen gyi sbug tu bskal pa'i me zhes rgyun chad med pa'i me rgyun nyar so/la sku da/lcags lug 'o/ra (1691/1751) ྅ rong rje dbon nas rgyal ba rgod tshang pa'i sgrub gnas thar pa gling chu bzang ngam deng bar 'awa ga chu bzang du 'ayodad pa'i grub chen la ba455 ba'i gtan tshigs kyi nang ((lugs gnyis kyi 'du sa gser gsum the rje'i gur khang nas bris nyi zhes 'khod pas/ lugs gnyis zhes pa ni rje dbon skya ser gnyis kyi bzhugs sgar yin pa gsal the gas thub/ snga dus shig na spo rong rje dbon gyi bzhugs sgar zhwa chen zhig yod pa de bzhin da lto'i gnas yul sbra chen zhes pa 'di min par de'i lho phyogs ri 'gram du deng sang 76

sgo rong rje dbon gyi ring lugs dang 'dzin skyong /yang gser gsum 'acadad pa'i 'brog sa zhig sku da pa 'di yin par grags/ de rjes rje dbon gyis bzhugs sgar da sku da sbra chen du ྅ sa nas zhwa chen de spyi rdzas su glur pa dang rje dbon rang nyid la pho brang bzhengs par mngon/ dus 'gyur skabs spo rong rje dbon bzhugs yul gzhung rkyang gi pho brang dang de'i 'khris su sku rim pa zhes lha khang chung ngu / de'i mdun du maṇa thang dang khang pa nar mo zhig yod pa dang dpe cha par chodag gi shog snyigs dang sā ts+tsha gas skyon can sogs gamo ga 'jog bgyis pa bcas yod/ 'o/ brang la rgyal sgo lho byang gnyis dang pho brang gi mdun du rta ra/ ba ra/ lug lhas sogs rgya che sku da/ rig gnas gsar rje'i skabs bo nga gsal sku ngas rdzogs gtor bshig btang nas byung shul tsam med pa bzos/ nged kyi pha mes khang pa'ang byung shul tsam las med pa masngagan mthodang byung /bod pa'i grogs po/ ten rig ha rar gyis bris pa'i ((bod nang lo bdun nyi zhes pa'i nang spo rong sbra chen gyi sgo ra 'di 'dra zhig 'khod pa dbyin skad nas rags tsam don bsgyur zhus pa/phyi lo 1944 dgun stod lor khong gnyis rdzong dga' nas thon te spo rong sbra chen du ma 'byor bar lam kha mtho zhing dben pa'i bya khyu la'i grang ngar dang sngo gas mtha' med pa'i dpal khud kyi thang gcadangs la dmyal ba'i lam ltar ngal ba myangs pa'i rjes ((de nas lug khyu zhig dang de'i rjes gyon chas mthug po stsodan pa'i lug rdzi kha shas nga tsho'i phyogs su slebs byung / kho tshos nga gnyis 77

'brog sde chen po skyo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /la grong gseb nye shos gar yod kyi phyogs bstan byung / de dgong nga gnyis rgya lam nas zur tsam du gnas pa'i sbra chen du 'byor/ de lta bu'i dka' ngal dang za chas kyang jo gas grabs la brten da ni mi'i kho da du tsha zob ber sdod rgyu byung na 'dzin bzung byas kyang 'gyod pa med dran/ sbra chen zhes pa'i yul 'di ni ming don mtshungs pa'i grong tsho zhig red 'dug /yul der dud grangs bzhi bcu tsam dang de'i sgang gi ri zur du dgon pa zhig kyang 'dug /sbra chen ni skar thog las gnas stangs legs pa dang phi ṭi brgya phrag mang sngo sa mthod ba 'dug /phal cher/e shi ya'am gcig byas na 'dzam gling nang gi mi'i yul sde mtho shos de de ring nga tsho la rnyed byung dran/ yul mi tshos nga tsho rgya gar nas yong par brtsis te za chas sogs 'gags med bsgu ngas byung / lam bar nga gnyis gangs ngar sdudags kyi dka' ngal chen wa myangs pa'i rjes yul mi chodas nga chodar dga' bsu dang bcas khang khyim dro mo'i bde ba mnyam spyod byed bcug par ha cang dga' chodar chen po byung / yul de'i dngo na po'i rgyal sgo brgyab nas bzhag 'dug pas ngos gnyis gasku/la ba min nam snyam nas ngos gnyis kyis kyang dpon sngo/ mjal bar ma bskyod /gcig byas na dpon pos rang 'gan g.yol ba srid/ nga gnyis la bod kyi dgu na kha'i ched spyodan chas med stabs pags pa'i khyodan chas mi nyo ka med thug /de nas g.yag gcig snyadas pas de'i ched gong tshad bsgrigs skabs spar bcog gi swo nga skad la bstan bshig gad dgod la rgyun ring rol/nyi zhes dang / ha rare gyi rogs pa/ pi ṭar ab se na'i ṭar gyis bris pa'i ((bod nang lo brgyad nyi ces 78

spo rong rje dbon gyi ring lugs dang 'dzin skyong /pa 'i nang / dpal khud mtsho 'am lha mtsho srin mtsho'i skor sa khra dang bcas 'grel brjod rgyas tsam dang / spo rong sbra chen lha ra ((sbra chen ni spo rong dpon gyi bzhugs sgar red 'dug /dpon des nga tshor bzod bsran gnang ba lta bu'i snang med bzhag byung / 'dir nga cho sa cadar 'dren ched g.yag gcig dang dgun kha'i gyodan chas lug lpags nyos pa yin/nyi zhes 'kho da/11 spo rong me mchodad/ston ka bod zla da pa'i nang chos sdings su dge 'dun pa rnams nas bo lugs me mchod gcig 'bul gyi yod/ de dus sbyin sreg gi me phung nang rkang gsum/lcags sgyed kyi steng du rdza khog gcig rgyun ring bsregs te dmar ngar thon mtshams 'cham dpon gachodan pas rdza khog dang / 'cham dpon bgres pas lcags skyed phyag gis dmar 'jus kyis bteg ste rtsodam khung la balha ra ba dang bcas bo lugs me mchod gzi rngams can zhig 'bul sku la sku da/ me mchod ma phul bo nga 'cham pa tsho rgyun ri nga bsnye na pa bskyal ba dang sgrub bzhag byed dgos pa yin/ snga dus rdza lcags thengs bzhi len khyodang yod pa dgung lo 67 phebs pa'i grwa chos grags kyis gsungs don/ ji zla sngo gsum tsam ring mtshams bzhugs bsnyen pa bskyal ring bo lugs sngags gasdudag gis sngags nus chang la thims pa byed/rdza lcags len skabs lag par sngags chang byugs te lag rjen la sngags phu rgyag gin 'cham 'khrabs pa yin/ nge rjes rgyun ring mer bsregs pa'i rdza lcags de gnyis lag rjen gyis len skabs lag mthil nas tshigs sgra go ba sdu/gas kyi zhed 79

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long / snang chen po yod rung / ljid tshad ki lo 10 yod pa'i lcags sgyed de lag pa'i sbar mthil du tsog ger mi sdod par yar mar g.yo rgyugs byed kyi yod pa'i snang ba lta bu las lag pa mi tshigs/ gal te sgrub bzhag yag po ma byung ba'am/ bsnyen pa yag the/ ma 'khyedal na lag pa tshigs rgyu nyag gcig red/ spyir stangs dgon pa'i grwa pa rgan gachodan na rim gyis me mchod kyi 'cham la zhugs dgos pa yin/ 'cham dpon gnyis dbo sa pas/ bslab pa rgan pa des lcags sgyed dang bslab pa gzhon pa des rdza ma len srol yod/ skabs re grwa pa re zung nas bsnyen pa ma 'khyol pa'i dbang gis gzhan glas te grwa khral rgyug srol yod/der brten nged kyis rdza lcags thengs ma bzhi len dgos don grwa pa gzhan gyi tshab rgyugs pa yin/nyi zhes ga3/ngas/12 spo rong gi rta/spo rong rje dbon la rgyun nyar rta pho mo brgya skor dang chibs dpon gnyis yod 'dug /chibs dalnga na gnyis lnga sbra chen gyi sku nga pa bu dga'i kho ngas nas 'dems srol 'dug /gna' dus shig nas spyod rong rje dbon la pho rta'am pho chen gyi rgyud pa grags chen zhig byung ba la brten nas spo ro nga pa'i rta dang lhag par spo rong pa'i pho chen rnams spo rong khul dang sa sbrel rdzong dga' dang brag sne sogs la' nga 'gro rgyugs chen rdzo yod 'dug /der brten spo rong gi chibs dpon gnyis 7lo thob sgo chen po dang dbang shed kyang gang 'tshams byed srol yod 'dug /bshad srol zhig la/ dpal khud mtsho nas yang nas yang du mcho lug dang mtsho g.yag80

spo rong rje dbon gyi ring lugs dang 'dzin skyong /mtsho rta sogs lnga na gyi sku da par grags/ lan cig spo rong pa'i rta khyu zhig dpal khud mchorware nye 'dabs su 'asnu bzhin skabs/ lha mtsho nas mtsho rta chodan nas yul rta rnga/nga 'dres pas rte'u khyad du 'phags pa zhig skyes/ de las mched pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis spo ro/nga pa'i rta la mchos rta'i rgyud pa yin zhes yul gru gang sar grags pas khyab/ yang bshad sku la gnyis pa zhig la/ mcho rta'i rte'u mang du dgos pa'i 'asnga da rngams kyis slar rta khyu dang rte'u bcas mcho 'gram du 'tsho bar 'khrid pas/ skabs 'dir mtsho rta 'o/ chen zhig mchos nang nas thon te lag yod rte'u de'i mgo bo nas 'jus te mchod nang du khrid par grags/bod kyi rta la spu mdog sna tshogs yod pas spru mdog la gzhigs te rta'i kha mdog gi tha snyad thun mong ma yin pa mang po 'dren rgyu yod/ dper na/ ༷4 mdodag dkar mdangs can gyi gras la/ gro dkar/ bo dmar/ sngo mdangs can gyi gras la/ spyodan po/ spyod nag /ser mdangs can gyi gras la/ rag pa/rag dkar/ rag nag /rag sbug /ngang pa/ ngang dkar/ ngang smug /dmar mdangs can gyi gras la/ rkyang sngo / rkyang dmar/ rkyang dkar/ rkyang nag /zag pa/ zag dkar/ zag dmar/ zag spug /nag wa'i gras la/ sngo la ba/ tha li/grol ser/ bre ser/ ga zhur/ gra nag ting nag sogs yodad/13 dril gyi 'byung khungs/ rta dang bong bu 'brel ba las dre'u skyes/ 'di la brtsi stangs gnyis yod/ rta pho dang bong mo 'brel ba las dre'u tho log ces pa skye/ 'di gzugs chung zhing 81

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /skyes so 'gom pas na gso bcag khag /rta rgod ma dang bong pho 'brel ba las dre'u bzhon drel skye/ 'di'i skyes so ma 'gem pas gso bcag bde zhing gzugs tshad ring la bzhon 'pher ba yod/ drel gyi spu mdog gi rnam grangs ni/ drel dmar 1rware gras la mtshal mo/ mtshal dkar/ mtshal dmar/ nag po'i gras la/ sgyu ro/ga /thal rag /rgya mo / rgya mo kha dkar mig dkar mo gas yod/ drel ser warware gras la/ sha rag /ser rag mo gas yod/14 'brog las dang 'brog pa'i mi tshe/'brog ces pa'i tshig gi don ni dben pa'am lung khug la go ba yin/ der brten 'brog las ni sa steng 'dir rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i ri lung rtswa chu sogs snod kyi bkod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i dben pa'i sa khul du ker 'thod mi yis dud 'gro sems can dag sgo 'gram du bcang ste mi'i mi che'i 'tsho las snga shos shig yin/ 'asnga/ga pa tshos rang gi sgo phyugs sems can la g.yang nor zhes gces snang chen lnga sa gasku skyodang spel gsum gyi lam nas bdag gnyer byed pa yin/ de yi bdag rkyen du rang nyid la dgos pa'i kha yi zas/ lus kyi bo sa/ nang gi drod/ thab kyi bud shing / khal gyi 'or 'dren/ mtha' na rogs med la sogs dzaXn gyi phan pa len pa yin/thog mar mi'i 'gro ba 'phel skabs mi rnams chags sa'i gnas ༷/la brago phug dang / de bzhin 'tsho las byed stangs ni shing gi yal ga dang rdo sogs rjang bzhin rno ngar can gyi mtshon cha bed spyod kyis ri dwags sems can bsad de 'tsho 82

sgo rong rje dbon gyi ring lugs dang 'dzin skyong / ba bskyal ba yin/ de nas rim pas gcan gzan dang gcan gzan ma yin pa'i sems can dbye 'byed kyis rang gshis dul zhing spo 'gram du bcang bde ba'i senas can ra dang / lug /ba phyugs/ 'bri/ g.yag /mdzo/ rta/ drel la mo gas pa la sgo phyugs sems can zhes gso skyong spel gsum gyi las gzhi nas 'brog las zhes pa 'bo tshugs pa yin/ 'brog las ni zhing las ma dar gong sku da bzhin pa'i mi'i 'tsho las snga shos shig yin par brten da lo/ dus rabs nyer gcig gi nang sa steng 'di ru e yod dran rung yang 'di 'dra min/ deng gi char yang 'dzam gling 'di'i nang la las 'phrul chas rigs pa'i stobs kyis nam mkha'i zla nang du bskyod cing bar sna nga mkha' dbyings su 'phrul gyi las khungs btsugs te sa steng sbar 'og tu bsdu thub pa dang / la las ni da dung yar bltas gnam dang mar bltas sa yi bar gyi byang thang stong par sbra gur nag pos khyim byed cing rang byung nam dus dbyar dgun stodan dpyid dang bstun bzhin gnag lug sems can mnyam gnas spo zhing gna' carware mi tshe nas lha ba len bzhin la shin tu rgya khyon che ba'i 'dzam gling dum bu 'di'i sgang gzhan pa su la'ang byus gtogs med pa lta bur mi tshe'i dus 'da' mkhan yang 'dzam gling gang sar ji snyed cig yod pas na kho bo'i sems la spro ba 'phel/bod kyi 'brog las ni khyim tshang gcig gi nang byis pa bu phrug phud pa'i nang mi yongs sgyu gas la 'gan sku/da pa'i 'tsho las stabs bde zhig yin/ 'brog pa nang khul dbul phyug gi dbye ba sna chodags yod/ re 'gar dkar khri nag stong 83

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /zhes ra lug khri dang 'bri g.yag stong lo da la/ re 'ga' 'bring dang de las zhan tsam/ re 'ga' ni dbul 'o/ngas tshe gang gzhan gyi bun 'og tu 'tsho mkhan yang yod/ 'brog pa'i 'tsho las byed stangs ni nged kyi pha yul spo rong gi mi tshang 'bring lta bu zhig la mtshon na/ nang gi pha rgan gyis spyodang du gnas zin te thon skyed phyir tshong dang dbo sa mkho sgrub 'chodal mo gas mgo ston 'chong skyodang gi las 'gan zin pa yin/ sku/ so'i lnga na skyed gcig sngo min par byang nas tshwa 'asnga na pa'am yang na byang 'asnga ga nas tshwa nyos te bal yul du phyir tshong byed pa yin/ nang gi a mas khyim las dang nang mi bu phrug mo gas skyodang stangs byed/ bu rgan pa dang mna' mas gathe sa nang mi gzhan mnyam rub kyis nam dus dang bstun nas 'aX ga sa spo bzhin sems can 'tsho skyong byed/ spyir stangs lug rdzi'i mi tshe ni rgyab tu rdzi khug /sked par 'ur rdo/ lag tu yogs shing gis brgyan te/ kha nas skabs re ma ṇi 'dren pa dang skabs re 'brog glu len/ dus dang rnam pa kun tu rang nyid dang 'bral thabs med pa'i 'grogs rogs ni 'gro ba rigs drug gi nang gses dud 'gro'i rigs kyi gnag lug gnyis su byed cing / byang thang gi ri lung rtswa chu gang bzang la nyin grangs zla la 'phos/ zla grangs lor 'phos kyang dus kyi 'gyur bgrod la snang ba mi galta nga ba'i mi tshe stabs bde zhig yin/lug la g.yang dkar lug dang gnag la sgo phyugs zhes phan tshun bka' dritshon bskyangs res kyi gna' bo'i 'tsho las shig yin/ nye 'char phyi rgyal yul snyi/ra lha 'cham pa brgyud gnas tshul khyad mtshar zhig go thos la mnga' ris khul gyi 84

sgo rong rje dbon gyi ring lugs dang 'dzin skyong /'brog pa 'byor ldan re 'ga'i rdzi bo la sked du lus sbyar kha par dang rdzi khug nang lha sa'i sbi rag gi shel dam yod 'dug pa ni rmi ltas bzang ngan ji 'dra zhig yin min bdag gis mi shes/ snga dus su lug 'tsho mkhan la lug rdzi dang 'bri g.yag 'a'or+sha mkhan la g.yag pa/ rta 'a3ོ5ོ mkhan la chibs dpon zer ba yin/15 'i 'khor gcig gi 'brog las rim pa/'o/ 'kho ra gcig gi 'thodag las kyi rnam grangs nam dus bzhir bgo bas/dbyar zla gsum ni/ bod zla 4/5/6 yin/ la stod khul du phag snying zhes pa'i 'thodag pa'i dus chen gal che zhig sku da/ de'i brtsi tshul ni dbyar nyi lde ga ('o/ ltar phyi zla 6 tshes 22) rjes 'o/ga zhag 21 'dren pa dang /de rjes smal zhag 15 'dren/ smal zhag bco lnga'i ring chu bzang bar brtsi/smal zhag rdzogs rjes nam bar zhag gsum/ de nas phag zhag 7 brtsi/ phag gi nyin bzhi bar phag snying zhes spro skyid gtong srol yod/ phag snying ni lo ltar phyi zla 8 tshes 4 la 'khel ba yin/ dus chen 'di'i ring 'brog pa rnams smal chu bdugs kyi yin zer nas chu brgal ba dang / dmar bcud len gyi yin zer nas sha mar sogs kyi lho legs par g.yos pa longs su spyodacing chu rtsed dang rgyan rtsed sna tsho gas la ro/la pa'i dus chen skyid po zhig yin/dus chen 'di'i ming la/ phag snying zhes sems can phag pa'i snying la yang go ba thebs/ 'di dang 'brel ba'i gnas tshul khyad mtshar zhig dran thog tu 'dir bkod par 'aro/da pas/ snga dus shig nas bal yul du gnas 'khod stod rigs 85

'grog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /skyabs bce la pa rnams kyis ((phag snying skyid sdug nyi ces pa zhig btsugs/de'i dmigs yul ni sngar srol bzhin dbyar phag gi dus su spro skyid gtong ba dang rgyan rtsed kyi thug 'bab nas yong stod bzo rgyu red 'dug /de nas bal yul du rum gdan gyi g.yang char babs pa'i bka' drin la brten nas lo re bzhin sku nga 'bab kyang gong 'phel gyis ma rtsa chen po zin/ 'on te ga ler dus 'gyur dbang gis phag snying skyid sdug la yong mi nyung du song khar rgyan rtsed la'ang mi mos mkhan mang po byung rkyen 'o/ shas shig nas de sngon rgyan rtsed kyis bsags pa'i phag snying skyid sdug gi ma rtsa bal sgor 'bum bcad lnga 15 tsam zhig yod pa de 7gong sa masnu ga la 'bul thag bcad de skyid sdug gi mdzad gtso rnam pa kha shas bzhugs sgar du bcar te gzim chung mjal kha thob/ de nyin gzim chung du gnas tshul khyad mtshar zhig byung bar grags/ skyid 3skyog nas 7gong sa mchog la bstan 'gro'i don du sku tshe yun ring brtan pa'i gsol 'debs kyi snyan zhu de phag snying skyid sdug gi las shog rdzig po de'i nang gzigs ma thag 7rgyal ba rin po che'i thugs snang ((phag snying gi zhes pa'i tshig don khyad mtshar de gzigs ma thag zhal 'dzum dang bcas phag snying zer ba'i brjod don gang ngam zhes bka' rtsad gnang skad/ de nyin phag snying skyid sdug gi gtso drag khongs skar rtsis la sbyang pa can gcig kyang med stabs 7rgyal ba'i thugs kyi bzhed dodan bskangs ma gib par dus da lta'ang de mur lus yod par grags/ tshobazhon drangs gtong dus/ dbyar bod zla 4 ba'i nang 'brog pa tsho dbyar 86

sgo rong rje dbon gyi ring lugs dang 'dzin skyong /sa zin nas ma mo dang lu gu kha 'phral gyis lhas dbye 'byed nang bcug pa yin/skabs 'dir dkar chu 'jo ba'i las dus yin pas snga dro'i 'o ma thengs gcig kyang ba dang nyin gang ma mo dang lug gu mnyam bsres kyis lug gur 'o ma 'thung baX/ga pa 6spun/skam rdzi/ ma rdzi/ dbyar mjug bod zla 5/6 pa nang lu gu dang pho lug mnyam bsres kyis zur du 'tsho ba yin pas 'di la ((skam rdzi nyi zer ba dang ma mo kho na dbye ste zur du 'tsho bar ((ma rdzi nyi zer ba yin/ ma rdzi'i skabs snga dro'i 'o ma bzhos pa'i khar ((bro bskor ba nyi zhes ma khyu nyin gung gur sar bkugs te so/ ma 'jo ba bcas nyin rer so/ ma thengs gnyis 'jo ba yin/pho lug sha gcod pa'am bya byed pa/ dbyar mjug bod zla 6 pa'i nang skar ma smal shar ba'i dus su/ g.yag g.ya'u dang / lug phrug la ga /re zung phud 'bras bu bton pa'am sha gcod byed pa'i dus yin/ sha gcod byed po la ((ya bo gi zhes nus khungs zhan pa brtsi ba yin/ sha gcod kyi nam dus skabs gnod pa yong thodags kyis gsang rgya chen pos dkar chu phyi la mi gtong ba dang phyi nas 'grul ba mi len pa sogs byed srol yod/ dacadas 'brel gnas tshul 'di 'dra yin te/ lug pho'i 'bras bu bshags gathe da kyis 'don dus skabs re ya cad tshos rang gi lag cha mo gas gtsang sbra 'phrod bsten ma byung ba'i rkyen gyis rma kha la gnyan kha btags nas rkyen ngan 'phrad kyi sku/da par 'alnge/ga pa chosas gcadad par rtsis pa min nam snyam/ 'bras bu blta na pa ya thod chorware thob thang du nyar nas chu la btsos te za ba yin/87

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /bal 'breg dus/ dbyar bod zla 6 pa'i nang lug khyu yongs rdzogs chu brgal bar 'khrid pa yin/ de rjes lug gi bal 'breg pa yin/ lug 'o/ dang lug gu'i bal 'breg pa yin/ ma mo dang tsher morware bal 'breg gi med/ lug gu'i bal la ((yul spu gnyi zhes reg la 'jam zhing 'od mdangs che bas na mi drag tshos bed spyod gtong ba'i phyu ba spu phrug ces bzo rgyu'i rgyu cha de yin/ston zla ba gsum ni/ bod zla 7/8/9 rtsu rnga byed pa'i dus yin/ dbyar kha'i char chu'i rjes spo rong pa'i rtswa thang spyi dang lhag par dpal khud thang gshongs kyi rgya khyon mu mtha' med pa lta bur rang bzhin skyes rtswa phi ṭi gnyis brgal ba'i rtswa thang rtswa rnga byed pa'i nam dus yin/ rngas rtswa chag dum ste ((rtsib sgo nyi brgyab nas 'asnga ga pa sku morware rtswa khang ngam yang na khang sgyu ga tu dgun kha'i ched gamo ga 'alnga ga byed pa yin/ rtswa rnga'i yul gzhas 'di 'dra zhig yod/ dpal khud thang gi gshongs gasna ngas/ g.ya'u la yi sgang sgang / bdag dang g.yag 'u mo ga chung /sgrib pa sbyong sa yin ce //ston chung / thug po gtong dus/ ston kha bod zla 7/8/9 ma mo la thug po gtong ba'i nam dus yin/ la las tsher mo la'ang thug sngo gtong sredal sku da kyang tsher mo'i lu gu la tsher phyag ces phran bu zhan pa brtsi sku la yod/ de dus gnam gshis tsha ༷ da che zhing skabs re nad gzhi lang gi yod/ 'brog pa'i kha rgyun la/ lha na tshad rag pas mi gasdudad/ dpyid chu sngo mo sa rta gamo da/ ces dang / sbrang ma ston sprong kha tsha/ rang la rag bde med par/ mi la a tsha 'bur lha na/ zhes sku/gas nam 88

sgo rong rje dbon gyi ring lugs dang 'dzin skyong /dus kyi khyad chos 'dren pa'i bshad srol 'di 'dra yang 'dugadagun zla ba gsum ni/ cadad zla 10/11/12 bcu gcig sa 'gad/ bcu gnyis rdo 'gad/ ces gnam gshis shin tu grang /bshas dus/ dgun dus ྅ged zla 10/11 nang bshas dus 'khel ba yin/grong pa che chung la gzhigs nas so/ so'i 'o/ 'kho ra gcig la malho byed kyi sha de nyin dus gcig la bshan pa'i lag nas bsad de gasku ga 'jog byed pa yin/ grong pa che bas lug 100 dang g.yag 4/5 bshas dus skabs gsod pa yin/ dgun sa zin dus/ dgun dus sems can dgun sa zin pa yin zhes sa bhecil dro sar 'bebs pa yin/ skabs 'dir sems can gcong po re zung dang rta drel sogs ma galta gas gzhan tshang ma rang bzhin gyi rtswa chu las lag pas gasdu/ 〈snal med/dpyid zla ba gsum ni/ bod zla 1/2/3 ring lug gu slog dus zhes lug phrug skyes pa'i dus yin/ lug phrug gi mngal yun ni zla ba gsum yin/dbyar dus nas rtswa kha bzang ba'i sa dmigs spyodan 'gog bgyis pa ((bkag rtswa'am shis rtswa nyi zhes pa'i sa khul du ma mo dang tsher mo rnams gso nyar gyis lug gu skyes bcug pa yin/ las dus 'di la lug gu slog pa'i las dus zer ba yin/ lug gu skyes rjes zla ngo gnyis tsam ring ma mo dang lug gu mnyam sbyar gyis 'o ma lug gur 'thung bcug pa yin/ de rjes bod zla 4/5/ca dbyar zla gsum ring 'o ma 'jo ba yin/89

'grog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long 16 sems can gyi lo tshad brtsi stangs dang lo tshad dang 'brel ba'i tha snyad gyi rnam grangs/sems can gyi lo tshad la gzhigs te thun mong ma yin pa'i tha snyad kyi rnam grangs mang po 'dren rgyu yod pas dper na/ spo rong khul gyi 'brog pas brtsi srol ni/lug phrug skyes 'o/nga ma la/ lug gu zer/zla drug lon pa'i lug gu la/ la ga zer/lo gcig lon pa'i la ga pho/ so chen gnyis ldan la thong pa zer thong pa'i lo tshad lon mtshams khal do 'or 'dren byed/lo gcig lon pa'i la ga mo/ so chen gnyis ldan la tsher mo zer tsher mo'i lo tshad lon mtshams lug phrug skyes thub/lo gnyis lon pa'i thong pa/ so chen bzhi ldan la gnyid pa zer/lo gnyis yon pa'i tsher mo/ so chen bzhi ldan la gnyid ma zer/lug mo la ma mo zer /'bras bu ma bton pa'i 'o/ lug la thug po'am pha lug zer/lugo la kha mdog mang po yod pos/ phol che ba dkar po dang la la nag po/ la la bra dmar/ la la snga chur sags yad/17 'bri g.yag gi rnam grangs/ 1 rte'abri g.yag dang mdzo mo ba phyugs bcas pa'i phyugs rigs la gnag brjode pa yin/ de bzhin nag kyang brjod srol 'dug /'brog pa 'byor ldan kha shas la 90

spo rong rje dbon gyi ring lugs dang 'dzin skyong /dkar khri nag stong gi bdag wa zhes lug khri dang gnag stong gi bdag wa yin par go ba yin/ g.yag ni 'o/ gnag dang 'bri mo gnag yin/ 'bri la be'u skye ba dang 'o smyo pre sprad pa yin/ g.yag ni do wa 'or 'dren dang skabs re bzhon g.yag kyang byed srol yod/ lo tshad kyi rnam grangs 'dren tshul ni 'di ltar ste /'bri phrug la/ be'u slog zer/so chung brgyad par/ 'o/ gcig lon pa pho la ya ru dang / mo la rdung ma zer/so chen gnyis mar/ lo gnyis 'o/na par/ mo la bya ma zer/so chen bzhi mar/ 'o/ gsum 'o/na par/ mo la ltag ma zer/so chen drug mar/ 'o/ bzhi 'o/na par/ mo la drug ma zer/so chen brgyad par/ lo lnga sku la/ kha gang zer/'bri g.yag gnag lug sogs la mal sku can gyi sems can zer/ 'di rigs la yar so med/ rta drel wa nga bu sogs la yar so mal so gnyis ldan gyi sems can yin/ mal sku can rnams 'o/ ngo bzhi 'o/na pa'am mo chen brgyad kyis kha gang na kha gang zer ba yin/ rta drel sogs kyi lo tshad brtsi stangs la/ kha rgyun du /bzhi ba sha sna ga gris bcad 'dra zhes lo bzhi 'osten mtshams yar sku bzhi dang mal so bzhi bo cha tshang skyes te mo gral gris bcad pa lta bu lha mas so/ de rjes lnga ba dbu ma'i mtha' nas yal/ zhes 'o/ lnga 'o/na mtshams dbus sduda'am dkyil sku nas brtsis pa'i g.yas gasku na yar mal gyi mtha' zur bzhi nas mo gral rim bzhin nyams 'gro ba bcas 'o/ tshad kyi tha snyad bgrang stangs yin/ kha gang rjes 91
sgro (rngo /rgyad/(lo gcig)

spo rong rje dbon gyi ring lugs dang 'dzin skyong /〈snags ) g.yag khyu yi bang mgo 'khrid mkhan la g.yag khyu pa'am/ lam pa yang zer/ g.yag gi gtam dpe kha shas ni/ mi mtshungs rta g.yag mabosgo sbrel/ g.yag chad gcig gis g.yag chad brgya/ tshig pa g.yag la bzas nas rdog rgyag be'u la gzhus/ g.yag gis chu 'thung ma 'asnga/da na/ gnya' nas mnan pas ci la phan/g.yag rgan gyis gdang 'tsho ma zin na/ gdang gi sked pa 'khyodag nyen yod/18 'bri g.yag gi 'brog las/ dbyar bod zla lnga pa'i nang 'bri la be'u 'am/ be'u log kyang brjod pa skyes mgo tshugs/ be'u skyes rjes nyin zhag bco lnga'i rjes nyin gang ma bos rang 'grigs dang mtshan la ma bes kha phral gyis be'u zur du gdang la btags te 'askru ga pa yin/de dus snga dro 'o ma bzho ba yin/ 'bri yi cad ma'i thodan tshad ni bzlo thengs rer li ṭar 3 nas 4 bar yin 'dug /gnag lug gi 'o ma bzhos rjes zho rtsi blugs te zho bsnyal/ zho de rkyal pa'i nang dkrog ste mar 'don/ mar bton rjes kyi khu ba la da ra zer/ da ra bskol te tsher bton/ tsher skam po la phyu ra zer/ phyu ra bton pa'i khu ba la phyur khu zer/ bod kyi phyu ra la sna tshogs yod/ phyur zhib ni rtsam pa 'dra/ phyur zhib dang mar bsres te thud zhes pa'i zhim zas bzo ba yin/ phyur zhib dang rtsam pa mar bcas bsres pa'i na nga ja thang tsha bo blugs pa'i stabs bde'i zas la/ ja ldur/ zhes bod mi phal che ba'i snga dro'i lto dus su longs spyod pa yin/ phyur dog la bzo lta dang ro bcud sna tshogs sku da / kha shas gru bzhi dang kha shas nar nar/ kha shas zod mngar mo dang 93

'grog sde chen po slo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /kha shas ro skyur mo/ phyur rdog ni rgya gar ba phal che bas kha nang mur gyin snga ba len pa'i shing 'bras ((su pa ri nyi lta bu nam byung kha nang du mur gyin za ba'i chodar zas shig yin/ 'asnga ga khul du phyur khu la mthodang med/ sems can 'bri g.yag sogs kyis 'thung pa yin/ de 'a'o/sa bdag med 'phang pa yin/ nged rang chung dus su dga' bo byed sa'i 'brog zas (jil bo gi zhes pa zhis/ yod/de ni da ra bskol ba'i zas shig la zer/ da ra 'khol ma'i kha steng du phyu ra rlon pa'am tsher sdings shing rlangs drod 'tshub 'tshub kyi nang mar dang skabs re bye kur blub/sa/ de'i nang rtsam pa blugs pa'i zas la zer/ zas 'di'i khyad chos ni ro bcud ldan pa'i tsha zas stabs bde yin pa ma zad rgan gzhon so can so med sus zos kyang 'thus/ za rgyu yang mo da la 'thung rgyu yang yod pa'i 'ango ga zas shig yin/ 'dir legs par g.yos pa'i la phra thodab/ la ngo bzhes la phebs/19 spo rong pa'i 'brog h+phu/ dbyar wa phag rdzing dus 'bri 'jo dka'/ /de dus a ce shi yong dran/ /ma shi khyar khyodar byung na bsam/ /bzho rdo chang rkyal kha ༷༅ba 'dra/ /nu ma rgya gling cha bzhi 'dra/ /bzho shes na 'o ma'i rgya mtsho yin/ /ma shes mthe 11re gnya' gce/na yin/ /'bri bzho stangs a ces bachod bzho byed/ /mgo ltag pa gnyis ngo dgye tsam byed/ /rgyab sog pa gnyis po 'aro/ngas tsam byed/ /mdun pus mo gnyis rta po rug tsam byed/'bri la bstod pa'i 'brog glu/94

spo rong rje dbon gyi ring lugs dang 'dzin skyong / brla rtsid brag ri kha sbyor 'dra/ /rnga ma dar phud spungs pa 'dra/ /ze ma la btsas gsol ba 'dra/ /mabo bo tshe dbang bum pa 'dra/ /rwa cad mar las bzhengs pa 'ang/ am cog rgyal ba rigs lnga 'dra/ /sne phrul dar cadag tshon lnga 'dra/ /mig ril nag kha pad lta ga 'dra/ /zi ma rgya khab btsugs/ pa 'dra/ /sna khung bre ser 'brong dang 'dra/ /mid pa 'gag chen 'gag dzam+bing la/ /og btags khra chen khra chung yod/ /phyi ru khyu yi mdzes rgyan yin/ /nang du a ce'i nor phud yin//skye khyo kha'i mi la skyid gsum dgos/ /rta bo lo sha kha yag na skyid/ /g.yag pho g.yag gdang thag ring na skyid/ /tshong rgya tshong gter kha legs na skyid/ /'bru dkar mo 'bru snye ring na skyid/ dman bu mo'i lus la skyid gsum dgos/ /tshe gtan grogs kha zer ring na skyid/ 'bri zar mo gdang thag ring na skyid/ /skyes bu phrug skyes kha legs na skyid/zho dasnartog 〉kyi/gru ze mar gyi rkyal pa/ gru thag g.yag ༷/ sum bsgril/zho dkar nyag gad snyadag gad/gru ze'i nang du blugs yod/chu gcig dang po blugs dus/ mar chung dpung gdang shig shigachu gcig gnyi sa pa glugs dus/

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /mar ril ngang rkyal rog rogamar gyis goyas boskor rgyabo sna gad ras g.yan bskar rgyab shagazangs chen ru lung nang du/tshang tshang rub nub 'dzoms shogaza ru ber shing dmar wa sa/mar chags thag skad rgyab shagamar glu/'bri lpags gtsang ma'i nang du/mor gyi do chung brgyab yod/da 〈peng g.yag la bkal nas/lha sa'i phyogs la bskyod song /jo bo shākya mu ge'i/gser gyi mchod kodang bkang mo nga /'di phyi bsam don 'grub pa'i/spyodan lam tshig gsum brgyab yod/20 'brog sde khul du gna' dus nas dar ba'i rgyang tshad 'dzin stangs/ ( 1 sor gang / sor mo'i zheng tshad/2 sen gang / sen sne nas mtheb tshigs bar/96

skyo rong rje dbon gyi ring lugs dang 'dzin skyong 3 mkhrid gang / mtheb rtse nas mdzub chung gi rtse bar/4 rdzogs gang / lag pa rdzogs mo sgongs pa'i mtheb rtse bar/5 mtho gang / mtheb rtse nas gung mo'i rtse bar/ 6 bskums khru gang / gru mo'i sne nas lag sor bskums pa'i khu tshu ra gyi dkyil mthil bar/7 brkyangs khru gang / gru mo'i sne nas gung mo'i rtse bar/8 mda' tshad ma/ mda' gang gi tshad/9 'dom phyed/ lag pa ya gcig brkyangs pa snying kha nas mdzub rtse bar/10 'dom gang / lag gnyis brkyangs pa'i mdzub rtse gnyis bar/11 mi tshad ma/ mi'i gzugs po'i tshad/12 skad rgyang gang / rgyang grags gcig /rna cog gi go thub pa'i ring tshad/13 mig rgyang gang / mig gis malnga nga thub pa'i rgyang tshad/14 mi tshugs gcig /mis nyin gang gcig gom babo/da kyis chodad pa'i rgyang tshad/15 rta tshugs gcig /rta batshuṭan nyin gang gcig gi sa/((lag pa'i sor mo lnga ni/ mthe bong / mdzub mo/ gung mo/ srin lagamathe'u chung /sor mo'i grangs 'bor mtho dang khru 'dom bcas rim bzhin gong du bsgril ba ste dper na/ sor brgyad bcu ni 'dom med khru gsum mtho med sor brgyad yod ga ces brtsi srol yod/

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /4 gdan sa chen po spo rong dpal mo chos sdings/bstan pa'i bdag po dpal ldan bo dong pa/ /gangs ri'i khrod du zab mo'i chos sgra sgrogs/ /'khor los sgyur ba dbyangs can dga' ba'i dpal/ /'jigs med grags pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes mchod par bcadad pa sngo na du btang nas skabs don gsol rgyu/ phyi 'orware dus rabs bcu gcig gi stod du sa/nyan lo sem ba dar ma grags pas rgya gar nas mkhan chen 'bum phrag ga3/ma pa (bya khri17ba'i/7) gdan drangs/ gtsang phyogs su zhabs bcags te phyi 'o/ 1049lor dase bshes mu tra chen podzes bo dong du phyag btab pa'i dgon chung de mkhan chen gyis dgon chung du mi sdod dgon chen gyur ro zhes dgon chung der chos grwa chen po bo dong e gsar du gtod/ bo dong chos 'byung gsal byed sgron me las/ skabs der bla ma'i mtshan la jo bo thob pa gnyis te/ rdzo bo a ti sha dang jo bo 'bum phrag gsum pa/ dgon pa'i ming la chos grwa thob pa gnyis las med de/ chos grwa gsang phu dang / chos grwa chen po bo dong e zhes bya ba yin no/ /dus de nas gdan sa 'dir mkhan rabs rin chen gyi 'phreng ba ltar byon pa nas/grags can re zung smros na/ dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa sku gas bo dong khu dbon rim byon dang / rgyal sras thogs med bzang sngo dang bla ma dam pa badzadad nams rgyal mtshan sogs khyad du 'phags pa'i mkhan rim nas mched pa'i nang gses phyi lo 1375 'o/ra sku bltams pa'i kun mkhyen bo dong pa'am bo dong 98

gdan sa chen cad spo rong dpal mo chos sdings/pa r+ṇa chen 'jigs bral khyodags las rnam rgyal zhes mtshan snyan phyogs bcur khyab pa gang gis phyag btab pa'i gdan sa spo rong dpal mo chos sdings 'di bzhin go drong sa khul dpal khud mtsho'i nye 'dabs su 'khod yod pa ma zad rje dbon ༷ rgyal 'bum dang rje de nyid phebs dus mtshungs/ rje dbon nam mkha' rngo rje'i skabs paṇa chen nyid kyi snag gcig rje dbon gyi bdag mor ba zhes te gdung sras bltams pa nas bzung rje daX na zhes pa'i tha snyad thogs par grags/ 'jigs bral chen po'i dus su rang khongs chos sde lnga yod de/ sgrub gnas dpal mo chos sdings/ shel dkar mngon dga' chos sde / gung thang rdzong dkar cos sde/ mnga' ris nya ma mngon dga'/ nub ris rta sga dgon bcas so/ /rje rang nyid kyis phyag btab pa'i gdan sa dpal mo chos sdings su gling lngas mtshon pa'i dgon sde yod de/ gsang sngags bde chen gling dang / sgrub sde bsam gtan gling / bshad grwa chos 'khor gling / dung sgra mthong sme na gli nga / btsun dgon sgrol ma gling bcas mdo sngags bshad sgrub kyi lhe gnas ma tshang ba med pa lta bu byung yod/ chos sdings rang du dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya skor yod pa yig rnying nang gsal/ rje nyid kyi rjes rim pas dar gud sna tshogs byung bas phyis su spo rong rje dbon gyi mnga' khongs su dgon ma lag bcu bzhi sku da rung phal che ba ser khyim lta bu las 'dul ba'i bstan pa chodas sdings dang mngon dga'/btsun dgon sgam mchog tsam las ma lhag /rgyas pa zur du gzigs/bo dong chos brgyud pa'i grwa rgyun dang btsun rgyun 'dzin skyong ched grwa khral dang 99

'brog sde chen po skyo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /btsun khral gyi 'gro lugs 'di ltar te/ dpal mo chos sdings dgon pa'i ched/g.ya' la yan nas bu gsum bar pa'i grwa khral yod/ shel dkar chos sde ra grwa khral 25 yod pas yong khungs ni zur mtsho khul gyi grong pa drag gras yin/mngon dga' chos sde'i grwa khral yong khungs ni bod gzhis khag lnga dang dpal smyo byang gnyis 'then pas tsho drug gi bu gsum bar pa yin/ btsun ma yongs khungs ni spo rong btsun dgon dang sgam mchog btsun dgon gnyis la g.ya' la yan nas bu mo gsum gyi bar ma dang sgam mchog tu dzad rong rje dbon gyi sras mo bar ma phebs dbo sa kyi yod/ de min btsun dgon gzhan gyi btsun khral bod gzhis khag nas sku nga / 'dir bo dong chos rgyun gyi grwa rgyun dang btsun rgyun skyodang stangs dang bo lugs dus mchod srung brtsi byed srol sogs dang 'a brel ba'i lo rgyus stong min tsam zhig gleng ba las 'jigs bral chen po dang gang gis mdzad pa'i rgya che zhing gting zab pa'i chos rgyun skor khungs gzhan du gzigs par zhu/4 1 chos sdings dgon pa'i gnas bshad/dgon ming sngo gas tshul/ yig rnying phal che ba'i nang 'jigs bral chen pos chos sdings su phyag btab pa'i gling lngas mtshon pa'i gdan sa'i mtshan la dpal mo chos sdings zhes gsal/ gdan sa chags yul rnyedab dasngo na chen po'i dus nas yongs grags dpal khud mtsho dang dpal mo thang gi dbu thod du 'khod yod starbes dpal mo zhes pa'i mtshan gasdudal ba min nam snyam/ phyis su chos sdings zhes 100

gdan sa chen po spo rong dpal mo chos sdings/yul ming du 'bod pa 'di'ang 'jigs bral chen pos dpal mo chos sdings zhes dgon ming gasdudal ba nas gyar bar macadan/ phyis kyi yig cha khag 'ga'i nang pad+ma chos sdings sam/ pad+ma chos gling sogs kyang 'khod 'dug pa ni yi ger sbyang ji/ chung dbang dpal snang zhes pa pad+mar ngag rgyun du 'jags pa zhig min nam snyam/de bzhin gling lngar grags pa'i chos sde khag gi dgon ming 'bod tshul yang brag dkar bas mdzad pa'i 'bur ba'i gdung rabs dang ngag rgyun gnyis cung zad mi mtshungs/ nged rang lpo rong du lta skor thengs gnyis bskyod skabs gong gsal dgon shul khag gnas mjal zhu ba dang chabs cig 'chos bzhugs dge 'dun pa bgres gras dang yul mi tsho la dgon shul skor 'dri rtsad zhu rgyu'i go skabs bzang po thob byung/ gling lngar grags pa'i chos sde lnga ni rigs gsum mgon po mtshon pa'i ri rtse gsum gyi mtshams su phan tshun skad rgyang kha shas kyi nang tshun 'khod 'dug /bshad grwa bde chen gling dang sgrub sde bsam gtan gling gnyis rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs rtsa brlag tu song ba dang de byings snga dus shig nas nyams gud kyis gyang ro zhe gcig red/ deng sang gi gnas stangs ni/ snga dus bshad grwa bde chen gling gi shul der dge 'dun zhal grangs bcu tsam gyi dgon chung stong min zhig slar gso mdzad 'dug /gling lngar grags pa'i chos sde khag ni gyang ro zhe gcig las ma lhag /gyang ro/ khag mjal mod sems la dga' skyo'i tshor snang gnyis 'char bas/ gyang ro de mos gna' dus bo dong pa'i mnga' thang dang nyams bzang khra lhem mtshon thub pas dga' ba rgyas kyang deng gi ya nga ba'i gnas 101

'brog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /stangs ni klo pham skyed gzhir gyur/ nged rang gnas mjal bskyod skabs sa gnas su 'dri rtsad kyis ngag rgyun gyi gling lnga 'di ltar ste / 1 bshad grwa bde chen gling / 2 sgrub sde bsam gtan gling / 3 gong thang 'phrul 'khor gling /4 ar+ya thar pa gling / 5 chos bzang sgrol ma gling / bcas dang / de'i khar rdo rje phag mos bzhengs par grags pa'i dung sgra mthong sme na gling zhes pa zhig yod 'dug pa'i byung shul ni chos sdings ri ldebs kyi rgyab ngos su mjal rgyu yod 'dug/chos sdings kyi gnas bshad mdor tsam gleng bar bya ba ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa 'chi med 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i bo dong chos 'byung las/ bod yul dbus dang mtha' 'khob kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtha' dag 'dus nas/ lnga sa bsam dang sgom sgrub la nan tan du byed kyi 'jig rten mi chos dang 'khor g.yog dang longs spyod dodan du gnyer ba ni shin tu nyung ste / rje thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang / 'jig rten gyi spros pa chen po la rgyab kyi phyogs te/ dpal mo chos sdings zhes bya/ skye bo dag gis bgrod par dka' ba der bsti gnas mdzad de bzhugs pa yin no/ /zhes 'jigs bral chen po dgung 'o/ sku lngar phebs mtshams phyi 'o/ 1410 'o/ra 'jig rten zang zing gi khrod nas yol te dben gnas su dpal mo chodas sdings phyag btab par bshad/ de bzhin dus rabs bcu bdune pa'i nang spo rong rje dbon nam mkha' dpal bzang gis chos sdings ri ldebs su bzhengs pa'i the sna sa gnas bshad khag gnyis mjal rgyu 'dug pas/ gnas 102

gdan sa chen po spo rong dpal mo chos sdings/bshad gcig gi nang / gling gi mchog gyur lho phyogs 'dzam bu'i gling / kha ba can zhes rdo rje gdan gyi byang / /lha chos rwa ba spu rgyal bod kyi yul/ /spyan rab gzigs dbang gdul bya'i zhing gyur ba/ /ru bzhi'i nang nas la stod lho yi khul/ /sku yi gnas mchog gangs dkar ti me'i shar/ /gsung gi gnas mchog la phyi chu dbar byang / /rtsa ri phag gdong thu ga sa kyi gnas kyi nub/ /gdan sa chen po pad+ma chos sdings na/ /rgyab ri rigs gsum mgon po 'dra ba'i mdun//g.yas na sgrub pa rnam dag bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /gasku na na chu snga dar dkar rkyong di 'dra/ /mdun gyi ri bo maṇ+ḍal phul ba 'dra/ /zhes dang / yang rdo rkos gnas bshad gzhan zhig las/ e ma lha / /gling las mchog gyur lho phyogs 'dzam gling 'dir/ /thub pa'i bstan pa mchog tu dar ba'i gnas/ /gangs ri rwa bas bsko ra ba'i zhing khams 'dir/ dpal gyi 'byung gnas dpal mo thang gi dbus/skal bzang mos pa'i rnam sprul bo dong pa'i/ /byang chub mchog brnyes mngon pa/ra byin rlabs pa'i/ /mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i pho brang chos kyi mdzod/ /sdings nas 'bur du dod pa cad mtshar che/ /chodas sdings bde chen rgyal ba'i gnas mchog der/ /rigs sngags 'chang ba grub pa'i dbang phyug che/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa ngur smrig zlos gar 'dzin/ zhes chags rabs gsal bar bshad/ dgung lo 89 son pa'i 'tsho bzhugs dkon gnyer ngag dbang gis gsung don/ rgyab ri rigs gsum mgon po brtsi stangs ni/ /rgyab kyi ri gsum rigs gsum mgon po ste/ /dbus su dung dkar mdog ldan spyan ras gzigs/ /g.yas 10 3

'grog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /su gur kumo mdog ldano 'jal dpal dbyangs/ /g.yon du gnam lcags mdog ldan phyag rdar bcas sa//yang dpal mo chos sdings dgon par bstod pa phul ba'i spo rong gi yul gzhas kyi gzhas tshig nang / e ma ho/ /'di nas bltas pa'i nyi ma'i shar khyedags na/ /dbo na gzhis ya gi rgya thodag dkar chung 'dra/ /rab gsal ya gi gser gyi pa tra 'dra/ /gser gyi pa tra'i gseng la bltas zer na/ /'o re'i rtsa ba'i bla ma bzhugs nyams 11/ /'jigs bral phyogs las rnam rgyal bzhugs nyams ljo /zhes 'khod pa ni mnga' ris chos rgyal gyis 'jigs bral chen po'i ched bzhings par grags pa'i gzim chung dkar mo'i balha da pa min nam snyam/ gang lags zer na/ bo dong dgon pa phal che ba'i chos mdog rang tsho sa dmar po red 'dug pas/ sgrub sde bsam gtan gling gi thod du bzhengs pa'i 'jigs bral gyi gzim chung gi mdodag dkar wa yin pa gzim khang dkar po zhes pa'i tha snyad rang nas shes thub/ de mtshungs 'brog pa spo rong pa sho rtsed la dar bzo che bas/ yu la mi tshos sho rtsed skabs chos sdings zhes pa'i sgra gdangs nas drangs te sho bshad khyad mtshar zhig rgyag gi 'dug pa ni/ lha mig bcu pa la chu dang / bdun pa la ding 'es pa nas drangs te/ chu ding / zhes 'bod srol gyi sho bshad/ chu ding dgon pa'i nyams bzang la/ dbyar skyid po chu ding gi nyams bzang la/ nyes chos sdings khul gyi dbyar kha'i nam dus la bstod bsngags kyi sho bshad cig te/ sgo rong khul gyi dbyar kha'i gnam gshis dang yul ldongs kyi mdzes sdug 104

gdan sa chen po spo rong dpal mo chos sdings/ni/ gangs ri dkar po bla zhwa gnam la reg /rdza ri sbug po pad+ma'i do shal sbrags//spangs gasna/ngas bde mo mchod gdan bting pa la/ /mtsho chen mtsho chung sku na chab phul ba yin/ /dpal khud thang gshongs mu mtha' med pa la/ /ri'u chen ri'u chung maṇ+ḍal phul ba 'dra/ /g.yang chags ri bo sman rdzas g.yogs pa la/ /spu khra legs pa'i sems can 'khor se 'khor/ /zhes gang thos gang mthong gi gnas bshad mdor bsdus 'di bzhin 'dir rdzogs so// (zur du gna' dus bo dong pa'i mnga' thang dang deng dus nyam nga'i gnas stangs legs par mtshon pa'i ris mo dang 'dra dpar mnyam bsdur gyis bsgrigs pa zhig deb 'di'i nang yod pas dgyes su gasku la/ )4 2ོchos sdings dgon pa'i lha khang khag gi rnam grangs dang nang rten gyi chod gzhung bkad par/lo mang dgon pa'i dkon gnyer gyi las sne pa/ dgung lo 88 thebs pa'i dkon gnyer ngag dbang gi dran tho/ chos sdings dgon pa ru gsham gsal lha khang rnams yod/ lha khang khag gi chags yul dang dbo na pa'i chags rabs ri mo dang lhan du gzigs na legs rtsodags yong nges/lha khang yongs kyi gtso bo/ 1 lha khang dmar mo'am kha rgyun du lha khang ma mo'ang zer/ de'i steng du/ da gser gdung lha khang bzhugs/ de'i rgyab ngos bar thog tu bar thog lha khang yod/ lha khang ma mo dang de'i steng gi gser gdung lha khang gnyis 105

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long / kyi mdun ngos su 3 gsung chodas ra ba'am bde yangs yod/ lha khang ma mo'i rgyab ngos ྅/ 4 'jigs bral mun mtshams zhes mtshams khang chung ngu zhig sku/da/de'i steng du 5 lha khang dkar mo bzhugs/ de'i steng du 6 bar thog lha khang sku da/ bar thog lha khang gi steng du 7 ye shes mchod rten thog tshad gsum ldan la steng du gser zangs kyi rgya phibs gzi brjid ldan par rgya phibs gyi sne zur la rlung dril chung ngu mang du sbrags pa'i skad sgra snyan po gang sar khyab pa yod/ mdun lngaras su gser zangs las grub pa'i galjir dang gser tog /phyogs bzhir g.yag tri〉da kyis btums pa'i thug bcas yod/ 'di bar lha khang dmar sna() khongs gtogs yin/ lha khang dmar mo'i g.yon ngos su da skyod sbyar zhes sbra chen gnyer pa dang mi mang 'dzoms yul gyi tshogs khang zhig yod pas de'i steng du 9 gzim chung rtse zhes pa'i lha khang chung ngu zhig dang de'i thog steng du 10 tshe ring ma'i lha tshugs shig yod/ skyid sbyor dang sbrel nas 11 gnas bcu lha khang dang de sbrel 12 dgon pa'i rung khang yod/ gnas bcu lha khang dang dang rung khang gnyis bde yangs la gtad sku da/ 13 lha khang dmar mo'i g.yas ngos su ma ṇi lag skor lha khang zhig sku da/ lha khang dmar mo'i mdun ngogs su spo rong rje dbon gyi gzim chung dang lha khang khag bzhi yod/ khul 'di la 14 bde chen rab rgyas brjod pa yin/ bde chen rab rgyas kyi 'og tu sa 'og nas gsang lam zhig yod pa de dmag dus skabs 'thung chu len sa'i gsang lam yin par grags/ de'i steng 15 gsar khang lha khang dang 16 skal bzang lha khang gnyis bzhugs/ de gnyis kyi steng du 106

gdan sa chen po spo rong dpal mo chos sdings/17 zhal gro khang zhes mdzod khang gcig dang de'i steng du 18 bka' 'gyur lha bang bzhugs/ thog tshad 'di nas stod dkar po zhes pa brgyud pa'i rgya ba ngos su 19rnga//can khung bzhugs/ mgon khang dang thog mnyam gyi ngos su 20 gzim chung dpa la 'dzoms 'khod/ gzim chung dpal 'dzoms kyi steng du spo rong spyi ba'i 21sanyer tshang yod/ de'i rgyab tu 22 spo rong gzhung rkyang gi mdzod khang yod/ de'i rgyab ngos su thog tshad dgu'i mkhar/ 23 mkha' spyod/ ces pa zhig yod/ mkha' sgrod kyi yang rtser 24 bod kyi brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi sku mkhar yod/ de'i 'og tu lha khang zhig sku da pa'i rten gtsor 25 'jigs bral shangs khrag ma zhes/ 'jigs bral chen po bsnyun pa'i shangs khrag las bzos pa'i bla sku byin can zhig dang de min sku gzhan mang po yod/ de'i 'og gi khang mig yongs rdzogs 26 spo rong rje dbon gyi bang mdzod yin/ 'dir gna' dus nas bsags pa'i dngos rnying rtsa che ba'i gser dngul zangs lcags sogs nor bu'i rigs dang dar gos chen rdog sgril la sogs gos kyi rigs dang / dmag chas dang rta chas/ rgyal gzhas kyi 'khrab chas sogs chas gos kyi rigs/ dmag 'khrug skabs nas za 'bru bkar bcug gis phyis su bed med rnying rul song ba mthong myong 'dug4 3 lha khang khag gi nang rten skor gyi 'o/ rgyus/phyis su dpal mo chos sdings su lha khang mang zhing lha khang khag gi nang rten la shin tu phyug pas/ de la rgyu mtshan zhig 'dren rgyu 'dug pa ni/ 'jigs bral chen po 'i 107

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /sku dus su chos sdings rang du dgon ma lag lnga dang / de rjes slo rong mnga' khul yul gru gzhan du'ang dgon ma lag bcu grangs dar khyab byung rung / rje nyid kyi rjes rim pas nyams gud kyis mtha' na gdan sa chos sdings rang gi dgon lag /ar+ya thar pa gling / bshad grwa bde chen gling / btsun dgon chos bzang sgrol ma gling bcas gyang ror gyur pa ma zad/ de snga rdzong dga'i 'khris su mnga' ris mngon dga' zhes pa'i bo dong pa'i 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i dbo na pa zhig tu gdung rten thog tshad ma dang tsan dan las grub pa'i rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku brnyan lha/gas nang rten la phyug cing 'bo/ don che ba'i dgon pa zhig yod mus sa sprel (1788) bo ra dmag skabs rtsa sko nga du gyur nas dgon pa de'i nang rten dang mchod chas phal che ba rdzong dga' chos sder phul/ de 'phros dpal mo chos sdings su gdan zhu bgyis par grags/ brag dkar bas mdzad pa'i 'bur ba'i gdung rabs nang / (kyis sprel ( 1788 ) lo'i sde gzar skabs sdig to can mu stegs gor ṣa'i dmag dpung gis mngon dga' chos sde yang rlag par byas skabs gdung rten dang bka' 'gyur rin po che sogs dge 'du na kha shas kyis ri khrod cig tu spyan drangs/nyi zhes 'kho da/ dgung lo 87 phebs pa'i khang dkar dzad spo byang chub lags kyis gsungs don/ nged kyi dran thog la bshad rgyun 'di 'dra zhig yod/ mang yu la skyid grong / mnga' ris gung thang ngam rdzong dga'/ dpal khud spo rong sogaso gna' dus nas gor cadad kyi lam chen zhig yin par brten gor bod dang rte+or bod dmag 'khrug snga phyi'i skabs dben par gnas pa'i bo dong dgon pa rnams 108

gdan sa chen po spo rong dpal mo chos sdings/la 'phrog bcom gyis pham nyes chen po 11ga /bshad srol la gor dmag skabs saser zangs las grub pa'i gdung rten re 'ga'i nang bla ma'i dmar gdung sazungs gzhug tu mjal bar gor ṣa'i dmag mis mi ro sbas 'dug ces zhed snang dang skyugs dro byas pas de rjes kyi dgon pa khag gi gdung rten gtor bshig 'a sa thar bar grags/ skabs de'i gor dmag gi gdong len du bod gzhung nas bka' blon rdo ring dang g.yu thog zhu ba dang khong gi phyag rogs su spo rong rje dbon la'ang 'gan dbang chen po 'khris pas/ gor dmag la gdong len tshul bzhin ma thub pa'i bka' nyes su mnga' ris mngon dga' spo rong nas gzhung bzhes kyis rdzong dga' chodas sder phul bar grags/ dgung lo 88 thebs pa'i dkon gnyer ngag dbang gis gsungs don/ nged kyi dus su dpal mo chos sdings su 7rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur bris ma cha tshang gnyis dang dpar ma cha tshang gsum bcas bka' 'gyur kho na cha tshang lnga dang / de bzhin 'jigs bral gyi bla sku gser zangs las grub pa dang sman 'dam las grub pa sogs che chung sna tshogs pa mang po zhig dang de min bla sku gzhan dang bstan 'gyur sogs dpe cha phon che bzhugs yul med pa lta bu byung khungs bor brlag tu song ba'i dgon pa thag nas chodas sdings kyi lha khang khag gi nang rten khongs brdzabs par sems/4 4 lha khang khag gi nang rten gyi skor/1 lha khang dmar mo'i na nga rten/ rten gral gyi dbus su rten gyi gtso bo sman 109

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /'dam las grub pa'i 'jigs bral nga 'dra ma mda' tshad/ g.yas gral ngos su gser zangs las grub pa'i thub dbang mda' tshad ma dang / gser zangs las grub pa'i rdor sems mda' tshad ma/ gser zangs las grub pa'i mchod rten mda' tshad ma/ gser zangs las grub pa'i 'jam dbyangs mda' tshad ma bcas bzhugs/ g.yon gral ngos su gser zangs las grub pa'i lha sku gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhes mda' tshad las che tsam rdeng / sman 'dam las grub pa'i 'jigs bral mthong ba don yod mda' tshad ma/ sman 'dam las grub pa'i spo rong nam mkha' dkar po'i bla sku mda' tshad ma bcas bzhugs/ lha khang ma mo'i g.yon ngos kyi rtsig ldebs sku gral la/ sman 'dam las grub pa'i rgya gar gyi grub chen bir wa pa'i sku brnyan 'dom tshad ma/ de rjes sman 'a dam las grub pa'i dpang 'o/ tsā ba slo gros brtan pa'i sku brnyan 'dom tshad ma/ de rjes sman 'dam las grub pa'i lo chen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi sku brnyan 'dom tshad ma/ de rjes sman 'dam las grub pa'i lo chen byang chub rtse mo'i sku brnyan 'dom tshad ma/ de rjes sman 'dam las grub pa'i 'jigs bral gyi sku cung mi 'dra ba zhes pa 'dom tshad ma/ de rjes gser zangs las grub pa'i rdo rje phag mo'i sku brnyan 'dom tshad ma/ de rjes g.yu thog mkhas pa zhes dgon pa bzhengs mkhan gyi mkhas pa'i sku brnyan sman 'dam las grub pa mda' tshad ma bcas yod/ de min sku 'dra dang zhal thang mchod rten sku/gas sna tshogs sku da/ lha khang ma mo zhes ming thogs tshul ni/ bshad srol du lug ma mo brgya tham pa'i lhas steng du bzhengs pas lha khang 110

gdan sa chen po spo rong dpal mo chos sdings/ma mo zhes 'bod par grags kyang lha khang gi rgya khyon ma mo brgya'i lhas las ha cang che ba ma zad lha khang 'di dgon pa'i 'du khang yang byed kyi red/ yang na lha khang lte nga la'ang go chog pa yin/'jigs bral chen po'i bla sku rnam grangs mi 'dra ba mang bas 'di'i skor rags tsam brjod na/ 'jigs bral nyid 'tsho bzhugs skabs gang gi 'dra sku mang po bzhengs par grags pas/ lan cig 'jigs bral gyis 'di cung mi 'dra sasung pas na 'jigs bral cung mi 'dra ba zhes pa'i mtshan thogs/ de rjes gzhan zhig bzhengs par 'di nga 'dra'o zhes gsungs pas de la 'jigs bral nga 'dra ma zhes mtshan gsol ba 'di bzhin dgon pa'i rten gtsor bkur nas deng sang bal yul du mjal rgyu yod pa 'di yin/ de min 'jigs bral sku bsnyun pa'i shangs khrag las grub pa'i bla sku/ 'jigs bral shangs khrag ma zhu ba dang / yang 'jigs bral gyi bla sku zhig la bla ma brgya tham pas phyag nas brgya tshar gyis rab gnas mdzad pas na 'jigs bral phyag nas brgya tshar ma zhes pa dang / yang 'jigs bral kyi bla sku zhig gis char rlung drag po dang se ra 'gog pas 'brog pa tshos slabs dang dus su 'brog sar gdan 'dren zhu ba dang dmigs bsal dad bskul zhu yul zhig chags pa de dbyar dus dge 'dun pa tsho 'brog sar dkar chu'i bsod snyoms la phebs dus mnyam 'khyer mdzad kyi yod pas na mtshan la'ang 'jigs bral dkar tog ma zhes gsol ba sogs mang du mchis/dkon gnyer ngag dbang gis brjod don/ lha khang 'dir sku gsu nga thugs 111

'brog sde chen po spo rong rgi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long / gsum mtshon pa'i rten/ gser zangs rdor sems dang gser zangs mchod rten/ gser chos brgyad stodang pa ngo mtshar can zhig /de bzhin ma ṇi lha khang mo gas spo mo nga rje daphra na gyi bdag mo zhig gi phyag nas mi ser zhig phyag nyes su phyin par sdig khyodang 'khyodad bshags su bzhengs pa rgan ngag gzhon 'jags kyi bshad srol zhig red 'dug /brag dkar rig 'dzin chodas kyi dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i 'bur ba'i gdung rabs nang / rje dbon nam mkha' dpal bzang bi dus su ((skabs shig chos sdings su zhabs gras blon po zhig gi spyod pa ma bzo bar thugs snyung bas 'jig rten pha rol gyi lam du gtang ba'i sdig sbyongs su chos sding gtsug lag khang gi 'dab 'byar ma ṇi skor chen lha khang dang bcas pa dang / mngon dga' chos sder ma ṇi lha khang / gong mtshungs gcen rin chen mgon gyi dgongs ljo gas su shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa brgyad stong pa'i glegs bam gser chodas rin dze che'i phra tshom can 'gran zla med pa zhig dang /gzhan yang rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che/ slob dalnga na chen po sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad dang bcas pa'i zhal thang grwa tshar/ grub thob brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi'i zhal thang grwa tshar rgyu dang bkod pas khyad du 'phags pa bzhengs pa sku gas rnam dkar mdzad bzang rgya cher bskrun/ sku gshegs rjes bsag sbyang gi gdung rten du gser zangs kyi byang chen mchod rten rin po che'i phra tshom can chos sdings lha khang ma mor bzhugs/ 'khrung brtag rje rig 'dzin chen por (kaḥthog rig 'dzin chen mo tshe dbang nor bu ) zhus pa 'phags yul gyi grub thob chen 112

gdan sa chen po spo rong dpal mo chos sdings/ po go rak+ṣa pa'i snang brnyan thang ka bzhengs /gi sogs 'khod/ dkon ngag la gong gsal lo rgyus bstan pas/ de dus rje dbon sku dbang che bas mi mang nas bdang/ mor khag bkri byas pa yin srid kyi red brjod/ brgyad stong pa'i gser chos 'di'i shog lhe dang po'i yig mgo dang rgya gar skad du sogs gser ljang rdung shog sbyar yig 'bru'i che tshad sor mo gnyis tsam yod 'dug 1959 dus 'gyur skabs spo rong sku bag kun bzang byams pa lags kyis gser chodas 'di gdan zhur bskyod kyang sku ngal 'phrad de gdan zhu ma thub pa'i skor lo rgyus snyan po 'di 'dra zhig gsungs/1959 lor nga tsho glo yul du slebs zin rjes slar nged rang khams pa kha shas 'khrid de spo rong du dngos chas len par log pa yin/ de dus spo rong du rgya mi mi 'dug /yul mi tshos kyang sngar rgyun las gnod 'tshe byed dwogs mi 'dug/nga tshos sbra chen nas ca dngos gang thob cig bsdu gsog brgyab ste chos sdings su gser chodas gdan zhu la bskyod pa yin/ gser chos len par shing gi skas 'dzegs gzar sngo zhig brgyud gting khung zhig la babs dbo sa kyi 'dug /de len par nged rang phyin na ma gtogs gzhan gtong ma shes/ gser chos 'di shin tu nas rtsa chen yin pa nged kyi rogs pa tshos shes kyi yod red/ nged rang skas 'dzegs de nas babs grabs bgyis pas sems la rnam sna ga cig skyes byung /gser chos ston zin nas khams pa'i lag tu thob ma thag nged rang sa 'og tu bkums na sus shes snyam nas gser chodas blos gtong byas pa yin/113

'brog sde chen po spo rong thi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /2 gser gdung lha khang / 'dir thog tshad lon pa'i gser zangs kyi gdung rten gnyis yod pas gcig brag dkar ba rig 'dzin chos kyi dbang phyug gi gdung rten yin par grags/ thog tshad lon pa'i gdung rten gzhan de bla ma su'i yin rtsad ma chod/ de min gdung rten che chung sna tshogs pa 'o/na che yod pa rnams bo dong bla rgyud dang spo rong rje dbon ser tsha'i gdung rten yin par grags/4 'jigs bral mun mtshams lha khang / lha khang 'di dang lha khang dkar mo gnyis sbrel te yod/ 'dir khri'u chung zhig yod pas der 'jigs bral chen po mun ma55mas bzhugs gnas yin stabs 'jigs bral na/na ma'argams zhes ming thogs/5 lha khang dkar mo/ lha khang 'di 'jigs bral mun mtshams dang sbrel te yod/ 'dir ldebs ris sna tshogs pa las lha sku sogs gang yang med/6 bar thog lha khang / lha khang 'di lha khang ma mo'i rgyab ngos dang ye shes mchod rten gyi 'og khang yin/ 'dir tshoms chen zhig yod pa'i rtsig ldebs su dus 'khor gyi sku la sogs pa'i logs bris gzi brjid dang ldan zhing mjal ba tsam gyis rang dbang med par yid 'phrog pa de 'dra mjal rgyu yod/7 ye shes mchod rten/ ye shes mchodad rten la thog tshad gsum yod/ mchod rten gyi khog pa'i nang shi nga gi skas 'dzegs thog tshad gsum bar dang nang rten du ldebs ris la sangs rgyang stong sku sogs lha bris sna tshogs pa/ mchod rte na gyi thog tu gser zangs kyi rgya phibs gzi brjid ldan par rgya phibs kyi sne zur la rlung dril chung ngu mang du sbrags pa'i skad sgra snyan po gang sar khyab pa yod/114

gdan sa chen po skyo rong dpal mo chos sdings/mdun ngos su gser zangs las grub pa'i galjir dang gser tog /de mtshungs sa yab rtsid kyis btums pa'i thug bcas thag ring nas mjal thub pa yod/ 'di d+ngha di/rmo lha khang dmar moḥre khongs gtogs yin /spre gzim chung rtse'i nang rten/ lha khang 'di skyid sbyar dang rtsig sbrel ri ngos lde bas su yod/ snga dus shig na 'jigs bral nyid 'dir bzhugs par grags/sakhrim chung 'di'i nang gsang spyod rang sgrig yod/ phyis su gzim chung 'di lha wang du gyur pas 'di'i nang rten du sku gsung thugs rten mang sngo sku da/9 tshe ring ma'i rten khang / rten khang 'di skyid sbyar gyi yang rtser yod /10 gnas bcu lha khang gi nang rten/ 'dir rtsig ldebs logs ris la rgya gar gyi/ gnas brtan bcu drug gi sku brnyan gtso bor gyur cing de min gser zangs kyi sku brnyan sna tshogs pas mchod gshom khengs pa yod/12 dgon pa'i rung khang /13 ma ṇi lha khang / lha khang 'di rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs galta ra bshig las thar tsam lus kyang nang rten gcig kyang lhag med/ 'dir ma ṇi lag skor zhig dang rtsig ldebs la zhung bshags kyi lha dang de min chos longs sprul gsum dang / sgrol ma'i lha sogs lha ris khyad du 'phags pa mang du sku da/ rig gnas bsar brje'i skabs lha khang 'dir ser lung nas chos sdings su yong ba'i grong pa zhig gi sdod khang bgyis nas lde bas ris la skyon cha ma ༅ོra tsam da lta'ang mjal rgyu 'dug

'grog sde chen po hro rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /phyi lo 1995 tsam la spo rong ྅kyi bag kun bzang byams pa lags dang sud si bdag mo gnyis lha sa brgyud sgo rong du khyug tsam bskyod skabs de nyin khong gnyis ma ṇi lha khang der sne len zhus/ skabs der ma ṇi lha khang gi rtsig ldebs dud dreg gis nag ngo nag rkyang yin par grags/ de nas sud si lcam gyis dud dreg gi gseng nas lha sku'i ri mo thar thor gzigs/ de rjes slar bod du bskyodad skabs phyi rgyal nas dmigs mngags dud dreg bkru snum gyis rtsig ldebs dud 'phyags bgyis 'bras rim pas je gsal du song nas deng sang 'o/gas ris phal che ba mjal thub/14 bde chen rab rgyas gyi nang rten/ khang pa 'di'i chags stangs gsung chos ra ba dang kha gtad/ lha khang ma mo da nga kha sgrod red/ 'di la thog tshad lnga yod pas cha tshang spo rong rje dbon gyi chos sdings su bzhugs sanas yin/15 gser khang lha khang gi nang rten/ 'dir rga rong gzhung rkyang gi bka' 'gyur dpar ma cha tshang dang rnying ma rgyud 'bum pod brgya/ tsan dan las grub pa'i tshe lha rnam gsum byin can la sogs sku gsung thugs rten mang tsam yod/16 skal bzang lha khang gi nang rten/ 'dir spo gro nga gzhung rkyang gi bstan 'gyur cha tshang dang gser chodas rdo rje gcod pa brgya tshar dang mtshan masnga tshe gzungs brgya tshar/ brgyad ྅rteng pa/ nyi khri/ mi dbang rtogs brjod cha tshang gnyis sogs dpe rnying shog tshad che zhing brjid tshad mi gcig gis mi theg pa de 'dra yotsho+od/18 bka' 'gyur lha khang gi nang rten/ 'dir 7rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur dpar 116
