gdan sa chen po spo rong dpal mo chos sdings/ma cha tshang gcig dang bris ma cha tshang gcig yod/ gser zangs kyi sku rtsa chen mang po yod/ spo rong du bka' 'gyur bris ma cha tshang gnyis yod pas de gnyis rngo zhengs par mi thog gsum 'gor bar grags/19 mgon khang gi nang rten/ 'di'i nang rten du 'jigs byed/ mgon po gur/lha mo drel bzhon ma/ chos srung bkra shis cadad 'bar/ chos srung rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ ma mgon lcam dral dang 'jigs bral chen dzetsware skabs kyi gdo/ra ma phon che yod/ gar 'cham gyi zhal 'bag khag bcas yod /20 gzim chung dpal 'dzoms kyi nang rten/ 'dir 'jigs bral gyi bur khang dang / gang gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum de kho na nyid 'dus pa cha tshang bzhugs yod/ lha mo dbyangs can ma'i sku brnyan gyis gtsos sku 'dra kha shas mjal rgyu yod/21/22 gnyis spo rong spyi pa'i gnyer tshang dang / lpo rong gzhung rkyang gi bang mdzod/ dkon gnyer ngag dbang gis brjod don/ bang mdzod 'dir rje dbon sku 'khor dang zhabs gras re zung las gzhan su gang mi slebs/ lcags 'brug 1 940 lor 7bo nga sa skyabs mgon sku 'phreng bcu bzhi pa mchog gser khrir mnga' ga sol gyi dga' stodan la spo rong rje dbon sku 'khor dang bcas lha sar bcar skabs rang 'bab 'bul tshan mi chung ba dbo sa nges lta ra/ skabs der nged kyang bang mdzod 'di'i nang zhabs gras kho ngas bskyod pa yin/ bang mdzod 'di'i mdo sbug shing sgam dang smyug gzeb sogs kyis khengs pa'i nang mi rabs 117

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /nas mi rabs bsags pa'i gser dngul la sogs rin chen sna tshogs yod par grags kyang de nyin nged rang gi lag thog nas rgyal ba rin po che la 'bul tshan ched shing sgam zhig gi nang nas gos chen ldeb bsgril gsum dang snam chas mang po 'or 'dren bgyis pa dran gyi 'dug23 mkha' spyod lha khang gi nang rten/ mkhar 'di ni thog tshad dgu lon pas/shel dkar yan gyi mkhar mtho shos su brtsis na 'thus/ mkhar 'di'i thog brtsegs gnyis sa 'og dang thog brtsegs bdun sa steng du yod par grags/ zhwa mo gyon pa'i mi zhig gis mkhar gyi 'khris nas dbu rtser bltas na mkhar gyi dbu rtse nam mkha'i bar snang mthon por g.yo ba lta bu mngon pa dang dbu rtse mtho bas mgo la gyon pa'i zhwa mo bud kyi sku da na mkha' spyod ma zhes ming thogs par grags/24 brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi rten mkhar/ mkha' spyod lha khang gi yang rtser bod kyi brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi rten mkhar yod/25 'jigs bral shangs khrag lha khang / mkha' spyod kyi thog tshad brgyad par lha khang zhig yod pa de'i nang rten gtso bor 'jigs bral shangs khrag ma zhes byin can zhig yod/27 chos sdings sgrub sde lha khang / dpal mo chos sdings rgyab ri'i ldebs su mnga' ris cos rgyal gyis 'jigs bral chen po'i ched bzhengs par sdigar+shas pa'i gzim khang dkar mo dang de'i 'og tu 'khod pa'i sgrub sde bsam gtan gling ni grwa mang gi bzhugs shag kyang yin/ 'dir lha khang zhig yod par dge 'dun 118

gdan sa chen po spo rong dpal mo chos sdings/rma rnams rgyun du tshogs 'dzoms gnang yul red/ lha khang dmar mo ni me mchod dang de min dus chen khag la tshogs ༷/la yin/28 dzo chen gzhung rkyang lha khang / sbra chen gzhung rkyang pho brang du lha khang gra rgyas zhig yod pa'i nang lha sku rten gsung dang bka' 'gyur bris ma cha tshang gcig dang dpar ma cha tshang gcig sku da/29 spra chen sku rim lha khang / lha khang 'di sgo rong gzhung rkyang gi rgyun mkho'i sku rim bya yul gyi lha khang yin pas sbra chen rang du yod/ 'dir dgon pa nas sku rim pa grwa pa gnyis rgyu na bzhugs yin/ 'di ru'ang lha sku rten gsung byin can mang po sku da/ 4 5 chos srung chen po bkra shis ca/da 'bar/1 go rong dgon pa'i chos srung gi gzungs po'i skor/spo rong du snga dus nas dgon pa'i srung ma dang yul lha so so'i chibs pa mtshon byed pha g.yag gam yul skad du spo'u zhes pa gzugs byad legs pa'i pho g.yag gcig lha srung so so'i sku khams la gzhigs te/ lha g.yag gzungs ngo ra ngos 'dzin zhu srol yod/ g.yag gzhan dang mi 'dra bar lha srung gi gzungs po ni rtsa cher brtsis te skabs dang dus la gsol kha zhu dgos kyi sku da/ dus chen khag la g.yag dza da'u gzhan gyi rwa co dang gze'u/ rnga ma bcas la ras gyi sne sbrogs 'dogs srol sku da kyang / gzungs po khag la gos chen tshon khra sna lnga 'i sne sprodags 119

'grog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /rdzig ngo 'dodags pa yin/ lha g.yag gzungs po dang / de min pha g.yag spo'u rnams 'brog pa so so'i khyu sa'i ri klungs rtswa chu gang bzang du rang dbang gtong pa las rgyun du 'tsho srol med/ lo ltar dbyar smad zla ngo gsum tsam ring 'bri dang pha g.yag spo'u rnams gtsang gzhung du phab nas mnyam du 'chos ba las de min lha g.yag dang spyoda'u tshang ma ri la sdod pa yin/ lo gsar tshes gsum nyin gzungs po rnams ri klungs gar yod nas gdan zhus kyis lha gsol byed pa yin/de dus rwa ze rnga gsum la gos chen tshos lnga'i sne sbrogs kyis lha gsol byed pa yin/ dbu ru dbu thod la mar gyi brten mar gsol/ ze dang rnga ma bcas la tsag dmar gasku la/ de nas khyu sar gtong ba yin pas de dus gzungs po rnams dgyes snang chen pos rnga ma gnam la g.yugs shing 'ur sgra dang bcas thon phebs pa yin/ grwa tshang gnag la gzungs po lnga yod/ spo rong dpal mo chos sding sa kyi chodas srung gnyis dang mgon snga gcig /yul lha gnyis bcas lha g.yag lnga la gzungs por gsol gyi yod red/1 dgon pa'i chos srung bkra shis 'od 'bar gyi gzungs po/ pha g.yag sngon po/2 dgon pa'i dzadas bdag rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi gzungs po/ pha g.yag kham pa/3 mgon po'i gzungs po/ pha g.yag nag po/4 yul lha gtsang lha'i gzungs po/ pha g.yag dkar po/ 5 yul lha srin phug drag btsan gyi gzungs wa / pha g.yag kham bu ga pa/7 2 chodas srung la bstod pa'i yul gzhas/120

gdan sa chen po sgo rong dpal mo chos sdings/rtsom pa po'i mchan/ rdzong dga' dang spo rong khul du chos srung gi bstodad gzhas ji gyang phug phu na bzhugs pa'i/ chos srung bkra shis 'od 'bar nyi zhes pa zhig 'khrab sku/la yod/ spo rdzong gnyis dbar/ ma la zhes pa'i la zhig dang de'i mtshams su/ lu ma ring po zhes pa'i 'brog sa zhig gis sa mtshams dbye ba las sa thag ha cang nye wa red/ sgyu nga dga' ni sngo nga dga' sgyu nga gi lte gnas dang / spo rong ni shel dkar rdzong 'og nang khrims rang btsan gna' dus kyi rgyal phran zhig red/ snga mo'i lo rgyus mang po zhig dang lhag par bo dong chos brgyud nas mched de spo rdzong dbar 'brel lam chen po chags yod pa red/ dper na/ bo dong pa 'o/ chen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis rdzong dkar chos sde'i mkhan thog dang po mdzad/ de rjes 'jigs bral dbon sras rnams kyis kyang 'o/ mang bskyangs/ de bzhin rdzong dga'i mnga' ris chos rgyal gyi sras mo rje btsun chos kyi cadan me nyid wa dong paṇa chen gyi thugs sras su gyur pa nas bzung deng bsam sdings rdo rje phag mo zhes bud med kyi bla ma yongs grags gang gi 'byung khungs kyang 'di la thug pa red/ ((gyang phug phu gyi zhes pa ni rdzong dga'i nye 'dabs su mjal rgyu yod pa'i chos srung bkra shis cadad 'bar dang 'brel ba'i bo dong chos brgyud kyi dgon pa zhig red/ snga dus shig la mnga' thang rgyas shing phun sum tshogs pa sku da kyang deng gyang ro tsam las lhag med/glu/lung pa'i phya/ nas yong bas/ /lung pa'i mdo ru slebs song /gro dang sran ma'i skye sa/ /lung bzang 'di ru yin no//zhabs wa / gyang phug phu na bzhugs pa'i/ /chos srung bkra shis 'od 'bar/121

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /rang yul rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor/ /mchodad pa bzhes la phebs shogachu mo mar 'gro shig shig /mar 'gro ya la 'o/ga shogasprul pa'i lha khang che mo'i/ /yon chab yar la log shogamachod pa mchod kha dngas la/ /mchod gcadam ri mo legs pa/me tog ldum ra'i nang la/ /mchodad pa bzhes la phebs cadag /ces so//zha dpal mo chos sdings dgon pa'i gna' rdzas kho ngas spo rong rje dbon nas chos srung bkra shis 'od 'bar 'dod gso/la dar dkar la sug bris phul ba zhig sprel gasnga nga zhal 'bag gi dar tshon khongs rnyed pa'i brjod don bkod pa gsham gsal/༄༅༅/ /rgyal kun rig 'dzin bla mas bka' bgos (bsgos) shing / /rnal 'byor sgrub (grub) mchog rnams kyi 'o/ nya ba/ /chos srung chen po bkra shis 'od 'bar la/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin 'di phul bas/ /bdag cag rig 'dzin yab sras brgyud 'dzin rnams/ /gzhis byes la sogs dus rnams kun tu yang / 'bral med 'grogs la las bzhi'i 'phrin las bskrub/ khyad par bstan don rin chen skyong ba'i phyir/ /'gro sdod las sgrub pa la khur blangs nas/ /mthun pa dang sprod nyes pa'i rigs po/ /'gal byed dgra bo'i srog rtsa dmar po chod//gang zhig bsam pa'i don bzhin ma sgrub na/ /chos srung khyed kyang mthu med mi 'gyur ram bsam bsam thams cad myur du 'grub nas kyang / /rang gnas rang 'khor mthod thon lam legs shing / /zhag grangs dus tshigs bsam pa'i thog de ru/ /bgrod pa'i mthu shugs khyed kyis stsal du gso/la/ sarba maṅga waṃ//122

gdan sa chen po spo rong dpal mo chos sdings/4 snyo mar me'i brtags pas bla ma 'dems tshul/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bo lugs shigadang ka mo chos sdings su lo yun gsum re'i rjes dgon pa'i bla ma'am mkhan po 'a pho 'gyur gyis bskyar 'dems byed pa red/ mkhan po 'dems tshul ni thun mong ma yin pa'i bo lugs kyi brtags pa zhig yod red/ de la mar me'i brtags pa brjod pa red/ dge 'dun rang khe ngas nas bslab pa dang mkhyen pa bgres gachodan la gzhigs 'e mkhan sngo ra 'os mi gnyis sam skabs re gsum tsam gyi 'os gzhi bton srol yod/dper na/ 'os gzhir 'os mi gnyis yod pa'i gnas stangs la/1 thog mar brtags yig ces 'os mi gnyis kyi mtshan sna ga bu che chung gcig pa'i steng bris te shog sgril che chung gcig rkyang gnyis bzo dgos/2 de rjes mchod kong che chung gcig rkyang gnyis la sdong ras 'bom phra gcig rkyang re btsugs te/ de gnyis mar khu thur ma do tsam gyis mang nyung he bag med par 'gengs pa yin/3 de rjes mar me gnyis dang brtags yig gnyis rten gtso 'jigs bral nga 'dra ma'i mdun du bsgrigs te dgon pa'i mkhan po las thog pas bo lugs zhal 'don dang bcas/ mar me gnyis kyi steng brtags sho 'phen nas mar me gnyis po sho mig che chung gis dbye zin 'phral shog sgril rtags yig gnyis kyang gong gsal bzhin sho mig che chung gis dbye ba 'byed pa yin/ mar me dang brtags yig dbye tshul 'di la sho mig che mtshon chung mtshon zhes/ sna mig che ba'i mar 123

'grog lde'un po spo rong gi byung gabarjod parwangs gsal me long mes sho mig che ba'i brtags yig mchogan pa dang de bzhin sna mig chung ba'i mar mes sho mig chung ba'i brtags yig mtshon pa yin/4 de nas mkhan po las khu/ga gis/ mar me gsal dwangs yun ring gis/ /bla ma'i mdzad pa rgyas gyur cig /ces smon lam dang bcas mar me gnyis snga de nyid spos sbom phra gcig pas me kha lhan cig tu zhal kha phye/5 mtha' bsdoms su der 'khod 'dus spyi yongs nas bar dbang bcas tshang mos ngango sgug gis mar me gnyis kyi nang nas yun ring bzhugasakhapa der mkhan par 'khad pa'//4 7 bo lugs sprul sku'i skor/spo rong khuladu sku ngas grags ngag rgyun zhig la wa dong tre gas las rnam rgyal dag zhing du gshegs 'phral shar rgyag byang sham lha lar phebs par grags pa dang / bo dong ba'i chos spyod smon lam re 'ga'i nang / byang phyogs sham lha lha yi pho brang na /snying rje 7rgyal ba gnyis pa thod dodang pa/ /bdag so/gas bsku da nams bsag pa'i rten la byon/ / spyan 'dren mchod pa'i gnas 'dir bshegs su gamo la/ zhes 'kho da/yang ngag rgyun gzhan zhig la rje nyid dag zhing du gshegs te 'o/ ngo lnga brgya'i rjes gang gi bstan pa rgya mtsho chen po'i pha mthar khyab bo ces pa'i lung bstan yang yo da par grags/ thams cad mkhyen pa 'chi med 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i bo dong rmes 'byung / ((de kho na nyid 'dus pa las bo dong chos 'byung gsal byed sgron me gnyi124

gdan sa chen po spo rong dpal mo chos sdings/zhes pa las/ (('jigs bral gyi dzā ba dpon chen po 'di ni dgung lo bdun bcu rtsadrug ba can du bzhugs nas dpal sna/ snu sa sdings su mya ngan las 'das so/ /deng sang sham bha la na rigs ldan rnam gnon du sprul nas dus kyi 'khor 'otsware chos 'khor skor ba'i skabs yin no/nyi /zhes 'khod pas skabs shig 'jigs bral nyid kyi skye sprul med par bshad/ 'on te yongs grags su bo dong paṇa chen gyi skye sprul lam yang srid gnyal sbyor ra thams cad mkhyen pa na rim byon pa dang / da dung bo dong gi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bla khag bdun du grags pa/ 1959 dus 'gyur skabs yar 'brog gi bsam sdings ro/ rje phag mo / ras chen dpal 'khyodar bzang sngo / 'gro mgon sprul sku/ me sprul/ 'chi med sprul sku bcas 'tsho bzhugs yod khongs nas bsam sdings rdo rje phag mo sku 'phreng bcu gnyis pa'am bcu bzhi pa bde chen chos kyi sgron me mchog ni da lta'ang gzhis su 'tsho bzhugs dang /sbyor ra thams cad mkhyen pa'i sprul sku snga ma khag cig nas gsang chen snga 'gyur rnying ma'i bstan par zhabs tog che zhing / dus phyis mi thog gcig gnyis sngon nam sbyor ra thams cad mkhyen pa gdan sa chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs su chos zhugs gnang ba'ang byung 'dug /da lta'i sbyodar ra thams cad mkhyen pa byes su ngos 'dzin gyis rgya gar lho phyogs mon dho 'bras spungs dgo/na du chos zhugs mdzad pa bo thos kyang deng gar bzhugs cha ma rtogs/ 'gro mgon ni mi lo bcu phrag gong tsam mon yul 'bum sde lar sku gshegs skad/ lo shas sngon gzhis bzhugs bod kyi rig gnas nyams zhib pa spo rong khyu lta/ga zla ba lags kyi 125

'grog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /phyag tu a mdo re ba bo nga gi shar skal ldan rgya mtsho'i gsung rnam zhig thob pa'i nang sku 'phreng brgyad du phebs pa'i shar skal ldan rgya mtsho'i skye rabs nang bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal yin skor gsal skad/ 'di lta'i bod kyi sa bka' rnying dge sogs chodas brgyud kyi bla ma mang po'i skye rabs sam 'khrungs rabs kyi bgrang 'dren du bo dong paṇa chen bzhugs pa mang po yong srid pa red lags/byes su bo dong chos rgyun slar gso'i las don la shin tu bka' drin che zhing bo dong chos rgyud dang 'brel che ba'i byang pa rnam rgyal grags bzang gi rnam sprul du grags pa tshe ring dam chos lags kyi dgongs par/ ((de snga bod du ngos 'dzin byung min la ma ltos par bo dong pa'i sprul sku ji snyed cig phebs srid pa red/ spo rong khul du mtshon na/ bar skabs shig nas spo rong rje dbon gyi mnga' thang nyams pa'i mur bo dong gi bstan pa la'ang nyams gud phyin pa gsal po red/ dper na mi rabs kha shas kyi gong nas spo rong khul du 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i bo dong pa'i dgon pa phal cher nyams pa lta bu dang dgon pa nang khul yang 'brel lam chad pa lta bu'i gnas stangs red/ 'jigs bral nyid kyis phyag btab pa'i mdo sngags bshad sgrub kyi gdan sa chen po dpal mo chos sdings la mtshon na nged kyi dran thog la dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu tsam gyis dus mchod me mchod dang sku rim bskang gso sogs kyi srol rgyun ma nyams tsam las 'dul ba'i bstan pa dang 'chad nyan gyi chos grwa sogos rtsabarlag phyin nas med/ gnas stangs 'dis rkyen pas nged kyi dran thog gi spo rong khul du chos snang la dkar ba'i skya ser tshang mas rnying chos nyams len byed pa red /126

gdan sa chen po spo rong dpal mo chos sdings/bla ma bsten tshul yang rong 'bug gi rum bu sangs rgyas dang / de rjes na bka'am nya gar gyi na bkra rin sngo che/ de bzhin 'khris su bzhugs 'khod khyod rwa dang the dmar bdang sras/ spo rong rang khongs su bar 'brog rdor gling pa chu bzang rin po che dang nā 'jam rin po che sogs bsten pa las bo dong rang gi bka' lung 'dzin pa'i bla ma med pa lta bu red/ nged rang gi mi tsher mtshon na chung dus bo dong gi bla ma zhig gi sprul pa yin pa'i rtags rten gsal por byung rung / spo rong pa dpon 'bangs su zhig nas nged la ngos 'dzin bdag sprod byed rgyu phar bzhag /de snga spo rong khul du sprang 'khyams ming la bo dong rgan chen zer ba zhig byung 'dug pas/ nged la de'i ming nas 'bod de 'phya sgyu da rgyag srol yod/ der brten nged kyang chung dus nas na bkra rin 1— che'i zhabs pad gtugs te chos la zhugs dbenas byung bas bo dong chos rgyun la 'chad nyan gyi go skabs ma thob/ byes su sprang 'khyams bdag la gathorga bor spyi nor 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog gi gzigs bskyangs dang de bzhin rje gong ma rnams kyi bslu ba med pa'i thugs smon/ lhag par du chos srung bkra shis rod 'bar nas pha yis bu la mngags pa lta bu'i lung bstan 'khrul ba med pa rim bstsal la brten nas nged rang 'chi ran khar bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi sprul pa'i sku mjal ba 'di ni gdul bya nges can ched gnas dus nges can la gzigs te phe bas pa zhig yin par gasnga na mi za bas/ 'o/ ngo lnga brgya'i rjes nged kyi bstan pa rgya mtsho chen wa'i phar mthar khyab ces pa'i lung bstan ltar bo dong gi chos rgyun slar gso thub pa'i ltas bzang po gcig yin par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ da 127

'grog sdechen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me longanani nad ro nga rang 'chi na yang 'gyod pa med/snyig ces dang /deng cad snga nga mchog sprul du grags pa'i bla ma dam pa balha/da nams rgyal mtshan ni 'jam dbyangs 'khon gdung sa skya'i bla chen khyad du 'phags pa zhig las phra ro/nga pa'i bla mar ngos 'dzin ji ltar thob ces dris par tshe ring dam chos lags kyis/((nged rang lo ngo bcu tsam gyi ring nad mnar mal lus su gyur cing lhag par sprul sku rin po che ngos 'dzin ma thub bar gyi mtha' ma'i lo ngo lnga'i ring tshabs che'i gshags bcos kyang byed dgos sku gas nam 'chi nges med kyi gnas stangs su lhungs na'ang nged rang la lo yun lnga tsam gyi ring bstud mar bstan pa'i rmi lam brtag pa ya mtshan rnams 'o/ re bzhin je gsal du 'bo bzhin pa'i 'bru don gathe cad ni bo thegang pa'i bla ma khyad 'phags mtshan la ba11da nams rgyal mtshan zhes pa zhig gi sprul pa phebs kyi yod par nged rang nas 'gan 'khur len dgos gsungs/ de rjes kyi lung bstan je gsal du gyur te mtha' ma der/ pha spo rong pa dang / ma gung thang pa yin par bu zhig 'khrungs pa de bo dong bla ma bsku/da nams rgyal mtshan gyi sprul sku yin zhes pa'i lung bstan phebs/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul nged rang gis glos 'gan bzod thabs med gshis bal yul du gnas 'khod spo rong ser skya mi mang la snyan seng zhus/ bal yul du spo rong pa pha zla ba dar rgyas dang rdzong dga' skal bzang chos sgron lags gnyis la dgung lo lngar sku na pa'i bu chung bsod namos don grub zhu ba zhig 'khrungs yod pa de sprul sku'i 'os ngo chod shos yin mod 4kyang spo rong ser skya dang yab yum bcas nas kyang 'gan dbang baX da min gyis bzhugs 128

gdan sa chen po spo rong dpal mo chos sdings/sgar du 7gong sa don gyi bdag po'i zhabs su gtugs te brtags lung zhus 'bras nged rang la lo mang bstan pa'i rmi ltas don smin du gyur/ skabs der yab yum rnam /pas gtsos 'brel yod mang po zhig gis nged la bo dong bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhu ba su yin ngo sprod dgos pa'i 'dri rtsad mang du phebs par de dus rang ngos nas thad /ra lan 'debs ma thub kyang / nged rang la bstan pa'i lung bstan 'khrul ba med pa zhig yin pa dang 7rgyal ba don gyi bdag pos bstsal ba'i brtags lung bslu ba med pa zhig yin pa bcas la gzhi bcol te ngo dong chodas 'byung la nyams zhib rags tsam bgyis 'bras/ spyir stangs bshad rgyun du bo dong gi bla rabs zer na dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa nas bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal bar gyi bo dong rgyud kyi bla rabs kho nar brtsi srol 'dug pas/ zhib par dpyad na dpang 'o/ chen dze ni mkhan chen 'bum phrag gsum pa nas bsdonas pa'i gdan sa chen po bo sngo/nga e'i mkhan thog nyi shu pa dang / de rjes lo chen byang chub rtse mo sku gas dbon rgyud dang rgyal sras thogs med bzang po dang bla ma dam pa ba〈snad nams rgyal mtshan sogs snag tu mi phebs pas kyang bo dong gi gdan sa bskyangs/ de rjes bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis bo dong gdan sa bskyangs te 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis mtshan snyan phyogs thams cad tu khyab pas phyogs las rnam rgyal zhes mtshan gnas thob pa sogs mkhan rabs lo rgyus la gzhigs na/ bo snga nga e'i mkhan rabs nang bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhes pa'i mtshan can bla ma gcig kho na las med pa de ni bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan las gzhan ma mchis na bo dong gi bla ma khyad 'phags zhes pa khengang 129

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /rang la ngo sa 'dzin zhus/nyi zhes dang /'bo sa 'o/ gachodan nu dpal gyis 1476 'o/ra mjug mo ngas su sngo gas par mdzad pa'i deb gter sngon po'i deb ther sngon po/ smad cha/ si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang / 1984 dum bu bcu pa/ dus kyi 'kho ra lo'i skabs kyi sna ga grangs 920las/ mkhas pa'i dbang thod dpang chod bo/sa brtan pa'i rnam thar bsdus pa'i nang / chos kyi rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pas dus kyi 'khe/ra 'orware rgyud 'grel gyi lung gsan pa na/ khyed kyis 'di la nan tan che ba zhig malhu da cig gsung ba'i bka' nan yang gnang / zhes dang / yang lo chen byang chub rtse mo'i rnam thar bsdus pa'i nang /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i bkas bo dong gi gdan sa yang mdzad / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa gong du 'byon no ba'i phyag phyir stag lung gi bar du byon pas/ stag lung rin po che rata nā ka ras/ lo tsā ba rtse mo 'di nged kyi dbon po'i slob dpon du gnang ba zhu zhes dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la zhus pas/ de bzhin du byas pas chog gsungs nas gnang / zhes gsal ba la bsam gzhigs bgyis tshe bla ma dam pa ba11da nams rgya la mtshan dang / ngo dong pa'i snga rabs kyi bla ma rnams chos 'brel phar 'bul tshur 'bul dang / 'brel 'dris chen sngo/ yod pa zhor nas shes thub/rtsom pa po'i mchan/ sngon brjod du zhus zin ltar bod kyi lo rgyus la shin tu mkhas pa/ i 'jin si mi thid (2 6373 581 khri) mchog gis mdzad pa'i (77179 7/khya9717 725851 nang bo dong pa'i grub mtha' dang ha cang 'brel che ba'i bla ma ko brag pa bsod /mas rgyal mtshan zhu ba zhig kyang mjal bas/ khong ni bo dong gi lta grub bzhed pa las bo dong gi 130

gdan sa chen po spo rong dpal mo chos sdings/ras gzigs dang gu ru sogs kyi rdo rkos sku brnyan bkod legs mang po bdag med rdo phung lta bu bzhag pa mang po mjal/ dgon pa'i nye 'khris byang phyogs ri ldebs kyi lam khar rdo leb chen po dum bu gnyis su gas chag so/nga ba der brjod bya mang po zhig bkod 'dug kyang gsal po med stabs de nyin dus gtugs dbang gis dpar len byas te bzhag /rjes 'o/ra nged kyi ngo shes bod gzhas dang gar 'cham nyams zhib pa dbyin ji 'jil sadha byu ri brgyud rdo rkos yig cha'i brjod bya gang gsal yig thog tu phab pa zhig nged kyi lag tu 〈snan byung ba gsham gsal dgyes su ga11la/ra༅༅/ /oṃ su sti/ grangs med gsum du chogs gnyis mthar son spros pa nyer zhi chos sku zab yangs klongs su pa'i 'chi med lha lam yangs pa'i gzhir/ /mkhyen dang brtse ba'i rin chen khams kyi dkyil 'khor 'od kyi snang ba chen sngo sa thub bstan 'dab brgya kun tu bzhad pa'i ge sar g.yo/ /mkhas mang glang po'i khyu mchog 'jigs med seng ge'i nga ro chen po grags pa'i dbyar rnga srid pa gsum na dog mo/ra bgyid/ khams gsum 'gro la maskyoran par malnga dang nges legs lam ston chodas kyi rgyal mtshan srid rtser gasku mkhas bo snga nga pa zhes spyi bos mchod/ /e ma ho/ gling las mchog gyur lho phyogs 'dzam gling 'dir/ thub pa'i bstan pa mchodag tu dar ba'i gnas/ /gangs ri ra bas bskor ba'i zhing khams 'dir/ /dpal gyi 'byung gnas dpal mo thang gi dbu/ /skal bzang mos pa'i rnam sprul bo dong pa'i/ /byang chub mchog brnyes mngon par byin rlabs 133

'grog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /pa'i/ /mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i pho brang chos kyi mdzod/ /mings nas 'bar du dod thabasdo ra spro ngo mtshar che/ /chos sdings bde chen rgyal ba'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /rigs sngags 'chang ba grub pa'i dbang phyug che/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa ngur smrig zlos gar 'dzin/ /mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i dbus na 'khor lo'i mgon/ /sngags 'chang chen po sangs rgyas rgya mtsho sogs/ /mkhas grub du ma'i gdung dbon las 'ongs shing / /rigs rus khungs btsan dpal gyis legs rgyan pa'i/ mchodag gsum bla mar bsten pa'i sbyin pa'i bdag /rab 'byams pa nam mkha' snga na grub dang /bstan la rab byung shes ldan ngag dbang / bsod nams stobs 'byor ldan rgya mchod dang / ser skya ma bu 'khor bcas bgros te/ /7rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang / / rang gzhan 'bo drug sgrib gnyis spangs phyir dang / /bsags pa'i nor la snying po blangs pa'i phyir/ /gangs can lha gcig spyan ras gzigs dbang gi/ /snying po ma ṇi drug pa'i gzungs mchog 'di/ /stong phrag gcig dang bcu phrag nyi shu bcas/ /mchog tu ngo mtshar 'bur du dod pa 'di/ /sra 'jam rdo yi ngos la legs par bzhengs/ /rab gnas yi ges bsam pa'i byin dbab dang / /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa'i dga' ston skrubs/ /sgrub yi ge legs dpag med / /sbyin pa'i bdag sngo 'khor bcas rnams kyis/ 9 4 9 chos sdings ri ldebs kyi rdo rkos yig cha gnyis pa/ tshor༅༅/ /oṃ si dhi si ji/ /mkhyen pa'i mkha' la rtogs pa'i nyi 'od rgyas/ thugs 134

gdan sa chen po skyo rong dpal mo chos sdings/rje'i 'phrin las snyan pa'i ba dan gasku / /rgyal mtshan lta ga ltar sku ngas 'dzin gtsug gis bsten/ /calaba'i bla ma'i 17gas la phyag 'tshal 'o// kye/ /dkar 17gas gsal bci bshes gnyen/ /gling gi mchog gyur lha phyogs 'dzam bu'i gling / kha ba can zhes rdo rje gdan gyi byang / /lha chos ra ba spu rgyal bod kyi yul/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang gdul bya'i zhing gyur ba/ /ru bzhi'i nang nas la stod lho yi khul/ /sku yi gnas mchog gangs dkar ti me'i shar/ /gsung gi gnas mchodag la phyi chu dbar byang / /tsā ri phag gawa nga thugs kyi gnas kyi nub/ /gdan sa chen po pad+ma chodas sdings na/ /rgyab ri rigs gsum mabo na wa 'dra ba'i mdun/ g.yas na sgrub pa rnam dag bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /gasku/na na chu 1/ dar dkar rkyang pa 'dra/ /mdun gyi ri bo maṇ+ḍal phul ba 'dra/ /de nyid 'dus pa'i pho brang du/ 'bur ba zhes pa'i chos rgyal byung / /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen sngo mi yi rje'i/ sras dang dbon po 'khor los sgyur/ sa skyong nam mkha' dpal/ zhes sogs 'khod 'dugartsom pa po 'i mchan/ rdo rkos yi ge 'di rje dbon nam mkha' dpal bzang gi sku dus mdzad par mngon/ brag dkar ba rig 'dzin chos kyi dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i 'bur ba'i gdung rabs nang rje dbon nam mkha' dpal bzang 'di pa dpa' mdzangs brtul phod cing rlo gros kyi dkyil yangs pa 'jig rten gyi dgra thabs la yang mkhas pas lha rong pa'i 'dzin dbang sa khongs stod smad bar gsum du rgya che ba yang 'di nyid kyi sku ring du byung bar grags/ zhes dang / yang / ( skabs shig chodas sding du zhabs gras blo na po zhig gi spyod pa ma bzo bar thugs snyung bas 'jig rten pha rol gyi lam du gtang ba'i sdig spyong du chos sding gtsug 135

'grog sde che na po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /lag khang gi 'dab 'byar du ma ṇi skor chen lha khang dang bcas pa dang / mngo na dga' chos sder ma ṇi lha khang gong mtshungs/ gcen rin chen mgon gyi dbo ngas rdzogs su shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa brgyad stong pa'i glegs bam gser chos rin po che'i phra tshom can 'gran zla med pa zhig dang / gzhan yang 7rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che/ slob dpon chen po sprul ba'i gu ru mtshan brgyad dang bcas pa'i zhal thang grwa tshar/ grub thob brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi'i zhal thang grwa tshar rgyu dang bkod pas khyad par du 'phags pa bzheng pa sogs rnam dkar gyi mdzad bzang rgya cher bskrun/gsu sogs sdig sbyong mthol bshags mthil phyin mdzad pa'i ru sogasanyi khungs su gong gsal rdo rkos yig cha rnams kyang tshud dam snyam/ rje dbon 'di 7rgyal mchog drug pa dang bdun pa'i dus su phebs pas me lug (1727) lor dbung gtsang dus zir gyi rkyen langs skabs rje dbon 'dis mi dbang pho lhar mi rta rang sgrigs brgya brgal ba rkang 'gro lag 'don gyis dpung 'degs bgyis ba'i bdag rkyen du bka' gtan she bam rim stsal byung ba sogs kyi 'o/ rgyus zur du gzigs/4 10 bod du dus phyis spo rong dgon pa'i gnas stangs/ 'chod bzhugs ྅ rong pa'i dran tho/la stod lpo rong dpal khud mtsho'i shar ngos ri ldebs su ((bo dong paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal dgung grangs sum cu so lnga spyi lo 1410 lor phyag btab cing rgyun ring 'dzin skyong gnang nyi ba'i gdan sa chen po dpal mo chos sdings 'dir rje nyid kyi sku dus su gling bzhir dbye ba'i cos sde khag tu mdo sngags 136

gdan sa chen po sgo rong dpal mo chos sdings/ bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa ma tshang ba med par 'chad ce da rtsom gsum dang thos bsam sgom gsum gyi lha nas 'dzin skyong spel gsum mdzad pa'i rjes shul dag ni dus da lta'ang mjal rgyu sku da pa'i gyang ro khag nas gsal rtogs thub rgyu ma zad/ skabs der gdan sa chen po e chos sde dang dpal mo chos sdings kyis dbus bo lugs bstan pa stod kyi glo yul nas dbus kyi snye mo dang mtsho sna/ sbyor ra/ deng rgya gar gyi mo na yul rta dbang bar dar khyab phyin pa mthong chos su yod/rje nyid kyi rjes rim pas nyams rgud skabs spo rong rje dbon du grags pa'i nam mkha'i mtshan can 'bur ba'i gdung rabs kyis bskyangs/ rim pas bsgyur gling bcu gsum skabs rdzong dga'i chos sde dkar po dang shel dkar chos sde sogs mi nyung ba zhig dge lugs su bsgyur/ spo rong khul du 'dul khri 'dzin pa'i gtsang dgon dpal mo chos sdings dang mngon dga' spyodas sde/ sgam mchodag btsun dgon bcas kyis dbus bo lugs ser khyim pa dang btsun dgon ma lag bcu grangs dang yar 'brog bsam sdings/ snye mo chos sde / gnyal sbyor ra sogs su bo lugs nyams len byed khul yang ches nyams pa'i gnas stangs la phyungs/ phyi lo 1959 dus 'gyur skabs bo dong pa'i bla ma'i mtshan gnas 'dzin pa yar 'brog bsam sdings rdo rje phag mo dang sbyor ra thams cad mkhyen pa/ 'gro mgon/'chi med sprul sku/ me sprul rin po che bcas lnga tsam las ma mchis/dgung lo 82 phebs pa'i spo rong pa dkon gnyer ngag dbang dang dgung lo 87 phebs pa'i khang dkar spyod lags byang chub lhan gnyis la dus phyis 137

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /spo rong dpal mo chodas sdings dgon pa'i gnas stangs skor bcar dri zhus par/snga dus spe rong rje dbon la gdung sras rgyun chad med par 'khrungs dus skya sa dang ser sa zhes gnyis su dbye bas gdung sras bgres pas skya sa rje dbon gyi go gnas 'dzin/ gdung sras 'bring ba 'am chung bas ser sa zhes dpal mo snu sa sdings kyis dbus bo lugs gtsang dpo na pa khag gi bla ma'i dbu gnas bzhes pa red/ de bzhin sras mo bar mas ྅pe lugs btsun dgon gyi mkhan sngo gnang srol yod red/ dper na phyi lo 1959 dus 'gyur skabs dzad rong sras mo bar ma skal bzang bu 'khrid lags sgam mchog btsun dgon gyi mkhan 46) mtshan gnas yod mus red/ mtshan la'ang rje btsun skal bzang lags zhu ba red/ de bzhin shel dkar chodas sde dang rdzong dkar chos sde so/gas kyi chos 'byung nang nam mkha'i mtshan can ྅/ snga nga bla rgyud dang spo rong gdung sras mang 16) mtshan gsal gyi red/ spe gro nga pa'i gdung sras kha shas grub chen rdzu 'phrul can de 'dra byung ba red/ dper na spo rong nam mkha' dkar po zhes pa4grub pa'i dbang po de'i dmar gdung ya mtshan can de da lta'ang mngon dga' chos sde ru mjal rgyu yod red/ lo ngo brgya phrag song rjes kyang dmar gdung de'i sku sha rlon pa lta bu yod red/ re 'gas byin rlabs mtshon ched sku gzugs la lag mur brgyab pa dang / la las dbu skra dang zhal ra bkog ste byin rten du nyar srol yod/ rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs dmar gdung 'di dad ldan kha shas kyis ri sbas brgyab nas 1990 nang malnga na dga' chos sder rang 'jags gdan 'dren zhus 'dug138

gdan sa chen po spo rong dpal mo chos sdings/de dus kyang sku sha rlon rjen yod par re zung gis phyag zhabs dang pus mo'i zur nas byin rten mchosan ched sku sha babo ga pa shes te mthar srid gzhung gis sku gdung 'a/ ras thum sprodan nas deng sang zhal ras las mjal rgyu med/ phyis su nga chorware mi thog la nyams rgud kyis dgon pa ru chos spyod dpe cha slo 'dzin dang gtor bzo dkar rgya na mo gas las bshad grwa tshugs pa'i slob gnyer mo gas med/ snu sa sdings dgon par mtshon na/ dpal lhe byang gnyis sam g.ya'u la yan gyi bu gsum bar ba'i grwa khral rang 'o/ brgyad son dasku na par sgrigs zhugs dgos/ de rjes rang lo bco brgyad ma zin bar 'bri klog shes tsam dang bo lugs chos spyod rlo 'dzin dang gtor bzo dkar rgyan sogs kyi slob sbyodang la brtson/ de bzhin bslab pa rgan gzhon gyi las 'gan rgyugs dbo sa pa ni/ grwa chung rnams la dang thog ja phud pa zhes lha khang dang mgon khang sogs la ja phud phul ba'i 'gan/ de rjes dung pa zhes chosags brda'i dung galta nga mkhan gyi las 'gan/ de rjes spyi ba zhes spyi ba'i las sde'i 'gan 'khur dbo sa pa yin/ rang lo bathod brgyad brgal rjes sngon 'gro gtong dgos/ de nas kun rig dang 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa legs grub rjes sku rim pa'i las 'gan nang zhugs chodag pa yin/ de rjes gnyer pa dang dge skos/ dbu mdzad/ mthar mgon khang bla ma zhes dgon pa'i bo gnas mtho shos bar sku/da/ yul skad du mgon khang bla ma'am re 'gas spo bla ma lags zhes bla ma'i mtshan gnas nas 'bod srol sku da rung / lha na du mkhan po'i thod gnas bzhes pa tsam las mgon khang bla mas yul mi skya ser su la'ang chos 'brel skyong 139

'grog sde chen po spo rong rgi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /ba'i nus pa dang srol rgyun snga sa zhig nas nyams par mngon/ mabonan khang bla ma'i thugs 'gan gtso bo ni cad lugs kyi grags chen me mchod kyi skabs bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin gyis rdza lcags len pa'i gar 'cham dang sbyin sreg bcas kyi dus mchod de rgyun 'dzin legs sgrub skyong rgyu de red/ 'pho bzhugs sku bag kun bzang byams pa lags kyis gsungs dodan/ chos sdings su 'jigs bral chen po nyid kyis bzhengs pa'i drag po'i gtor chen zhig yod pas/ gtor chen de dag 'u thug dus kyi mtha' ma la dgra wa'i rgol lan du rgyag par mngags zhes zer rgyun yod red/phyi lo 1959 'o/ra bod du dus 'gyur skabs spo rong sku ngos chos sdings su phebs nas mgon khang bla mar drag watware gtor chen rgyag pa'i dus la babs pa'i go sgrig bgyis gsungs par/ mgon khang bla ma dang dge 'dun pa rnams nas cang mi smra bar mgo cad 'phur shin bzhugs te gtor rgyag byed ma thub/ de rjes shes sna gas byung don gtor rgyag gi cho ga dang bsnyen rgyun sku gas nyams nas med pa'i rgyu ma'argan gyis yin par shes/4 11 dge 'dun pa'i zhal grangs/dus 'gyur skabs dge 'dun pa'i zhal grangs sum cu yas mas las med kyang snga dus su dge 'dun pa'i zhal grangs nyis brgya skor sku da pa gsham gsal kha mchu'i dpyad yig nas gsal/140

gdan sa chen po sgo rong dpal mo chos sdings/chu rta 1942 lor dgon pa'i daskadan gnyer las thog ngag dbang gis dkon gnyer gsar pa bla zur don chos la dgon pa'i rten mchod rtsis sprod rtsis len ba/bas phan tshun 'khon 'dzin gyis 'gor gzhi byung dus dkon ngag nas kho si ra bsnyad 'dzugs thub tshod bshad pa nad theg thabs med ces lha sar spo rong 'tsho 'dzin yab gzhis lha klu la snyan zhu phul bar 'chongo 'dzin mchog nas sa gnas su zhib dakhyodad kyis bden brdzun thag gcod byed 'thus rgyu zhes bka' lan phebs pa'i kha mchu de'i mtha' ma'i sgrigs 'doms 'tsho 'dzin sku tshab bya mang tshe ring ngam/ mtshan ngan la 'tsho 'dzin mgo ril zhes pa dang spo rong spyi khyab gnyer pa/ dgra 'dul/ spo rong drung yig phan phyi dbang phyug bcas nas gnang ba'i dpyad shog ngo 'dra ngo ma zhig dkon ngag rang nas da bar bdag nyar bgyis pa de'i nang skabs de'i dgon pa'i gnas stangs skor 'di 'dra gsal/ ji lhag don gus tsho'i dgon gnas pad chos 'di bzhin de snga bo lugs gtsang dgon dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya brgal ba nas bstan srid zhabs 'degs mi dman tsam sku(da lu gas kyang / rim nyams deng skabs dge 'dun bslab pa'ang 'chal zhing zhal grangs kyang je nyung deng zhal grangs sum cu tsam la thug pa 'di yang nyams pa sor tshud mi nyams gong 'phel bca' yig rin po che'i dbo ngas don bzhin bstan srid kyi zhabs 'degs lhag bsam rnam dag 'byung ched bka' zhib mthar phyin zhig yod pa zhu/gnyi zhes gsal ba nas 'jigs bral chen sngo/sa phyag btab pa'i gdan sa 'i gnas stangs snga dus shig nas nyams gud song ba gsal rtogs thub/ dkon 141

'grog sde chen po skyo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /ngag gi dran thog la/ spo rong du spyi khyab zla ba dar rgyas zhes lha sar rgyun ring bzhugs shing rtsis dawa na lung shar dang lo mang mnyam gshib kyi rlo thub yod pa khong gis rang dgon dpal mo chos sdings kyi 'dul ba'i bstan pa dang bshad sgrub kyi sde slar gso dgos kyi 'dug ces thugs 'tshab gnang gi yod kyang lung shar la sku nyes phog pa dang spyi khyab nyid kyang sku tshe ma zin pas de mur lus pa red/ skabs de'i h+pho rong rje dbon gyi mkhyen pa'ang de tsam med la thugs sems bzang zhing mi mang sgyu ga thug mi mdzad mkhan zhig sku da/ der brten rang khongs mi mang re zung nas rje dbon la gyen log gis gdan sa chen wa se ra dang mdzod sbug sku gas la mabo btags byas pa'ang lo rgyus gamo sa pa yod/ ces bshad/

5 sa rong dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus khag cig5 1 glob dpon gyi gnas chen dpal khud mtsho 'am lha mtsho srin mtsho /rtsom pa po'i mchan/ gzhis bzhugs spo rong pa khyu tog zla ba lags kyis brtsams pa'i gsham gsal 'o/ rgyus 'di gus kyi lag tu son byung bas dus gtugs dzar+shag mchan lngasteb min la ma ltos par 'bri rtsom 'di dang 'brel che bar brten ji ma ji bzhin bkod yod lags/((dpal khud mtsho zhes pa ni dpal khud ces pa yul gyi ming yin zhing deng skabs skyo rong zhes grags pa gnya' nang rdzong gi khongs su gto/gas pa'i shang zhig yin la / yul de'i nub kyi cha la deng skabs dpal kud mdza 'am sa khra 'ga' zhig gi nang phad kud mcho zhes ma dag pa rgyun 'jags su gnas/ gang ltar mtsho 'di ni/ sngon gyi dus su slob dpon chen po bod yul du thog mar phebs skabs bod yul kha la'i la thog tu gangs dkar sha med dam la 'dogs gangs dkar ma mtsho la bros shing / slob dpon gyis mcho skol bas gangs dkar ma sha rus bye nas rus pa dkar sang song bas de phyin chad gangs dkar sha med ma'am sha med shod rje g.yu sgron mar grags pa de mo gas brtan ma'i bla mace ra grags la/ g.ya'u la yan chod sgo rong khul la sgo phyugs mdzo bsten mi rung zhing / ram chos rgyag mi nyan pa da lta'ang bo mas gshis rgyun chags su gnas mus lags/ de bzhin bon gyi khyodags nas masnu ma pham dang la ngag masnum gnyis kyi gnas tshab tu bsngags shing lha mtsho srin mtsho zhes mtsho gcig la ming gnyis su snang ba yang 143

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /de ltar yin 'dug go/ /gang ltar mtsho 'di ni brtan ma'i bla mtshor grags pa dang masnu la dar chags dang ma chags sku gas rten 'brel ni mang du brtag rgyu sku da pa zhig yin 'dug la mtsho skor 'bul ba sogs gnas gnyan wa ra ngos 'dzin par snang / mchod 'di'i nub phyogs su lho nas byang ngos su rim pa bzhin du wa da yul kha la'i la thog ces pa gangs dkar sha med ma'i gnas yul gangs ri dam bzhag gnang yul yang yin la/ de nas rim bzhin ja la'am ja khyu la dang /ma la/ gung thang la kha zhes chodab dpon chen po srin yul du gshegs skabs bod kyi rje 'bangs phebs skyel du ༷ na pa'i gnas mang yul gung thang la kha sku da/ mtsho 'di'i shar du/ dpal mo thang gi dpal thang du:ོ brtan ma bcu gnyis dam la btags: zhes pa'i sa cha da lta'i bar sa ming 'pho 'gyur med par gnas yod la/ brtan ma'i mchod 'dren dang bzhugs khang lto byang gnyis bcas yod/ mtsho 'di'i nye 'khris su gnyer ston bya mang wa chen po'i gdan sa mang ngo byang chub gling dang / la sbug bde chen sgang zhes pa bon gyi bla rgyud grags chen spa tshang gi gdan sa/ gtsug snodar dkar nag mchodad rten/ de las cung zad rgyang tsam na gsang 'dus pho brang pad+ma chos sdings sam dpal mo chos sdings su grags pa bo dong paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal dgung grangs sum cu so lnga spyi lo 1410 lor phyag btab cing rgyun ring 'dzin skyong gnang bas de'i ring la/ rgyal ba dge 'dun grub sdu/gas bstan 'dzin gyi skye chen mang po'i zhabs kyis bcags/phyis nas kyang spo rong rje dbon nam mkha'i mtshan can mang lnga/ rim pas bskyangs/ 144

1— rong dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus khag cigade ltar dpal khyad mtsho dang de'i nye 'khor gyi ngos sbyor mdor bsdus su yul spo rong gi skye warware tha shal phran zla bas 2001 'orware zla 12 tshes 10 la phul snyigam —4 na/ 'tsho bzhugs spe rong pa bgres po tsho'i dran thog la mtsho 'di'i khyad chos ya mtshan can zhig ni kha rgyun du ga tsang dar gas na mchong dar chags zhes/ lo ltar bod zla 1 tshes 15 la gtsang po'i dar kha gas pa'i du sa su dpal khud mchos gzim song zhes dar kha sgrig pa yin/ de rjes bod zla 3 tshes 15 nyin lha mtsho bzhengs song zhes mtsho'i dar kha 'jig par grags/ mchos dar sgrig skabs 'brog sde nang khul 'grim 'grul ha cang nye ba dang mtsho'i dar khas sems can khyu snu gas thegs pa ma zad phyis su snum 'khor mo ṭa yang thegs kyi sku da 'dug /mcho 'di gting mcho yin pas spo gro nga nub byang sa mtshams kyi gangs ri nas thon pa'i chu bo lha chu dang / rta chu/ de min rgyug chu kha shas kyis 'geng pa yin/mtsho 'di dang yar 'brog g.yu mtsho gnyis mthil sbrel ba'i lo rgyus bshad srol 'dug5 2 the rong pa dang sge ra lung shar/ yab gzhis lha klu/ yab gzhis g.yu thog bcas kyi skor/'brog sde ba spo rong pa dang bod kyi rgyal rabs nang yongs grags rtsis dpon lung rigar dod rje tshe rgyal dbar mthun phyogs kyi 'brel ba chen dze/ byung bas/ de las 'phros te spo rong rje dbon nam mkha' ngag dbang 'jigs med kyi bdag mor lung shar gyi nu mo 'am mkhar rta 'or pa'i sras mo chung :wal lags zhu ba bsus/ de 145

'grog sde chen po slo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /bzhin spo rong pa dang lha sa'i sku drag nas/ yab gzhis lha klu gzim shag dang /yab gzhis g.yu thodag gzim shag bcas kyi dbar yang mdza' 'brel chen po byung bar brten phyi 'o/ 1952 'o/ra da lta 'chod bzhugs yab gzhis lha klu'i gcung sngo/'am yab gzhis g.yu thog gi sras kun bzang byams pa lags spo grogang rje dbon gyi sras mo'i sku bag tu bzhes te spo rong 'bur pa'i gdung zam chad pa'i rjes kyi rje dbon dang po de khong rang chags pa red/ de snga bod kyi rgyal sa lha sar spo mo nga pa'i 'tsho 'dzin zer ba'i go gnas med kyang dus mtshams de 'dra zhig nas dbo sa dbang gis yab gzhis lha klu gzim shag la the rong snu brgyad kyi 'tsho 'dzin du bskul ba dang de bzhin spo rong gnyer pa la spe rong spyi khyab ces go gnas kyi ming la'ang 'pho 'gyur byung ba red/lung shar dang spo rong pa'i dbar thog ma'i 'brel ba chags stangs ni rje dngo na gong ma lha sras dam pa'i skabs nas byung ba zhig tu mngon/ dgung lo 88phebs pa'i spo rong khang dkar spo spo byang chub lags kyis gsungs wa na ((de dus nga lo chung chung song tsang dran yag po sos kyi mi 'dug /bshad srol la shel dkar du lnga da gzhung gis me mo bka' zhib zer ba zhig tshugs pa red/ da lta byas dus bka' zhib de 7rgyal ba sku 'phreng bcu gsum pa'i skabs grong drag dmag sgar zhes pa ba3kyil rgyu'i ched chos gzhis che khag dang sger pa che khag nas gzhung khral bsdu rgyu'i lha ra yin pa 'dra 'dug /de'i skabs la shel dkar mnga' zhabs nang spo rong pa ha cang gi dbang shugs chen wa red/ phal cher spo rong 146

sgo rong dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus khag cigapas gar bzhag lta bu'i skad grags yodad pa red/ rje dbon lha sras dam pa zhu ba de chos srid gnyis la mkhyen 'jo na ldan pa zhig byung ba red/ kho nga gi phyag zhabs su po nga rang nang bzhin gyi shes 'jon gnyis ldan yin pa khang dkar gnyer pa nga kra shis zhu ba gcig byung ba red/ gnyer pa bkra shis zer ba de nga'i pa lags dang bu rang gi ma phyogs kyi spo spo red/ khang dkar gnyer pa bkra shis dang spo rong rje dbon lha sras dam pa gnyis ha cang gi thugs mthun nye sgrig chen po red/ rtsaba'i gnyer pa lags la zur mtshor rang khyim du bu spun gzhan gyi mnyam mna' ma yod mus kyang / rje dbon gyi zhabs phyir rgyun ring sbra chen du bzhugs dgos byung stabs rje dngo na gyi sras mo bgres sna sa dawa na mo bu 'khrid lags zhu ba dang mnyam mthun gyis sras gnyis dang sras mo/ gcig 'khrungs pas sras mo pad+ma lags zhu ba de bu rang gi skyed ma dang dpon mo bu 'khrid lags zhu ba de bu rang gi rmo rmo red gnyer pa bkra shis bu rang gi h+pho lags red/ skabs der shes yon dang 'jon stangs mi rgyu gang gi thad nas spe rong pa mnga' thang longs spyod rgyas shing snyan grags chen sngo yod pas khong cho gnyis lhan 'dzoms la rgyal blon lhan 'dzoms zer ba dang shel dkar mnga' zhabs nang khong gnyis la spo rong gi stag gzig gnyis zhes ming 'dogs kyang thogs pa red/ bka' zhib de'i skabs shel dkar mnga' zhabs su rtsodad gleng mang po byung bas/ kha shas kyis gzhung khral ngos len zhus pa dang kha shas kyis rgol len byas pa red/ spo rong pas bod gzhung la zhabs ste ga sa kyis gzhung khral la lnga sa len zhus rkyen shel 147

'grog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /dkar mnga' zhabs nas bo nga drag dmag khral 'bul gtan 'khel ba red/ zer srol la skabs der shel dkar chos sder khral 'bab chen po 'khris pa 'dod med blo pham ngang 'bul dbo sa byung stabs bzod min gyis spo ro/nga pa la ngan ma thu brgyab pa red ces de rjes sku ngo lha sras dam pa sku tshe yun ring ma brtan pa dang khang dkar khyim tshang la'ang khyodang bo da chen wa chags pa red/ da lta byas na grong drag dmag mi skul mkhan lte ba de lung shar red 'dug /de dus nas spo rong pa dang lung shar gnyis mthun lam chen po byung ba 'dra 'duganyi ces gsung /gong 'khod lo rgyus skor da lta 'tsho bzhugs dgung lo 88 thebs pa'i spo rong pa dkon gnyer ngag dbang rang nyid kyi myong tshor dang bcas gsungs don/ ((spo rong tsho brgyad zer dus ha cang gi sa rgya chen po red/ de 'dra song tsang rtswa kha'i snga na dag la sa mtshams ga sa ga nas kha mchu yang yang sku/nga gi sku da red/ nga rang gi dran thog la spo rong rje dbon nam mkha' ngag dbang 'jigs med kyi skabs gnyer pa zla ba dar rgyas zhes pa'i mi skad grags chen po gcig byung ba red/ khong da lta 'o re'i spyi khyab bu dngos grub kyi spo lags de red/ nga rang gzhon dus gnyer pa zla ba dar rgyas kyi zhabs phyi la ga sa ga la 'gro tshudang / de dus nga lo 17 tsam dang gnyer pa lags dgung lo 50 tsam red/ 'o re'i gnyer pa zla ba dar rgyas de spyir stangs sbyangs pa'i shes yon la mkhas pa zhig min yang las wa na lnga ga la spo rong spyi pa la zhen khog che zhing mi dmongs dang dpon g.yog mtho dman bar gsum la 'brel ba 'jog thub pa dang skad cha 148

spo rong dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus khag cis bshad ya la the tshom med par blo khog chen wa sa rang thag chod po shod thub mkhan gcig yod red/ khong ni mi dbang chen gcig yod red/ khong gi skabs la swo rong tsho brgyad mnyam rub kyis gan rgya mthu ྅/ che zhes pa gcig bzhag pa red/de ga re red ce na/ tsho brgyad pa su 'dra zhig la'ang gzhan gyis thub tshod gtong ba'am kha mchu 'dzugs pa sku gas byung na de'i lha la len chos brgyad mi rgyu mnyam rub kyis byed rgyu de red/ de 'dra song tsang lpo rong pa'irdza kha'i kha mchu'i don la gnyer pa lags dzad rong pa'i don gcod du bskos nas lha sar bzhugs dgos kyi yod red/ khong gi zhabs phyir nga yang lha sar lo gnyis lhag tsam bsdad pa yin/ 'gro gron yang gang 'tshams yod stabs mi mang re 'ga'i lhu gas nas mos mthun med pa'i rnam 'gyur stodan mkhan yang byung yod pa red/ gnyer pa lags khong rang lha sa ru snga rjes bsdoms lo ngo nyi shu lhag tsam lus pa red/ de 'dra'i las don dang 'brel spo ro/nga pa dang rtsis dpon lung shar gnyis gcig phan gnyis rogs kyi mthun phyo gas chags pa red/ skabs shig rtsis dasnga na lung shar phran bu 'khos zhan byung ba'i gnas stangs la spo rong pho brgyad nas rogs skyor du 'bri ltag ma 80 dang de dag 'tsho yul gyi rtsa khar/ gangs lhas/ zhes pa dang / lag sgor ra/ zhes pa gnyis phul ba red/ spo rong rje dbon nam mkha' ngag dbang 'jigs med la bdag mo kha shas bsus kyang rgyun ring ma gnas stabs mthar rtsis dpon lung shar nas thabs byus kyis khong rang gi nu mo 'am mkhar rta 'or pa'i sras mo/ chung sgrol lags/ zhu ba de bsus pa red/ 'brel 149

'brog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long / lam de la brten rjes su rje dbon nam mkha' ngag dbang 'jigs med la gdung rgyud 'acirdon mkhan gyi sras ma 'khrungs stabs lha sa nas yab gzhis gaX/ thog gi sras sam yab gzhis lha klu'i gcung sngo kun bzang byams pa lags spo mo nga gi sku bag tu len pa red/ de bzhin lha sa ru yab gzhis lha klu gzim shag la spo mo nga pa'i 'tsho 'dzin zhes dang gnyer pa zla ba dar rgyas la spo rong spyi khyab ces bo gnas kyi ming yang bsgyur ba red/ lung shar dang yab gzhis lha klu/ yab gzhis g.yu thog bcas kyi gzim shag phan tshun gyi 'brel ba'i stodar de mgo lha gas tsha bo yod red/ de'i skor deb gzhan pa de 'dra gzigs na yag po yod red/ngas khungs 'khyol mi yong / nga rang lha sar 'gro dus lung shar la bka' nyes phogs zin nas mi 'dug /de 'dra song tsang nga dza'ire gnas tshang shel dkar gling pa red/ de'i sngon la spo rong pa'i gnas tshang lung shar gyi gzim shag yin 'dugalha sa'i sku drag gi kho ngas rtsis dawa na lung shar dang mnyam blo mthun yid ches 'pher ba'i phyag rogs gcig ni rgyal mkhar nang pa'i sku ngo bshe zur zhu ba de red/ lung shar la bka' nyes phogs rjes bshe zur lags kong yul du rgyang 'bud btang ba red/ de bzhin lung shar gyi zhabs phyi lhag pa rdo rje zer ba de the rong sku bag gi chibs zhabs su lha sa nas spo rong du 'byor bas mthar spo rong sbra chen du gzhis chags te kho ba'i bu rdo rje don grub ces pa dus deng sang yang sbra chen rang du yoci+od mus yin/sa zhes dang /dgung lo 68 thebs pa'i khang dkar bu bsam grub lags dang lpo rong sku 150

spe rong dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus khag cigabag kun bzang byams pa gnyis 'o/ mang mnyam gshib dang phyi ltar dpon gasku ga gi rnam rdzu tsam las don du nang tshags chen po byung ba'i cha nas lung shar skor 'di 'dra ga bye/ngas kyi 'dug ((spo rong sku ngo kun bzang byams pa lags sku 'khor dang nged rang lo mang gshib snu nga yod/ rtsa ba'i nga tsho dpon g.yog yin khul yang don du nang tshags kyis nga tsho ga sa ga la mnyam lnga phyin nas snang ba skyid wa byed snu nga / lha sar yang rgyun ring bsdad pa red/ spo rong sras mo tsho'i yum phung shar gyi nu mo red/ khong rang gis lung shar la zhang lags zhu ba red/ skabs gcig ngas yu ma sku zhabs la nang tshags brnyad 'tshol gyis rtsis dpon lung shar zer ba de ni bdud re da zer gyi 'dug /rkub la rnga ma skyes yod red zer gyi 'dug /de 'dra gang red zhus par yum sku zhabs kyis 'di 'dra gsungs byung / zhang lags dam pa de bdud yin nam lha yin ngas mi shes/ gang ltar mi phal pa gcig ni cangab nas min gsungs byung / gang ngam zhes bka' 'dri zhus pas 'di 'dra gsung gi 'dug /nged rang zhang lags kyi mnyam du lha sar sdod dus pho brang nas zhang lags su sam ṭa yang yang phebs3) red/ sam ṭa zhal kha ma phye gong zhang lags yar bzhengs nas sam ṭa de phyag gnyis kyis bteg ste dbu cadad kyi steng du bzhag nas thugs sgyu na dang bcas gus pa chen ྅/sa zhal phye gnang gi red/ sam ṭa ni yang yang phebs kyi sku/da pa dran gyi 'dug /7rgyal ba rin po ches zhang lags la de 'dra'i thugs re dang yid ches gnang gi yod na khong rang lha yin dang bdud yin sus lab thub kyi red gsungs myong /nyi zhes gsungs/151/

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /me mo/ bka' zhib zhes pa de phyi 'o/ 1927 me mo yos lor tshugs pa red/de rjes phyi lo 1932 chu sprel 'i ra grong drag dmag skar bskul ba dang 1933chu bya 'o/ra 7rgyal ba sku 'phreng bcu gsum pa chen po sku mya ngan las 'das rjes rtsis dpon lung shar la bka' nyes 'o/gas te mig ril gtol ba red/'bri rtsom 'di mjug bsdu byed khar pha yul drwa rgya'i nang 'jam dbyangs nor bu lags nas a ri'i mkhas pa ghol si ṭan (5khu/5〉bzhu 60/spubya khu10) la lan 'debs ring po zhig gnang ba'i khongs rtsis dpon lung shar gyi stodar la'ang gsal kha mngo na malnga nga che ba'i gleng ba mang dag cig mdzad pa de tsho'i bakhyodad bya rang skad du bsgyur na go dodan ji chags brjod mi thub kyang / 'di'i skor chung dus nas dbyin slob kho na 'grims pa'i nged kyi bu mo rnam rgyal sgrol dkar gyis nged la dri ba ya mtshan can zhig btang byung / ((pa lags/ rtsis dpon lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal zer ba de ing lanaḍa dang rgya gar sku/gas rgyal khab mang por 'thod myong ba'i bod pa'i dasngo/na po gal chen zhig yin pa 'dra 'dug khos (2/7067760)shes kyi yod red zer gyi 'dug pas ga nas sbyangs pa yin 'bo / bod pa'i spyi tshogs nang ab ri kha'i (70060018210) de 'dra sku da red pas nyi zer gyi 'dug /rnam rgyal sgrol dkar ni bod dang ngo da dodan skor dod snang can gyi na ga'on ma zhig yin pa ma zad 'jam dbyangs nor bu lags kyi 'bri rtsom la shin tu ma sa shing dga' gus can ma zhig red/ dri ba 'di btang rjes 'jam ce ra lags kyi 'bri rtsom de cha tshang zhig nged rang gis kyang bklags pa yin/ 'byung 'gyur byes 152

sgo rong dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus khag ciga' byor bod mi'i spyi chodags kyi gnas stangs la dbyin skad ni gasku la thabs med pa'i skad rigs shig yin pa dang rnam rgyal sgrol dkar lta bu'i na gzhon ni je mang nga/ 'phar rgyur gdon mi za/ der brten nged kyi ngos nas bu mo rnam rgya la sgrol dkar la lan 'debs 'di 'dra zhig byas pa yin/ nga tsho'i nang du zhabs rim mang po byed kyi yo da pa'i khongs skabs re mi gzugs brdzangs pa/ dper na lo sasar ma ran gong nyi shu dgu'i nyin a ma jo mo zhes mi gzugs la 'o/ gcig gi dgos mkho sku ngas rdzogs dang bcas brdzangs sku la yod pa khyed rang gis shes shes red/ de bzhin dbo na pa khag gi nang sbyin sreg me mchod dang zhi drag gi gtor rgyag byed pa sku gas khyed rang gis shes shes pa red/ de'i gras la masnga sa rdzong gtor rgyag ces rkyen sel gyi zhabs rim khongs tshud pa red/ de min gna' dus shig nas dar ba'i gsang sngags kyi chos log khyodad byas te gzhan la gcodad pa gtong rgyur gtad bcug sri gcodan sogs ngan mthu'i lo rgyus mang po sku da/ spo rong gi ngag rgyun lo rgyus nang du'ang bkod yod/ lo ngo nyis stong brgal ba'i bod kyi rgyal rabs lo rgyus rnams bden pa bden bzhag dang phyi gsal nang gsal du kū la'i na bza' lta bu 'bri mkhan byung na ngan mthu zer ba dang ngan gasku zer ba sogs bshad rgyu mang wa mo da red/ der brten mdodas rdzong gtor rgyag dang ngan mthu gtad bcug sogs ni gna' dus nas dar ba'i rang re'i spyi tshogs kyi rig gzhung gi yan lag lta bu zhig chags sku da pa las rtsis dpon lung shar gyis dbyin yul du sbyangs nas bod du slebs pa zhig ye nas ma red ces brjod pa yin/153

'grog sde chen po hro rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /deng sud sir gnas 'khod mkhar 'or bu rig 'dzin rdo rje lags kyis gsungs don/ rtsis dpon lung shar gyi skor gzhan gyis bris pa dang ngag rgyun gyi lo rgyus mang dag yod rung phyogs lhang spangs pa'i bden pa bden bzhag gis bris pa'i lo rgyus ches dkon/ ngas shes rtogs la sku ngo rma bya tshe dbang 'gyur med lags nas rang nyid kyi sku tshe'i lo rgyus zin bris shog grangs phon che yod pa zhig par bskrun ma thub par lus pa de tsha rong gi sras shig la g.yar nas phyir log ma byung bar da lta gar yod cha med du gyur pa dang / yang la las kyis brjod don sku ngo rma bya'i lcam gyis mer bsregs btang par yang grags/ gang ltar zin bris de'i nang rtsis dpon lung shar gyi skor 'grel brjod dang bcas lo rgyus rgyas tsam sku/da skad 'dug ces gsungs/spyir stangs bshad srol la 'o/ rgyus kyi kha lo dbang 'dzin pas byed ces pa lta ra/ sde ba gzhung gis rtsis dpon lung shar glo bur du 'dzin bzung mdzad de khrims sar lugs mthun bden rtsod kyi go skabs med par ya nga zhing yid mug ba'i nyes chad mig gnyis kyi 'bras bu rtsabarkos bgyis pa ma zad/ gar bltas mun pa ma galta gas rig rgyu med pa'i long ba kher rkyang de'ang khang chung mun nag zhig gi nang du bcug pa bcas bka' gnyan pa'i gnas stangs der lung shar rang ngos sam phyogs gtogs su zhig nas bden rtsod gnang thub pa'i slo slobs dang nus pa ye nas ma mchis shing don dngos su skabs de'i dbang 'dzin pa rnam pas gang bshad bden pa lta bu chags pa ni chab srid kyi chos nyid du gyur ro snyam/ gal 154

spo rong dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus khag cigate rtsis dpon lung shar gyis 'char gzhi ltar bod kyi rgyal srid la bcos bsgyur chen mo de lam 'gro phyin sku da na de mjug gi bod kyi gnas stangs ji 'gro sus kyangamangon shes bshad thub kyi ma red/ 'char gzhi de lag thog slebs khar gtor bshig gtong mkhan ni khong gis rgyun ring yid ches byed sa'i dpung rogs ka shod pa red 'dug /ka shod pa'i lo rgyus bshad na ka shod ḍa ma mgo sbrel zhes rang don khog bcug gis rang nyid kyi lus ngag yid gsum ngan g.yo'i bya ba kho nar spyod mkhan zhig yin pa yong grags red/ 'jam nor lags kyi dgongs tshul la lung shar gyi bcos sgyur lam lhong byung du 'gyur na'ang bod du bla ma'i ring lugs mu mthud 'gro gi red brjod par snang bas/ skabs de'i gnas stangs la gzhigs na ser 'bras dga' gsum sogs sde pa gzhung la'ang wa gtad gasgu ga mkhan gyi nus pa la babs bsnyun byas par dge mtshan babyuṇ+ḍis pa ni dngos yod kyi gnas stangs shig re da/ dper na dus 'gyur skabs kyi gnas tshul la gzhigs na rgya ngos nas kyang sku so'i dgos snga na sgrub ched bod kyi bla dpon mkhan po sogs su rung rang phyogs su bkug ste bed spyod byas yod/ mtha' na sku'i gcen po stag 'tsher thub bstan 'jigs med nor bu bar du thar pa btang med pa sku ngas grags red/ der brten lung shar nas ser 'bras mo gas dgon pa khag na nye sgrig bzos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis skru nga gi mtha' ma'i dmigs yul 'o/ga pa red brjod rgyu ni thal cha'i dgongs tshul zhig red snyam/ kun slong bzang pos bskul ba'i dmigs yul nges can zhig sgrub par thabs zhi rgyas dbang drag 155

'brog sde chen po skyo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /gi lam gang yang rung zhes pa'i bka' slob kyang rang re tshang ma'i dran thog tu yod/mdor na/ bod nas yab gzhis lha klu tshe dbang rdo rjes bris pa'i nga'i pha lung shar the rje tshe rgyal zhes pa dang de min bcadas med ngag rgyun dag la gzhigs na bod kyi khyim tshang 'bring po zhig nas yong ba'i bod mi skya bo phal pa zhig chung dus chos srid kyi sbyang pa mthil phyin pa byas/ de nas rim pas bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gi skas 'dzegs gzar zhing ring la gug kyog mang ba der shar 'dzegs kyis 7rgyal mchog bcu gsum pa chen po'i thugs kyi bzhed don lhan gyis 'grub ched dmigs bsal spyan gsal gyi go 'phang mthon sngo ra slebs thub pa dang / de bzhin bod gangs ri'i rwa ba'i phyi rol du 'khod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i 'dzam gling go la chen por rgyun ring bskor ba byas te mthar rang yul gyi zhabs zhur phyir 'o/ga gis nged kyi pha yul 'di'ang rgyal khab gzhan mtshungs dus bstun bsgyur bcos shig thub na ci ma rung snyam pa'i nges 'byung drag pos bskul zhing dngangs tshab can gyi bod kyi bu yag po de rang re'i spyi bsod kyis ma theg par phan med du btang bar ngos 'dzin zhu gi yod/5 3 'brog sde spo rong pa'i khyad chos 'dren pa/chos rgyal dus su bal bza' byon/ /de rjes slob dpon chen po yis/ /grags pa'i mtsho chen dpal khyad du/ /brtan ma bcu gnyis dam la btags/ /a ti sha dang 'bum phrag rje/ /'bum phrag gsum pas cad dong btab/ /de nas mi la 156

spo rong dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus khag cigayab sras gyon/ /bu yi khengs pa btul ba'i ched/ /dpal khud thang gshongs leb mo ru/ /ser phab g.yag ru'i rdzu 'phrul bstan/ /gnas der de bas ser lung zer/ /ber rtse 'dod yon rdzong du byon/ /rgan mo shi ba'i ro las kyis/bu smu mi rtag 'chi chos gsungs/ /mkha' la gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /sbas phug ma mo rdzong mdun du/ /lam gyi lug rdzi chos la bskul/ /rdzi bo ras pa de nas byung / /dpal thang mtsho yi shar ngos su/ /yul de la phug ces pa na/'chi la ran pa'i bon gyi phas/ /longs spyod sdig la sbyor nye bar/ /thabs kyis bcos te chos la bskul/ /gshen sgom ras pa de nas byung / /rwa lo gnyan smu+o thogs med sras/ /dpang shong grags pa rgyal mtshan rje/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan byang chub rtse/ /'jigs bral khu dawa na 'kho ra bcas dang / /sprul pa'i rje btsun rdo rje phag /lhag par dge 'dun grub rje 'am/ /thams cad mkhyen pa la sdudags pa'i/ /'o/ paṇa rin chen 'phreng ba'i tshogs/ /gnas 'dir phebs 'e byin gyis brlabs/ /e/ tha ṇi yi gtsug lag tu/ /shi ra tha te zhes bkur pa 'i/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsā ba/ /rtsam zan 'di yang yul 'di'i bu/ /dpal mo tha nga gi dpal thang du:ོ brtan ma bcu gnyis dam la btags:ོ bod yul ba la'i la thog tu:ོ gangs dkar sha med dam la btags: zhes sogs yongs su grags pa'i gnas/ /yul 'di ru ma gtogs gang du rnyed/ /slob dpon chen ngo 'i bka' yis balha sa/ /dpang lo'i rjes 'brang bod du byon/ /chos srung bkra yis 'od 'bar 'khor/ /khyed kyi rten mkhar phyo gas bzhir gzengs/ /'bur 157

'brog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /gdung snu sa rgyal chen ngo yis/ /rje dbon lugs kyis chodas bzhin bskyangs/g.yag rtsid bal las legs bskrun pa'i/ /stong shong rgya che'i sbra chen nang / bskal pa'i me yi rgyun byin sku/da/ /de bas yul ming sbra chen lnga gas/ /chodas kyi sgra yis rab phyug cing / /rdzogs ldan dpa' dang dpa' mo'i gar/ /dkar phyogs rgyal ba'i dga' ston mchodan/ /gara'adir de bas rgyal gzhas zer/ /'di lta'i khyad chos rin chen rgyan/ /yul 'dir ma gtogs gang du rnyed/5 4 7rgyal ba'i rnam thar nas lung drangs pa'i skabs de'i spe rong gi gnas stangs/7rgyal ba'i thog ma rje dge 'dun grub kyi rang rnam dang / 7rgyal mchog lnga pa chen wa'i rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mchodas mdzad pa'i 7rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i rnam thar rab gsal gser gyi snye ma bcas shin tu rtsa che ba'i bod kyi lo rgyus 'di gsum rags tsam zhal mjal thub pa skal bzang du gyur/ rnam thar dag nyin tho rim bkod la gzhigs te 7rgyal ba'i mdzad pa ngo mtshar can mtha' yas pa rnams phreng bsgrigs mdzad pa'i nang /gnam lo nam gsar gyis mchotshon mnga' thang dang nyams bzang che ba'i sde pa gzhung gi mdzad lha khag la phebs zhugs chog pa'i bla dpon mi sna rnams gdan sprodab la gzhigs te bzhugs gral la 'khod kyi yod pa sku(gas kyi 'e1 rgyus nang skabs de'i spo rong dang bo dong chos brgyud kyi skor zhor 'phros mang dag cig 'khod kyang 158

skyo rong dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus khas cigare re bzhin 'dir yig chodags che bas ma bkod/ dper mtshon re zung zhus na/ mdzad sgo dang mdzad rim khag gi nang (paspyodang phro nga nam mkha' dgon/ mngon dga' spong rong chos rje/ pad+ma chos gling chos sdings/ bo dong sman phyi bla ma ji gas dang / bo dong chos brgyud dang 'brel ba/ bo dong sbyor ra sprul sku/ bsam sdongs sprul sku/ bo dong me long mgon po ba chos rje pad+ma gar dbang nyi sogs kyang mang du gsal/ spo phra nga dang thad /ra 'brel ba'i 'o/ rgyus khag gsum 'dir lung 'dren gyis zhus na/ 7rgyal ba dang po rje dge 'dun grub spong chos sdings su zhabs bcags kyis 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam rgyal dang zhal mjal ce sa 'brel zhus pa'i skor rje nyid kyi gsung rnam ji thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar rmad byung lha ra bu'i 'phreng ba bzhugs so/nyi zhes pa'i nang / ((yang de dus paṇa chen phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i slob ma mkhas grub dpal ldan sangs rgyas pa zhes pa dang / rje 'di pa shel dkar tshosnags su bgro gleng la bzhengs/ gnyis ka thams cad kyi yid smon pa'i gnas su byed pa byung / des rkyen byas nas paṇa chen khyedags las rnam rgyal mjal nas chos zhu ba'i 'dun pa drag wa zhig byung ste/ dawa na lha ba rnams pad+ma snu sa sdings la byon/ yar lam gla 'khor du pha dam pa'i sku gdung ka ru la mjal/ dang /de nas pad+ma chodas sdings su gyon te/ paṇa chen dang mjal/ zhag shas der bzhugs/ dzadas mang du zhus/ khyad par sgrol ma nyer gcig ma/ sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma sogs kyi dbang dang / rje btsun ma dkar sngo gnyis dang / dbyangs 159

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /can ma/ gdugs dkar sogs kyi rjes gnang mang du zhus/ paṇa chen gyis dri ba mang po mdzad pa rnams la lan phul bas thugs shin tu dgyes par byung nas/da phyin chad thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub gyis zhes pa'i mnga' gsol yang mdzad do/nyi /ces gsal/7rgyal ba lnga ba chen po'i rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang zhes pa'i pod gsum pa'i nang / sa rta (1678) gnam 'o/ gsar tshes kyi rten 'brel he/ra zhes pa'i nang / (('di nyin nas smon lam che mor dge 'dun stong brgyad brgya skor la ya ja 'khor drug ma chig brgya nga gnyis/ rta nyis brgya nyi shu dang dre'u nga dgu 'bo de tse'i 'phreng ba rgyal pa bco lnga/ sge dwos mi rgyab bco brgyad/ des ma ldang par ser ljang sbag zhe gcig /bu ram ltang rtse sum brgya zhe brgyad bcas 'gyed bzhi tshes bcu gcig la nged rang gis mkhan po/ khyab bdag zha ༷/ pa chen pos chodab dpon/ dbon po 'o/ tsā bas gsang ston/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas dus bsgo ba/ mchod dawa na ngag dbang shes rab dang rin chen 'jam dbyangs dpal gyis kha stodang byas/ chodas rje dbon rin po che/ gnas snying zhabs drung gi sprul sku/ mngon dga' bla ma sang rong chos rje gsum pa dang / phyi dro dbu blo bzang yon tan/ dar mo sman rams pa blo bzang chos grags/ chos rje ru ba ngag dbang rgyal po rdo rje gsum rnams bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs/ga zhes gas smu/ de bzhin brag dkar bas mdzad pa'i 'bur ba'i gdung rabs nang / rje dbon naca/ mkha' mgon 11 la sras gasdo/ma 'aX/ngas pas sras bgres shos nam mkha' 160

spo rong dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus khag cigabasnan 'dzin nyid pho brang chen po ri bo gru 'dzin du 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i spyan rma ngar gtsug phud phul/ mtshan ngag dbang nam mkha' bstan 'dzin du gsol/ chos grwa chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs su mtshan nyid theg pa'i sde snod la mkhas par sbyangs/ zhes gsal bas/song gsal du kū la'i gos bzang nang gsal ba'i mngon dga' bla ma spong rong chos rje gsum pa zhes pa ni nam mkha' dkar sngarware yang tsha nam mkha' bstan 'dzin yin nam snyam/ de rjes 7rgyal ba bdun pa'i sku dus su'ang rje dbon nam mkha' dpal bzang gi sras nam mkha' 'gyur med rab tu byung zhing gangs can 'gro ba'i mgon po bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i spyan mngar gtsug phud phul/mtshan blo bzang 'jigs med dbang por gsol zhes se gas gsal 'o///yang du kū la'i gos bzang pod gnyis pa las/ ((hor zla ba drug pa'i tshes gsum smu rgyal po tha'i ji tse/ pa shi/ a chi mgon po can drag rigs la phyag drug pa'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul dang / las gshin phyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang / sang nyin rgyal po sku rkyang la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang dgung grangs/ phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi rjes gnang / kun dga' ra bar gsang phu chos rje chen po gzhung las pa rnams kyis zang zing gi maṇ+ḍal dang bcas par gnas pa'i smon lam mdzad cing bka' gdams lha bzhi'i rjes gnang phul/ dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i be'u bum gyi lung gung ru dbyangs dpon pa zhing brjes pa nas bzung rgyun chad 'dug pa bo lugs la yod du re'i rtsad bcad kyang bsam sdings dang mtsho sna tshor med pa'i khungs chod/161

'brog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /spo nga rong rje dasngo na la sku da 'gro zer bas zha lu mkhan rin po ches thabs rtsol gyis zhu ba'i khur bzhes gnang / mgron gnyer drung pas ngos sbyor gyi yi ge dang bcas grub chen bkras rgyam pa rdzong brda mdzad par bla ma nam mkha' dkar sngo sa bstang ba dang mdos chog gi lung zhig mdzad nas be'u bum thams cad de la tshang khul las chos bka' gnang ba lta chodag dpe cha'ang gzigs tshod mi 'dug /bskang mdos kyi dpe gnyis dang sbrags grub chen pa mkhan rin po che dpon slob sman lung pa'i sar chu bo rir rdzong bde mdzad/ dpon slob kyis lung gsan te 'bras spungs su phebs byung yang de gnyis ni sngar thob zin pas ma zhus/ zhag bzhi tsam gyi bar gsung gleng zhib rgyas dang kun dga' ra ba'i gzigs mo gnang nas phyir phebs/ sna dkar rtse phyogs kyi gnas tshul la bo dong par deng sang mdo phyogs kyi bshad grwa dga' mo 'dug kyang gsang sngags la 'go tso1 dang mjug swā hwa gang yang med pa gleng ba shin tu bden/rta zhes 'khod/yang 7rgyal ba lnga ba chen pos mdzad pa'i gdan thob nang skabs de'i spo rong rje dbon gyi skor cang mi gsal yang / skabs de'i bo dong pa'i bla chen/ bo dong sbyor ra che ba/ zhu ba'i gdan thob ni rim pa ha cang mthon por 'khod pa gsham gsal nas mkhyen nges/ gdan yig gsar bris mdzad skor sogs zhes pa'i le'u yi nang /((sngon chad gdan yig sogs par bkab mi snang ba mtho dmang nges med byung tshe bsnyad dogs re 'khang gi rgyu dang shes ldan 'dras khrel gnas su mi byed pa'i nges pa mi 'dug gshis/ 'di ga'i khri la cha lngar byas pa'i cha bzhi'i rtsis gdan sa gong 162

spe blo nga dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus khag ciga'og gnyis/ de'ang rtse gdong gi zhal sngo chodas kyi rgyal sngo 'phags pa'i bzhugs khri ri d+mo can du khri 'don ma mdzad pa'i rigs la gdan sa gong las cung dma' ba/ cha phyed ri zhi ba sne'u sdong rtse/ stag lung lha sde/ zhwa dmar nag /cha gsum pa dga' ྅ na khri rin po che/ bkra shis lhan po/ 'brug pa/ sgam po/ mtshur phu drung pa/'phags pa lha rnams kyi sprul sku/ sgam po'i gdung rgyud spyan sngar blta na pa/ khams ri bo che'i chos rje/ 'bri gung gi gdung rgyud yod skabs stag lung pa dang 'dra yang da cha 'di gras/ de las cung zad dma' ba sde pa/ cha gnyis pa rdo rje brag /bo dong sbyor ra che ba/ 'brog bsam sdings/ gzim khang thodang / bar khams rta tshag /de mo ba/ lcags zam pa/ khal kha'i 'jam dbyangs/ byams pa/ rgyal khang rtse/ ྅ nga 'bor ba rnams kyi sprul sku/ gnas rnying khri pa bslab gtsang yin min la ma lto sa d+ku ra dang ge re lha pa bslab gtsang rnams/nyi zhes 'khod/ (gdan thob nang du kha spus la mi snang yang mdzad sgo'i bzhugs gral gyi rim pa 'ga'i nang ((skyid shod byu khu sa mas kyi mtshon pa'i sde pa dpon nam/ yang pa sde pa khag nyi ces sogs gsal pa rnge da pa ji snyed cig 'dug)yang zhabs dkar ba tshogs drug rang grol (178/—/85/) gyi rang rnam nang bal yul du mchodad rten rnam gnyis gnas mjal la phebs skabs spo rong dpal bud mchorwa re nye 'khris bya mang 1/ra chos bshad mdzad pa zhig kha gsal 'dug pas bsham gsal ltar/ci(de nas gung thang la brgyab ste bya mang po zer ba'i sde chung ngu zhig tu 'dug 163

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /pa de ru zhag gis bsdad pas 'dza ba zhabs do/ga yag smra/ zhig byas/ de nas phyag masprodad sde pa dbang wa dpon gasku ga 'ga' zhig byas dpal khud thang spong rong brgyud dbus su sku nga / bdag cag rnams kyis bya mang wa'i sku na bdag tshor chos bshad mgur dbyangs blangs/ bsngo smon bkra shis brjod nas la phyi'i phyogs la chas so/ga /zhes gsal/5 5 spo rong rje dbon dang dbus gtsang sde gzar/ mi dbang pho lha bsod nams stobs rgyas bcas kyi skor/phyi lo 1727 me lug lor bod kyi rgyal rabs nang bka' blon nang 'khrug gis rkyen pas nga lum sbyar gsum gyis da'i ching bā dur bsad/ de'i dgra lan du mi dbang pho lha ba bsod nams lha bas rgyal gyis stod dang gtsang khul nas dmas drangs te dbus gtsang dus zing gi rkyen chags pa'i skabs spo rong rje dbon nam mkha' dpal bzang ngam spo rong gi dpon a jo zhu bas mi dbang pho lha bamo da nams lha bas rgyal la mi rta rang sgrig brgya skor rkang 'gro lag 'don gyis dpung rogs mdzad pa'i bdag rkyen du spo rong rje dbon la thog mar chu lug 1703lor 7rgyal dbang drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i sku dus su she bam ((ga ang 7nyi zhes pa dang / de rjes me 'brug phyi 'o/ 1736 lor 7rgyal dbang bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mchodas rgyab spu na ((she bam ltab dril ang lnga pa nyi zhes pa dang / de rjes chu mo phag 1743 'o/ra mi dbang pho lha ba bsod 164

spo sngagang dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus khag ciganams stobs rgyal gyis sta rab ba'i she bam ((ga ang 14gnyi bcas she bam rim stsal byung ba'i 'bru don zur bkod yig rnying khag nas mkhyen nges dang / de mi/ gzhung dga' ldan 'o/ brang nas spo rong rje da bon la stsal ba'i bka' gtan dang r+sha bam sogs ji snyed cig yod pa dre rong pa bgres gras rnams kyi dran thog la yod kyang yig cha ma rnyed/dbus gtsang sde gzar zhes pa'i skor 'dir rags tsam 'grel brjod bgyis na rgyal rabs dwangs shel 'phrul gyi me long las/ ((sde srid stag rtse ba bkrongs ji 'i 'og tu/ nga phod rdo rje rgyal po dang / lum pa bkra shis rgyal po nas dbu 'khrid thos chodags 'dur gros bsdur gyis chab srid lo gcig bskyangs/ lcags glang phyi wo (1721) lo nas da'i ching bā dur bsdudad nams rgyal po/ nga lum gnyis/pho la tha'i ji bsod nams lha bas rgyal/ sbyar ra ba blo gros rgyal dze bcas bka' blon thun mong nas srid 'gan blangs te me lug ( 1727) bar lo bdun gyi ring chab srid bskyangs/ de nas bod spyi'i bsod nams dman pa dang / rgyal 'gong sadug pa'i cho 'phrul lta bus bka' blo na rnams thugs nang ma mthun pa'i rkyen gyis satsang pho lha ba g.yol nas rang gzhis su phyir phebs/ nga lum sbyar gsum nas da'i ching bā dur bsod nams rgyal po la ma dga' bas las khungs tsho gas sar g.yo 'phrul gyis bkrongs shing / phyogs galta/gas yum sras dang bcas pa nyes pa med bzhin du nyam nyes su btang / sa sprel (1728) lor pho lha bas gtsang stod nas g.yul gshams te 'thab pas/ las 'bras dang balha/da nams kyi dpung shugs 165

'brog sde chen po spo rong rgi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /btsan sngo sa bod ljongs stod smad kyi sa lhu gas phal che ba bsod nams stobs rgyal gyi lhu gas su byung / skabs der 'o/ lha bas thabs byus kyis 7gong sa bdun pa chen po'i sku phywa'i 'gan srung yin tshul am ban dmag bcas ched bskul lha sar 'byor te 'o/ lha bas zhus rjes ltar nga lum sbyar gsum rjes 'brangs dang bcas mi bcu gsum dus gcig la bkum/ sa sprel phyi sku/ (1728) lo mjug nas mi dbang pho lha ba bamo da nams stobs rgyal gyis bod rje'i khri bzung /nyi zhes dang / yang mi dbang rtogs bswā da las/ ((me yos lo'i (phyi lo 1747) gnam lo'i mdzad sgo grub rjes 7mi'i dbang po'i sku mjing la gnyan 'bur gtod pa'i bsnyun zug drag pos mnar te gang gis zlog med du hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gnyis nyin sku gshegs nyi zhes pa'i bar mi lo bcu dgu'i ring bod kyi srid dbang pho lha bas bskyangs/ de rjes sras che ba gung 'gyur med tshe brtan ma nga' ris kyi spyi dpon du bskos/ sras gzhon pa 'gyur med rnam rgyal gyis pha shul bu 'dzin gyis cadad kyi sde srid byas pa bcas so//dbus gtsang sde gzar gyis mchodan skabs de'i cadad kyi chab srid kyi 'gyur ldog nam shar la spo rong rje dbon nas gzhung dga' ldan sgyu brang pa kha phyogs ma log pa'i dpung 'degs rim par bgyis sku da pas/ dper na/ 7rgyal ba drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i sku dus su chu lug lor (1703) slo song rje dbon la stsal ba'i she bam nang ((lcags sprul (1701) bde gzar dus gzhung zhabs phyir 'gyur bar ma zad sa phag gzhis rtser nor bkras gnyis 166

spo rong ngang lezil ruben je rgyus ༄༄4ca༄kyi zir bun skabs shel dkar skya ser gyi byed 'dzol dus lpo rong skya ser gyis kha phyogs ma 'e ga pa'i shel dkar sbyodang sdod kyi dpung pa zhor 'degs bcas sa/nga bsam snga phyir du che ba yin 'dug nyi ces dang / me lug ( 1727)dbus gtsang sde gzar skabs kyang spo rong rje dbon gyis mtshon skabs de'i stod dang gtsang khul gyi dawa na rigs mi dbang 'o/ lha'i rgyab tu langs nas mthun phyogs kyi dmag dpung bsgrigs pa'i skor/ mi dbang rtogs brjod las/ pho lha ba ci slar mnga' ris su bskyod nas bskor gsum gyi rje bo dga' bzhi ba dang gcig tu bgros nas 'u cag yul sa dga'i char dpung gi chodags lhan gcig tu 'dus par byas te mig gi tsher ma 'dra ba dgra bo gachodam par byed do ces 'phrin yig zhib mor bkod nas pho nya mngags/ rim gyis spo rong gi sde la zhabs sdudar bkod de dpon rigs a jo la bgros te/ mi'i bdag po da'i ching bā dur ma rung bar byas/ da ni de'i 'khon lan blang bar khyed kyis kyang dpung gi tshogs bsdus te bsam pa rtse gcig pas pha rol gzhom par lha ba gyis shig /des lan smras pa/ sngar shing pho 'brug (1724) gi lo la gnam mdza'ire 'gram ngogs nas/ bka' blo na rnams nang 'khrugs pa yo lang zhig byung ngam snyam na/ de'i tshe khyed kyis nga'i grogs bya dgos gsungs pa bdag cag gtsang ljongs kyi skye ༷/ mnga' ris bskor gsum dang bcas te kha rog 'dug pa'i skabs med/ rta mchog bzhon pa can brgya phrag gi grangs dang ldan pa bdag nyid kho nas bsham par byacad/gi zhes dang / yang / zhwa skab pa dbang phyug bde ldan gyis mdzad pa'i ((bod kyi 167

'brog sde chen po spo rong bi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /srid don rgyal rabs/nyi nang / ((de nas spo rong du dbon rigs a jos dang blangs kyis rta dmag brgya skor dang / khong rang na tshod smin yang zhabs rjes su bcar/nyi zhes 'khod/ dmu dge bsam gtan gyis brtsams pa'i khyi(bod kyi lo rgyus kun dga'i me long gnyi nang / ((de bzhin spo rong gi dpon a jo dang / mnga' ris kyi sgar dpon dga' bzhi sogs bskul te pho lha rang gi dmag bcas gtsang dmag 'bor chen gyis me lug 1727 'orware zla 7 tshes 17nyin dbus phyogs su dmag bskyod byas/nyi zhes dang / yang brag dkar ba rig 'dzin chos kyi dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i 'bur ba'i gdung rabs nang / rje dbon nam mkha' dpal bzang gis ((me lug dbus gtsang dus zir gyi skabs 7mi dbang rngo lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyal stod phyogs su dmag bskul bar byon dus rta dmag brgya phrag lhag pa sogs snga phyir zhabs 'degs yang dag par sgrub pa'i bdag rkyen du gtan tshigs she bam rim can ༄55 zhing thugs gtsigs shin tu che/nyi bcas sku/ /rgyab cadangs 'o/ rgyus 'bud tsam gleng na/ grags can sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos 7rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po mchog dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs pa'i gnas tshul lo ngo bathe lnga gsang rgya gnang ring pho brang po ta la gsar bzhengs sogs chos srid kyi mdzad pa rgya che'i bka' drin bskyangs pa gdon mi za/ de nges dgung lo 16 thebs pa'i 7rgyal ba sku 'phreng drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho mchodag gser khrir mnga' gsol dang sku yon phul mtshon gang ci'i thad la mdzad 168

spo rong dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus khag cis dka' mang dag 'phrad khar/ de snga nas 'khon zhing 'khrugs la nye ba'i sog po'i dngo na rigs khag gnyis te/ lha bzang khang dang 'jung sgar gnyis kyi 'gal zla'i ser kha je cher phyin pa'i sbir sgra bod srid gzhung gi mdzad gtso sde srid dang mkhan bla grwa tshang sogs kyi nang khyab ste skabs shig lha sa'i chab srid gnyan 'phrang can zhig tu gyur/ de'i khar bod kyi chab srid la the byus byed rgyur 'o/ rog gtor sgug ltar bsdad pa'i man ju bo nga ma la'ang gnas babs de go skabs bzang po thig tu gyur pa bcas/ mdor na/ dus rabs bcu bdun dang bco brgyad bar gyi bod kyi chab srid de rgya sku ga gi the byus nang lhangs te ngo da kyi rgyal sa lha sar rgya sog bod gsum gyi dpung tshogs nang khul 'kho na 'khrugs rnyogs zing rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa lta bu'i rba klong drag po de'i nang bod sog gi mdzad gathong phal che ba dang de min nyes med wa da mi ser skya khri phrag gi srog cadar ba ma zad/ chodas lugs nang khrul dkrug shing dbyen byor bzos pa'i rkyen gyis dbo na pa dang rten gsu ma mtha' yas pa gtor bzhig btang ba sku/gas dug ga//ma gyis ba3/la ba'i dmag mun nag po de'i khrod du mi dbang 'o/ lha zhes bod mi phal pa'i khrod nas thodan pa zhig gis ljo ga phyogs dgra 1rware ngan byus thams cad g.yol gyin gnyan 'phrang che ba'i bod kyi dus zir de lta bu zhig la mtha' 'doms kyis rang yul du zhi bde bskrun pa 'i mdzad bzang de skye bo phal ba'i bya gzhag cig min mod kyang / rang re'i lo rgyus smra ba ngo nang khul dathodangs tshul 'dra min 'dug pas/ la las mi dbang 'o/ lha ba nyid blo rig dpa' myo/dzangs ldan zhing chos phyogs la shin tu dkar ba ma zad 169

'grog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /rgyal po dga' ldan tshe dbang gi skye sprul du bkur ba dang / de bzhin mkhas dbang /i 'jin si mi thid mchog gis/ ((smin gling lo chen dar ma shrī'i slob ma mi dbang pho lha na bsod nams stobs rgyas (1689 /747) dang masnga mkhar tshe ring dbang rgyal (/697 /763) gnyis kyi thabs jus chab srid la brten nas bo da du chos lugs nang khul kyi mthun lam slar gso thub pa red/nyi ces dang / de bzhin yongs grags 7rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa'i bsngo sman/((gangs ri ra bas bskor ba'i zhing khams 'di/ /phan dang bde ba ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho yi/ /zhabs pad srid mtha'i bar du brtan par shoganyinyi /ces pa'i spyodan lam 'di bzhin thog mar phyi 'o/ 1745 lor mi dbang pho lhas 7rgyal ba bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtshor bstod pa brtsams pa'i snga da kyi rgyal glu dang po de yin pa yang brjod chog /yang gzhung zhabs zur pa rgyal mtshan chos ldan la sdudags smra ba po 'gas mi dbang pho lha bod du man ju'i dmag dpung 'dren mkhan gyi byed gte gtso bo ((log smon dam sri gyi zhig red ces smad mkhan yang yod/ spyir stangs lo rgyus gang 'dra zhig la'ang 'asnga da dre gas kyi bshad sku la mi mthun pa kha shas sku/da pa ni chodas nyid yin/ rang re'i 'o/ rgyus rnying pa kha shas kyi nang ha cang thal che ba'i 'awa da phyogs/dper na nye ba'i dus su rtsis dpon lung shar nyid bdud kyi sprul pa red cesaspyi tshogs nang nag nyes bachod rgyu'i sgrub byed du dpang rtags yod min la ma ltos par khong gi /ba la rnga ma yod red ces skabs de'i dbang 'dzin rnam pas spel ba'i 170

slo rong dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus khag cigadakro+og gtam de chodas can du grangs te rig pa smra ba 'gas glang dar gyi dbu la rwa co med pa de gzhi grub ces pa ltar yin/ 'byung 'gyur mi rabs la drang ldan ci lam nas bya dga' bzang po 'jog go snyam pa'i kun slong bzang sngo sa nag 'gros su phab pa'i lo rgyus legs shos de ni gang thub bar du dngo sa yod gnas tshul ji byung la lhad kyi dri mas ma go sa par drang thig 'drongs pos baspo da pa de yin/la las ni so so'i byas rjes dang lang khyedags mngon mchodar bteg cing de las ldog pa thams cad la ming 'dogs sna tshogs kyis mtha' skyodad galta nga ba dper na/ ((log smon dam sri gnyi 'am/ ((bdud rgyal rwa co can nyi nam/ ((bdud sprul rnga ma can zhes so/gas dang / byes su'ang rang re'i mthong chos su khyi(tha'i wan phogs zan gyi nam/ ((rgya mi'i so pa/nyi zhes mo gas ngan gaskurware ming 'dogs sna tshogs kyis spyi chodags dum bur gtong gzhi'i byed tshul 'di ni 'byung 'gyur mi ra bas la 'gos nad lta bur khyab nyen la sngon 'gog byed rgyu gal che yin/ deng dus rabs nyer gcig gi gnas stangs la 'dzam gling go la'i gnas tshul che phra chu nga gsum ci 'dra zhig yin rung so so'i mdzub rtse g.yo tsam gyis nam mkho bar snang nas lta gas thub pa yin pas/ 'o/ rgyus gang rung zhig drang thig ma 'grims par 'khyodag bshad dang lhad 'debs kyis bskrun du gyur na deng gi char skusna bsrang byed lnga ni bal yul ma〈snad rten gyi spyan bzhin nam yang mi 'dzum par bzhugs yod do//171
