'grog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /6 spo rong dang 'brel bo'i rtso che'i yig snying khag gi brjad dan/6 1 chu lug (1703) lor 7rgyal ba drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mchodas spo rong rje dawa na la stsal ba'i she bam ldog ang 7) zhes pa ji ma ji bzhin zhig gsham gsal ltar/༄༅༅/ /gong ma hong de'i lung gis/ zi then/ ta zhan/ tsi rtswa phu+o/ sholī then zha/ shi kyo'u/ yi thung / bi'i zhi/ de'i chi/ kying gang / de'i khe/ shang zi/ byurga yan/ zhes nub kyi lha gnas ches dge ba bde bar gnas pa'i sangs rgyas bka' lung gnam cadag gi skye 'aX thams cad bstan pa gcig tu gyur pa 'gyur med rdo rje rgya mtsho'i bla mar dbang bskur ba drug pa'i gtam/'dzam gling yangs pa'i sa gzhir 'khod pa'i skye dgu spyi dang / bye brag stod mnga' ris skor gsum bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i 'char 'khod pa'i bla ma slob dpon/ sde dngo na/ nang rnam/ rdzong sdod/ gnyer las 'dzin/ rgan bcu mi dmangs bya ba zhi drag gi sne mor mngags slebs dang bcas mtha' dag la springs pa/ spo ro/nga rje dbon khu tshan gyi lcags sprul sde gzar dus mchod yon gyi zhabs phyir 'gyur ba byung gshis spo rong pa rang gi sngar 'dzi na zhi drag sgrub brten byang pa'i gtan tshigs nang gsal bzhin lha brang gtsang ma dzaṭī 'bab/ ngal rgyas man nas phra phu la/ mang mkhar chu tshan/ gra phu ༷/la mtshams yan/ byang gtsang po 172

spo rong dang 'brel ba'i mche'i yig rnying khag gi brjod don/rtal rgyud kyi khongs su yod pa'i rtswa chu lhas mal gang yod rnams spo rong 'brog pa'i dmag khral rkang 'gro lag 'don gyi sgrub rten la byang dus nas byor 'jags bya/ 'dug pa sngar gnas la mchodad yon gong ma nas bzung gtan tshigs dmar nag rim par 'dug don la da lta phan 'di kha nas bsgyur bkod med pa'i gnas bzhin yin 'dug par 'brog pa rnams dga' ldan gyi phyag phyir stod dmag la 'gro ring gzhis 'dzin bu smad rgan byis la 'gro mtshams kyi zur maḥḍa a ra las lung sangs la ba sogs bod pas phu 'degs dang rtswa mtshams rim bsgral bar 'brog tu o rgyan yongs grags zer bas dbo na pa gsar rgyag byas nas spo rong pa'i rtswa thang du phyugs ma ra lug brten pa bcas sgrigs lad dang gsar spros ma 'gab pa sa byang gtan gyi don da lta phan gnas bzhin ci yin dang / lcags sbul sde sa/zar dus gzhung zhabs phyir 'gyur bar ma zad sa phag gzhis rtser nor bkras gnyis kyi zir bun skabs shel dkar skya ser gyi byed 'dzol dus kyang spo rong skya ser gyis kha phyogs ma log pa'i shel dkar rdzong sda da kyi dpung pa zhor 'degs bcas gzhung bsam snga phyir du che ba yin 'dug par deng sang rje dbon mi 'khron chung zhing na gzhon pa'i gnas skabs ltas pa'i rje dbon gyi mabo 'og lus 'chug med par spo rong brgya chag phan bzhi'i sde khongs nas lhagazhung la zur bzhag mig lho sa ngan pa'i bod sku ga gi che btsan la mabo gtad sku gas byas pa byung tshe rdzong sdod dang rje dbon sgo bstun gyi gtsag bu rnag thog gi nad sprod khrims mthun drang bzhag gi ga4)da rgya byas pa'i ngan pa je 'phel du mi 'gro ba byed pa dang /173

'brog sde chen po so rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /spo rong rgya chags phan bzhi'i zhi drag dmag khral rkang 'bo lag 'thodan gyi 'khri sgrub sngar 'bab thog chu phag ngam ring du zhib gcod dus zur mtsho a ra las lung yul gong 'og sogs bod pa yul sde rkang stongs kyi sa khungs la rtswa rin mar khral gsar 'gel shel dkar du khral 'bab byings sdebs su yig rgya'i don lta ra lcags sprul nas sgrub pa sogs da lta phan bzhin sor gnas dang / 'dam du lo ltar rgod g.yar dgu/ rma snag rang 'bab kyi sog khral lug brgya dang nyi shu tham pa kre par nang spad kyi sgrub pa sngar rgyun ltar gnas pa bcas sgrub blang deb gsal gang yin sngar khri zhwa 'chag med pa byang phyin grub go ngur sogs la phyi nang bod 'brog rong bcas pa'i lha sde mi sde'i 'dzin skyong dang gtan tshigs su gsal ba'i sa mtshams rtswa chu lhas mal gong bzhin bcas ser rtsa nam mkha' dkar sngo/ dang skya rtsa rje dbon bsod mgon gyi bzhin rang 'jags da lta phan sngar gnas dang /snga sor rje dbon tshe dang nam mkha' mgon khu tshan 'dod pa ma gcig pa tshe 'das rjes shul mi dang nam mkha' mgon 'dod gcig byas chog pa zhus khrol sgril bsdoms kyi gan rgya lha na med yin na dang gtan tshigs na rim gyi 'bru don la da lta phan bsgyur bkod ma song na gnas bzhin sngar srol snyon med ci yin la rgyab gnon sbyin pa yin pas khyod gong 'khod rnams kyis mi 'os pa'i za 'dod snyad rtser sogs ma byed par rje dbon nam mkha' dpal bzang brgyud bcas la bde bar gnas chug zhes go bar bya ba'i yi ge nyi ma zhes pa chu mo lug (1703)lo hor zla brgyad pa'i gral tshes dge bar phun tshogs lugs brgya'i mdun sa pho 174

h+pho rong dang 'brel ba'i rtsa che'i yig rnying khag sga brjod don/brang chen po sngo/ ta la nas bris/ci gong du bka' shog rin po che phebs 'dug pa'i 'byu don ci yin la zhabs 3desas kyi tham ka byas pa yin/ shing sprel (1704) zla cesas la zhes 7rgyal mchog drug pa chen sngo/ nas 3skor ba'i she bam rgyab snon bcas pa tringes khang du tringes pa lung shar ba can nas tshig zhus nges 'dze ngas song / me lug ( 1907)zla tshes la nyi zhes phyi lo 1907 lor rtsis dpon lung shar gyis ngo ta lar yed pa'i she bam sngar 'dra nas bshus te bden rtags tham ka bcas 'khrul med yod/6 2 me 'brug ( 1736) zla 8 tshes 24 la 7rgyal dbang bdun pa chen pos spo rong rje dbon la stsal ba'i she bam /ltab dril ang lnga pa/ (tsha pa ra/ skyabs mgon rin sngo che nas stsal ba'i she bam ) zhes pa'i bakhyodad don/༄7/ /bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi sa'i khar 'khod pa'i bla ma/ slob dpon/rgyal po/ rgyal/ rigs/ lha sde / mi sde / mkhan slob/ spyi gnyer/ mdun na 3ngon/ bstan don las mi srid las kyi bya bar mngags pa'i bka' mda' rtsis sasu/ma/ dmag dpon/ ru las/ rgya dpon/ lha ngam/ sa dga'/ rdzong skyi da/sanya' nang / shel dkar bcas kyi rdzong sdod/ bkar sku nga / zhi drag gi bskul bde'i slebs/ sa rtsis gi chos ngos/ rtswa shing rtsod 'dren rgya bod ter gyi lam phyi'i 'grim 'grul/ nub lhan stan/ lho khang gsar/ rgan bcu mi dam/ngas bcas skye 'gro mchog dman mtha' dag la springs/ spo mo nga rje dbon 175

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /skya ser gnyis 'dzin gyi khongs gtogs gang na ci 'dug tshang ma'i dag thob dbang rigs bka' gtan yig rigs rim can gyi don la 7mi dbang mchog nas sbyin 'jags kyi rgyab lha na she bam stsal 'dug pa ltar gyi 'bru don sgrub 'chag ci yin la rtsed bsun snyad 'asnga gas med pa gnas dbo sa kyi 'di nas kyang tham ka sbyin pa yin de/ khyed gong 'khod tshang mas phan grogs su nang gyur las ya yur yang shing lta bur snyad pa'i bza' 'dod bskul rtsed sogs mi byed cing / bka' gtan 'byu don ci yin la gnas 'jug pa dang / gal srid go ba log rgyag gi khrims 'gal shed khyer rtsi med bzos ma bde'i rigs byas srid na 'di kha nas rjes gce na then nan galta nga nges yin pa'i nges pa bgyis/ me 'byug ( 1736)zla 8 tshes 24 dge bar bris/63 sa lug 'o/ra (1739) mi dbang 'o/ lha ba bamo da nams lha bas rgyas sna mo sa pe'i les spo gro nga rje dbon la bstsal ba'i she bam tham sbyar gos chen ser po'i sgang la bris ma 'di bzhin deng sang bzhugs sga ra bod kyi dpe mdzod khang gi gna' rdzas khongs yod/༄༅༅/ /'dzam gling yangs pa'i sa'i char 'khod pa'i skye 'gro spyi dang / bye brag tu stod mnga' ris skor gsum/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ smad mdo kha/mas sgang drug gi bla dawa na/ rgyal rigs/ lha sde/ mi sde/ bstan don las bzhi'i bya bar mngags pa'i bka' mda' rtsis gsum/ dmag dawa na/ ru las/ brgya 176

spo rong dang 'brel ba'i rtsa che'i yig rnying khag gi brjod don/dpo na/ lha ngam/ sa dga'/ rdzong skyid/ gnye nang / shel dkar bcas kyi rdzong sdod/ bkar yong / al phyi'i 'grim 'grul bsdud dang bskul bde'i sne cho/tshor mngags slebs gnyer las 'dzin/ rgan bcu mi dmangs sku gas mdor na skad rigs dang cha lugs rnam 'gyur mi 'dra ba'i mchog dman mtha' dag la springs pa/ spo rong rje dbon la mchod yon gong ma na rim gyi gtan tshigs dang /'di kha'i tham kha sngon song bcas rim pa sbyin 'jags kyi skya ser nyis 'dzin gyi khongs su gtogs pa'i dgon mngon dga' chos sde/ pad+mo chos sdings/ mnga' ris mngon dga'/ chos sde dkar po/ rta sga bcas kyi dgon ma lag /chos sanyis mo bran bcas gang na ci 'dug tshang ma'i bdag thob dbang rigs su gyur pa'i gzhis kha lag 'debs/ bogs thog phud/ sa rigs rtsa mtshams/ grwa rtsa yon khul bcas dang / skya sa spo rong sma nag kha 'thor dang bcas pa'i sde khag nyis 'gril dang / grugs go ngur/ byang rdzong gzhis chung / gling shar/ 'gyeg ltong / srang skya/ dgon gsar/ mkhar chen lha po/ ldum ra ga skya/ me tog gling / dga' dpe/ dga' ldan/ sha ngus brag dmar/ gnas shar rag nyi ma zhur/ gnya' pa yang thog /rud gsar tsho/ gyi li ko ron/ thang khum g.yang dkar tshes/ shag mo bran me sring mkhar/ tshu ru bkris gang mo yan bcas me sprul phan gyi 'dzin bdag ya ma bral ba'i gnas bzhin ci yin tshang ma'i mi calami mus/ yong 'bab/ mi gra/ gzhis kha lag 'debs/ bogs lnga ga phud/ sa rigs rtsa mtshams sogs sngar gnas 'dzin zhing bdag pa'i sa khongs/ shar 177

'brog sde chen po spo sdong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /skyed chad la nas bul rong / skya sbyang ze brgyud lha rgod pa/ lto khri 'od ze brgyud sba ri skya rag /ngal rgyas mthong la ze brgyud/ nub tshob rong / nyung lu ze brgyud/ byang gtsang po ltal brgyud da lta phan rtsod med bdag pa'i khongs su gtogs pa'i/ rtswa chu lhas mal mtsher 'bebs dang / mar khral gsar sgrub deb gsal gyi sa khongs/ zur tsho khul lha brang / spo ra/ nya sgro da/ yul dgo bar/ dgon dkar dmar gyi ri klung gi rtswa chu lhas mal mtsher 'bebs sngar nas za bzhin bsnyon med bcas kyi khongs gang na ci 'dug tshang ma dang / phra da rong gi sa zhing khang / ri klung gi rtswa chu lhas mal/ skye shing nags tshal bcas so sku(re gtan khra yig rigs rim can dang 'brel ba'i 'dzin bzhin ya ma bral ba gang na ci 'dug tshang ma sbyin 'jags kyi/ gong gsal dgon ma bu'i gra rigs nas 'dul khrims dang bca' yig tu mi gnas pa dang / skya sa nas khrims 'gal gyi dpon g.yog gi go babs su mi che ba'i ngan spyod byed rigs byung na rtsag bu rnag 'grel gyi nyes 'gel babs mtshungs byas chodag pa dang / wa da phro nga gi gamo ga gzhis bo nga gsal gyi sku/nga 'babs rnams sa spre deb 'awa na gsar sbyin gyi chod don bzhin dge rgyun du 'jags pa byas shing / 7bka' 'gyur lha khang dang / ma ṇi khri lha ra gyi mchodad thebs ra khyu khag cig la mar khral/ ga khral sogs 'khri med dang / khral rigs kyi sgrub mtshams bod 'brog gnyis gas dmag da nga /dpus mar/ drung spyi'i bsdu cha/ rta zam sgrub cha/ lam thog gi 'khri sgrub/9chu yur ma shom lta bu'i rigs sgrub pa dang / bod nas smon lam brngod chen/ 'brog 178

spo rong dang 'brel ba'i mche'i yig rnying khag gi brjod don/nas da lta phan skrub bzhin gnyag pa dpe 'gre'i phyag deb nang gsal bcas sgrubs rjes/ de phyin gyi rtsa 'dams brnga ba/ rtswa shing gcod 'dren/ brngod nas skyes 'ape na/ gar dgos 'u lag /sol khral/ rdzong khral/ gram tsho bye 'don/ bzo bral/ bsrung cha spos bdor/ 'bam tshong dpus bsgyur/ yog snyeg sho snyo dril / sran sgo gral thag /brgya khral/ 'tsho khral sogs bcas yig mig 'dir gsal 'khod min la ma lto sa sker leb dgur gsum gyi khral rigs rkang 'bo la ga 'don la the ga sa so cog che phra da lta phan bzhin las gsar 'gel byas mi chogag ji 'i gtan tshigs sbyin pa yin pas/ khyod betang 'khod rnams kyi 'bru log rgyag si snyad 'dogs 'gel bkod kyi gtser bsun za 'dod zos mi bder 'gro ba spu tsam ma byed par bde bar kho rang da lta ngo bo rje dbon na ma mkha' dpal bzang be+e 'dzin 'bras ci yi na kho rang gi bu chos pa bla ma nam mkha' 'gyur med dang /skya'u rdo rje lha skyabs rgyud bcas ji srid bar yi ge 'dzin bcug pa yin/ zhes kho bar bya ba'i yi ge sa lug zla tshes la chos 'khor lha sa'i sgyu brang chen snga dga' ldan khang gsar nas bris/ tham kha / 6 4 chu mo phag ( 1743) lor pho lha ba ba11da nams stobs rgyas kyis sperdzo rong rje dbon la stsal ba'i she bam (jig ang 14 pho lha 7mi dbang bsod nams stodabs rgyal nas stsal ba'i the bam bka' tham sbyar ma dge'o/ /chu phag 'khod pa nyi zhes bya ba ji ma ji bzhin babo da par gsham gsal/179

'brog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /༄༅// 'jam dbyangs mi'i gzugs can 7gong ma bdag po chen po'i lung gis/yangs pa'i sna ra 'dzin gyi khyodan la lugs gnyis khrims kyi byed wa ra mngags pa mi'i dbang po jun wang zhes sa skyong bsod nams stobs kyi rgyal po'i gtam/nyi ma'i snang bas khyab pa'i lus can gyi khams spyi dang / bye brag tu lha da mnga' ris skor gsum/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ smad mdo khams sgang drug gi bla dalnga na/ rgyal rigs/ lha sde/ bstan dodan las gzhi'i bya bar mngags pa'i bka' mdang rtsis gsum/ dmag dasngo na/ ru las/ brgya dasngo na/ lha ngam sa dga'/ rdzong skyid/ gnya' nang / shel dkar bcas kyi rdzong sde da/ bkar sku nga / al phyi'i 'grim 'grul bsdud dang bskul bde'i sne mo ra mngags slebs gnyer las 'dzin/ rgan bcu mi dmangs sogs mdor na skad rigs dang / cha lugs rnam 'gyur mi 'dra ba'i mchog dman mtha' dag la springs pa/ dzad rong rje dasngo na mdzadad yon 7gong ma na rim gyi gtan tshigs dang / 'di ga'i tham kha sngo na song bcas rim par sbyin 'jags kyi skya ser gnyis 'dzin gyi khongs su gtogs pa'i dgon mngon dga' chos sde/ pad mo chos sdings/ mnga' ris malnga na dga'/ snu sa sde dkar wa / rta sga bcas kyi dbo na ma lag /mo sa gzhis mo bran bcas gang na ci 'dug tshang ma'i bdag thob dbang rigs su gyur pa'i gzhis kha lag 'debs/ bogs thog phud/ sa rigs rtswa mtshams/ grwa rtsa yon khul bcas dang / skya sa spo rong rma nag kha 'thor dang bcas pa'i sde khag nyis 'gril dang / grugs gong ngur/ bya rdzong gzhis chung gling shar/ 'gyog stong /180

hro rong dang 'brel ba'i mche'i yig rnying khag gi brjod don/srang skya dgon gsar/ mkhar chen lho pa/ ldum ra ga skya/ me tog gling / dga' spe/ dga' ldan/ sha ngus brag dmar/ gnas shar rag ma nyi zhur/ gnya' ba pyang thog /rug gsar tsho/ gyi ling ko mo na/ thang khum g.yang dkar tshes shag mo bran me sring mkhar/ tshu ru bkra shis sgang mo yal bcas me sgrul yan —gyi 'dzin bdag ya ma bral ba'i gnas bzhin ci yin tshang ma'i mi rtsa mi lus/ sku/nga 'bab/ mi gra/ gzhis kha lag 'debs/ sngo/gas thog phud/ sa rigs rtswa mtshams sogs sngar gnas 'dzin zhing bdag pa'i sa kho ngas/ shar skyed chad la nas bul rong / skya byang ze brgyud/ lha nod pa/ lho khri 'od ze brgyud sba ri skya rag ngal rgyas mthong la ze brgyud/ nub tsha'o rong / nyu lung ze brgyud / byang gtsang po ltal brgyud da lta phan rtsodad med khongs su gtogs pa'i rtswa chu lhas mal mtsher 'bebs dang / mar khral gsar sgrub deb gsal gyi sa khongs/ sur cho khul lha brang / spo ra nya phrod/ yul gong bar/ dgon dkar dmar gyi ri klung gi rtswa chu lhas mal mtsher 'bebs sngar nas za bzhin bsnyon med gang yin bcas kyi khongs gang na ci 'dug tshang ma dang / bod rong gi sa zhing khang / ri klung gi rtswa chu lhas mal/ skye shing nags tshal bcas sku( sorware gtan khra yig rigs rim can dang 'brel ba'i 'dzin zhing ya ma bral ba gang na ci 'dug tshang ma sbyin 'jags kyi/ bo nga gsal dasprodan ma bu'i grwa rigs nas 'dul khrims dang bca' yig tu mi gnas pa dang / skya sa nas khrims 'gal gyi da11na gasku/ga gi beta babs su mi che ba'i ngan spyod byed rigs byung na gtsag bu rnag 'gel gyi nyes 'grel 181

'grog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /babs mtshungs byed chodag pa dang / bod rong gi g.yog gzhis gong gsal gyi yong 'bab rnams sa spre deb 'don gyi gsar sbyin gyi chod nges dge rgyun du 'jags pa byas shing / 7bka' 'gyur lha khang dang / ma ṇi khri sa ra gyi mchod thebs ra khyu khag gcig la mar khral/ ga khral sogs 'khri med dang / khral rigs sgrub mtshams bod 'brog gnyis gas dmag dang / dpus mar/ drung spyi'i bsdu cha/ lam thog gi 'khri sgrub chu yur ma shoms lta bu'i rigs sgrub pa dang / bod nas smon lam brngod chen/ 'brog nas da lta phan sgrub bzhin gnyag pa dpe 'gre'i deb gsal sgrub rjes/ de phyin gyi rtsa 'dam brnga ba/ rtswa shing gcod 'dren/ brjod nas skyel 'dren/ gar dgos 'u lag /mo la khral/ rdzong khral/ gram mchod bye 'don/ bzo khral/ bsrung cha spos bdor/ 'bam sang spus bsgyur yog snyeg sho sgo khral/ dran grod gral thag /brgya khral/ 'tsho khral sogs yig mig 'dir tshig gsal 'khod min la ma ltos pa'i ker leb dgur gsum gyi khral rigs rkang 'bo/ lag 'don la gtogs so cog che phra da lta phan bzhin las gsar 'grel byas mi cho ga pa'i gtan tshigs sbyin pa yin pas/ khyed re gnyis nas rje dbon nam mkha' dpal bzang 'das rjes bu gnyis na gzhon pa bcas 'gro mtshams kyi rtswa za chu 'thung mtsher 'bebs sogs la rtsod gleng dang / tham khar 'byu log gi bsnyad 'dogs byed pa zhig sku da 'dug pa da cha de rigs byas na mi 'gab pos/khyed gong 'khod rnams nas kyang phan 'grogs las gtser sun za 'dod kyi zos mi bder 'gro ba spu tsam ma byed par chos pa bla ma nam mkha' 'gyur med dang 182

skyo rong dang 'brel ba'i rtsa che'i yig rnying khag gi brjod don/skya'u rdo rje lha skyabs brgyud bcas ji srid bar yi ge 'dzin rgyu'i she bam sbyin pa yin pas tshang mas nges shing bo ba'ispangs blangs gyis/ zhes bo bar bya ba'i yige chu mo lug 'orware gral tshes dge bar phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang chen po dga' ldan khang gsar nas bris/ zhes 7mi dbang 'o/ lha bas stsa la ba'i she bam dang rtsis khang du rtsis pa lung shar ba can nas tshig zhus nges 'drongs song / me lug zla tshes la/ tham kha sbyar ma/6 5 phyi 'i 1830 lcags stag 'e/ra 7rgyal dbang 'phrin las rgya mtshos bskul ba'i ((lcags stag zhib gzhung gnyi las/ she la dkar khul gyi zhib gzhung bkod par zhes pa'i nang gses cadag grangs 313 la/ lha ro/nga rje daphra na la chodad pa sger dga' ldan pa ngo bo dang g.yog 'don thog nas 'go mchan ltar bud rnying phud gser khyim dgon pa ba dang bcas rkang nyi shu la 'don bcu tham pa sgrub/ yang shog grangs 318 la/ spo rong rje dbon khungs dathodan gsar mthodan wa can rkang gnyis la 'don gcig /yang shog grangs 321 la/ spo mo nga rje dbon la chod pa brang rdzong dgon pa'i mi ser rnam sras pa can rkang phyed bzhi la nyis sna'i 'don phyed gnyis bzhi cha gcig sgrub/ gye bzhin/ spo 1ring rje dbon la chod pa sger gling shar pa ngo bo gcig 'thus kyi chag pa'i g.yog bcu dpon pa can rkang phyed lnga dang bzhi cha gcig sgrub/ de bzhi na/ dre mo nga rje dbon la chod pa sger mdo mkhar ngo bo gasku ga rkang gnyis la sgrub 'asngatshen gcig /yang sna ga grangs 330 la/ spo gro nga 'go pa 183

'grog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /nam mkha' mgon 14 can 'thodag phan phyi yan la sbra dud sum brgya dang gnyis gsal bar 'brog rigs sa zhing rten med du sku nga ba bcas da sgos 'thodag dud lnga sgril gyi rkang drug cu tham pa dang lnga cha gnyis kyi lam sgyu ga sa rdzong rjes 'brel dang / 'asngo ga khral spyi 'gre sngar rgyun bcas sgrub/yang sngo nga dga' khul gyi zhib gzhung bkod par/ zhes pa'i ro/ga grangs 334la/ spo rong 'og gi ling dang / gsar mtsho/ spo ron/ bla dkar yang thog/chos 'khor/ dkar rtsegs thang gsum/ rud pa/ glad pa bcas nas bud rnying phud 'byed gsal bsdad rkang brgya dang bcu gsum la nyis sna'i 'don lnga bcu phyed nga bdun sgrub/ yang skyid bo/ nga khul gyi zhib gzhung bkod par/ zhes pa'i lha ga grangs 337la/ spo phro nga rje dathodan la chod pa gnas shar dang / byams gling mchod gzhis bcas khyon rkang bzhi bcu byed zhe gcig la nyis sna'i 'don nyi shu tham pa dang bzhi cha gcig ྅/ba/ bcas gsal 'ong//6 ca sa lug ((1859 'am 1919 lor spo rong 'brog sde tsho lnga'i zha tho ('brog skad du sbra gur la zha zer bas/ zha tho zer na gur gyi dud grangs la bo ba yin/ dzad rong sbra chen gyi sbra gur chen po la zha chen po zhes 'bod srol yod ) zhib gsher gyis gtan la phab pa'i yig cha/ spo 'dodan 'brog sde chod lnga'i zha chod/ snga na grub ces pa sa lug 'brel tho skabs gtan 'bebs gsar bzos 184

spo rong dang 'brel ba'i mche'i yig rnying khag gi brjod don/bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ zhes bya ba las/༄tsho/ /sa lug zla tshes 6 la/ gza' skar 'phrod sbyor legs 'dzoms nyin spo 'don tsho lnga'i zha grangs kyi gzhung phra bkod par/thog mar rgya mtsho nas bu dga' ba zha gcig /rab khang zha gcig /spre pa skal 'a gcig /bsod chung zha gcig /dgu gazlo na zha gcig /phur bsam zha gcigabasod hri zha gcig /dmag bsam zha gcig /rgan phun zha gcig /kong lha zha gcig /'bar bsod zha gcig /gnyer dbang mo zha gcig /skyid stobs zha gcig /bzang don zha gcig /rgan bzang tshe zha gcig /drung cho ba zha gcigasnya ga tshe dbang zha gcig kong rtam zha gcig /ga dalnga sa zha gcig khang gsar ba zha gcig /lnga da chos zha gcig /kun rgyal gcig /spre ba nub pa zha gcigaye shes rab brtan zha gcig phur rnam zha gcig /a bsam zha gcig /bkra shis phan thogs zha gcig /wa da phun zha gcig /spen tshe zha gcig /'bar gro zha gcig /dbang 'dus zha gcig dmag bamo da nams zha gcig /mig dmar zha gcig /dbang rgyal zha gcig /sbra chen zha gcig /se pa zha gcig /kun spen zha gcig /dkyur sngon pa zha gcig lha btsan zha gcig /lhag chung zha gcig /sde rab zha gcig /gnyer dpal bzang zha gcig /kun bzang zha gcig/ra༅/nam tsho nas/ khang gsar zha gcig /rnam rgyal zha gcig /don dkar zha gcig /tshe dosten zha gcig /kun dga' zha gcig /skal bzang zha gcig /bag stobs zha gcig /cung mgon zha gcig /spre pa zha gcig /gnam ru zha gcig185

'brog sde chen po spo rong bi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long / rong kun zha gcig /mig dmar zha gcig /kong g.yu zha gcig /a ya bkra shis zha gcig /snyag pa zha gcig /a ya zha gcig /khral gsar zha gcig /se pa zha gcig /mdzo dgran zha gcig /rgya rab zha gcig /gnyer rab zha gcis chos nor zha gcig /dmag bsod zha gcig /kong chos zha gcig /spen pa/ zha gcig 'bar ro zha gcig /rgya stobs zha gcig /nyi ma zha gcig /se nga dbang mo zha gcig tshe zla ba zha gcig /dpal 'dren zha gcig /da mchog 'a gcig /'bar dpal bzang zha gcig/༄༅/zur tsho nas/ bu dga' zha gcig /rgan bsod rgyal zha gcig /yon bdas rgan pa zha gcig /phun tshogs pa zha gcig /nor skyid pa zha gcig /'bar tshog zha gcig /'bar skal ldan zha gcig /shar sgo ba zha gcig /tshes bcu zha gcis a ya zha gcig /bkra shis zha gcig /phug bzang ba zha gcig /dkon mchog pa zha gcig /bkras ldan rgan pa zha gcig /bkras gacho na rdo rje zha gcig /spyi gnyer khang gsar pa gcig /dbang phyug zha gcig / yon bdag pa zha gci sadapon tshe zha gcig /skyid phug pa zha gcig /a ya phun zha gcig /rgan kong po zha gcig tshog bdag zha gcig /gnyer pa pad ma zha gcig /bstan skal zha gcig /khral rdor zha gcig /blo bzang zha gcig /bsu mi dbang mo zha gcis lha rgyal zha bcas yar 'phel/ra༅/dpal byang nas/ sog phrug pa zha gcig /sbra phun zha gcig /dbang rgyal zha gcig /a ya dpal bzang zha gcig /nor chung zha gcig /bde legs 186

spo rong dang 'brel ba'i rtsa che'i yig rnying khag sga brjod don/phur chung zha gcig /bla rdor zha gcig /'byor rgyas zer ba rdo rgyal zha gcigargon bsam grub zha gcig /snyag bsam 'grub zha gcig /bstan ring zha gcigadam na/ thos zha gcig /dbang phyug zha gcig khang gsar zha gcig /bkra shis 'a gcig /dpal ser zha gcig /byang pa rnam rgyal zha gcig /yon tan zha sacis /'bar skal zha gcig /'ab chen zha gcig /lha btsan dbang 'dus zha gcig /tshe brtan nor 'phel zha gcig /dpal 'dzom ma bu zha gcig /lug dpo na tshe don zha gcig /༄9/dpal lho nas/ spre nub pa zha gcig /sman chung zha gcig /g.yul rgyal /bha sacig /tshangs ldan zha gcig /khyod spre zha gcig /'byor khang zha gcig /khral bsar zha gcig /'jigs med zha gcig /tshe tshen zha gcig /rnyi don zha gcig ser lung rgan don grub zha gcig /gnag dpon pa zha gcig /dpon yig pa 'a gcig /lhag don zha gcig /'brog pa zha gcig /dpal gsal zha gcigargya don zha gcig /se pa dpal bzang zha gcig /nag tshangs zha gcig /mig leb zha gcig /dpon tshe ring bu 'khrid zha gcig /rta mgrin zha gcig /lhag don zha gcig /dkar chung zha gcig bcas yod/ gong gsal la he bag med/song tshes la tham kaji 1 lcags lug lor spo rong rje dbon nas rgyal ba rgod tshang pa'i sgrub gnas bar 'brog chu bzang la bstsal ba'i gtan tshigs ((lcags lug spong rong nas 187

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long / bstsal ba'i rgyab snon bzhugs nyi zhes pa/༄byu/ /rang zhabs su gtogs pa'i ser skya drag zhan spyi dang / bskor la sdod pa'i 'brog ris mtha' dag gis nges rgyur/ rgyal ba rgod tshang chos rje'i sgrub gnas thar pa gling chu bzang zhes bya bar/ tha dad nas dge ba gong 'phel gyis grogs ldan byed ma rtogs snyad gtsor 'o/ga 'gal du 'gro ba rtan nas byed mi 'os kyang / deng sang khyed 'ga' zhig gis dgon pa'i nye 'khor gyi ri dwags la rtsi med gshed khyer gyis khyi ra rgyag pa sku gas mi 'tshams pa byas 'dug pa rma 'os pas/ da nas bzungs 7zha chen nas gnang pa'i gtan tshigs ma bu'i don ltar/ chu bzang pa'i rtsa chu lhas shing gi bsrung ri rgod khyu zam 'go nas/ sdis ra/ lja lag bskor/ dgon phu'i bar gyi sa khongs su/ ri dwags che chung gang la yang khyi ra byed pa sogs za 'dod du 'gro ba spu tsam ma byed par bde bar gnas chug /lcags lug zla tshes la/ lugs gnyis kyi 'du sa gser gsum rdo rje'i gur khang nas bris/ rtsa rigs sngar 'khyun ltar la dbo na pa'i bsrung ri yin nges la khyi ra ma byed/ tham ka/mchan/ gtan tshigs 'di deng bal yul du bzhugs 'kho da grub dbang chen po bar 'bros chu bzang sprul sku 'phrin las rgya mtsho rin po che mchog gi phyag nas ngo 'dra dpar len gyis zhus pa yin/ dgung lo 88 rin pa'i dkon gnyer ngag dbang gis gsungs don/ bser gsum zer ba deng spo rong sbra chen gyi lho phyogs ri zur brgal mtshams su snga mo'i 'brob sa yod pa de la go bar grags/ deng dus kyang gser gsum gyi ming nas 'bod/188

sgo rong dang 'brel ba'i mche'i yig rnying khag rgi brjod don/6 8 ba chu'i dpyad cadag 'dra gnyis grwa ngag dbang nas nyar/༄/ /dgon pad+ma chos lding grwa tshang dang / dkon gnyer rnying pa grwa ngag dbang sanyis bsgrub sprod go bde'i dpyad shog 'dra gnyis su btang don/ khyed gnyis 'dus sde gcig gi lar rgyar mi blta rung bka' khrims kyi 'jigs gzil dang /ming 'phya/ khyi rgod yong rgyur bsam mthun lam chag pa zhig dgos gras rung /ngang tshul de las rgyab kyi phyogs te snga 'o/ ngag dbang nas mi dbang chen wa ra zhu+o phul don da lam 'dir rtsa zhib bgyis don/ bka' khrims kyi che ba stegs byed dar re dang dngul mgur mo re 'dra mnyam du sgrub dgos/ don rtsa nyams len dbos rgyu'i snying por/ dkon rnying gnyer ngag dbang nas snga lam rang mgon ritsho 'dzin chen sngotshere sku gam du nad ma theg pa'i zhu ba phul gsal gus 'bangs sa/ra chu rta lo dgon pa'i dkon gnyer re 'khel gyi lo gcig ring las 'khur /zhabs zhus kyi rten deb nang gsal zhib gsher dang 'brel rtsis 'bul zhus te slar yang gus pa'i dge phrug 'jigs med chos dar re 'khel la rten rtsis zhus kyi gong bzhin lo gcig las khur zhabs zhus kyi chu lug zla 6 nang dbu snu sa lhan rgyas thog dkon gnyer gsar pa bla zur don chos su rtsis 'bul zhu skabs chad khra shog lhe dbu rnying 'jigs med lu gu dang / bla ma ser rdzong gnyis kyis lag bris ma zur 'bul ltar gus pas dngos rogs rtsa chad la ngo tshab sgrub rgyu dang / skyodan shor bzo bcos zhu rgyu sogs ji mang zhig chad 'don gnang khar/rten gtso 'jigs bral rin po che'i rgyun sgron gos chen gyi sku spang la snum thig 189

'grog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /shor tshul dang / de mtshungs skyon med skyon shor byung lugs sogs bsnya/da dkyis/ kyi nyes pa dngul srang sum brgya sum cu so gnyis sgrub 'jal zhu dgos bka' gnang byung ba 'di thad sngon yod rten deb rnying pa nang gsal tshur rtsis zhus gnang byung ba bzhin rtsis 'bul zhu skabs la'ang deb rnying rang nas rtsis 'bul zhu dasos de ltar yang / chu rta 'o/ rten deb gsar bzos thog nas rtsis bzhes gnang song bar rten deb gsar rnying dbar he bag yod shag la gser bzang sku spang la khyi gang tsam ngo grangs drug dang / rag ting bdun tshar gsum/ tsa ka li grangs bzhi bcu skor/ dung mchod nyi shu skor bcas lhag thon song ba dang / de snga dkon gnyer na rim nas thog chad 'dra rim par yod kyang de rnams yig hrul song tshul gyis lta zhib tsam med par ra nad lug dkris kyi gus pa nyam chung thos mi 'bab 'gro 'tshams kyi chad 'don dang / nyes pa sgrub 'jal zhu rgyu bcas bka' nan ci che gnang bar brten 'u thug bzod bral sdug nad theg re sbad bral gyis rang dgon 7mi dbang 'tsho 'dzin chen po mchog gi mdun sar bde sdug 7snyan mabo na zhu rgyur mi bcar mthu med lags na/ da sgos zhu ba'i snying por/ gong gsol dkon gnyer na rim nas chad khra rim can dang / rten deb gsar rnying dbar he bag ji yod sdudags bka' zhib thugs rje che ba nas gus 'bangs rang gi lnga ga ngo chad la tshab bsgrig dang / skyon shor la bzo bcos zhu dbo sa rna mas mi zhu tshad bral zhus chog pa zhig dang / de min sngon chad dang / skyon shor rigs gus par zhabs zhu thub re sbad bral lags na/ rgyu ma phu 'ded kyis so so'i 190

skyo rong dang 'brel ba'i mche'i yig rnying khag gi brjod don/'aso thog g.yam bsel sku(nga ba'i bka' dpyad skyabs 'jug thugs rje che ba zhus/: sa don gus tsho'i dgon gnas pad chos 'di bzhin de snga bo lugs gtsang dgon dbe 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya brgal ba nas bstan srid zhabs 'degs mi dman tsam yad 'dug kyang / rim nyams deng skabs dge 'dun ba slab pa'ang 'chal 'ing zhal grangs kyang je nyung deng zhal grangs sum cu la thug pa 'di'ang nyams ge sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel bca' yig rin po che'i dgongs ro/na bzhin bzung bstan srid kyi zhabs 'degs lhag bsam rnam dag 'byung ched bka' zhib mthar phyin zhig yod pa bcas zhus pa dang / de lan pad chos grwa tshang nas zhu gsal/ de snga 'jigs bral bo dong pa'i bstan pa dar zhing / mdo sngags zung 'brel dge 'dun zhal grangs mang zhing khrims gtsang yar ldan 'byung mus dang / de rjes rang dpon chos rgyal 'bur ba'i sku gdung rim byon gyi chos srid gnyis ldan gyi mi nyams gong 'phel rgyun ring du gnas dang gnas spos rung / phyis dus dbang gi par mkhan bla sogs dbu 'dom mdzad po med pa dang / dge 'dun zhal grangs nyung ba bcas 'dug rung / 'on kyang gus tsho rang gi las thog gtsug lag khang dang / bde yangs 11gas zhig ral 'debs bris chu skyodan sogs nyams gso gang dbo sa hur skyed zhus pa bla dathodan gzigs chodad lags pa ma zad/rten gtsos dbus 'du khang khag gi rtsis sprod ji yod sku gnyer rim byon nas nyam chag tu mi 'bo ba'i ched deb gsar bzo dang 'brel chad khra zur 'gol byas pa sogs slad mtha' 'doms yong res grwa mang mo la bsdur gyi baX sa pa las/191

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /re zung gis rang 'dod sbug bcug gi bzos pa min nges la/ da sgos zhu snying dkon gnyer ngag dbang nas gus tshor mi bab tshad rtsis yul byol rgyab ltas byed babs la bka' nyes dang / slad me ༷kyi mnyam gshib sku/nga gral mchod rgyun ma rtsa'i lo zla ji song gi ngo skyed khris pa ra rtsis rgyag gsol ras/ dkon gnyer las rgyun gyi chad khri rnams skyodan med skyon cadar yin min 7bla dpon dbyings gzigs ltar dgon gyi 'dzin bdag rang dgon spo rje mchodag yin lags na ngan pa byas rgyal du mi 'gro ba'i cad 'gel cordos slad rtsa 'dzin sku gas bla dpon dbyings bcad zhu ba bcas kyi skor/ 'jigs bral sku 7snyan gyi dbu rnams sku spang se gas la snum thig bdun bcu ro/na dgu chad khrar gsal yang ngag dbang nas snum thig lnga bcu nga lnga sngon nas yod nges dag 'bud zhu pher dang / rten deb gsar rnying dbar he bag yod lugs/ gser bzang sku dpang la khyi gang tsam yod pa ngo grangs drug sogs lhag yod tshul gsal rung / dgongs 'jags tho khongs la ma gsal ba dang / dkon gnyer sngon ma'i chad dron shog lhe ston rgyu med ngesadag pher zhu ba dang / 'di lo dkon gnyer rtsis sgod deb gsar nas bsheraskabs rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku brnyan gcig dang / rtsa li/ dus chos bcas lhagasong yang rten bzhugs yul lha khang 'phar spo tshur shugs byas 'dug pa der rkyenapa yin shag da lam deb gsar snying zhud dag skabs gsar sbyor khag las rnyingagras chad lhag thon ma song ba bcas skabs der gnyis lhu gas nas lha/la rgyugs la nyes pa tsam dgos gras rung rang dgon la bsam yangs pa byas shing / slang192

sgo rong dang 'brel ba'i mche'i yig rnying khag gi brjod don/nas dngos bo sa rin thang che chung la gzhigs pa'i snum thig ṭam ma'i 'khor rgya man la chad dron dngul zho lnga dang srang gang re babs bsnyun 'gel sgrub dang / de las che ba dang shag ral la rims 'gros bab mtshungs 'gel sgrub kyi dngul 'bab khar ma dor ma so/nga ba'i gsar bzo dang nyam gso dgos rigs 'phral 'phral grwa tshang bas dgos rgyu/ da lam gyi chad dron stodar phan tshun 'then 'khyer nyung bar brten snum thig gong gsal nas grangs nyi shu rtsa bdun bcag 'phros la rer dngul zho bdun re rtsis 'bab dang / de byings chad dron dang nyam gso dgos pa tho gsal nas sgrub chag shog lhe 'dra gnyis zur song ltar ngag dbang bas 'grub thus dgos rgyu ma zad/ gnas bcu lha khang gi rten khri'i lha gas skyon dang / rtsi nyog pa/ rdo bcal dbu chos bzhugs khang 'debs bris rdo phag sku snyan gyi tshon nyog pa bcas la krag dam gcig phul te nyams gasku( grwa tshang nas bya rgyu byas don ltar byed/ slad lcam gdung chags pa sogs kyi rgyug rigs dang /chos chas gong phan sku gsung thugs rten/ khra sogs chag grum bor thor snum thig sogs byung tshe rin nges rigs dgong 'phab ste sprod len dang / chu skyon gas nyig bcas dkon gnyer 'phos mtshams lo gcig khongs zin pa dbo sa rgyu las/ sngar lugs nar 'gyang lab snyog ched bzos de rigs bgyis mi snu ga/sngar dus pad spyodas dbo na gra rgyas dge 'dun zhal grangs mang lugs gnyis ga'i zhu bar gsal zhing grwa rgan gras phran bu'i 'grig min la snyad phyir 'bud byas pas ma 'thus shis bla zur zhe nor/ dbu zur rgyal mtshan/ bcas grwa kho ngas su bcug 193

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /ste sngar kho na zhe 'dzin sogs kyi gleng ngan phan tshun gnyis phyo gas nas bgyis mi chodag /ngag dbang zhu gsal grwa ngo mo da phal cher bslab pa 'ang 'chal lugs zhu lha ra re re bzhin mtha' 'ded bgyis tshe rgyugs pa kho ga lang yong rgyu dngos masgyu nga la tshang ma ngal brdab rgyur brten slad lam ce ra sna ga shes kyi tshul mthun bya rgyu sku da na bsam da lam ring then cing / slad 'grigs khrims zhu sgo bca' yig rin po che'i dgongs don mi 'gal ba'i spang blang dgos rgyu dang / grwa ngag dbang nas dkon gnyer chad dron ya yol thub re'i yul byol lta bur phyin par nyes pa dgos gras rung / rang dgon chen po'i sku gam bde sdug sol te phyir log byung stabs nyes 'bab yang pa byas te dbo na gyis bshags skrub bca' yig dbo ngas don 'bab yang phul thodag bsgrigs kho ngas skyar 'o/ga bgyis mi chog /ngag dbang su chod rgyun ma rtsa rtsis sprod dang / 'dod bzhugs bun grwa tshang la phar 'bul dbo sa dang / dkon gnyer 'o/gas thod ba mo gas grwa tshang nas ngag dbang la sprod dgos rigs da lam rtsis rgyag sngo ga sprod lan dgos rgyu bcas grang thig gis dpyad shog 'dir mos na chod yig dan thel kyang da lta theb pa dgos rgyu dang /ma mos tshe mi dbang 'tsho 'dzin chen po'i sku gam 7snyan zhu dang bsgrags zhabs rdzong zhu rgyur de don khe nyen 'dem ka ma log pa byed/ spo rje dang / cho 'dzin ྅kyi tshab kyis shing bya zla 10 tshes 4 la/gong gsal bka' dpyad dbo ngas don la do bdag phan tshun gnyis mo sa kyi sgrub khyodad kyang zhus zin pas slad 'khon med nyi ma sprin bral ba las/ sngar 'khon 194

spe gro nga dang 'brel ba'i 'o/ rgyus khag khungs gtugs yig cha dang cadang can mi sna khag bi lnga / 31 rtsis dpon lung shar gyis spo zodang khul du khral 'don legs bcos bgyis pa'i yig snying khag32 snga dus spo rong du kha mchu thag gcod kyi dpyad yig /dpyad shog ngo 'dra gnyis nas grwa ngag dbang nas nyar/ zhes pa/33 dgung lo 88 la'ang gson bzhugs spo rong dpal mo chos sdings kyi dkon gnyer zur pa/ byes su spo rong dpal mo chos sdings slar gso la bka' drin can dkon gnyer ngag dbang /34 dgung lo 65 bar gso/na bzhugs byes su spo rong dpal mo chos sdings slar gso la shin tu bka' drin che ba tshe ring dam chos/25 dgung 'i 87 bar gasku na bzhugs de snga spo rong rje dbon gyi zhabs gras dang rtsa hrang rdzong tshab khang dkar spo lags byang chub/36 dgung lo 66 bar gso/na bzhugs dus 'gyur skabs rtsa hrang rdzong dpon las thog khang dkar bu don grub tshe ring /37 dgung 'i 70 la'ang gson bzhugs spo blosnong spyi khyab dngos grub tshe ring /28 dgung lo 72 la'ang gamo na bzhugs de snga spo rong sku bag kun bzang byams pa'i sku 'khor du ches mnyam gshib che ba khang dkar bu tshe ring bsasku/ sdi/ba/ 39 dgung lo 76 bar gasku na bzhugs de snga spo rong rje dalnga na gyi zhabs gras dang spo blo nga gi gzhas chen rgyal gzhas la mkhas shing byes su rgyal gzhas 201
