༄༅/ /byes 'byor lpo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/nged rang chung dus kyi dran sprodag la nged tsho sbra chen yul mi mang wa zhig spo ro/nga rje dbon gyi pho brang sge'u khung nas de snga go myong med pa'i 'ur sgra'i skad gdangs yis nyan par 'gro myong yod/ yul mi tshos 'ur sgra de la spo rong sku ngo'i wa yang den nam rlung 'phrin nyan par 'gro zhes ya mtshan du brtsis te nyan par 'gro ba las de'i brjod don mo gas ga nas rtogs/ rjes su spo rong pa bgres pa chodas gsungs don/ spo rong sku ngos de dus nas rlung 'phrin rgyud dbyin ji'i gsar 'gyu ra gsan gyi sku da pa dang cadad la dus 'gyur 'gro gi sku da pa sku gas kyang gsal rtogs byung sku da 'dug/1 spo rong rje dbon glo yul du bros byol phebs 'phral yul mi ser skya phon che zhig rang mgo rang thon gyis btsan byol du gyar bzhin dgon pa'i rten gtso sogs bal yul du gdan zhu thub pa'i skor/phyi lo 195 9 lo'i dus 'gyur gyi 'o/ shas sngon wa da gzhung nas spo rong rje dbon sku bag kun bzang byams pa lags cangahreng sngo nga dpon du balha bzhag mdzad/skabs der khong rang lha sar bzhugs mus 'phral phebs thub min sngo nga tshab spo rong spyi khyab khang dkar dbang phyug gi bu don grub tshe ring sogs brdzangs/ de 203

'brog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /rjes phyi lo 1959 lo'i dus 'gyur zin ma thag rje dbon sku bag dang lcam bgres pa ngag dbang rnam sku la lags/ lcam gzhon pa bde chen masnur rgyal lags/sras mo/ pad+ma bde chen lags/ rje btsun ma skal bzang bu 'khrid lags dang zhabs gras kha shas bcas pa wa 'dren rta g.yag sku gas 'o/na che ded nas lhod 'jam ngang rtsa hre nga rdzong 'go zin par gzhis bteg /mi ring bar yul du gnas tshul go thos la/ spo phra nga gzhung rkyang bal yul sa mtshams glo yul du btsan byol la phebs pa las rdzong 'go zin par phebs pa'i gnas tshul bden pa min pa gsal po chags/ de rjes dre rong pa rā na che gsang ba chen pos rang mthod rang thon gyis/ la las skyid grong brgyud bal yul sa mtshams ri zur dang tsum dang / la las bal yul sa mtshams shar khum khul du btsan byol du 'byor/ ri zur sa mtshams 'byor kho ngas spo gro nga dpal mo chos sdings dgon pa'i mdzad gtso bla zur don chos 'phel dang dge phrug tshul khrims/ bla thog bla ma dbang 'dus dang dge phrug blo bzang chodas dar/ de bzhin spo rong mi dmangs kho ngas nas dkon gnyer ngag dbang can grong pa bcu sko ra dang de'i khongs nged kyi khyim tshang yang yod red/ ri zur (ra su wa ) sa mtshams 'byor ba'i spe rong pa phal che ba bal po'i sa mtshams gyi sku nga gseb/ gser thang zhes pa dang / khang gcig ma zhes pa gnyis su gnas skabs shig ring sgar chags/ bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang de 'dra'i thabs skyo min pas ring min phyir log byed rgyu'i go skabs shig shar yong zhes re ba chen pos de mur bsdad kyang / mi ring bar bod kyi gnas 204

byes 'byor sgo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/ snangs je zhan je sdug tu 'gro yi yo da pa'i gnas tshul gsal mthong khar bstan srung dang blangs dmag mi'i ming 'khyer ba'i khams rigs mang sngo zhig gcig mjam gnyis mthud brel dngangs chen sngo sa bal sngotsware sa mtshams/ su bros dre la 'bye ra gyi yod stabs der 'khod h+pho rong pa skya ser lhan 'dzoms kyis ma gros bsam pa gcig mthun byung don la/ rang dgon dpal mo chos sdings kyi rten gtso 'jigs bral nga 'dra mas gasgu sa lha sku rten gsung byin can rnams bod du rang gar bzhag na 'gan blo sa bzod thabs med pas rang ngos nas thabs shes sang drag gis gang lnga ba cig gdan zhu byed rgyur sems thag bcad/phyi lo 1960 bod zla 2 bar bla zur don chos 'phel dang bla ma dbang 'dus/ mi mang khongs nas daskadan gnyer nga ga dbang / spo chos dbang bcas mi 'gro bzhi gsang rgya chen wa sa spo rong chodas sdings su phyir log /skabs der skyid grong du yod pa'i rgya dmag rnams sa gnas gzhan zhig tu bskyod pa'i bar gseng 'khel bas yar lam rkyen med bde 'byedar thub/ de nas gzhis lus grwa dmangs dang gros mo la gyis rgya dmag med pa'i dus skabs dang stabs bstun nas rten gtso 'jigs bral rin wa ches gceras gser dngul las grub pa'i mchod chas rtsa chen dang sku gsung thugs rten do grangs kha shas shig brel 'chub ngang bsdu gamo ga gis/ spo rong nas skyid gro nga spang shing bar g.yag gis 'or 'dren dang de rjes bal po'i sa mtshams bar skyid grong khur pa glas te gad na 'dren zhus/ rten gtso rin po che rta g.yag sdusags la bkal nas mi gzhan la mngags 205

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /na 'gan len bzod min zhes dkon gnyer ngag dbang dang spo chos dbang gnyis res mos kyis rgyab 'khur gdan 'dren zhu thub pa bcas skal bzang du gyur/'brog pa spo rong pa'i lha sde mi sde'i dad dam lhad med yin pa'i rtag sa mtshan du cadad nas rten gathor bal yul sa mtshams/ khang gcig ma zhes par 'khyodar ba'i nyin de rang la rgya gar nas kyang gnas mjal gyis phyir 'o/ga yong ba'i spo rong pa tsā ri pa sangs dang / chags pa'i chodas byung gnyis ma rgyab dus ras de nyin khang gcig ma ru 'byor/ rgyun ring rjes rgyus med skyabs med mi yul de 'dra zhig tu ma rgyab dus ra de 'dra zhig byung bar rten 'brel bzang po byung zhes tshang ma dga' tshor 'kho la zhing de nyin mtshan gang lab gleng dang ja chang longs spyod la dus 'das/ de nas tsā ri dang chags pa gnyis kyis kyang rgya sar gnas mjal la phyin te lag stong min pas gtam bzang sku da ces bzhugs sbar dha ram sa lar 7gong sa mchog dang sku ngas 'dzin rnam gnyis/ de bzhin 7rgya' dbang kurma pa sogs ris med bla chen mang ngo mjal ba'i gtam bzang khar yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis dang lhag par yongs 'dzin sku bgres gling rin dro mchog gis khong tsho ra lung phyogs gang nas yin dang / pha yul du dgon pa ji yod mo gas bka' rtsad gnang ba'i lan du/ kho nga snu sa spo mo nga nas yin pa dang dgon pa bo snga nga paṇa chen gyi gdan sa dpal mo chos sdings yod lugs zhus ri ra khyed tshos thabs shes gang drag gis bo wa nga pa'i rten gsung gzhan gdan zhu thub na ma thub na'ang bo dong paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum de nyid 'dus ni 206

byes 'byor spo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/sosas nges par du gdan 'dren zhu dgos pa'i bka' slob nan phebs byung ba'i lo rgyus zhus 'bras khong dza sa slar yang bod du phyir log gis gsung 'bum sadan zhu byed rgyu'i 'char gzhi bting /de nas phyi lo 1960 bod zla 5 bar dgon pa'i grwa blo bzang chos dar dang dbu zur lug 'gu/ tsā ri'i mag pa pa sangs dang bsod nams stobs rgyal bcas gsang rgya chen ngo sa bod du phyir 'o/ga byas/ skabs der byes 'asdudar dge 'dun khongs nas na gachodan gzugs thang grwa blo bzang chos dar las med stabs bo rngu gsung 'bum gdan zhu kho na'i ched don gnyer chen dze sa yong / de byings spo rong pa rnams spyi sger gnyis phan gyi rogs pa yong rer khong tsho lhan du bskyod/chos sdings su 'byor ma thag gzhis lus dge 'dun pa rnams dang gros mol byung 'bras gzhis nas grwa skal bzang grags pa (ba las ) dang seng phrug sanyis gsung 'bum gdan zhur bcar rgyu bcas/ mthar gsung 'bum bris ma/dbu can pod brgya 100 lhag tsam dang dbu med pod brgya 100 lhag tsam bcas gsung 'bum kho na do grangs 18 de snga bzhin skyid grong spang shing bar g.yag gis 'or/ de rjes skyid grong pa'i khur pa grus te thon yong skabs rgya dmag skyid grong du sgar btab pa dang skabs 'khel bas lam bar gzab mkhas byed dgos pa'i gnas tshul chags/ gsung 'bum do grangs 18 kyi khar sger dngos do grangs phon che bcas khyon bsdoms 'or mi grangs 25 tshang ma mnyam du min par snga rjes yas mas kyis mtshan la bskyod/ rgya lam spangs/ srang 207

'grog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /lam 'grims pa'i khul gyis bal sngo da sa mtshams phyogs su lnga na kyang / skyid grong gi grong zur zin mtshams mjug 'ded pa dgon pa'i grwa blo bzang chos dar dang tsā ri bso/da stobs/ tsā ri 'brug rgyal/ khur pa kha shas bcas rgya dmas gis 'dzin bzung nang tshud/ gsung 'bum do grangs drug dang sger dngos phon che dmag mis snga dam la shor/2 ngo mtshar ba'i gtam/(1)de nyin gnas tshul ya mtshan can zhig byung ba ni dbo na pa'i rten gyi khe ngas sangs rgyas kyi zhal 'bag /gzungs gzhug tu sangs rgyas cadad srung gi ring bsrel dang zhal ras la 'dzam bu chu gser sgron pa'i rten rtsa chen de grwa blo bzang chos dar gyi rgyab 'khur nang yod 'dug kho pas nged la brjod don/ ((skyid grong gi grong zur slebs skabs nga tsho'i mdun du slog gzhu'i 'od chem zhing skad cor rgyas mkhan 'dra ྅/ byas sdudang / mtha' ma byas dus nga tsho rgya dmag gis mtha' bskor zin 'dug /nga dza'ire sngon tsam la yod pa'i khur pa dang gzhan pa tsho dmag mis mthong mi 'dug kho tsho thar pa red/ 'dzin bzung byas pa'i khongs nga dang tsā ri bamo da nams stodabs rgyal/ tsā ri 'brug rgyal/ khur pa chod bcas yod/ rgya dmag gis nga mo ru sgrig nang bcug ste rgyab mdun yongs rdzogs bslor nas skyid grong gro nga khyer gyi phyogs la 'khrid mkhan 'dra bo byas so/nga / nged rang ru gra' dkyil tsam la yod/ nga'i 'khris la yod pa'i rgya mi des nga la wa snang gang yang 208

byes 'byor sgo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/byed kyi mi 'dug /gzhan pa de chodar skabs re ce tso zer nas 'ded pa dang 'jigs bskul byed kyi 'dug /gang 'tshams rjes nga rang gi zhed snang de'ang brlang/ khur po de yang yang du 'gro gi yod pa lta bu'i tshor snang khyad mtshar zhig byung / de nas lam zur zhig tu ru gral nas lnga na te gcin pa gtong khul gyis bsdad par/ rgya dmag gis nged rang ma mthong ba lta bu'i gang yang brjod kyi mi 'dug /lam zur de ga rang du kho nga tsho mig yul nas ma yal bar bsdad/ de ma thag lam gasdo/nga nas bskyodags te stunong thang 'grims nas bal 11re sa ma35mas phyogs su ༷ sa sku nga ba yin/ sang nyin khang gcig ma ru 'byor sku nga / de 'dra'i ya mtshan byung /nyi gsungs/ tsā ri bsku da stobs dang bamo da 'brug gnyis 'dzin bzung gis rdzong dgar khrid de btson 'jug byas/ tsā ri'i dngos chas phon che rdo dam nang tshud de gyong gun chen po rag /'on te mi ring bar btson 'jug byas pa'i tsā ri spun gnyis rdzong dga'i btson khang gi 'dam rtsig la i khung brus nas bros byol du 'khyodar/3 ngo mtshar ba'i gtam/ (2) phyi lo 2006 lor nged rang sud si grogs po tsho'i mnyam du sa rong du ched baspyod kyis nyin zhag bcu sdod ring gzhis lus dgon pa'i grwa skal bzang grags si dang lhod mjal byung / ngas khong la gsung 'bum gdan zhu'i skabs skyid grong bar slebs zin nas phyir log byed dgos pa'i gnas tshul ji yin dris par khong 209

'grog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /gis 'grel brjod 'di 'dra zhig gnang / ((de dus khyad mtshar zhe bo gcig byas sku nga / nga dang grwa ye shes seng phrug gnyis gsung 'bum gdan zhu la bcar ba dang chabs cig rdog thon byas pa yin/ 'on kyang mar lam nged gnyis don med 'khon 'dzin chen po shor byung / dus rgyun mi 'chams pa gang yang med/ skyid grong slebs khar nged gnyis phan tshun khong khro drag pos phal cher lag 'dzing thug rgyu'i nyen khar slebs song / nga re'i rang ngos nas bzod sgom byas khul yang seng phrug gis ga la nyan/ mthar kho pas brjod don la/ khyed rang yar lopye na nga mar 'gro/ khyed rang mar 'gro na nga yar log shin/ nged gnyis lung pa gcig tu cha la gnas thabs med zer/ de nas nga gnyis kha bral rgyur nges/ nga thodad la log shin bakhyodad pas seng phrug gis nga rgya gar la 'bo gi yin zer nas kho rang gi rgyab khur do bo de'i ched khur pa glas te tsum brgyud bal yul la thon song / nga'i do bo'ang khur pa la bskur nas spo rong la phyir log byas/ phyir mig bltas te bsam rlo btang dus de nyin nged gnyis 'khon bcug mkhan de 'o re'i chos srung de min nam dran gyi 'dug /gang yin zer na rtsa ba'i a khu 'jigs med thig skyogs sku/gas bod du grwa ba rgan pa gzhan kha shas yod mus ma zad nged rang bslab pa rgan shos min na yang rig gnas gsar brje'i po/tor bzhig rjes nga'i sems la skyo snang shugs che zhig skyes byung / dgon pa'i gna' shul ngadag 'dzin dang chos rgyun slar gasdud byed dgos snyam pa'i sems 'gul chen po zhig kyang thebs byung / der brten dgon pa'i sku gsung thugs rten lhag ma de tsho 210

byes 'byor sgo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/bdag bzung gis gces nyar byas/ de bzhin bar skabs shig dzad blo nga khul du chos pa chodag rdzun de 'dra mang 11 sku/nga nas mi mang la mo/ lung brtag pa dang zhabs rim/ 'beb pa sku gas 'bo rgyug chen lnga chags pas dalnga sa snga na du khong cho ca lag rnying pa rub rub bzo mkhan red 'dug /sku yon mi len pa'i tshul gyis khong tsho sa grong gseb pa nas ca dngos rnying pa gang thob dang / lhag par dgon pa dang mi tshang drag gras kyi shing rkos dpe cha'i glegs shing rnying pa mang po bsdu gsog yis chag dum brgyab ste bzhag pa mthong byung / nyin cig nged rang bsdad slos ma bzod par gle gas shing de tsho nga tsho'i dgon pa'i red ces kho tsho'i lag nas phrogs te dathodan nang bsdus pa yin/ debazhin mi mang la'ang chodab gasku bo bskon dang / dbo na pa'i lha srung la'ang 'phrin bcadal gzab rgyas zhus pa yin pas de rjes zog po de choda'ang gar song cha med du gyur song / de nas gang 'tshams rjes spo rong du ya mtshan can gyi gnas tshul de 'dra kha shas gcig mjug gnyis mthud du byung ba red/ spo rong khul gyi grong pa kha shas dang / de las lhag pa spo rong ma yin pa'i kre ba sogs kyi mi tshang de 'dra'ang nga ṣ+ṭharware dgon par yong nas lha sku dang thang ka sogs dngos snying de 'dra dgon par phul bar slebs song / kho chos brjod don/ dngos rnying 'di dgon pa'i yin bzo 'dug /yar bzhes rogs gnang / nga dzarware khyim tshang la gnod kyi 'dug /dbo na pa'i lha srung gso rogs gnang / bshags pa bzhes zodags gnang / zhes thang ka la sdu/gas pa ca lag rnying pa mang wa phul mkhan byung / bu rang gis mchod mjal skabs 211

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /gzigs pa de tsho red/ dngos snying de tsho kha shas 'o re'i dgon pa'i yin la kha shas ni e yin bsam pa'ang 'dug /gang ltar deng sang srid gzhung gis kyang nga chod la shel dkar mnga' khul du khyed rang tsho'i dgon pa tig ro/sa red ces bdag nyar 'phyug med dgo sa pa'i slob gso/ yang gtong gi 'dug rta ces gsungs byung /4 gsung 'bum do grangs drug skyid grong du mer bsregs btang ba'i skor/phyi lo 1962 lor dkon gnyer ngag dbang can spo phro nga pa khag cig bal yul 'alnga khel baX grwar gnas 'khod stabs skyid grong nas gsar 'byor gnas shar zla ba zhes pas spo rong par 'brel gtugs kyis brjod don/ spo rong pa'i gsung 'bum do grangs drug skyid grong byams sprin lha khang gi bang khrir bdag med lta bu mjal rgyu yod pa dang / skabs der byams sprin lha khang du dkon gnyer med cing lta rtog byed mi phag pa galha/ mkhan phag rdzi zhig las gzhan su gang med stabs gsung 'bum gdan zhu byed rgyur dka' ngal med lugs dang / bal yul bar gdan zhu byed rgyur 'gro gron bal skor chig sko nga tsam btang na kho bos gdan zhu thub kyi yod pa'i lhad med dad bskul zhus par/ skabs der lpo rong dgon pa 'khos zhan che bas bal sgor chig lha nga 'gro gron gtong dmigs med stabs de snga bzhugs sgar nas bka' slob zab mo phebs don sems bcang gis sa gnas don gcod sku ngo ye shes lhan grub lags kyi mdun du bcar nas bal sgor 212

byes 'byor spo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/1000 tham pa snga g.yar yong ba'i snyan seng lan mang nan gyis zhus kyang sku ngo mchog nas nga tsho sa zhu don la yid ches ma gnang bar/ khyed snuras 'bo/ sgo na thab ṭa shes kyis gsung 'bum bal yul rgyal sa bar du gdan zhu thub pa bgyis/de 'phral bal sgor 1000 tham pa don gcod las khungs nas rogs skyor gnang rgyu las/ las nge na ma sgrub bo nga snga g.yar gastodang 'gan bajo da kyi med lugs sogs bka' nan phebs brten rgyun ring zhig ci bya galta la med de mur lus/ de nas lo shas rjes skyid grong byams sprin du bzhugs pa'i bo dong gsung 'bum do grangs drug po dag srung dmag dmar pos mer bsregs kyis shog le gcig kyang mjal rgyu med pa'i gnas tshul thabs zhan de 'byor/ gnas tshul 'di shin tu blo pham pa'i rang bzhin zhig red/ gang gis brjod na/ bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis drung yig nyi shu skor la dpod bris kyi brtsams par grags pa'i gsung 'bum bris ma lnga da 120 brgal ba de gras cha tshang bzhi las med par grags/ phyi 'o/ 1959 'o/ra spo ro/nga pas gdan 'dren zhus pa'i khongs dbu chen la bris pa dang dbu med la bris pa bsdoms pod cha tshang ba gnyis med dam snyam/ 'on kyang skyid grong du mer bsregs btang ba'i gsung 'bum do grangs drug po de'i khongs pod grangs ji yod dang le tshan ji yin sogs bshad rgyu med stabs da lta lag yod gsung 'bum 'di'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig bzo bde med pa chags/ thugs snang dgos rgyur/ bod kyi bstan bcos khag cig gi mtshan byang dri med shel dkar 'phreng ba/ zhes pa/ mchos sngon mi rigs 213

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /dpe skrun khang nas 1985 lor dpar skrun bgyis 'dug /rgyus yod mi snar rtsad zhib skabs 'di ni a mdo bla brang bkra shis 'khyil dgon par dpe mdzod chen mo/ phyi nang gsang gsum yod kho ngas nas phal cher dpe mdzod phyi ma'i dkar chag red ces gsungs 'dug /des na gong gsal dkar chag de'i shog grangs 131 143 bar ((wa wa nga pa lhu gas las rnam rgyal gyi bka' 'bum nyi zhes par dpe tshan 329 bzhugs 'dug /po ta la dang 'bras spungs/ sa skya sogs kyi dkar chag nang cad wa nga pa'i dpe cha gang 'tshams yod par grags kyang gsung 'bum ni yod bzo ma mchis/ bo dong paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i lam rim dpar ma ༷༅sa legs shig khang dkar tshul khrims skal bzang lags kyi phyag tu 'bul mkhan byung 'dug pa de ldi lir khang dkar bu don grub tshe ring lags kyis dpar skrun mdzad de da lta tshang ma'i kho da du mjal rgyu mchis kyang blo pham zhig la/ bo dong lam rim ma dpe gcig las med pa de ldi lir dpar skrun byed skabs ngag dbang stobs rgyal lags kyi phyag tu yod mus nas ldi lir gnas 'khod cadad khang gi mdzad gce zhig gi spyan rgyang nas ma thar ba'i byus ngan shor ba red ces lam rim ma dpe de'ang gar song cha med du gyur/ bod kyi lo paṇa bka' drin can rnams kyis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum mtha' yas pa sku da pa sna 'dzam gling mi mang la bod mi'i ngos nas mgo bo sgreng zhing slo spobs chen pathos ngom chog pa'i phyag rjes rin chen gyi ri rab dang dbyer med cig yin pas gces 'dzin bdag gnyer byed rgyu ni shin tu gal gnad che/ dus 'gyur rjes bod phyi 214

byes 'byor slo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/mang gang sar yongs khyab bka' bstan spyi dang lhag par ches dkon pa'i bo dong ju ṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum dang 'thor bris sogs la 'dzam gling / ༄9 gru gang sa dang / lhag par mkhas pa mang sngo/sa dmigs bsal thugs snang mdzad kyi 'dug pa ni dga' ba'i rang bzhin du gyur/ 7gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren rgyal dbang ྅/ 'phreng bcu bzhi pa chen sngo/ mchog nas bo dong gis mtshon nyams gud rtsa brlag tu 'bo/ra nyen pa'i chodas brgyud khag la thugs snang che bzhes kyis rogs skyor mdzad pa ni gzhal zla med pa'i bka' drin du gyur/5 ngo mtshar ba'i gtam/(3)khong gsal dang dbyer med ngo mtshar ba'i gnas tshul zhig bal yul du'ang byung ba tshang mas shes gsal red/ de snga dus 'gyur rjes dge 'dun rnams bros byol phebs skabs dge 'dun pa kha shas kyis ngos nas mdza na srung thodab ched dgon pa'i bla sku re zung bdag nyar byed srol byung yod/ de'i gras su byes la skya babs spo rong ser lung rgan chen pa'i grwa 'jigs med bstan 'dzin lags kyi phyag tu 'jigs bral gyi bla ྅kyi malnga gang ma zhig byung ba red 'dug 1960nas bzung bla sku de kho rang khyim du bdag nyar gyis grong pa'i mchod khang nang rtsa cher rtsis te phyag mchod sogs legs pos dad rten du nyar/ phyi 'o/ 1980nang rgan chen pa khyim tshang rgya gar nas bal yul du gnas spos kyis gdan gyi bzo grwa zin/ de rjes gcung po tshing rdor ḍi kun dang slob khongs nas dgongs 215

'brog sde chen po sa rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /zhus kyis bal yul du rang khongs bal las bzo grwa zhig 'dzin skyong byed skabs rgan chen khyim tshang la gnas dzaXl ya mtshan zhig byung ba kun shes red/ a khru tshing dodar dam pa des nged la gsal por gsungs don/ ((nga bal yul slebs nas tin cu lir bzo grwa zin dus rmi lam dngangs skrag tsha wa de 'dra mang po zhis bstan par dang thog snang ba ma btang / rjes su dogs pa skyes byung / gang lags zhe na/ bod du dra rong dgon par srung ma'i gzungs po zhes lha g.yag sngon po zhig sku da pa red/ ngo da du nga'i mi tshe g.yag lug kho da du bskyal tsang dgon pa'i gzungs wa de 'khrul med cad shes kyi 'dug /rmi lam nang gi g.yag de gzungs po sngon wa de rang red 'dug /nga'i rmi lam la gzungs po des nga ded nas bros res bros tshad bakhrod gi 'dug /gzungs pos nga bdas nas rwa co rno bo de gnyis kyis nga'i rkub gtol mo nga bsam pa dang rmi lam rdzogs kyi 'dug /rmi lam de ni yang nas yang du bstan/ de rjes nga la rnam rtog skyes song / ngas a co grwa ba 'jigs med bstan 'dzin la rmi lam brtag pa 'di 'dra zhig 'dug ces bshad pa yin/ nga tsho'i nang la dgon pa'i ca lag snying pa de 'dra med dam dris pas/tag tag kho rang / gcen sngo/sa dgon pa'i bla sku gcig sku da red/ mchod gcadam nang la bsgrigs sku da red/ da chongod sku de dbo na pa la phul bzhag na yag gi red zer byung / mchod gasna ma bsngogs pas 'jigs bral gyi bla sku mtho gang ma cis rnyed byung / de dus ( 1989) spo rong dgon pa nyam chung zhig bzhengs zin yod stabs sang nyin de rang dgon par yar phul ba yin/ de rjes rmi lam/ 216

byes 'byor hro rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/gcig kyang bstan ma byung / 'jam thing nger phyin mo nga / 'o/ re'i chodas srung 'di khyad mtshar de 'dra zhig yod red/ bod du nga rang g.yag rdzi yin tsang chos sro nga gi gzungs po sngon po de tag ger ngo shes song nyi zhes brjod byung /6 ngo mtshar gyi gtam/ (4)deng dathodan par rgan chos su zhugs pa'i dgung lo 83 thebs pa'i a khu 'jam dbyangs la chos srung dang lha g.yag gzungs po'i skor 'dri rtsad bgyis par/khong gis gsungs don/ (runga'i mi tshe phyed lhag tsam thodad du gnag lug gi khrod du bskyal ba yin/ dgon pa'i gnag la grwa tshang gi gnag zer/ grwa tshang gi gnag 'tsho mkhan la grwa tshang gi gnag pa zer/ grwa tshang gi gnag pa rgya masnurare bza' zla nga'i a lcag red/ nga tsho lo mang gshib myong sku da/ grwa tshang gi gnag la gzungs po lnga yod red/ de'i nang nas chos srung gi gzungs po sngon po de rgan tshugs zin pa dang spyod pa ya rabs shig mo da/ spyir stangs dbyar smad pha g.yag tsho lung gzhung la 'bab dus nang khul 'khrugs 'dzing byed srol yod/ de 'dra'i skabs chos srung gi gzungs sngo/ der g.yag gzhan gyis rgol skabs rgan dzaXgs zin mdodag kha wa sa mchu to g.yugs tsam gyi rgol lan sprodad pa las dngos su 'khrugs 'dzing gnang sku la med/ lan cig lan gnyis gyong gun yang 'khyer gyi yod/ 'on kyang chos srung gi gzungs wa rang nyid las gzugs stodabs che zhing 'khrugs 'dzing rgod pa'i spo'u gzhan dang 'khrugs pa yin na dang thog bzod pa 217

'brog sde chen po skyo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /bzhes pa las kha ya mi mdzad/ gal te 'u thug bzos pa yin na kha gtad su 'dra zhig thug na'ang lha la lan mthar skrodad kyis dmar gso/da gtong rkyang las/ thar pa galta nga ba min/ de 'dra'i ya mtshan yod/ nged kyi dran thog la/ spo rong so/ga phrug la dzada'u nag po gzugs stobs shin tu che ba zhig yod red/ de la so/ga phrug gi spo'u nag dze zhes skad grags yod red/ lan gcig sog phrug gi spo 'u dang chos srung gi gzungs po gnyis 'khrugs te de nyin chos srung gi gzungs sngo/ pham par grags/ skabs der grwa tshang g.yag pas sdudag phrug g.yag pa la/ de ring yag po byas ma song / chodas gzungs kyis pham bzhes song / nyin cig khyed tsho'i go'u shi rkyang red/ thar pa gtong gi ma red brjod par/ sog phrug gi g.yag pas khyad gasdusad dang nga rgyal gyis bcadad pa/ a las/ gso/da pa rang 'dug khyed tsho'i gzungs wa de nga tsho'i spolus ras ling g.yugs g.yugs byas song nga / de zer gyi yin 'gro/ zhes brjod/ rjes lor dbyar smad grwa tshang gi gnag dang sku ga phrug gi gnag bcas dkar ru codid 'khyil mtsho 'gram du gnag sar phab/ de dus sog phrug gi spo'u dang chos srung gi gzungs po gnyis 'dzing res thug /so/ga phrug gi spo'u gzugs stobs che la rdzig nyams dodad kyang / de nyin srung ma'i gzungs pos sog phyag gi po'u'i mgo bo mtsho zur gyi chu la bkar nas gasku 'gul mi thub pa bzos/ rgyun ring bkar/ mthar chu nang du dbub/sa sub btang ste bsad/ skabs der mo ga phrug gi g.yag pas ma bakhrodad par srung ma'i gzungs po'i spyan la thal ba bshos/ sku lus la rdo zhus/ des ma tshad 218

byes 'byor spo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/mthar 'u thug gis chos gzungs la gri btsugs par bskyodad 'dug pa g.yag pa gzhan gyis bkag /de 'dra'i mi rub brgyab kyang chodas gzungs kyis snang ba ma bstu/ ri bar sog phrug gi spo'u'i skusgog blangs/ de 'phral sku(ga phrug gi g.yag pa'ang rjes 'ded kyis gsod grabs la thug skabs brag rtse zhig tu 'dzegs thub ste srog thar tsam byung nyi zhes gsungs/7 ngo mtshar ba'i gtam/ (5)a khu 'jam dbyangs kyis slar gsungs don/ ((lo gsar tshes gsum nyin gzungs po rnams lha gsol byed kyi red/ de dus gzungs po rnams gar bzhugs nas gdan zhur bcar dgos pa yin/ lan gcig grwa tshang g.yag pas le lo byas te yul mi zhig gzungs lnga rnams gdan zhu byed par mngags/ kho ji rkang stong phyir log yong dgos byung ba red/ gang yin zer na kho pas gzungs po rnams pho g.yag phal pa nang bzhin 'ur rdo 'phen bzhin 'ded khul byas pas/gzungs po tsho phebs rgyu phar bzhag /sku rlung gis kho par dung grabs byas byung zer nas rkang stong log dgos byung / skabs der grwa tshang gnag pas brjod pa/dgongs dag khyed la khag med/ chodas srung gi gzungs po la 'ur rdo 'phen nas ga la phebs/ ngas khyed la mngags rgyu brjed pa red/ gzungs po gdan zhu'i skabs mjal ma thag sku phyag gsum phul/ phebs mo gas zhes dad gus chen po/sa bskul dgos pa red/ de nas chos sdings pa des kho pa rang gzungs po 219

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /rnams gdan zhu la skyodad kyin bakhyodad pa ltar btang / gnag pas mngags pa bzhin bgyis pas chos gzungs rnams dgyes spro'i ngang gdan 'dren zhu thub pa red/snyi ces gsungs byung /8 dgon pa'i 'dus sde nam zhig grol zhing rten gtso rin po che snang skyid dgon par bzhugs bcol gyi spo rong mi mang nas zhabs zhu dang gsung 'bum sogs bod gzhung la phul ba'i skor/phyi lo 1960 bod zla 7 pa'i nang gzhis lus grwa dbu ma swa sti/ rgan chen pa 'jigs med bstan 'dzin/ a khu 'jigs med dam thig skyogs/ ldings dpon pa'i grwa ba/ sngo sprel grwa ba bcas kyis byes su dge 'dun pa tsho'i 'tsho ba la dmigs te dgon pa'i 'bri g.yag gang 'tshams ded nas shar khum sa mtshams su bros blol la mthar/ khong chosare mnyam du snumis srung bkra shis 'od 'bar gyi zhal 'bag khro bo sprel gdong pa byin can dang swā nag nas grub pa'i mgon 1tsware sku brnyan zhig bcas gdan zhu thub/ kho nga tsho'i dgong sa par 'bri g.yag rnams 'tsho skyong gis byes su dge 'dun rnams kyi 'tsho ba spyor thabs yin khul yang / khum bur 'byor 'phral yul lung mdo phugs bros dre la du 'byor ba'i bod mi'i 'bri g.yag sems can gyis khengs pa gzigs nas 'acadag las lta ci 'bri g.yag rnams bcol yul ma rnyed rnga'i dka' ngal phrad/ mthar sems can de tsho shar pa ngo shes shig la bdag nyar byed rogs zhes sbyin pa btang ba dang dbyer med du cadar/220

byes 'byor spo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/ de nas phyi lo 1961 lo stod khang gcig ma nas spo rong pa ser skya dang rten gtso rin wa che/ de bzhin gsung 'bum bcas bal yul rgyal sar gnas spoblo/ dus mtshungs khum bu nas dge 'dun pa rnams dang chos srung gi zhal 'bag so/gas/ tsum dang blo sa mtshams brgyud nas seng phrug dang grwa chos grags ba cas khyon bsdoms dge 'dun pa zhal grangs 11 che/ra bal yul rgyal sar zhil 'dzoms kyis gnas chen 'phags pa shing kun gyi mdun du khang pa zhig glas 'e bo dong pa'i gdan sa slar gso bgyis khul byas/ skabs che'i dge 'dun pa'i mtshan tho gasdon34 gatra/05/1 bla zur don chos/ 2 bla thog bla ma dbang 'dus/ 3 dbu mdzad su sti/4 a khu 'jigs med thig skyogs 5 rgan chen pa 'jigs med bstan 'dzin/ 6 sdings dpon pa'i grwa pa/ 7 snga spre grwa pa/ 8 blo bzang chos da ra/ 9 lde(la khrims/ 10 〈ge lnga/ rgyud grwa chos grags/ 11 lnga(ma brgyud grwa seng phrug bcas yin/'on kyang glo bur du rang yul gyar nas mi yul 'grims dgos shar ba'i sanas stangs der rgyus med 'khos zhan nyam nga'i khar dge 'dun pa sku na bgres mi 'ga' shas yul khams 'a'o/da min gyis bsnyung / la las rang khyim dang stabs bstun byed dgos dbang gis dgon khongs nas gyar/ la las 'o/ na gzhon dbang rgya gar du slob sbyong gi go skabs len 'dod sogs kyi sku ngal 'phrad pas/ mthar dge 'dun pa rnams dgongs pa gcig mthun gyis thag chodad byung don/ rten ga47 221

'brog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long rin po che dang rgyun mkho'i mchodad chas gang 'tshams shig las de byings stu gsung thugs rten dang mchod chas rnams bal yul du 'di mur bdag nyar 'gan byedas baX da min la brten rgya gar du gdan zhus kyis rang gzhung la bcol 'bu' zhus na bor brlag gi nyen kha nas thar zhing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan rlabs che ba sku/nga nges zhes kun slong bzang ngo 'di 'dra zhig gis bskul te/ phyi wo 1961 lor bla zur don chos can dge 'dun pa bgres gras rnams dha ram sa lar ched bcar gyi 7gong sa mchog mjal zhu dang bcas deng ldi li bod khang du mjal rgyu yod pa'i bo dong paṇa chen gyi gsung 'bum pod 120 dang mchod chas gang 'tshams shig phul/ phyir 'khor rjes dgon pa'i 'gan dbang yongs rdzogs bla zur don chos dang bla thog dbang 'dus/ dbu mdzad lug dga' gsum la 'khris/ khong gsum yang ༷/la kha mas 'phrod min gyis dbyar dgun gnas/ sa spe dgos sogs kyi sku ngal la brten 'gan blos ma bzod par slar phyi wo 1963 lor spo rong grwa rje drung mgon po dang bal yul don gcod ye shes lhan grub lags gnyis brgyud lnga gzhung zur gsal dbo na pa'i mchod chas / rol mo dang / sil snyan/ dung chen/ gser kong / dngul ting sogs dngu' chas to la 2000 brgal ba dang / de bzhin da lta dha sa ngo da kyi dpe mdzong khang du mjal rgyu yod pa'i sku rgyu shar li las grub pa yi dam rdo rje 'jigs bye da kyi sku brnyan byin can sogs phul tho shog grangs 9 can rang gzhung la bcozhwa 'bul zhus/222

byes 'byor sgo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/ phyi lo 1961—1964 bar gyi ga nas stangs/ rgya mtsho nas mtho tshad mi ter 4000 brgal ba nas phebs pa'i spo rong sgrub sde'i dge 'dun pa rnams glo ngu/ra du bal yul rgyal sa malnga tshad mi ṭar 1000 babs te de snga sngo sa myong las myangs myong med pa'i dbyar kha'i tsha tshad/ sel sa se 30 (30622733khu ) yas mas dasngo sa su myong dgos kyi skabs der/ dge 'dun pa rnams rang nyid yul khams ma 'a'o/da pa'i gsung skad cadar gyi sku da pa ltar sman 'dam las grub pa'i rten gathe rin wa che'ang de bzhin gyi sku ngal che ba ci ma rung snyam nas/dbyar dus bal ༷/da sa mtshams sbas yul du grags pa yul pad+ma tshal zhes pa'i gri+ong sde rkyang shing du rgyab 'khur gyis gdan 'dren zhus/ dgun dus bal yul rgyal sa 'phags shing dang skabs shig mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi drung du'ang bzhugs/ phyi lo 1964 dgun stod rten gtso rin po che dang bla thog dbang 'dus 'jo khel du phebs/ bla zur don chos dang dbu mdzad swa sti rnam gnyis rkyang shing du las mjug bskyangs te phebs 'char yin 'dug kyang rgyun ring ma phebs/ de'i ring bla ma dbang 'dus bgres po slo bur du sku tshe ma zin/ gnas skabs shig ring rten gtso rin lnga cher mchodad 'bul zhabs zhu'i mchosan dkon gnyer gyi las 'gan 'jo khel dzad rong mi mang gis bsgrubs/ skabs der 'jo spel du gnas 'khod spo rong pa dkon gnyer ngag dbang / spo rong tsā ri khyim tshang / dbu ma'i bde skyi da lags/ dpon yig pa'i sna rmo bsod nams sogs nas do 'khur chen po bzhes/223

'brog sde chen po po rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /de rjes dgon pa'i mdzad gtso bla zur don chos dang dbu mdzad rnam gnyis rkyang shing nas 'khe/ra mtshams blo pham chen pos spo rong mi mang la gsungs don /kho nga tsho gnyis kyang dgung lo yar sku na khar yul khams 'phrod min la brten bod du phyir 'o/ga phebs rgyu las thabs shes gzhan mi 'dug ces slad dgon pa'i bdag bzung dang rten gtso rin po che'i zhabs zhu'i skor ji dge'i skya ser thun mo nga gis thag gcod dgos pa'i gros 'char bton pa ltar/ phyi 'o/ 1965 lor spo rong ser skya mi mang lhan 'dzoms kyis rten gtso rin po che dang sku gsung thugs rten ji yod gnas skabs ring bal yul rgyal sa'i nye 'dabs dben gnas/ shi wa pu rir yod rgyan sprul sku rin po che'i sgrub khang snang skyid dgon par gnas skabs ring bcol ma zhus te skabs shig spo rong dpal mo chos sdings lha sde mi sde kha bral lta bur gyur/ lo ngo lnga tsam skyabs bcol gyi gnas stangs la de mur lus/phyi lo 1971 lor bal yul rgyal sar gnas 'kho da spo rong pa khyim tshang nyi shu skor gyi 'tsho ba'i gnas stangs phran bu yar rgyas dang yul khrims dang lung pa'i bo mas gshis sdu/gas la byang bo mas kyis rang mgo lnga na pa'i gnas stangs der tshang mas ma gros bsam pa gcig mthun gyis/ rten gtso rin sngo/ che'i rgyun mchod dang dus mchod sogs slar gso'i ched thebs rtsa'i zhal 'debs chis bsdus/ de bzhin bod zla 4 tshes 15 nam yin la 'jigs bral rin ngo che'i dgongs rdzogs dus chen srung srol yod pa ltar dus chen slar gso dang 224

byes 'byor hro rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/bcas sgo rong pa rnams snang skyid dgon du bcar nas tshogs 'bul dang mchod mjal zhu mgo tshugs/ skabs de ra dkon gnyer ngag dbang can spo rong pa spyi dngalhag par spo rong pa bkra shis don grub nas gtong phod chen pos dad bskul shu/bas che zhus/ mchod dod shing mar lcags ṭin dang chosags 'bul ched dza gas rdzas sogs spo rong pa re mo sa kyis snang skyid dgon pa bar rgyab 'khur 'or 'dren zhus/ dgo na pa dang 'brel ba'i dus chen nam yin la spyod rong pa rnams snang skyid dgon du 'du 'dzoms kyis snga dro mogs 'bul dang de rjes yul gzhas 'khyab pa mo gas 'aX ga pa spo rong pa'i lha sde mi sde'i 'brel ba dang spyi chomags kyi rnam pa slar gasku thub pa'i ngo wa zhig shar/de rjes lo ngo bcu tsam nang 'dzam gling yul gru gang sar 'thor pa'i spo rong pa rnams la la gnas mjal dang gnyen 'phrad/ la la gnas spos dang gnyen sgrig zhigs la brten nas bal yul du yong mgo tshugs/ lhag par sud si gnas 'khod tshe ring dam chodas dang g.yag pa rdo rje sogs bal yul du gnas mjal la 'byor skabs rang dgon slar gso dgos pa'i sems skul dang dpal 'byor gyi rgyab rten la do 'khur dang / de bzhin shar khum gzhis khongs nang yod spo rong pa spyi khyab dang kong po khyim tshang sogs dang rgya gar nas spo rong pa khang dkar dang rgan chen khyim tshang sku gas bal yul gnas dre sa/ de min bal yul du gzhung sger las byed khongs spo rong pa mi nyung tsam byung ba bcas/225

'acadag sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /9 dzad resnang mi mang gis rang kho ngas grwa chodas grags ḍi ḍūn dang slob nas dgongs zhus kyis daskadan gnyer slar gamo bgyis pa'i skor/phyi lo 1979 lor spo rong mi mang lhan 'dzoms kyis rten gtso rin po ches gtsos rang dgon gyi lha sku rten gsung 'di mur gzhan bcol bdag med lda bur bzhag na nyams dma' zhing mi rabs kyi las 'gan g.yol bar 'askra/ bas/ da tshod rten gtso rin po che snang skyid ri khrod nas bal yul rgyal sar gdan zhu dang rgya gar ste ḍūn dmag khe ngas su bzhugs pa'i grwa chos grags la 'brel gtugs kyis dasku na pa'i 'gan dbang phul dgos zhes gros 'chams byung ba ltar/ rtsod rgyan sprul sku rin sngo che la snyan seng zhus 'bras de snga bcadal ma zhus pa'i tho gzhung nas sku brnyan chung tsag re zung dgon pa gsar bzhengs kyi sku gzungs la phul ba phud de min chod 'khod gzhir bzung cha tshang phyir slog gnang ba ma zad rten gathong rin po che bzhugs yul lha khang dang grwa shag stabs bde zhig bcas mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'khris bka' rnying bshad sgrub gling dgon pa'i zur du bstsal/ skabs der lha rgyan sprul sku rin po che nas bka' slob phebs don/ rang dgon bka' rnying bshad sgrub gling bal gzhung la deb skyel bgyis/ pa'i dgon pa zhig la brten spe rong dgon pa'i rten mchod dag bka' rnying bshad sgrub gling gi khongs su bzhugs na rjes su khrims sngo ga 'gal rkyen 'phrad srid pas de bas dgon pa'i phyi phro la du bzhugs na legs zhes bka' snyadab bzange phebs byung /226

byes 'byor sgo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/phyi lo 1981 phyi zla 2 tshes 15 nyin rten gtso rin po che snang skyid dgon pa nas gdan zhus kyis mchod rten nye 'khris bka' rnying bshad sgrub gling darkyon pa'i khang chung zhig tu mdzad sgo gzab rgyas dang bcas spo rong dgon pa'i grwa chos grags lags su rtsis 'bul zhus/ de nyin gyi mdzad sgor dad dam lhad med ma gros lhan gyis grub pa'i rtags rten bzang por/ dbo na gnyer ngag dbang can sa gnas su yod mus spo rong pa'i khar rjes su khum bu nas gnas ྅ sa spyi khyab dngos grub dang kong po bu tshe dbang / rgya gar nas khang dkar don grub tshe ring dang rgan chen pad rgyal/ de bzhin bod nas lo mang btson 'jug rjes glod grol byung ba'i khang dkar gnyer pa dbang phyug dang spe rong phan phyi bu ngag dbang rgya mtsho/ sud si nas spo gro nga sras mo pad+ma bde chen dang rnam rgyal lha la rma// kha ṇa ḍa nas spo rong phan phyi 'chi med sgrol ma/ rgya gar nas lha rong phan phyi rje drung dang zla ba dar rgyas/ rgan chen pa blo bzang chos 'phel so/gas bod mi/ gnas 'kho da rgyal khab lnga tsam nas spo rong pa phon che zhig ma rgyab dus ra lhan 'dzoms byung ba sogs rtags rten bzang pos mdzad sgo legs grub kyis bo dong si r+ṇa chen gyi gdan sa mdzub mo 'dzugs yul yod pa zhig slar gso zhus/ de rjes bod nas dbu ma lug dga' dang g.yag pa rdo rje nas nan bskul zhus pa ltar ya/nga le shod du rdza sprul rin po che'i grwa khongs yod mus spo rong pa a khu 'jam dbyangs bcas rang dbo na du zhugs/ de bzhin rgya gar ḍi ḍūn dmag khongs nas spo rong dgon pa'i grwa kre nub blo bzang dgongs khrol yong ba'i snyan zhu phul/22—7

'grog sde chen4rispo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /10 rten gtso rin po che spo rong bkra shis rdo rje'i nang du gdan zhus kyis dpal mo chos sdings 'dus sde slar gso thub pa'i sku+or/phyi lo 1983 lor che ring dam chos nas mgron 'bod kyis dkon gnyer ngag dbang sud sir gnyen 'phrad la bskyod zhor sud 'khod spo rong pa yongs 'dzoms sar 'bod bskul zhus pa ltar/ de nas bzung sud si spo rong pa khyim tshang re nas lo rer mchod dod zhal 'debs sud sgor lnga bcu re dang / rten gtso rin sngo che o rgyan sprul sku rin po che'i dgon pa nas gdan zhus kyis sger khang zhig tu rang dbo na slar gso'i ched 'o/ lnga'i khang gla khas len bcas dodan chen ba3/bas/de rjes phyi 'o/ 1985 'o/ra stod pa'i skyid sdug nas gnas chen rdo rje gdan du 7bo nga sa chen lnga ra brtan bzhugs gzab rgyas shig 'degs 'bul zhus pa'i skal bzang gi dus chen la ro/da gzhis byes gnyis dang 'dzam gling yul gru gang sa nas bod rigs spun zla mang khrod zhal 'acadams skabs ma mjal rgyun ring song ba'i spo rong khul gyi mi sna'ang sgyu na che 'phrad de/ phan tshun lhod zhib lab gleng byung 'bras sud sir gnas 'khod spo rong pa rnams nas rten gasgu rin po che dang dge 'dun pa kha shas bzhugs yul gyi khang gla de snga nas zhal bzhes mo da pa'i khar ma sgrig rten 'brel gyis bod nas dbu mdzad lug dga' slar phra sa /zu la du phebs pa dbo na pa'i sgrigs kho ngas su zhugs pa dang / rgya gar nas de snga dgon pa'i grwa rgan chen 'jigs med bstan 'dzin nang mi bal yul du gnas spos byung 228

byes 'byor sgo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/ba bcas kyi skabs shig la spo gro nga pa ser skya 'o/na che mnyam 'jo mas kyis bo sa mol byung don/ nam zhig bod mi rnams rang yul du phyir 'o/ga byed rgyu'i dus ba /nga zhig shar tshe rten gtso rin wa gzhis su gdan zhu byed rgyu spo phro nga pa'i las 'gan du gyur pas/ der brten rten gatho rin sngo che da mur gzhan dbang du min ri ra spo rong pa rang nas rang thag chodad pa'i zhabs zhu byed rgyu'i dus la babs 'dug ces gros mthun byung ba ltar slar dkon gnyer ngag dbang dang spyi khyab dngos grub gnyis tse/ rgyan sprul sku rin po che'i mdun du bcar nas skabs dus kyi gnas stangs dang 'phral phugs kyi dmigs yul rnams gsal bshad bcas dgos don zhus 'bras tse/ rgyan sprul ྅kyi rin ngo che nas dgyes snang chen sngo sa jikhyed tsho'i rten gce nged kyi dgon pa'i nang bzhugs ring nga tsho la'ang bya ba lam 'gro chen phra byung / bka' drin chen dze yin/ da tshod khyed rang tsho'i dbo na pa slar gso/ thub kyi sku1da na nga la dga' ba skye nyi zhe sa zhal bzhes thob pa ltar/mthar mchod rten rin po che'i nye 'dabs su spo rong pa bkra shis rdo rje'i khang rma 'i bar thog khe gtsang la stong min khang gla zla rer bal lha ra 1100 re byas te/ phyi lo 1985 zla ba 9 tshes 5 gza' skar dge ba'i nyin spo ro/nga se ra skya yongs nas mdzad sgo gzab rgyas dang bcas rten gtso rin po che bka' rnying bshad sgrub gling dgon pa nas spo rong bkra shis rdo rje'i bar thog tu gdan 'dren zhus/229

'brog sde chen pri+o spo rong rgi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /11 bal yul du bo dong paṇa chen gyi gdan sa dpal mo chos sdings gsar bzhengs/bar skabs shig nas bal yul du rum gdan phyir tshong gi tshong las 'phel rlabs che bas de snga nas spo phro nga pa khyim tshang phon che rum bzo byed mus khar rgya gar sdu/gas nas gcig la gcig brgyud kyis spo rong pa gang 'tshams bal yul du gnas spos dang / sud sis gtsos yul gyu gang sa nas spo rong pa phon che bal yul gnas mjal la yong mgo tshugs pa sogs rgyun ring yul gru gang sar gram pa'i ngo shes rnams ma shi tshe ring gis phan tshun zhal mjal thub pa'i dga' snang dang / de bzhin spo rong pa lha sde mi sde dang yul mi nang khul gyi dad dam la lhad kyi dri mas ma gos par blo dkar dam gtsang gis skyid gtam sdug gtam bshad res bcas mi yul du dus rabs gsar pa zhig shar ba'i gnas stangs der tshang ma'i re 'dod la/ da tshod rten gtso rin po che dang dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa rnams 'di mur khang gla'i nang bzhugs pa las spo rong pa nang khul nas zhal 'debs dang ma rtsa thabs shes kyis rang dgon zhig gsar rgyag byed rgyu dang ma dngul phran bu yod pa'i khar spo rong pa khang dkar khyim tshang / spo rong kong rngu+o khyim tshang / rgan chen khyim tshang / daskadan gnyer ngag dbang / grwa chos grags/spyi khyab dngos grub sogs nas skyed med ma dngul snga g.yar byung ba ltar ma thar phyi lo 1989 lor bal yul mchod rten rin po che'i nye 'dabs/ tin cu li/ zhes pa'i gnas sa zhig tu spo rong pa spo nga po bu snga na grub lags nas dmigs

byes 'byor sgo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/bsal nang bshug gis sa cha mo pa ṇi gcig la bal sgor nyis 'bum sprad de dang thog phyi lo 1989 'o/ra thodag tshad gnyis kyi dbo na pa nyam chung zhig bzhengs/ de ‘ nas rim pas sngo ga tshad brtsegs te mthar phyi lo 1990 lor lha khang dang grwa shag sdudags lnga ga tshad gsum gyi dbo na pa nyam chung zhig bzhengs/ skabs de'i dgon pa gsar bzhengs kyi ar las la spe rong kong po bu tshe dbang dang rgan chen pad rgyal gnyis nas dmigs bsal thugs khur bzhes/dgon pa gsar rgyag grub rjes grwa rgyun gsar bcug dang bslab pa slob gnyer gyi lam nas cesas rgyun mi nyams gong 'phel yong rgyur rang khongs mi mang nas slob thon shes sku na can gyi dge 'dun pa gang na su bzhugs 'tshol zhib byed dgos zhes bsam 'char byung ba ltar dz+nya sa bod khyim stsodab dge rgan pad+ma rdo rje lags su yig ngag gnyis thog nas 'brel ba zhus kyang yun ring lan gsal ma thob/ dgon pa gsar bzhengs rjes kho nga rang bal yul du khyug tsam phebs bstun gsungs don/ khong rang las brel che dbang khom gyi med lugs dang khong dang khyad med yin zhes rgya gar snyir slob grwar dge rgan gnang mus spo mo nga kre nub pa tshe ring rdo rje lags su mngags/ tshe ring rdo rje lags kyang lam seng khom min zhes lo ngo gnyis lhag tsam 'gor rjes mthar phyi 'o/ 1995 lor dgon pa/'i 'gan 'dzin du phebs/ bhir slob grwar zhabs gla ji thob dang de'i khar bod khyim slo ba khongs su spun mched bu mo gnyis kyi slob yon rogs ram dgos pa'i cha rkyen yang ngo sa len zhus te bu mo gnyis kyi slob yon skor tshe ring dam 231

'brog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /chos lags nas sbyin bdag thabs 'asnu la gnang rgyu bcas re zhig gi ring bo dong paṇa chen gyi gdan sa mdzub mo 'dzugs yul yod tsam zhig slar gso zhus/12 spo rong chos cho gas zhes snga mo'i spo gro nga spyi cho gas la gzhir bzhag gis spo rong skyi da sdug tshugs pa/de rjes bal yul du gnas 'khod lpo rong pa rnams lhan 'dzoms kyis/ spo rong chodas dza gas zhes sgrigs tshugs stabs bde zhig btsugs pas/ de'ang de snga phra da du spo rong tsho brgyad dang spyi khyab ces mi mang nas thad 'dems bgyis pa'i dmangs gathorware lam lugs shig yod par gzhi bzhag nas skabs babs bal yul rgyal sa'i ljongs su gnas 'khod spo rong pa dud grangs 90 tsam yod pa rnams tshang 'aspradams kyis spyi khyab rgyun las bzhi dang / de 'og lo ngo gsum rer las rgyun 'pho len 'gro ba'i gtong sgo'i gnyer pa khag bzhi la gnyer pa rer las byed mi grangs brgyad re yod pa'i sgrigs gzhi zhig gsar gtod kyis ((dre rong chos dzadags nyi zhes pa'i mthun tshogs nyam dzadring zhig btsugs pa'i dmigs yul gce bo ni pha mes kyi rjes shul lha sde mi sde'i dad dam gyi 'brel ba nyams pa slar gasku dang ma nyams gong 'a phel yong slad sngo dong paṇa chen gyi gdan sa spo rong pad+ma chos sdings sam ((dpal mo chos sdings gi kyang brjod/ byes su gsar bzhengs kyis thodad nas gdan zhu thub pa'i rten gatho rin po ches dbus lha sku rten gsung rtsa che rnams bdag bzung don gnyer dang / sngar srol dus 232

byes 'byor skyo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/mchod 〈snags slar gaskurware mtshon mace)da sku/na zhabs zhu dang grwa rgyun slar gso zhu rgyu/de bzhin spo gro nga pa nang khul gcig phan gnyis rogs dang gzhis lus dgon pa dang 'khos zhan yul mi rnams la gang lha gas phan rogs zhu rgyu bcas so//bka' drin zla med tshe ring dam chos lags kyi dgongs gzhi ltar phyi lo 1991 lor khong rang gi ngo shes sud si mi ser ka rin (55 57nga ba227227)dang / bal 'khod spo rong dbo na pa gnyis mthun sbrel gyis dang thog bal 'kho da bod phrug nyam thag rnams la snyadab sku na dang rgas gce nga rnams la 'chod ༷gen gyi rogs skyor byed rgyu'i las gzhi/ (1/ne'u thabastu'i 1/756/bas ba'i/) zhes pa nyam chung zhig mgo 'dzugs bgyis pa de rim pas bod kyi gtam dper ja 'dur spag la bsgyur zer ba ltar/ da bar du slob phrug grangs 400 brgal bar/ rnyedab phrug rer lo re'i slob yon bal sgor 26000 dang / rgas gcong grangs 50 brgal bar 'o/ rer 'dza snon bal sgor 20000 skor zhabs zhu dang /rogs med mabo na med dza drag gi gnas stangs la dza drag rogs skyodar zhes mang nyung la ma ltos par gnad smin mthun rkyen sgrub pa sdu/gas gzhan phan gyi zhabs zhu zhu mus ni dga' ba bskyed sems 'kho la ba'i rang bzhin dang / yang nyi hong du gnas 'kho da khang dkar tshul khrims skal bzang lags nas thabs shes kyis/sku zhabs a ra yi zhes pa zhig gis kyang spo rong dgon pa'i grwa gsar slob sku/na ched phyi 'o/ 1996 tsam nas 2005 'o/ra kho nga rang dbo ngas pa ma snga gas bar nang pa'i chos cho gas shig gi ming thog lo ltar a sgor bdun brgya lhag tsam 233

'brog sde chen po so rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /gnang rkyang gi bka' drin che ba byung ba red/ de bzhin phyi 'e 2004 nas bzung sud si grogs po/ la'u ra dang / ad ri ya no/ gnyis nas bal yul du gong zhus ltar slob phrug grangs 60 dang rgas gcong 10 lha ra la slob sku na gong gsal ltar dang / khong gnyis bod la yul skor spro 'cham gnang bar yang yang bskyod skabs spo rong khul gyi 'brog sde'i gnas stangs khyod bo gzigs pa dang 'di nas kyang 'asngo/da bskul nan zhus la brten el wo gan (2/50/075)zhes pa'i 1rigs cho gas btsugs nas spo mo nga dgon pa dang zung sbrel gyis gzhis su'ang spyod tshal 'debs las dang bu bcadal khang gsar rgyag so gas lha sa bral gnad smin gyi rogs ram mang wa gnang mus red/ de bzhin rgyal gzhas kyi lo rgyus nang zhus zin pa ltar g.yag pa sna rje bza' tshang gnyis kyi dmigs bsal thugs khur 'og bod kyi rig gzhung spyi dang sgos su spo rong pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gna' phrarware gzhas chen rgyal gzhas dngos su 'khrab lha na gyis ma nyams rgyun 'dzin thub pa ma zad 'di nas mched de deng sang a ri dang / kha ṇa ḍa sogs su'ang spe rong rgyal gzhas 'khrab ston zhu mus red/13 skabs de'i sngo rong chodas tshogs gyi rgyun las dang dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa zhal grangs bcas gsham gsal/1 grwa cesas grags/2 ga kre nub pa rlo bzang /234

byes 'byor sgo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/3 gyu 'jam dbyangs/4 dkon gnyer ngag dbang /spyi byab rgyun las bzhi/1 bang dkar don grub tshe ring /2 spyi khyab bu dngos grub/na kong po bu tshe dbang /4 phan phyi zla ba dar rgyas/rtsis pa snga rjes gnyis kyi ming /1 rtsis pa chags pa'i 'jigs med bstan 'dzin/ 2 bkra shis tshe ring /gnyer las khag bzhi nas/ gnyer pa las thog dang warware ming tho (snga rjes rim byung )1 nam 'brog blo bzang tshe ring / 2 rab brtan/ 3 ngag dbang dge legs/ 4 gces bkra shis/ 5 tshe ring chos 'phel/ ca nam 'brog tshe dbang / 7 rnam rgyal tshe ring / 8 khang dkar tshe ring stobs rgyal/9 'alnga khel byams pa/ 10 blo bzang skal bzang / 11 byams pa/ 12nam 'brog tshe ring rdo rje/ 13 tshe ring phun tshogs/ 14 lnga pa sangs/gnyer pa las sgyu ga gnyis pa (snga rjes rim byung )1 spo rong kong wa bu dodan grug 2 sgo drug 'chi med g.yung drung / 3྅ rong tsā ri rta mgrin/ 4 bkra shis don grub/ 5 tse/ rgyan/ 6 bkra 235

'brog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /shis tshe ring / 7 karma zla ba/ 8 nam 'asnga ga sna rje/ 9 nam 'brog rdo rje/gnyer pa las lnga ga gsum pa/ (snga rjes rim byung)1 khang dkar bsam grub/ da rgan chen tshe ring rdo rje/ zha rgan chen legs ldan/ 4 'jo khel bkra shis/ 5 sto ri thag gcod/ 6 cha ga sa pa 'jigs med bstan 'dzin (rtsis pa ) 7 'jo khel tshul khrims 8 khang dkar ngag dbang rdo rje/ 9 khang dkar bu dbang rgyal/ 10 mang rug tse/ rgyan/gnyer pa las thodag bzhi pa/ (snga rjes rim byung)1 rgan chen pad rgyal/ 2 khang dkar /rma dbang rgyal/ 3 mer 'brog bkra shis/ 4 sgra chen bu dgu dar/ 5 a ya blo bzang / ca dbang grags pad+ma/ 7 khang dkar bstan 'dzin 'phrin las/ 8 tshe ring lhan grub/ 9 'jigs med shes rab/ 10 dga' rab sna rje/14 'o/ 'kho ra gcig gi nang spo mo nga ser skya thun mo nga nas chos phyogs kyi las rim zhu bya/'o/ gsar mchodad mjal/ dpal mo chodas sdings dgon gyi srodal bzang ma nyams rgyun 'dzin ched the da zla bcu gnyis pa'i gnam gang nyin nas rten gtso 'jigs bral rin po che'i sku brnyan ka ṇi lta bu'i 'og khung yod pa'i khri steng glu mnga' gasdugel/ de nas myong gsar tshes gcig nyin snga sngo rang nas dge 'dun pa rnams 236

byes 'byor sgo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/'du khang du cho ga 'ur 'don dang sbrags mi mang 'byor rim rten gtso rin po che'i khri 'og nas zhabs dbang zhu ba dang lhan cig mjal kha grub kyin srung mdud dang tshe ril gnang ba red/ mchodad mjal grub rjes mi mang ji phebs dgon pa'i gro so phye mar nang phud galta ra dang bkra shis pa'i tshig gis phan tshun gus btud zhu ba red/ de nas dbo na pa'i cho mas chen du gral la 'kho da de gasnu la ja dang 'bras sil bteg pa bcas sngar sredal slar gso thub pa byung yod pa red/ dgongs rdzogs dus dran dang zogs 'bul/ bod zla 3 tshes 30 nyin/ lo ltar bod zla gsum pa'i gnam gang nyin 'jigs bral rin po che'i dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul dus chen 'khel bas de nyin dad ldan mi mang rnams dbo na par 'dzoms te mchodad 'bul dang ma ṇi grangs gsog so/gas la brtsodan/ de nyin gyi nyin gung gasdudal tshigs gnyer pa las thodag nas nar gajo nga dang skabs bstun mi mang la spyi wa na gsal bsgrags dang bsam tshul bsdu len sku gas kyang byed srol yod red/7rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che dag 'don/ lo ltar phyi zla bcu pa'i nang bar yul du hin dhū chodas lugs kyi dus chen/ dz+nya sen zhes pa dang / de rjesati har/ zhes pa gnyis kyi ring sems can che chung sna tshogs pa khri phrag mang po srog gcod kyis dmar mchodad 'bul ba'i dus chen ya nga can zhig yod pa dang stabs bstun sa rong dgon par rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che dag 'don zhu ba red/ 'di'i ched spo ro/nga pa rnams nas bka' 'gyur gyi thebs rtsa zhes 237

'grog sde chen po spo rong be+e byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /ma rtsa ched 'dzugs kyis/ phyi lo 1990 nas bzung da bar chad med das 'awa na zhus rkyang zhus pa ma zad 2006 nas bzung bstan 'gyur dang bo dong paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i lam rim sku/gas kyang zhal phye gnang 'go btsugs pa red/ 'di dag sku/ 'khor gcig gi nang gnyer pa las chodag gi las 'gan che shos red/ spyir stangs ko paṇa dgon par dge 'dun pa zhal grangs grwa btsun gnyis bsdoms drug brgya skor yod pa phyi'i zhabs rim la phebs srol med kyang / phyi lo 1991 nas bzung spo rong dgon pa'i bka' 'gyur dag 'don la ko pa ṇa dgon pa'i btsun ma rnams kyis res gza' spen pa dang stabs bstun phebs srol/ bzang po zhig gtod yod pa da lta'ang rgyun skyong gis btsun ma zhal grangs sum brgya skor dang spo rong dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa mnyam rub kyis bka' 'gyur rin po che cha tshang dag 'don dang / bstan 'gyur sogs zhal phye la bsdoms nyin zhag gnyis nang 'thus gtsang grub kyi yod red/nges med mdzad sbed/ 1989 lor 7gong sa mchog la no snel zhi bde'i gzengs rtags 'bul bzhes kyi gtam bzang thos ma thag gtam snyan dar phyar gyi rgyal gzhas 'khrab stodan/ dgon pa gsar bzhengs dbu 'byed mdzad sgo/ bo dong mchog sprul rin po che gser khrir mnga' gsol/ dpal sa skya bdag khri rin po che dang skyabs rje 'khrul zhig rin po che/ skyabs rje bco brgyad khri tshan rin snga che/ mkhan po a pad rin po che bcas rang dbo na du gdan zhu zhabs bcags kyis spo rong pas gtsos mi mang stong phrag la chos 'brel bka' drin 238

byes 'byor spo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/ rim par bskyangs pa bcas kyi mdzad lha gra sgrig dang / phebs bsu dang phebs skyel sogs la rang khongs rgyal gzhas dang skabs re bal yul lha mo tshogs pa ched rinabod bcas kyis mi yul yin rung ngo da kyi thun mo nga ma yin pa'i rig gzhung dang mnga' thang ma nyams rgyun skyodang byas khul bcas sdu/ /15 phyi lo 1991 lor byes 'byor spo rong pa'i dud grangs bkod pa gsham sasdo/05// bal yul khul gyi dud grangs/1 dpal mo chos sdings dgon par dge 'dun rgan gzhon bsdoms zhal grangs brgyad/ na dkon gnyer ngag dbang can gsum/ 3 khang dkar byang chub can drug 4 khang dkar bsam grub can drug 5 khang dkar /rma dbang rgyal can lnga/ 6 khang dkar ngag dbang rdo rje can bzhi/ 7 khang dkar skal bzang g.yu lags can drug na g.yag pa the rje can gsum/ 9 sto ri rta mgrin can bdun/10 tshul khrims sgrol dkar can lnga/ 11 spo rong kong po bu tshe dbang can drug 12 spo rong kong zur bu don grub can lnga/ 12 spyi khyab dngos grub can drug 14 rgyan chen pa pad rgyal can lnga/ 15 rgan chen pa 'jigs med bstan 'dzin can drug 16 khang gsar dpal ldan nam rgan chen a ce ngag dbang can lnga/ 17 sgo drug skal bzang phun tshogs can bzhi/ 18 dpal lags bya ma tshul khrims can bdun/ 19 chags pa 'jigs med bstan 'dzin can bzhi/239

'grog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /20 gces bkra shis ser ༷/nga pa ca na bzhi/ 21 phan phyi zla ba dar rgyas can bdun/ 22 ser lung bkra shis dbang mo can bzhi/ na ser 'asnga ga dga' rab dod rje can bzhi/ 24 ser 'brog 'jigs med chodas dar can lnga/ 25 ser 'aX ga pad+ma chodas 'dzin can drug 26 ser 'alnga ga phu na cho gas sgro la ma can drug27 yab chen tshe ring bzang wa la phug pa can brgyad/ 29 klu jo ga bkra shis can bzhi/ 30 klu thodag chodas sgro na pad rdo ra can lnga/ 3) kru lnga ga tshe ring bu 'khrid can gsum/ 32 kyu thog g.yu sgro na can gcig 33 kru thog kun bzang can gsum/ 34 ku thog thodan grub can gsum/ 35 bkra shis rdo rje 'asnga da rgu g.yang 'khyil can bdun/ 36 bkra shis rdo rje'i bu mo na bkra'i bdag mo can gnyis/37 dbyangs 'dzoms sam a wa pad+ma rnam rgyal can lnga/ 38 dbyangs can sba ju ka ji can bzhi/ 39 blo bzang dzadas 'phel can bzhi/ 40 bkra shis dodanagrub can gsum/ 41 pad+ma dang rgan rig 'dzin can lnga/ 42 sding dpon pabakra shis can lnga/ 43 spo rong tsā ri thag gcod can bzhi/ 44 spo rong tsāri blo bzang can gsum/ 45 sto ri a zhang bamo da nams stobs rgyal khe hrang 46 a ce a sgrol can gsum/ 47 rab brtan can bzhi/ 48 ngag dbang dmachodas can gnyis/ 49 bkra shis tshe ring dam chodas can brgyad/ 50 tshe ringachodas 'phel dam chodas can bzhi/ 51 rnam rgyal dam chodas can gsum/ 523sgro lam dbyangs skyid ye shes can lnga/ 53 'chi med g.yu sgron 'phrin las dpala'agyor can lnga/ 54 mna' ma phur bu can bcu gnyis/ 55 ngag dbang dge240

'brog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long / drung gcig rkyang / 91 na khra dbang phyug 'phrin las can bzhi/ 92 ngag dbang blo ldan can gsum/ 93 bsod nams stobs rgyal gcig rkyang / 94 mna' phur rnam rgyal can bzhi/ 95 mna' phur pad+ma rdo rje can lnga/kha sud sir gnas 'khod spo rong pa'i dud grangs/1 spo rong sku bag kun bzang byams pa / 2 spo rong sras mo pad+ma bde chen khyim tshang / 3 tshe ring dam chos khyim tshang / 4 mkhar 'or rnam grol khyim tshang / 5 dam chos tse/ rgyan khyim tshang / ca dam chos zla ba khyim tshang / 7 dam chos pa sangs khyim tshang / 8 dam chos pad+ma bstan 'dzin khyim ca5nga / rdzo dam chos nyi ma sgrol ma khyim chang / 10 dam chos bu thub bstan/ 11 dam chos bu pa sangs/ 12 dam chos bu mo bsku da nams sgrol ma/ 13 sog phrug nyi ma khyim tshang / 14 sbra chen rnam rgyal/ 15 bkra shis tshe ring lug dpon pa/ 16 bkra shis lha mo lug dpon pa/ 1ma spen pa lha mo/ 18 pad+ma sgrol ma thub bkras/ 19 khril gsar pa sangs/ 20 ngag dbang chodas sgron/ 21 nam 'brog tshe ring stodabs ldan/ 22 nam 'brog rgya mtsho/ 23 nam 'grog tshe ring chos dar/ga phyi 'o/ 1991 'o/ra a ri dang 'ja' pan/ kha ṇa ḍa bcas su gnas 'khod h+pho rong pa'i dud grangs/ 1 rgan chen pa dbang phyug rdo rje khyim tshang / 2 rgan chen pa tshe ring chos 'byor khyim tshang / 3 bla ma khang gsar pad+ma dbyangs skyid khyim tshang / ༄ rgan chen 242

byes 'byor skyo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/pa bstan 'dzin khyim tshang / 5 chags pa bkra shis khyim tshang / 6 zhing dbo na tshe ring chos 'phel khyim tshang / 7 zhing dgon bsod nams chos 'phel khyim tshang / 8 zhing dgon rnam rgyal khyim tshang / 'di'i khar/ 1 'ja' pan du khang dkar tshul khrims skal bzang khyim tshang / 2 kha ṇa ṭar phan phyi bu mo 'chi med lha la ma sman stod khyim tshang bcas so//nga phyi lo 1991 lor rgya gar du gnas 'khod spe rong pa'i dud grangs/) sbel bo ba bde slar gzhis khongs the rong sras mo skal bzang bu 'khrid lags khyim tshang / 2 ko le ghal gzhis kho ngas spo 1ring sras mo bde chen mtsho rgyal lags/3 ) nub pad rdor/ 4 rkye nub lhag pa/ 5 skre nub dbyangs can/ 6 skre nub spen pa/ 7 dzaXl khrims/ da gnag pa'i dbyangs can/ 9 bkra shis rgya mtsho/10 zla ba'i dbyangs 'dzoms/ 11 pa sangs gi dbyangs 'dzoms/ 12 mchog skyid/ 13 rnal 'byor gyi rgyal mtshan/ 14 ngo yon rdo rje'i lha mo/ 15 ngo yon rdo rje'i skal bzang bstan 'dzin/ lhan dha ra gzhis khongs 16 bla brang slo bzang / 17 bla brang bcad lnga/ 21 bla brang sgrol ma/ bla brang bu 'khrid/ bla brang bsod nams rgya mtsho/ bla brang gling shar pa bskungad nams rgyal mtshan/ khyung lnga lha mo/ khyung lnga'i bu mo dbyangs skyid/ skyu tog gra chung / skyu tog jo rnam rgyal/ 'ango ra mo tshe ring rdo rje/ ngo mo na chodas sgron/ hun sur gzhis khongs thag chung dar rgyas/ thag chung nyi ma/ sdudag phrug lha mo/ nyi ma bkra shis/ mo/na n+dho gzhis khongs chos 'dzoms khyim tshang / lug pa'i g.yu sgron/ sku ga phrug 243

'brog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long //rma/ man par gzhis kho ngas sku ga phrug khyim tshang / bzhugs sgar dge bshes pad+ma rdo rje lags can/ kre nub g.yu sgron/ rdzi bsod dbyangs 'dzadams/ pon ṭa gzhis khongs bu chen pa sangs/ bu chen tshe ring sgrol ma/ gro nga gsar tshe ring chodas sgron/ sim lar slo bzang skal ldan/ sa skya gzhis khongs phur bu tshe ring / kun phan/ sdi lir ngag dbang chos sgron dang / skyid pa'i bu tshul khrims/ ka la maṇa spyodan du dbu ma'i rje drung / dbu ma'i dbyangs 'jo mas/ bla brang gling shar bu bkra shis phun chogs/ ma su ri dang ra ji pur khul du/ phur bu dgon gsar/ skal bzang sgrol dkar/ khyung lnga'i bu mo bde chen tshe ring bcas/16 bal yul du cad dong paṇa chen gyi gdan sa rten dang brten pa bcas pa slar gso'i skor/lo rgyus rgyas pa sa bcad gzhan nas gsal rtogs yong nges bzhin sud sir gnas pa'i spyod rong pa tshe ring dam chos la lo ngo bcu tsam ring rmi lam rtags pa ya mtshan can mang thod zhig rgyun chad med par byung pa rnams rgyun ring zhig snang med bzhag kyang mthar 'gan brjid ma bzod par/ spo rong ser skya mi 'thu sa bzhugs sgar du ched bcar gyis 7bo nga sa skyabs mabo na chen snga ra yig nga// gnyis thog nas snyan seng zhus 'bras 7gong sa mchodag nas phyi 'o/ 1996 zla 11 tshes 13 'kho da brtag pa bgyis 'bras bka' lan du ((pha spo mo nga ba zla 244

byes 'byor sgo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/ba dar rgyas dang / ma rdzong dga' skal bzang chos sgron gnyis kyi bu bsod nams don grub/ rang lo lngar nye ba de bo dong bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi yang phri da du ngos 'dzin bgyis na shin tu bzang /nyi zhes mo gas sprul sku rin po che ngo sa 'dzin gyi phyag rtags phebs pa ni dad ldan spo rong pa rnams la borjed thabs med pa'i gtam bzang zhig tu gyur/ de rjes phyi 'o/ 1997 zla 3 tshes 13nyin spo rong ser skya mi 'thus su kre nub grwa bstan 'dzin dang spyi khyab dngos grub/yab yum gnyis bcas bzhugs sgar du ched bcar gyis 7gong sa mchodag gi drung du sprul sku rin po che'i gtsug phud phul/ mtshan la bstan 'dzin mthu stobs 'jigs bral zhes ba4star/ de 'phral phyi 'osgo 1997 zla 4 tshes 10 nyin bal 'kho da dre rong pa ser skya dang yul gru gzhan gyi mi 'thus bcas nas bal yul du gtam snyan dar 'phyar gyi dga' ston dang 'brel yang srid rin po che bal yul spo rong dpal mo chos sdings dgon pa'i bla mar gser khri mnga' gsol zhus pa bcas kyi skal bzang gi dus der/ slar spo rong pa rnams lhan 'dzoms kyis gros mol byung ba'i 'byu don snying por/ da ko grwa pa gsar bcug gis dge 'dun pa'i zhal grangs spar rgyu/ dge bshes pad+ma rdo rje lags su dgon pa'i thugs 'gan bzhes rgyur 'brel ba mu 'thud zhu rgyu/ grwa btsun rnams slob grwar galta nga mtshams bzhag ste dbo na pa rang du 'dzin grwa tshugs thabs/ masnga ra na ngo dong paṇa chen gyis phyag btab pa'i dgon pa gcig kho na las med pa 'di'i rten dang brten pa bcas pa mi rabs 'di thodag nas slar gamo thub par bce na rgyu dang 245

'grog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long / dmigs yul 'di lta bu zhig sgrub thabs su ma lan ma 'gyod med pa'i 'bad 'bungs la brtson rgyu/ da yod dgon pa'i sa rgya chung khar thog tshad 'phar brtsegs bya yul med stabs dgon rgyab sa sbrel khyim mtshes kyi sa gzhongs stong pa spus nyo thub na grwa shag 'phar ma dang 'dzin khang gsar rgyag bya yul ldeng nges kyang /ma dngul phon che dgos thad tshe ring dam chos lags su sbyin bdag thabs 'tshol yong ba'i 'bod bskul zhu rgyu bcas kyi gros thag bcad/ tshe ring dam chos lags su 'brel ba zhus 'bras dgon pa rgya bskyed kyi 'gro gron khong rang gi ngo shes/ mar li se koran phelaḍa zhu bas sbyin bdag gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes thob pa'i gtam bzang 'byor/ de 'phral dgon rgyab sa sbrel sa cha de spus nyo byed rgyu'i 'brel ba baX sa pas rin tshad mo gas mi 'grig pa med kyang dgon pa'i gasku na ngos khyim mtshes kyi sa sne nar mo zhig 'dug pa de'ang mnyam nyo ma byas na sa cha'i bzo lta mi legs pa'i rkye na 'phrad/ 'on te sa sbrel khyim mtshes gnyis phran bu slo khams mi mthun pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis red ces dgon pa'i ngos nas lo ngo gnyis ring 'grig thabs re bsgugs byas kyang ya med lta bur lus te 'u thug bzos/gang 'tshams rjes sbyin bdag gi ngos nas kyang sa cha nyo phyo gas skor 'dri rtsad phebs/ 'bo ra gzhi che bar ngo gnong zhing gnas tshul rgyu rkyen rnams sbyin bdag la chad lhag med par snyan seng zhus 'bras/ rkyen ngan grogs shar lta bus sbyin bdag bka' drin can nas dgongs tshul 'di 'dra zhig phebs/ lung pa gang sar dgon pa mang drags pas nged rang cadas nas dgon pa khag la rogs ram 246

byes 'byor spo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/sprad kyi med/ cadan kyang da lam tshe ring dam chos brgyud shes rtogs la/ 'e ngo drug brgya'i lo rgyus ldan zhing da lta rtsa brlag tu 'gror nyen pa'i bo dong chos brgyud slar gamo byed rgyur bslab pa rnyedab gnyer byed rgyu gal che yin 'dug pa ma zad khyed tshor ta la'i bla mas ngo sa 'dzin gnang ba'i sprul sku zhig kyang phebs yod red/ der brten dgon pa rgya bskyed kyi 'char gzhi 'di mur nar 'gyangs satong ba las/ khyed rang chorware ngos nas mos mthun yod na spo rong dgon pa gsar pa zhig bzheng rgyur nged kyi ngos nas rgyu sbyor gang thub zhu chog ces blo yul las 'das pa'i gtam bzang zhig 'byor/ de nas ༷ rong pa rnams nas lha blar brtags lung dang nang khul gros mol lhag ngo bgyis pa'i mdo don du/da yod dgon pa spus bsgyur gyis dgon tshab spus legs shig bzheng rgyu dang /ma dngul kha bsnon ji 'bab sbyin bdag che mo nas skyabs 'jug sku nga ba zhus par/tshe ring dam chodas lags dang sbyin bdag lhan gnyis nang mo la byung ba ltar zhal bzhes gtsang ma thob pa ma zad/ dbo na pa gsar bzheng byas pa'i tshe 'bo sku na la ma 'dzems par bal yul du cad dong paṇa chen gyi gdan sa ngoms su chog pa zhig bzhengs dasku sa zhes/ dathodan pa gsar pa'i bzo dbyibs ri mo mkhan sud si rang nas/ ki ri si ṭin/ in ḍar mu'i le (0smos/bya /thab /bskukhung khukhu'i/0)zhes pa thad ba'u sa gnang rgyu/ rgyun du ar las babo da gtong 'char gzhi ltar tshags tshud sku/nga thabs bal yul du ar las tshogs chung zhig ched 'dzugs dgos rgyu/ bkod gtong 'char gzhi ltar 'phyug med sku nga thabs sud si ri mo 247

'brog sde chen mi+o spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /mkhan dang bal yul ar las dbar myu ra 'phrin/ i mel/ brgyud 'dra par dang ri mo gtong res kyis phan tshun dogs 'dri byed res bcas kyi 'brel lam gzab wa dasgo sa rgyu bcas gnas lan 'byedar bas na/ 'asnga ga pa spo mo nga pa tsho skabs shig 'thoms su bcug /don du bod pa'i gtam dper/ spo rong pa'i 'char gzhi snyoms chung de ja 'dur spag la gyur pa lta bur chags/spo rong pa'i dgon pa snying pa de dgon pa'i ngo bo mtshon tsam las bzo dbyibs sku gas dgon pa mchosan pa'i rgyas sprodas med par bed spyod gar gtong chog pa zhig yod rung / dad ldan mi mang rang nyid nas zhal 'debs bsdu rub kyis bzhengs shing lo ngo bcu tsam ring bo dong pa'i rten gtso rin po che bzhugs yul gyi gnas shig la brten gang dran tsho nga sgyur byed rgyur blo pham sku nga gzhi'i gnas stangs der/ ma basprodas stabs sgrig lag bzos lta bur bal bod sa mtshams su gnas 'kho da chu dbar 'a1— phan gling dbothon pa dben gnas de nas bal yul rgyal sar gnas spo gnang 'char gyis sa dmigs 'chosal zhib gnang bzhin pa'i gnas tshul thos/ de 'dra'i stabs legs ni spo rong pa lha sde mi sde'i dad dam la lhad kyi dri mas ma gos pa'i rten 'brel yin zhes chu dbar ba dang 'brel gtugs zhus/྅ rong dang chu dbar gnyis gna' dus nas mdza' bshes dang phan tshun 'brel lam che ba'i dbo na gnas zhig la brten/ spo rong pa'i ngos nas rang dgon rnying pa de chu dbar bar thugs phan gasdudas na rin 'bab la mkhregs rtsodad mi byed par chu dbar ba'i thugs 'dod dang bstun phul bas chog ces nang gros byung ba ltar/248

byes 'byor sgo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/bal sgor sa ya phyed dang lnga la phul ba ma zad zhu 'bab kyang phyed ka lag thodag dang phyed ka 'o/ ngo gcig rjes skyed med gnang 'thus chodad gan bzhag/da ko spo gro nga dgon pa gsar bzhengs bya yul sa dmigs 'tsho la ba'i dus la babs pas/ ser skya tshang ma'i 'dod par gong tshad ji yin la ma lto sa par rang dgon gsar pa de'ang mchodad rten rin po che'i nye 'khris su dgos rgyu gal che yin pa'i bsam 'char gzhir bzhag /nyin cu li'i khul du sa dmigs bzhi tsam rtogs zhib bgyis mthar/ dbo na snying gi nye 'khris su/ bhū wal dhan ra/zhes par spo rangang pa khang dkar bsam grub lags kyi sa cha/ ro pa ṇi gnyis lhag tsam gyi rgya khyegen can de gong tshad phran bu che yang sa dmigs gzhan las chags rabs legs shing / lhag par du g.yas gasku na khyim mtshes phal che ba cadad rigs dang de'ang dbo na pa yin pa ma zad mdun du bal po'i sku drag cig gi mes po'i khang pa rgya che zhing dang rtsi shing me tog gis phyug pa'i ldum rwa zhig yodad pa de'ang sa dong paṇa chen la maṇ+ḍal phul ba lta bu'i mdzes rgyan du gyur pas/ sa cu nga ro pa ṇi gnyis lhag tsam la bal sgor sa ya phyed dang gsum la thag bcad de snyadas/bo dong paṇa chen gyi bstan pa cadad du nyams pa de bal yul du gasku bar bya'o snyam pa'i sems shugs drag sngo sa bskul ba ltar/ da lan gyi bo skabs 'dir dgon pa'i phyi nang gi bzo dbyibs dang ldebs ris sogs bo dong pa'i gdan sa mtshon thub pa'i rnam pa zhig bskrun rgyu dang / lha da kyi babo da pa kho nas bstan pa mi gso bas nang bcud kyi snying wa phun sum chodags pa dbo sa zhes gnad dze na 249

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /'di'i skor lo mang sngon nas sa rā mtshan nyid slob grwa'i dbu 'dzin spo rong pa pad+ma rdo rje lags su re bcol zhus kyang de mur lus par/ tshe ring dam chos rang nyid snyung gzhi tshabs chen mal lus yin rung phyi 'o/ 1999 zla 6 nang gus zla dar dang daspo na ngag gnyis la blo tshabs chen wa sa kha dpar thengs gnyis 'byor don/ 1999 phyi zla 7 nang pad+ma rdo rje lags sud sir phebs kyi sku da cing kho nga rang dang sbyin bdag mar li se bcas lhan 'dzoms skabs pad rdor lags su bal yul spo rong pa'i sa rtags 'khod pa'i re bskul shugs che zhig myur 'phrin theka si gtong dgos zhes mngags pa ltar cadag grangs bzhi 'a snga na tshan gsum du grangs pa'i gsham gsal gnas 'phrin btang /༄༅༅/ /mkhyen rlabs zla med pad+ma rdo rje lags kyi zhabs drung du/ stabs gsol/tshe ring dam chodas lags nas gsungs don sku nyid de ru phyi zla bdun pa'i tshes shar la phebs bsnyun 'di nas gnas bris 'di 'bul gyi sku da/ da lan lhan gnyis spyod mjal gyis rang re spo rong dgon pa'i ma 'ongs 'dzin skyong spel gsum skor bka' mol lhag sngo/ zhig gnang lha nga zhu/ rgyu mtshan gang lags zhu na/ de snga nas rags tsam zhus zin ltar/1) lo ngo brgya phrag mang po'i lo rgyus dang ldan pa'i rten gtso 'jigs bral nga 'dra ma dang gsung 'bum de nyid 'dus chen sogs kyis gcesas sku gsung thubs rten byin can 'di dag dgra bo'i lag cadag tu ma shor bar rang lag tu yod pa dang de la rgyab gnyer dad sbyin mi mang yod pa/ lhag par du don gyi bdag po 7gong 250

byes 'byor sgo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba sa yid bzhin nor bu mchog nas thugs snang dang dgyes mnyes gnang bzhin pa'i two dong phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis phyag btab pa'i dbo na pa gcig kho na las med ri redi dag ma nyams gong 'phel nyams pa slar gasdud byed dang mi byed/ yong dang mi yong zhes pa'i mi rabs kyi las 'gan su la 'khris pa red zer na chodas rgyun dad sbyin spyi dang lhag par spo rong pa shes ldan/ de'i nang nas kyang sdom ldan dge 'dun pa rnams la 'khris pa ni bcadad mi dgos pa zhig yin/2) da bar lha blas bka' drin nam spo rong pa spyi dang lhag par bal yul dang sud sir bzhugs pa rnams kyi rgyun bsrings 'bad brtson la brten nas/ dgon chung mdzub mo 'dzugs sa tsam dang grwa rgyun ma nyams tsam bskyangs grub yod/3) nye ba'i char nas tshe ring dam chos lags rang nyid lo mang ྅ na shi gson dbar nas 'das log lta bu ra gyur/ de bzhin lo ngo lnga ring la rtags rten ya mtshan can mang po byung ba rnams 7gong sa mchog la lhad med rang rjen snyan seng zhus 'bras bo dong chos rgyun 'dzin pa'i yang srid rin dze che gcig kyang phebs/de rjes gtso bo tshe ring dam chos lags nas thugs 'khur gasgu bzhes bka' drin las/ rang ngo sa nas/ 'bad med lhan gyis grub pa'i dad sbyin gzhan dang lhag par du nye ba'i char/ cha/ra li se koran phelaḍa nas dbon pa gsar bzhengs la a sgor drug khri gnang ba sogs yod dus/ da ko nga tsho skya bo dad ldan spo rong pa rnams nas de snga nas zhus zin ltar da dung 'bod bskul zer na'ang 'dra/ smon lam zer na'ang 'dra/ rang khongs dge 'dun pa shes ldan gang na su bzhugs 251

'brog sde chen po skyo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /nas thugs 'gan che bzhes kyis dasku na pa'i 'dzin skyodang spel gsum gyi las 'gan dge 'dun pa rnams nas bzhes dgos 'dug ces pa'i re 'dun 'di da lta'ang 'dod khengs legs grub ma byung zhing / slad nga tsho'i re bar sku zhabs pad+ma rdo rje lags de snga nas zhal bzhes dang de bzhin 7gong sa mchog nas bka' bzang phebs yod par 'gyur ba med pa'i thodag nas phebs thub na nga tsho'i re 'dun ma 'grub pa zhig sku nyid phebs nas sgrub sku nga bsam pa'i re ba byed bzhin sku da/ de bzhin nga tsho'i re bar yang srid rin po che sku na ma son bar du rang dgon gyi 'dzin skyodang mthud sbyor gnang mkhan zhig byung na de mtshams mdzad pa shin tu rgyas pa'i re ba yodad/ der brten lhan gnyis lhu+od mjal gyis mi mang gi re ba smin pa ci nas kyang zhu bcas/ bal yul spo rong pad+ma chos sdings ser skya mi mang nas/ phyi lo 1999 zla 6 tshes 30 bzang por phul/ spyi khyab dalnga sa grus tshe ring gi sa rtags/ zla ba dar rgyas kyi sa rtags/17 lnga mtshar ba'i gtam/(6)go nga zhus tshe ring dam chodas lags dang pad+ma rdo rje lags gnyis dbar thog ma'i 'brel ba byung 'phral zla lnga gcig gi rjes sbyin bdag /mar li se nas nged la zhal par 'khyodar ro/na/ tshe ring dam chodas kyi snyun gzhi tshabs cher gyur pas ga ri mgyogs thug 'phrad yong dbo sa gsung pa ltar/ phyi 'o/ 1999 zla 8 tshes 24 nyin nged rang sud sir 'byor/ tshe ring gi snyun gzhi snying shugs nyams 252

byes 'byor sgo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/ji/'i rgyu mtshan la brten sku gzugs la na zug gang yang med kyang zas kyi dang kha nyams pas khu bcud la brten nas 'asnu ba dang / chab bcin mi babs pa'i dngangs skab/ dang skabs re mgo yu 'khor ba bcas kyis mnar/ lan gcig tshe ring this/ khyad mtshar la/ de ring ngas malnga nga thub kyi mi 'dug /mi ngo shes kyi mi 'dug ces zhed snang gis cang mi smra bar mal chas nang lus/ ngag chung gis slar bod lugs 'byu chang rnying pa thur ma kha shas kha nang blugs pas de 'phral drag skyed kyis/ rig pa brtan po dang khong ra nga gi zhal 'don dang sgom bzlas sogs gang lcogs gnang thub/ de dus tshe ring gis nged kyi lag pa gnyis nas dam por 'jus te ngal gso rgyag shin 'di 'dra gsung / mi tshe 'di la lhan yab yum gnyis mjal ba shin tu dga' bo byung / de bzhin spo ngag dbang / bu dngos grub/ bu don grub/ bu tshe dbang sogs spo rong pa mang po zhig gi ming 'bod de/ tshang ma la thugs rje che zhu rogs zhes mngags/ snge na bu rang gis nga la gnang ba'i sgrol dkar gyi thang ka ya gir gzigs dang / thang ka 'di bod kyi thang snying zhig gi dpar la thang gsham gsar pa sgron pa zhig red 'dug ga /thang ka 'di'i g.yon ngos kyi rtse zur du gzigs dang / bla ma zhal ra can pa zhig 'dug ga/ khong rang bo dong pa'i bla ma/ byang pa rnam rgyal grags bzang zhu ba de red/nga'i rmi lam la'ang byang pa/ yar longs zhes pa de dang gcig pa red/ yab yum lhan gnyis dang ngos dbar de 'dra'i rten 'brel bzang po byung ba red ces dang / de nas ngag chung la skad 'bod kyis sgam chung zhig baspyodags bcug pa'i 253

'grog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /nang nas 'phreng ba byu di rnying pa zhig dang rus pa'i ḍa ma ru zhig /gzi mig ba'i pa zhig gi mthar byu ru gnyis yod pa'i mjing lung zhig bcas gus kyi lag tu sprad de/ 'di rin po che la phul rogs gnang / 'phreng ba 'di byang pa mi thos drug gi 'phreng ba yin/ 'di rtsad gcod byed mkhan mang po yod srid/ gsang rgya chen pos nyar ba las gang byung ma gnang rogs/ zhes dang / de nas khong rang la sud si grogs po bco lnga tsam gyis bsnyun gsol phul ba'i ming tho zhis nged la dpod bris btang ste dngul 'bor bsdoms bcug /khyon bsdoms sud sgor 2130 tham pa 'dug pa nas/ sud sgor chig stodang bod du zhabs dga' slob grwar zhal 'debs dang / de 'phros rin po che'i sku yon dang dgon pa'i thebs rtsar zhal 'debs dang / de min skud sgor 1300 tham pa nged la bskur nas/ bal yul du bal dngul la brjes te bdag nyar gnang rogs gnang rim pas mngags cha zhu rgyu mang lnga yod par snga 'don du yin par brjod/ de rjes slar nged kyi lag pa nas dam por 'jus te/ sprul sku rin po che la sku yon phul phyogs/ spo rong dgon pa gsar bzhengs skor sbyin bdag nas zhal bzhes cha tshang yod skor/ spo rong mi mang nas snga phyir re 'dun bton pa ltar kho nga rang ngos nas kyang pad+ma sna rje lags su mig chu btang nas 'ango da bskul zhus lha ra/ sbyin bdag mar li se mnyam mthun 'brel gzab po dang bal yul du rmo rang gi slob grwa gsar rgyag gi 'char gzhir sems khral byed kyi 'dug pas 'di'i skor khyed kyi ngos nas rogs skyodar byed dgos pa sku gas mang du mngags/ tshe 254

byes 'byor slo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/ring rang khyim du sku da stabs nged kyis sman khang la bsnyal na zhes bsam tshul bton pas sud si em rje dang bza' zla ngag chung gnyis gas brjod ro/na/ dngos snaX/la byas na khong rang shi ba dang khyad yod pa ma red/ khong rang gi snying gi nus shugs la bltas na lo mang sngon nas bo ngas dgos kyi yod red/ byas tsang sman bang du bsnyal nas 'thol pa gang yang byed ya yod ma red/ de las so so'i nang du khams la yod pa'i zas la spyad/ ma shi bar nang mi'i mnyam du nub rub sdod rgyu yod pa ma zad mtha' ma shi kha la khar spyodan lam tshig gsum dang mchodad me phul chog yod red ces brjod/ tshe ring gi bu gnyis dang bu mo sdod gnas khag khag yod kyang pha ma gnyis la brtse dung shin tu che bas khams la sku/da pa'i zas dang rngan pa khyer nas nang du cadang /tshes 29 res gza' nyi ma'i nyin rgyal sa ste ran nas sbyin bdag mar li se lanaḍa kharaṇa ru tshe ring thug 'phrad dang nged len pa gcig lcogs phebs/sbyin bdag nas bal yul du dwa phrug dang nyam thag gi ched slob grwa spus legs shig rgyag bzhin pa'i thad rtsa 'dzin yig cha 'jo ga stangs skor las ro/gas rdo rje rnam rgyal dang mnyam dasprodangs tshul phran bu mthun min thugs tshabs la brten/gnad don 'di'i lha ra ngos gnyis byeran du yig char nyams zhib dang gros 'dur gyis sgeran gyi nye 'khris su bal yul dang bod pa'i sgo ra myong can mkhas pa sku zhabs ṭo ṇi ha lhen mjal 'phrad kyis slob ston zhu 'char yang tshes 30nyin tshe ring gi snyun gzhi tshabs cher gyur nas 'phral du sku nga dathodas pa'i kha dpar 255

'grog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /'byor/ skabs der chos don drung zur sga rje khams sprul rin po che sud sir phebs pa dang stabs legs 'khel bas/ ngag chung gis de nyin rang rin po che la snyan seng lha na pas rin lnga ches bar snga lnga sa bo la gyi dpe cha zhig gra sgrig dgos gsungs/ thodas grol gar sprodab rdza sprul blo bzang lags su zhal par phul bas/ri kon dgon pa'i 'khris su ba ri dbang rgyal zhes pa'i grong par nged rang dang tshe ring gi ngo shes sud si btsun ma/ mo ni kha 'am/ a ne+e bstan 'dzin sgrol ma gnyis mo rang gi mo ṭa btang nas dpe cha len par bskyod/ ngo sa gnyis tshe ring sar 'byor skabs khong rang mal khri'i sgang skyil krung gi tshul du dran med lta bur bzhugs 'dug /mo ṇi kha ngos gnyis nas bo dong pa'i zhal 'don gang shes bton nas tshe ring gi tshe la bar chad mi sku(nga ba'i smon lam btab/ de nas khams sprul rin dze che phebs/ kho nga rang gnyis de sngon nas mdza' bshes red 'dug /rin po ches/ da bla ma tshe ring bzhugs kyi min gsung gi yod red ces tshe ring gi mal khri'i 'gram du rgyun ring sku rkyang bzhugs/ de dus tshe ring la dran pa slebs pa lta bus khong rang gi mgo bo rin po che'i bang khar sbyar nas bsdad/ rin po ches skabs re bka' mo la gnang ba dang skabs re smon lam 'don gyi yod pa lta bur rgyun ring bzhugs/ de nas rin po ches/ bla ma da lta bzhugs kyi red/ bar dod klog dgos mi 'dug khong rang lha ma bzlas gan/ri gi 'dug pas ma dmo gas ang zhes mngags te phebs sku1nga /de rjes drag skyed kyi lnga wa sa ngas mig gis masgyu nga thub kyi 'dug ces dga' 256

byes 'byor spo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/ snang dang bcas nged la sbyin bdag gi mnyam las mjug skyong bar rgyugs zhes mngags pa ltar tshes 31 nyin slar nged rang snyeran du bskyod de de nyin rang sbyin bdag ngos gnyis ṭo ṇi ha sten 'phrad par bskyod/phyi zla 9 tshes 1 nyin tshe ring thug 'phrad la tshur log /de nyin tshe ring gi nang du nged rang dang bu gzhon pa pa sangs yod/ dus rgyun tshe ring gsang spyod du ngag chung gis skyor nas bskyod dgos sogs nad g.yog sbyar ma sde da dgos kyang / de nyin gnas tshul ngo mtshar can zhig byung ba red/ mtshan smad ngag chung gi gnyid gseng la gsang spyod kyi sgo phye pa dang mi zhig yar 'gro mar 'gro byed pa'i snang ba 'char/ yar langs nas bltas dus/ tshe ring gcig por gsang spyod nas don de mchod khang du 'dzul ba mthong / ngag chung mo rang zhed snang gis bu pa sangs dang nged gnyis gnyid sad de yar slang / tshe ring gcig por mchod khang gi dkyil du gzugs sgreng zhing mig phyed btsum gyis 'don pa bton pa'am chos bshad byed pa lta bu'i tshul du bzhugs/ gang 'tshams rjes khong rang yar bzhengs nas/ mchod khang chung ngu de'i dkyil du gar 'cham lan gsum gyi g.yas skor brgyab/ de nas mchod khang nang gi mal khri stabs bde de'i sgang sgom bzlas kyi rnam par bzhugs/ nged rang ya mtshan gyis gang byed mi shes par bltas bsdad pas/ bu chung ba pa sangs 'u thug pa lta bus mi nad pa mal khri'i sgang ma nyal bar 'di 'dra bsdad na nad gzhi sdug tu 'boston/ zhes tshe ring mchodad khang nas mal khang bar 'khrid thabs bgyis sku/nga bas pa sangs 257
