'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /gcig pos glags ma 'khel/ de nas nged gnyis kyi nus shugs gcig tu bsgril te tshe ring mchodad khang nas mal khang du 'khyodal thabs bgyis pas/ ngo sa gnyis rub kyang sha med pags skam du gyur pa'i tshe ring bteg ma thub par ya mtshan byung / de 'tshams nas tshe ring gis/ de ring nga rang gcig por 'dir nyal bcug rogs/ khyed rang tsho la dka' ngal bzos sdudang / gzim la phebs/ gzim 'a/ phebs/ zhes nga tsho tshang ma so so'i mal khang du nyal bar bskyod/ skabs der nam smad chu cho da gnyis pa yas mas yin/ tshe ring gis mchod khang nang du gar 'cham/ brgyab pa'i rnam pa mthong ba dang nged rang ya mtshan zhing dad pa'i sems 'gul zhis thebs/ der brten nged rang gis bo dong pa'i zhal 'don gang shes bskyor nas tshe ring sku tshe brtan rogs zhes spyodan lam zhig brgyab pa yin/dus rgyun ngag chung dang phru gu tsho'i ngos nas tshe ring la brtse dung ha cang che yang bla mar bkur ba'i rnam 'gyur ches ma macadan/ ngag chung rang nyid kyi gshis ka dang phyi spyod rnam 'gyur ni mkhas snyan mi shes par kha ri kha thug dang snang ba skyid sngo zhig tu mngon/ de bzhin gzhan phan dang gtong phod tshe ring gis lab tshad la rgyab skyor byed pa las sun gtsor gyis spu+od log ston mkhan zhig tu ma mngon/ 'on te de nyin tshe ring gi nang mi'i skor nged rang gis nang tshags kyis 'dris par/ ngag chung gis/ tshe ring kho rang sems bzang po dang rig pa sno bo mi shes dgu she sa shes mkhan zhig yod red/ mi'i mnyam sngo/ mthun po dang grogs po mang po 'khor gyi red/ sngon ma tshung dus la dkrog dkrog de 'dra'ang

byes 'byor sgo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/byas yod red/ rjes su ga ler nyer lnga tshes bcu la tshogs 'bul sogs chos nyams len la do snang che ru phyin/ sngon ma bzo grwa'i sbyin bdag gis kho rang la rtsi mthong chen lnga byas pa de 'dra song tsang bzo grwa'i 'gram du lha khang zhig dbo sa zer nas lha khang chung chung zhig kyang sgyu ba pa red/ de bzhin spyi ba'i las ka la sems 'khur chen 1/ red/ grwa chas gyon pa'i zhal 'debs slong mkhan zhig thug na dga' snang gis rogs pa byed kyi red/ zhal 'debs dang sngo so sos phul/de nas rogs pa tsho la'ang skul 'ded byed mkhan de 'dra red/ spo rong dgon di 'i skor la bdag gis zhu mi dgos par mkhyen gsal red sogs bswā da/ tshe ring dang lo mang mdza' bshes spo rong dgon pa'i sbyin bdag mar li sis tshe ring skor 'di 'dra gsung ((tshe ring nged gnyis lo mang sngon nas ngo shes kyi grogs sngo yin/ nga la dka' ngal 'phrad na tshe ring la slob ston zhu gi sku da/ khong gis nga la sngagags pa mang rngo/ gnang snu/nga / kho rang mi nyam chung sems bzang po zhig red/ kho nga la 'awa da rngams rtsa ba nas sku da ma red/ mi gzhan zhig kho rang gi dngos po zhig la sems zug na de ma nyid du sbyin mkhan zhig yod red/ de 'dra song tsang ngas spo rong dgon pa la rogs pa byed kyi yodakyi gsungs/ de rjes tshe ring phran bu drag skyed lta bu'i gnas stangs la nged kyi sud si'i thong mchan wi sa rdzogs pas phyi lo 1999 zla 9 tshes 3 nyin bal ༷/la du phyir 'o/ga byas/ de nas nyin zhag nyi shu'irjes phyi lo 1999 zla 9 tshes 32nyin tshe ring 'das bo ngas su gyur pa'i gnas tshul mi snyan pa de thos/ skabs 259

'grog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /'dir smra bar 'dod pa ni/ sa skya legs bshad las/ des na las kyis mnar bas na/ /mkhas pa blun sngo re nang du 'khyams/ /rlung gis bdas pa'i ma li kadri zhim phyag bdar khrod na rdzi/12 phyi lo 2000 phyi zla 2 tshes 11 nyin dge bshes pad+ma the rje lags dang bal yul spo blo nga ser skya lhan 'dzoms kyis tshogs 'du rgyas pa zhig chodags pa'i cirgag tho bkod pa gsham gsal/cho gas bcar ba/1 rgan tshe ring rdo rje/ 2 a zhang 'jam dbyangs/ 3 dkon gnyer ngag dbang / 4 shang dkar bu don grub/ 5 yab chen zla ba dar rgyas/ 6 spyi khyab dngos grub/ 7 khang dkar bu bsam grub/ 8 nas lung slo bzang tshe ring /rdzo rgan chen tshe ring rdo rje/ 10 dge bshes pad+ma rdo rje/ codrog tho/1 bo dong mchog sprul rin po cher sku yon 'bul phyogs dang rdzong chos su phebs 'char gyi lha ra la 'brel yod nas gsal bshad byung don bzhin 'o/ gnyis tsam gyi ring khyodan du chod don byung ba bzhin rdzong chos su phebs rgyu dang de nas gzhung chen la che ba gnyer gnang rgyu shin tu gal cher song bzhugs sgar rigs lam slob gnyer khang du phebs te sku yon gsan bzhes gnang rgyu bcas la tshogs mi 55nga ma snangs mja/na byung / 260

byes 'byor sgo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/ bo dong mchog sprul rin po che rdzong chos su gdan 'dren zhu dgos pa'i dmigs yul dang rgyu mtshan de sngo na gros bsdur ji byung sogs yab chen lags dang khang dkar bu don grub lags rnam gnyis nas gsal bshad byung zhing / de yang rdzong chos mkhan rin po che'i lhan du yig cha bzhag yod pa dang / 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen por dgongs skor zhus bstun thag gcod byas pa'i skor gsal bshad gnang / 2 bo dong gi bstan pa 'di bzhin chos brgyud gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i nyag phra 'di lta bu chags rkyen gtso bo ni de snga bo dong gi chos rgyun 'dzin pa'i dgon khag dang grwa btsun bcas nas gzhung che mor chodab gnyer mthil phyin zhig ma byung ba'i rkyen gyis yin par song / bo dong gi bstan pa'i rtsa 'dzugs dgos pa lta bu chags stabs pad+ma chos sding gi grwa rgyun rnams nas bo dong paṇa chen gyi gsung spyi dang /bye brag gzhung chen bka' pod lnga la rigs lam gyi lha nas slob sbyong byed pa'i phyi nang gi mthun rkyen dus bstun bskrun thabs la 'bad dgos kyi skor la tshang mas mo sa mthun byung / der sman phra wa nga paṇa chen gyi gsung nas bsdus grwa/rlo rig /rtags ri ga /phar phyin/ dbu ma/ mdzod/ 'dul ba bcas kyi skor zur 'don dang 'brel ma 'ongs dgon pa'i slob tshan gyi 'char gzhi dang bstun te phyag dpe par skrun zhu rgyu dang / de'i las 'gan sa rā rigs slob kyi slob spyi pad+ma do rje lags nas 'khyer rgyu dang / de'i 'gro gron gyi rigs mar li se koran phelaḍa mchog nas zhal bzhes sngar yod thog slar yang nan zhu dang 'brel 261

'brog sde chen po sa rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /zhal bzhes gtsang ma byung bstun bosnang gsal las 'gul mgo 'dzugs bya rgyu'i thag gcod gtsang ma byung / gzhi rtsa'i 'di lta bu'i slob tshan dang de dang 'brel ba'i phyag deb zur 'don phyogs sgrig zhu 'char gyi skor 7gong sa mchog la snyan seng dang 'brel de don byung na ha cang gi yag po yong rgyu zhes bka' slob dgongs snga na gzhi rtsar bzhag pa zhig yin/zha rang re'i dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa tsho gnas skabs ring rigs lam dang 'brel ba'i gzhung chen gyi slob sbyong bya rgyu'i phyi nang gi mthun rkyen ma 'dzoms kyi bar du dge 'dun pa phran bu rig pa dang slob sbyong kun spyod bcas drag 'dems kyis rigs slob tu slob sbyong byed par gtong rgyu dang / de'i 'gro gron gyi rigs mar li se spo ran phelaḍa lags nas zhal bzhes byung don bzhin skyabs 'jus zhus te 'di 'o/ rigs slob tu 'dzin grwa gsar 'dzugs kyi skabs yong thabs pad+ma rdo rje lags nas bya rgyur tshang mas mos mthun byung / de bzhin stabs legs mthun rkyen 'dzoms tshe mthe rim slob gnyer khang gzhan la'ang gtong thabs kyi 'bad brtson gnang na dge mtshan sku/nga nges zhes bka' mo/la byung /4 ma 'ongs par cad ro/nga pad+ma chos sdings 'di bzhin dbo na pa tsam ma yin par bo dong paṇa chen gyi gsung la slob sbyong byed sa'i bshad grwa spus dag yong thabs su tshang mas thugs la bcang ste 'bad brtson zhu dgos pa gal cher nga tsho tshang mas mos mthun byung zhing / de bzhin ma 'ongs par grwa btsun tsam ma yin par khyim pa nang chos sogs la slob sbyong byed 'dun yod pa tshang mar go skabs sprod 262

byes 'byor sgo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/ rgyu'i thabs shes dang mthun rkyen bsgrub na/ zhes bka' sna/la gro ba tsam byung zhing 'di'i skor rjes su bka' mo la zhib phra gnang rgyu zhes pa las thag gcod gtan bkrel ma byung yang / de ltar byung na legs tshul gyi dgongs 'char 'don mkhan sang 'tshams byung / kha shas nas bshad grwa tsam ma yin par dad sbyin khag gi bsam ngo dang bstun te cho ga phyag len dang 'phrin bcol sogs kyi sde tshan 'di yang ha cang gi gal cher so/nga mu mthud zung 'brel du 'asprod thub pa zhig byung na legs tshul dbo ngas 'char blta na/ mtha' wa na dasprodan pa zhig yin pa'i cha nas nang chos kyi slob gnyer bya rgyu dang / dad sbyin khag gi bsam snga na bzhin zhabs brtan rim 'bo sogs gang sku nga la 'bad brtson gnang ba bzhin mu mthud bya gal la bsam tshul gnyis med zung 'brel du 'aX dbo sa kyi skor la mos mthun byung /5 spyi khyab bu dngos grub lags dang / spo bo ngag dbang lags so/gas nas pad+ma rdo rje lags spo rong dgon par bcar rgyu'i skor de snga khas len byas par/ slar yang 'gyur ba lta bus da cha yong thub kyi med pa'i bzo 'dra bo go yong gi 'dug pa 'di rtsa ba nas yag wa mi 'dug /'di'i skor gang 'dra yin gsal bshad dgongs tshul byung ba bzhin/ do bdag pad+ma rdo rje lags nas spo rong dgon par zhing 'dod med pa'i rnam pa rtsa ba nas med cing sngar gyi thag gcod gzhir bzung gis 'di lo phyi zla 8 pa'i nang bcar rgyu'i bsam blo dang / 'char gzhi ji ma ji bzhin/ 99 zla 10 tshes 28 nyin rigs sbedab 'gan 'dzin cho gas 'dur snyan seng zhus par/ rigs slob d+ku dbu 'dzin sogs nas rtsa ba'i phugs 263

'grog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /su spo rong dbo na par 'gro gtan de la 'gyur ba med kyang / gnas skabs lo gnyis tsam ring sa rā rigs dzā ba 'di bzhin slob gnyer khang gsar pa zhig yin pa dang / las 'char mang sngo zhig yar rgyas gtong rgyu mo gas gang cir med thabs med pa'i skor dang / tshab gzhan bskos su zin kyang las don spyi dang bye brag da lta 'bo bzhin pa'i las ga'i thog phyi rgyal la 'brel ba byed rgyu/ de bzhin 'dzin skyong dang snyadab 'khrid bcas gang cir mkho gnad shin tu chen ngo chags yod stabs ༷/ tshugs mthar skyel gyis lo shas sdod dgos pa byung zhing / de yang rgyu mtshan gang ci'i thog bsam blo btang tshe ma casas ma 'tshams pa zhig min pa lta bu'i bsam tshul dang / de bzhin rang dbo na gyi sbyin bdag (5'i(112350796/spu)sa rar phebs skabs kyang gzigs tshul de ga rang byung zhing / khong nas de la mos mthun gnang ba bcas la brten ring mthar lo gnyis las lhag pa sa rār sdod ma dgos par rang dbo na du bcar rgyu'i khas len dgos zhes mos mthun byung ba bzhin do bdag nas kyang khas len gtsang ma byas/6 gong du gros bsdur byung ba spyi dang lhag par phyag deb par skrun/ grwa rgyun gyi slob sbyong gi slob sku na/ ma so/ngas dgon pa'i 'char gzhi/ mchog sprul rin wa cher sku yon 'bul phyogs kyi 'char gzhi bcas cha tshang sbyin bdag che mor snyan seng gsal bshad dang 'brel/ de snga rogs ram ji gnang la thugs rje che dang de sngon bzhugs skar du phebs skabs zhal bzhes gnang ba bzhin bskyar nan zhu rgyu bcas mo sa mthun dang der sku zhabs tshe ring shod rje lags/ yab chen 264

byes 'byor sgo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/zla ba dar rgyas lags dang pad+ma rdo rje lags bcas ched bcar gyis zhu rgyu byas pa 6spun/7 dgon pa gsar bzhengs kyi skor la thag chodad pa zhe drag ma byung yang dgongs /char byung ba kha shas gsham gsal/ 1 dgon pa'i bkod pa rgyas spro khra khra zing zing med par dper na bzhugs sgar gtsug lag khang nang bzhin zhig la nang gi slob gnyer sprus dag yod pa zhig bzheng rgyu gal chen wa 'dug3 rogs ram gnang mkhan gyi dbo ngas par yang bal yul khul du dgon pa shin tu mang po sku da par snang yang / slob gnyer sku gas grwa btsun tsam ma yin par/mang tshogs la'ang shes sku/na sku gas kyi zhabs 'degs gang zhu'i skorngo bcas mthong tshul 'dra min dang bstun te slob gnyer byed rgyur mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa'ibakod pa yod pa zhig byung na zhes sogs kyi dgongs 'char byung /gong gsal tshogs 'du'i dgongs don phyi lo 2001 lor pad+ma rdo rje lags nas go sgrig gnang don ltar slar yang spo rong ser skya'i sku tshab tu rgan tshe ring rdo rje/ spyi khyab dngos grub/ sbyin bdag mar li se bcas bzhugs sgar dz+nya sar ched bcar gyis 7gong sa mchog zhal mjal bka' slob dgongs don/bo dong mchog sprul rin po che sa rā mtshan nyid slob khongs phebs rgyu dang / dge bshes pad+ma rdo rje lags gnas skabs ring rgya bal gnyis su gang chu gas gnang rgyu byas/ de rjes phyi lo 2004 zla 2 tshes 3 nyin bo dong mchog sprul 265

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /sa rā mtshan nyid slob khongs sa ba zhugs mdzad/ 'on kyang skabs der sprul sku na phra ba dang sa rār ser skya 'o/ mo mnyam bsres kyi kho ra yug sku gas kyi gnas bab la brten 'o/ de'i zla ba 12 tshes 18 nyin rdzong chodas su phyir phebs mdzad/ de rjes 7gong sa don gyi bdag po'i bka' bzhin phyi lo 2006 zla ba 10 tshes 25 gza' skar 'phrod sbyor dge ba'i nyin ser byes mnga' ris khang tshan du chos zhugs dang 'brel ser byes mkhan zur dge bshes byams pa theg mchodag yongs 'dzin bgres pa dang / dge bshes ngag dbang sangs rgyas yongs 'dzin gzhon par mnga' gamo la lnga ga da lta gus rtag brtson pas mdo rgyud gzhung lugs rgya mtshor dzā ba bzhin pa bcas mo /19 ngo mtshar ba'i gtam/(7)bal yul du spo zodang dbo na pa chags yul ni tin cu li zhes pa'i sa gnas/ mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi byang ngos nye 'khris skar ma bcu'i gom bgrod sar gnas sku da/ khul 'di bzhin nang pa'i dathodan pa dang rum gdan bzo grwa sku gas kyis khengs pa'i mi snu gas che ba'i sde zhig yin/ khul 'di'i nye 'khris gang sar shing nags sam ldum rwa sogs ri dag sa spre'u'i rigs chags yul gang yang med/phyi 'o/ 2003 'o/ra spo phro nga dbo na pa gsar bzhengs kyi las gzhi tshubartsa skabs tsam nas dgon pa'i 'khris su 'kho da pa'i nged kyi khang lnga ga tu gar 'gro cha med kyi spre'u re gnyis slebs 'go btsugs/ skabs re spre'u pho mo gnyis dang skabs 266

byes 'byor spo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/re spre rgan kher rkyang zhig sku/nga nas nged kyi khang 10ga nas spo rong dgon pa'i khyodags / spyod thabs bgyis pa thengs 'ga' byung / 'on kyang de dus nged tshor do snang sdu /da cing yul mi dang lhag par du 'di khul rum gdan bajo grwa'i 'thag mi 'o/na che zhi da pa chodas brnyad 'tshe dang sna bzhur byed pa/ khul 'dir khyi 'khyam mang po mchis ju 'i 'ab skad kyis spre'u lhod sde da mi bcug pa sogs la nga tsho'i ngos nas kyang dmi gas bsal do snang ma byung / de rjes lan grangs kha shas rjes rnam rtog lta bu'i tā nga ba zhig skyes te nged kyi khang lnga ga tu phebs skabs spos snes bsu ba dang shing shis phul bar dgyes bzhes mdzad pa ma zad lan cig nged tsho'i sprod khang du bshar badzul gyis lcog steng gi shing 'bras mchod pa'ang byung /spo rong dgon pa dbu 'byed kyi mdzad sgo dngos gzhi'i nyin gcig gong phyi lo na005 zla 1 tshes 13 nyin mdzad lharware bo sgrig snu gas chung gi las byed tshang ma snga dro tho rangs tsam nas brel 'tshub 'ar 'ur gyis las thodan la zhugs bzhin 'i 'i skabs slar nged kyi khang thog tu spre'u khe rkyang gzugs stodabs che la gzi nyams can zhig phebs pa nang mi gro sa mjal/ nged rang brel 'tshub ngang gzugs mthong dpa ra chas khyer te khang thog tu bskyod pas spre'u de nged kyi khang thog nas tshe ring sen gso khang gi khang thog brgyud spo rong dbo na pa'i yang rtser 'dzegs/ skabs dir snga dro'i tshu tshod bdun pa tsam yin/ spre rgan des dbo na pa'i rtse thog tu sa nga nyin gyi mdzad sgo'i 'ar 'ur brel zing la snang ba mi mdzad par dgon pa'i yang rtser spyod bzhugs kyis skabs re gser lta ga la bskor ba byed pa dang skabs re gdugs 267

'grog sde chen po smo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /dang thug la 'thams pa/ skabs re nyams bzang dod pos phyogs gang sar gzigs te bzhugs pa sku gas ya mtshan byung / de nas nged rang 'phral du dbo na par basbyo nga de sprul sku rin sngo che'i dbus dbo na pa'i dge 'dun pa rnams la snyan seng zhus sri sa gasku/la dpon bcas dge 'dun pa khag cig gis spos dang shing do/ga khyer te dbon pa'i rtse thog tu bcar/ spre'u des shing tog phul ba rnams dgyes bzhes mdzad/ mi tshogs dang 'ar 'ur la zhed snang mi mdzad par lhod bder bzhugs/ skabs nger su'i shen nas ched bcar gzugs mthong dpar pa/ ka ral/ zhes pa dang rosas pa bcas khong gnyis mal chas nas yar slangs te dgon pa'i rtse 10ga tu sngar rnge ri spre'u phebs pa'i skor bshad pas kho gnyis kyis kyang yun ring sku dpar sgron/ nge rjes spre'u de nyin rgyab chu tshod bzhi pa tsam bar dgon pa'i yang rtser bzhugs pa tshang mas ma3rin mthong thub pa byung / dad ldan pa snuras spre rgan 'di snu sa srung bkra zhis 'od 'bar sku drag po sprel gdong can gyi rnam sprul dngos su phebs par ngos 'dzin zhu gi sku da/20 bo dong paṇa chen gyi gdan sa spyod rong dpal mo chos sdings gsar bzheng sa legs grub kyi mdzad sgo gzab rgyas bskyangs pa/1 dgon pa'i ming / bo dong paṇa chen gyi gdan sa spo rong dpal mo/ chos sdings na dgon pa'i chos rgyun/ bo dong pa/3 da gon pa'i bla ma/ bo dong mchog sprul bstan 'dzin mthu stobs 'jigs bra' /268

byes 'byor skyo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/4 dge 'dun zhal grangs/ lda bcu/5 chags yul/ bal yul rgyal sa'i shar ngo sa mchod rten chen wa bya rung kha rmoḥgyi nye 'dabs tin cu li/snyo dgon dbyibs/ sud si khang dbyibs ri mo mkhan/ ki risi shiyan in sngar mul nas phyi lugs gzugs ris la spo gro nga ar las snu gas chung nas bod lugs dgon dbyibs brtsegs te snga mo'i cadad kyi nyams bzang dang deng gi mkhar bzo rig pa'i rig rtsal mnyam bsres kyis legs par bskrun pa'i grub 'bras shig7 dgon pa'i rgya khyodan/ sa cha mo pa ṇi gnyis lhag tsam steng dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga bcu skor la gnas mal cha tshang 'thus pa yod/ rjes su ro pa ṇi gcig lha ga tsam 'phar sgyu na bcas khyon ro pa ṇi gsum lhag yod/8 spo gro nga ar las gas chung / ar las do dam pa dbang grags pad+ma tshe ring / ar rdzas mkho sgrub dang dngul gnyer spyi khyab dngos grub dang khang dkar bu bsam grub/ rtsis zhib pa chags pa'i 'jigs med bstan 'dzin dang dbang grags bkra shis tshe ring / phyi 'brel dang gzugs bkodad dod dam pa phan phyi zla ba dar rgyas dang grwa tshe ring shod rje/ ar las dngo sa gzhi'i skabs khang dkar bu don grub tshe ring lags dam pa de nyid 'tsho bzhugs med kyang de sngon sa cha mkhro sgrub sdudags kyi las snga na la thugs 'khur che bzhes gnang bar rjes dran zhus/9 ar las 'alha ra ༷/na/ phyi lo 2003 phyi zla 4 nas phyi lo 2005 phyi zla 9 bar/ phyi 'o/ 2005 zla ba 10 tshes 14 gza' skar dge ba'i nyin 269

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /bal yul du bo dong paṇa chen gyi gdan sa dpal mo chos sdings rten dang brten pa bcas slar gso legs grub dbu 'byed mdzad sgo dang / rab gnas bcas skyabs rje zhwa de'u 'khrul zhig rin po che mdzadag nas zhal bzhes bka' drin bskyangs pa ltar/ rin po che mchog la phebs bsku'i bo sgrigs su nyin cu li'i sum mdo khar bkra shis rtags brgyad ri mo/sa brgyan zhing/ bcom ldan gang sna cadan pa legs/ /mo gas phebs bsu'i rgyal sgo dang gyang yig ras dar sogs/ kyis phebs lam khra tshom mer khengs shing / gtsang legs snyigs bral dkar thig gis dbye ba'i lam zur du mi mang nyis stong las brgal bas lag tu dar dkar thogs te phebs sgug zhus shing mthar snga dro chu tshod brgyad dang phyed ka 'i thog skyabs rje rin po che zhabs 'khor dang bcas pa phebs mdun/ spo rong rgyal gzhas snu gas pa nas bod gyi gna' ྅rware gzhas chen rgyal gzhas dang bal yul nywa mo/ tshogs pa nas bkra shis zhol pa 'khrab ༷ na gyis sngon bsku'i rjes/ gdam sa'i rgyal sgor bo dong mchog sprul rin po che dang / dge bshes pad+ma rdo rje lags kyis dbus spo rong ser skya'i mi 'thus nas rnga rol dang gdugs dar gyi 'phreng bas 'du khang che mo ra zhabs 'khod kyis gsham 'kho da mdzad rim bskyangs/de nyin gyi mdzad sgor sku mgron du/ rang gzhung sku tshab don gcod mchos dang sa gnas su bzhugs pa'i bod mi mang spyi 'thus/ sprul sku chos kyi nyi ma 13 po ches dbus bal yul dgon sde khag gi sku tshab dang rgya gar nas rdzong dkar chos sde'i mkhan sngo dang slo ba dasngo na/ sa gnas gros tshogs kyis dbus gzhung 'brel

byes 'byor spo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/las byed rnam pa dang slob grwa khag gi dbu 'dzin rnam pa/ sud si nas sbyin bdag che mo mar li se gtsos phyi rgyal mi sna grangs nyer lnga tsam dang / sud si (163 thabastu //75dzi/bsakhuba'i/) blosags 3ོ5ོgas kyi ngos nas ྅/ zhabs khong 87nga/'i 07thab855 dang ྅/ zhabs 21 3068bab235061bsku/bying sa ngabya sa 00/05077bab bcas dang / phyi rgyal yul gru gang sar khyab pa'i spo phragang mi mang gi sku tshab mdzad sgor ched phebs thub pa/ sud si nas tshe ring dam chodas 'das po'i sku zla ngag chung / a ri nas spo rong rgan chen a khu pad rgyal/ kha ṇa ḍa nas spo bloring phan phyi 'chi med sman stod/rgya gar nas spo rong pa tshul khrims/ bkra shis rgya masnum/ dbyangs 'alnga mas bal 'khrod bod mi'i tshogs skyid khag gi sku tshab/ spo rong pa ser skya mi mang dang de mi na 'brel yod mi sna phon che bcas bsdodams 'bor mi grangs 2000 lhag tsam phebs 'byor gyis dbu 'byed mdzad lho gra rgyas shig zhus pa gsham gsal mdzad rim nas mkhyen nges/ de lnga'i 'char gzhir 7skyabs rje 'khrul zhig rin po che mchog dgong dre'i mdzad rim bo la 'phral bzhugs gnas suspur phebs gnang rgyu yin yang / skabs mtshams mchog sprul rin sngo che mchog dang spo mo nga pa ser skya yongs nas ga11la ba btab pa bzhin/ de nyin dbo(na par bzhugs zhag mdzad pa ma zad gar 'cham dang / dgong dre'i rgyal gzhas gzigs 'bul sogs la bzhad 'dzum dang bcas gzim chung dpal 'dzoms kyi rab gsal mthodan po'i rgya nas dgyes gzigs mdzad/ sang nyin snga dro'i phebs skyel la'ang spe rong rgyal gzhas pas mdun bsus par 7skyabs rje mchog snum 'khor 'gul bzhin nas phyir phebs 2 da

'brog sde chen po skyo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /kyis der 'khod lha rong pa las byed pa rnams dang / rgyal gzhas pa rnams la thugs rje che zhes dgyes snang chen wa'i bka' slob dang lhag par du spo rong pa'i rgyal gzhas 'di bzhin thodad kyi rig gnas chung ba lnga'i nang tshan zlos gar gyi rig gnas mchen zhig yi na pas bdag cadad nge sa par du dgos zhes bka' slob zab mo phebs/༄༅༅/ /phyi lo 2005 zla 10 tshes 14 nyin dgon pa gsar bzhengs dbu 'byed mdzad sgo'i las rim/7skyabs rje 'khrul zhig rin wa che mchog dgon par zhabs sku ra 'kho da de 'du khang rab gnas dang / wa ro/nga mchog sprul rin po che mchodag da nga sbyin bdag mar li se gnyis nas sgrobyun me zhal kha phye rgyu/snga dro chu tshod/ 8 45 sku mgron tshang ma dgon pa'i 'du khang du gdan 'dren zhu rgyu/9 00 7skyabs rje 'khrul zhig rin po che mchog la maṇ+ḍal rten gsum 'degs 'bul zhu rgyu/9 20 sku mgron rnams dang chogags bcar sku ngas la gasku la ja dang 'bras sil 'degs 'bul zhu rgyu /9 50 dge bshes pad+ma rdo rje lags nas dga' bsku dang bo dong ngo sprod kyi gsung bshad mdor bsdus/10 10 zla ba dar rgyas lags nas dgon pa gsar bzhengs dang da gon pa'i skor gsung bshad mdor bsdus/

byes 'byor spo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/10 20 mchodag sprul rin wa che masnu ga nas sbyin bdag dang mo gas tshogs sogegs la phyag rtags gnang rgyu/10 na0 dgon pa'i sbyin bdag chen mo mar li se mchog nas gsung bshad gnang rgyu/00 45 dgon pa'i bzo dbyibs ri mo mkhan ki risi 〉yan nas gsung bshad gnang rgyu/ 10 50 7skyabs rje 'khrul zhig rin sngo che mchog nas bka' slob gsung bshad gnang rgyu/11 00 mchodag sprul rin po che mchodag nas thugs rje che zhu'i gsung bshad dbyin wa da shan sbyar gnang rgyu/11 35 snurags mang nas dboton pa gsar bzheng la rten 'brel mjal dar 'bul rgyu/12 nas 2 bar sku mabo na rnam pa dang mi mang yongs la nyin gung gsol tshigs 'degs rgyu /nyin rgyab chu tshod/3 spo rong dpal mo chodas sdings kyi dge 'dun pa rnams nas gar 'cham gzigs 'bul/3 30 ྅rto rong rgyal gzhas cho gas pa nas ྅ped kyi gzhas chen rgyal gzhas gzigs 'bul zhu rgyu/ 5 00 gso/la ja'i bar gseng rjes rgya che mi mang thams cad yul khyodags yul gzhas la ral rgyu/273

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /21 spo rong gi skor sge ra skul 'bri snyu ma khag cig1 nged kyi sngags nas nges par du bshad dbo sa pa'i gtam kha shas/ dkon gnyer ngag dbang nas ngag lnga ga bshad pa nag 'gros su phab/rtsom pa po'i mchan/ phyi lo 2008 lor dgung lo 82 phebs pa'i spo rong pa dkon gnyer ngag dbang gis ngag thog bshad pa'i gtam 'di chad lhag med par nag 'gros su bkod rgyur/ dkon gnyer ngag dbang dang tshe ring dam chos gnyis kyi skor lo rgyus rgyas pa sa bcad gzhan khag nas rtogs thub kyang 'dir ngo sprodad mtshon ched sbud tsam gleng na/ phyi lo 1959 lor bod du dus 'gyur gyi rang re phon che btsan byol du sku nga skabs rang don rgyab bskyur gyis lpo rong dpal mo chos sdings dgon pa'i lha sku rten gsung bal yul du gdan zhu dang de rjes zhabs zhu/ de nas rim pas bal yul du dgo na pa gsar bzhengs dang 7gong sa mchog nas sprul sku rin wa che ngo sa 'dzin gnang mchodan mo gas dus 'gyur rjes kyi spo rong dang 'brel ba'i snga phyi'i gnas tshul yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyab ljongs su dkon gnyer ngag dbang dang tshe ring dam chodas gnyis sngon las bzang po zhig gi nus pa med da rma snyam zhing / dkon ngag ni dpal mo chos sdings dgon pa'i grwa pa zhig rjes su skya rten gyi tshul can zhig dang tshe ring dam chos ni bod du na bkra bla ma rig 'dzin pad+ma tshe dbang rin ngo che'i drung nas gsung chos lan mang zhus pa las bshad grwa sogs 'grim cadang med pa 'i mi tshang nyam chung zhig gi bu zhig red/ kho nga gnyis bod rang nas chung 'dris che zhing skyab/ rje na bkra rin dze che'i sku mdun nas gsung snu sa mnyam zhu bgyis pa'i ser khyim chos grogs shig kyang red/ byes su tshe ring sud sir gnas 'khod dang dkon ngag bal yul du gnas 274

byes 'byor spo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/sna'od kyis khong gnyis rgyal khams kha bral du gyur kyang tshe ring gis dkon ngag la rang gi pha ltar bkur bas phan tshun gyi 'brel lam chu rgyun du gnas/ ma〈snar na/ ches nyam chung ni/ ri 'khos ka zhan pa'i 'brog 'thoms 'di gnyis kyi snying stabs la brten nas byes su 'dzam gling yul gru gang sa/ra kha 'thor du gyur pa'i spo rong pa nang khul 'brel lam bzo thub sri dang / lha sde mi sde'i dad dam la lhad kyi dri mas ma gos pa'i nyer len la brten nas so so'i pha mes kyi dad rgyun slar gso thub pa ma zad zhar du bal 'khod bod phrug nyam chung snye rdzob yon gyi mthun rkyen dang de bzhin gzhis lus spo rong pa rnams la'ang zhabs zhu mi dman tsam zhu thub pa'i spro ba spel thub pa bcas so//༄7/ /sprul sku rin po che'i yab bu zla ba dar rgyas nas spo rong dang / spo rong dgon pa'i skor lo rgyus yig cha bskrugs nas deb 'don gyi yin gsungs nas nga'i sar lan mang phebs te dri ba mang sngo btang ba ma zad nged rang gi ngos nas kyang bsam dzaXl 'ga' shas bshad dbotos pa'i ba3/la ma nan por gnang byung bar/ nged rang gi gang dran bu lags nas yig thodag tu phabs te rang ngos nas nges par du bshad dgos pa'i gtam kha shas yod pa rnams ro/na tshan gsum nang ( rgyur/ka do na tshan dang po/ tshe ring dam chos/ (/940 /999) tshe ring dam chodas la brten nas 'o rang tsho la sprul sku zhig phebs/ de'i mnyam du gtong phod che ba'i sbyin bdag rlabs chen de 'dra zhig kyang 'khyodar/ de la brten nas cod re'i dgon pa de'ang spus dag cig slar gasku thub pa mo gas dpe mi srid pa'i bya ba lam 'gro 275

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /chen po byung par brten/ tshe ring gi skor la ngas tshig gnyis zhu gi yin/tshe ring nged gnyis chung 'dris yin/ kho rang nga las lo nyi shu tsam gyi gzhon pa yin na'ang nged gnyis na bkra rin po che'i rtsa nas gsung snu sa mnyam du zhus pa'i dzadas grogs yin/ nged bzang tshang gnyis la phru gu med stabs nga'i bza' zla dpal skyid kyis kyang tshe ring la bu ltar brtse dung byed kyi red/ tshe ring gi pha ming rig 'dzin rdo rje dang ma ming tshe ring sgrol ma zer/ rig 'dzin rdo rje khong rang spo rong pa ma red/ khong rang bo dong gi nye 'dabs 'jad zer ba'i lung pa de nas spo rong du 'byor ba zhig red/ 'jad zer na/ de snga rgya gar ku lu khul du 'jad pa rin dze che zhes mtshan snyan che ba'i bla ma zhig byung ba red/khong tshe ring gi a khu'i gras shig red/ de min bod du 'ang 'jad pa khyung po sprul sku mo gas bla sprul ྅/ mched mang tsam sku da red/ khyung sngo sprul skus bkra shis lhan 11 nyams gasku/ sdudags la phyag las gnang rkyen bar skabs shig la sku ngal 'phrad skad/ skabs shig tshe ring dang 'brel gtugs sku/da pa ma zad phan tshun lag rtags bskur res kyang sku da red/ de nas 'brel gtugs byed ma mo nga zhes gnas tshul 'byor skad 'dug /tshe ring gi pha de rang bo dong pa'i chos pa shig red/ yi ge 'bri klo ga dang lhag par dpe cha klog 'awa na shin tu bzang bas na spo mo nga rje dngo na gyi chodas 'brel zhabs gras su nyar ba red/ khong tsho'i khang pa de'ang rje dawa na gyi 'o/ brang gi rgyal sgo lho dang sbrel nas yod red/ skabs shig spo phro nga gnas bcu lha khang gi dgo na gnyer yang byas pa red/ rig 'dzin rdo 276

byes 'byor skyo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/rjes chos mdo mang nyin kle ga rgyag gi red ces skad grags yod red/ spo mo nga sbra chen du slebs rjes spo mo nga gnyer pa dbang grags kyi gcung mo tshe ring sgrol smu dang 'phrad de tshe ring dam chodas skyes pa red/ tshe ring gi a ma'ang thog ma'i zhing khungs spyod rong mnga' zhabs zur mchod nas red/ phyis su sbra chen du gnas spos pa zhig red/ tshe ring khong rang sbra chen du skyes pa red/ tshe ring skyes d+ku 'i nyin de hre 1ring bdag mo sa nam mkha' la 'ja' gzigs nas yul mi gzhan smu khyed tshos do snang byung ngam zhes bka' 'dri gnang ba'i 'o/ rgyus sku da red/ kho gnyi/ sa la bu gcig las med stabs gces phrug ces ha cang gi brtse dung dang saces skyong byed kyi red/ tshe ring chung dus nas rnam rig bkra zhing chos phyogs la dkar snang chen po yod red/ 'dam bag gi lha sku dang gling bu bzo ba dang de bzhin slo ba mkhan med kyang lhe bris byed pa sogs rig pa swā bo sku da red/ chung dus su tshe ring gis/ nga rang sngo dodang pa yin zhes lab kyi yod par yul mi chodas tshe ring la brnyas gtser gyis/ a las/ khyed rang bo snga nga rgan chen gyi skye ba yin zer gyi sku da red pas/ zhes 'phya smod rgyag sred la sku da/ 'on kyang tshe ring gis gzhan gyi brnyas gtsor la snang ba mi btang bar nga rang sngo dong pa yin zhes mtha' skyel byed kyi red/ bo dong rgan chen zhes pa ni de snga spo rong du sprang 'khyams shig mo da pa de la zer/ tshe ring gi nang mi dpal 'byor zhan yang chos phyogs la dkar zhing lha rong rje dbon la thugs phan gasku/sa pa'i zhabs gras shig red/

'brog sde chen po spo rong sga byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /chung dus su tshe ring la tshang mas gces phrug yin zhes nang du nyar nas byams wa byed pa las slob grwar btang yod ma red/ 'on kyang rang khyim du pa phas 'bri klog dang zhal 'don tsag tsig bslabs yod red/ tshe ring gi pha nges nga la'ang yig ge bslabs myong sku da/ de snga spo rong du lo ltar bod zla bzhi pa'i nang dzad rong khul gyi mi tshang mang po na bkrar/ na bkra rin po che'i sku mdun nas gsung chos zhu bar 'gro sgra la sku da pa ltar de dus pha ma tshos tshe ring yang mnyam po 'khrid kyi red/ de rjes tshe ring khong rang na bkra ru gang 'tshams bsdad pa nas rnying lugs chos la sbyang pa byas yod red/1959 bod du dus 'gyur byung 'phral tshe ring gi nang mi phal che ba spo rong nas skyid grong phyogs su gnas yol nas khyug tsam bod sa rang du bsdad 'dusade rjes 1961 lor nga tsho 'jo la khel kem du mnyam 'dzoms byung ba red/de dus nga tso tshang ma skyabs bcol du 'byor ba 'dra 'dra yin rung tshe ring khong rang nga tsho las gtsang sbrangang dodwa la rnam rig kyang spung bas na/ rgya gram dmar 11re sbyin bdag gis sman khang du skad sgyur dang sman zhabs pa gcig lcogs lta bu'i las byed du bskos pa red/ de dus mi mang tshos tshe ring la sman khang thi tshe ring lags zer nas gus bkur dang dga' mos byas pa red/ skabs der nga snu sa lag 'dogs tshu tshod ces pa mthong smyu/nga tsam las nyo rgyu'i spobs pa me kyang tshe ring la sud si mem sa teb kyis gnang ba red ces lag par chu chod cig kyang 'dogs rgyu yod red/ tshe ring gis de snga nas bal skad phran bu thes 278

byes 'byor spo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/srid kyang dbyin skad shes khungs rtsa nas med pas/ khong rang rnam rig bkra ba'i dbang gis sman khang gi skad sgyur khungs 'khyol ba ma zad sud si sbyin bdag tsho'i pyi ni lam du rgyugs po sogs chung dus nas khong rang 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra zhig yod red/ de nas sman khab stod pa'i chibs dpon rgyal po'i bu mo ngag chung dang gnyen sgrigs kyis rten 'brel stabs bde zhig kyang byas pa red/phyi 'o/ 1962 'o/ra rgya gar ku lu lam bajo ra khyug tsam gnas spos kyis sud si gzhis khongs thon pa red/ sud si ru'ang kho rang gis gtsos khongs gtog sa sngo/da mi khyim tshang bcu grangs shig laṇaḍa kharaṇa/ zhes pa'i sa gnas su shog bu'i bzo grwa zhig gi nang las ka thob/ de rungang tshe ring la sbyin bdag this rtsi mthong che ba'i las mi zhig chags pa ma zad rim pas shog dngul bakhrod rgyu'i 'khrul chas gal che zhig gi thon skyed 'gan 'dzin du bskos/ zhar du nam bom bod spyi ba'i las don la'ang sems shug sa kyi las 'gan mang sngo 'khyer sku da re da/ khong gnyis la phru gu bu gnyis dang bu mo gcig skyes/ bu rgan pa thub bstan dang gachodan pa pa sangs/ bu mo bsod nams bcas kyang so sdurware pha mar brtse dung che zhing ༷/la mi mtho dman bar gsum mnyam 'chams mthun du gnas mkhan zhe cig mo da red/ skabs shig baX grwa'i sbyin bdag gis dgyes snang chen pos tshe ring la/ khyed tsho bod pa las mi tsho la bzo grwa'i ngos nas rngan pa zhig sprad 'dod 'dug pas/ rngan pa gang zhig sprad na legs khyed kyi slob ston gnang rogs gsungs par/ tshe ring gis/ rngan pa legs shos ni bzo grwa'i sa khungs 279

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /yas mas shig tu nga chodar mchodad pa'i gnas lha khang chung ngu zhig gnang na mchos 'gyur yin zhus par de bzhin thob/ khong rang rig pa rmo bo dang spyi tshogs nang mtho dma' bar gsum tshang ma'i mnyam po lam seng mthun lam bahwa thub mtham zhig red/ sud sir slebs nas gzhon dus su skud si lung pa'i 'gro lusasku la'ang 'o chu mnyam bsres lta bu sbyang zhing goms par gyur nas skabs yis phyi rgyal gyi sgra snyan lag tu thogs nas phyi rgyal gyi gzhas gtong ba sogs na ga'on dkrog pa'i dus shig kyang byung ba red/ dar yol rjes khong rang chos phyobs la do snang che zhing nyer lnga tshes bcu srung brtsi mtshon nyams len gang lcogs dang /nged la'ang dpe cha dang rdo ra dril/ gcod kyi ḍa ma ru sogs mchod chas mang po mngags pa bzhin btang tshudang / bal yul du gung gseng nam yong la 'jir nga chorware gcod tshogs shig yod khongs mnyam zhugs dang rogs pa'ang cung zang byas yod red/kho nga rang bza' tshang gnyis ka sems pa bzang po dang chos phyogs la dkar po yod par brten sud si yul mi mang pos tshe ring sar yong nas nang chos rmo ra dri ba btang ba dang la las bla mar bkur gyi yod red/ 'on kyang tshe ring bi ngos nas kho nga dza ra/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos ni zab cing rgya che bas rang ngos nas kyang til 'byu tsam las mi shes shing / khyed rnam pas kyang dus tshod thung ngu zhig la dodags dka' snyam/ codan kyang nyams len gyi cha nas stabs bde 'is bshad na/ ta la'i bla mas rtag par gsung gi yod pa zhig ngas kyang khyed tshor 280

byes 'byor spo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/zhus na/ gzhan la phan pa gang thub bgyis/ /gal te gzhan phan mi thub na/ /gatheṭad ji rab tu spang bar bya/ /zhes go bde'i bka' slob 'di gzhir bzhag rang sngo sa nas gang la gang ston gyi lam ༷ na gang 'jon bgyis par yul mi mang po zhig tshe ring gi grogs por gyur/ rang nyid kyi rnam spyod kyang drang srong zhig dang dbyer med dper na/ dngul rngan gyi 'bul ba byung ba thams cad spo rong dgon di slar gso'i ched yin zhes sgam chung zhig gi nang zur gasku ga byed pa las sger spyod med pa/ yul mi su 'dra zhig thug 'phrad du slebs na'ang zhal stong log mi rung zhes rang nyid kyi thab tshang du gang sku da mgron por bteg pa dang / rang nyid kyi ca dalnga sa shig la gzhan sems zug pa shes na lam seng sbyin pa gtong ba sogs/ gzhan phan kho na'i rnam phyungad 'di 'dra zhig la brten nas ༷/la mi la smus bla ma tshe ring zhes dad pas bkur/ la las blo thub grogs dze ra bkur ba mu+ogs kyi kho da nas gtong phod can ma/ mar li se kon phelaḍa zhes pas bka yul du zho rong dgon pa slar gso'i sbyin bdag mdzad/ ka rin lhar sar gyis sgo rong dgon pa dang zung sbrel gyis slob yon rogs tshogs btsugs/sde rjes la'u ra dang / ad ri'o gnyis kyis lpo rong dgon pa dang zung sbrel gyis bal bod gnyis shar khyab pa'i rogs dza gas btsugs/ de min grogs sngo sazhan mang pos kyang tsag tsig 'brel mchosan gnang ba sku/gas skal bzang du gyur/kha don tshan gnyis pa/ mchog sprul rin po che ngos 'dzin/ phyi lo 1986tsam nas tshe ring khong rang snying shugs nyams pa'i nad kyis mnar nas sman 281

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me yong /bcos ji byas phan pa med par skabs re drag skyed dang skabs re mal lus su gyur/ lan cig dzu rig gi sman khang zhig tu tshe ring gi zag phung nus pa rdzogs/ pa lta bur gyur pas/ de dgong em rjes tshe ring gi phung po ro khang sgo 'gram du bang khri'i nang bcug /de'i mtshan gyi gnyid gseng la khong rang la 'gram cas shugs che shig zhu mkhan byung ba la brten nas gnyid sad/ de nas kho nga rang bang khri'i nang du bcug pa shes te yar lang ste rang gi bla ma dang yi dam sgom gyin spyodan lam brgyab nas bsdad dus snga ༷ nam langs/ sman zhabs gcig yis tshe ring gamo na pa mthong nas zhed snang gis phyir bros te em rje 'bod du bskyod/tshe ring gson ngo ra mthodang nas las byed nang khul khag dkri byed kyin tshe ring yar sman khang du drangs/ de rjes em rjes balja da don la/ khyed kyi nad ga'i la gzhigs na khyed rang gi snying rtsa'i nus pa brgya cha nyer lnga tsam las mi 'dus pas nam 'chi nges med la brten khyed rang la kha chems yod na bzhag pas chos ces ku re dang 'brel bshad 'dug /'on te de rjes kyang gnas stangs de rmu ra 'o/ mang bsdad pas em rje tshos tshe ring la ya mtshan can gyi nad pa zer pa'i mi nga yang thogs pa red/ rgyun ring sman bcos gzhan gyis ma phan pa'i gnas stangs/ la gshags bathodas byed rgyu las thabs shes gzhan med pa lta bu chags/ 'on kyang nad gzhir gzhigs na gshags bathodas 'gor gzhi che bar brten tshe ring yigazugs pos 'khyogs min em rje tsho'ang the tshom nang lhungs/ der brten 7song sa mchodag la brtag lung snyan seng zhus 'bras lan gcig gshags bsgu sa bkas 282

byes 'byor spo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba pa bzang gsungs/ de'i rgyun tshe ring la bzhugs sgar nas skud si don gcod brgyud bod sman dang byin rten sotegs rgyun chad med par nang du 'acadal ba gnang /de ri ris slar brtag lung zhus par gshags bcos bgyis pa bzang zhes bka' lan phebs 'phral phyi myong 1991 myongar gshags bathodas bgyis pa lam lhongs su gyur/sashags bcos rjes rang nyid kyi gzugs po rje btsun mi la ltar sha lpags tsam las med pa lta bu skam zhing ya ngar gyur pa ma zad mgo lag gi khrag rtsa'ang sngo phyu rer mngon mthong thub pa gyur na'ang khong rang gi nang bsam pa'i sems shugs ri ltar brtan pas na gshags bcos tshabs chen de'i rjes kyang lo ngo brgyad lhag tsam gson sngo ra bzhugs/ de'i ring rmi lam rtags mtshan 'dra min byung ba rnams spyir stangs kyi rmi lam mam wa na chen gyi rtags mtshan ji yin the tshom du gyur nas khong rang gis sud si nas bal yul la bskyod mi phyi rgyal ngo shes/ ka rin/ lhar ghar mdun gsang rgya chen pos rten gtso rin po che'i sku mdun du brtag zhur zan sgril bskur ba nged rang dang spo rong dgon pa'i 'gan 'dzin dge tshe ring rdo rje/ dge kre nub bcas gsum thun mong nas rten gtso rin po che'i mdun du smon lam gzab rgyas dang bcas brtag pa zhus par wa na chen yod ces pa'i zan sgril de brtag par babs/mthar phyi lo 1996 phyi zla 9 tshes 18 mtshan gyi tshu tshod gnyis yas mas kyi rmi lam la/ rang gi ngo shes spo rong zla ba dar rgyas dang de snga mjal myong med pa'i kho nga gi bza' zla skal bzang chos sprodan lags lhan gnyis mnyam 283

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /bzhugs kyi pang gseng nas byis pa sngo mtshar can zhig thon nas tshe ring bi sar brtse dung chen lnga sa rgyugs sku/nga nas khyed kyi 'asnumal bzhin pa'i phru gu de nga yin zhes kho pa'i mjing par 'tham pa rmis/ skabs der tshe ring gis zla ba dar rgyas lags khyim tshang la phru gu bu sku da med shes kyi med stabs de 'phral bza' zla ngag chung gnyid bsad de zla ba dar rgyas lags la bu mo da med dris par/ ngas chung la'ang gsal sngo bshad rgyu med stabs de 'phral bal yul du zla dar lags su zhal par phul rjes/ dgung lo lngar nye ba'i bu zhig yod par shes ma thag yang yum gnyis ngos kyi dgongs tshul ji yin la ma ltos par/ khong rang dga' sems 'khol zhing rmi lam de dran pa tsam gyis dad pa'i ba spu g.yo zhing nga'i bla ma rnyed song zhes yab yum zung dang nged spo zodang pa 'thus mi rnams la 'brel ba byas/ yab yum gnyis la bu mo bzhi dang bu gcig kho na las med stabs/ dang thog tshe ring dang yab yum dbar shar kor phran bu byung tshod 'dug kyang / skabs der yum gyi sku mched btsun ma chodas lha na lags nas nang bskul mdzad pa sogs la brten nas mtha' don rgyal ba rin 〈sna che la snyan seng brtag zhus kyis ngos 'dzin gnang na smos med mo sa mthun du gyur pa'i thag chod gzhir bzhag /phyi 'o/ 1996 phyi zla 11 tshes 12 nyin spo rong ser skya'i mi 'thus su dgon pa'i 'gan 'dzin grwa tshe ring rdo rje dang khang dkar bu don grub tshe ring ngos rang bcas/ bzhugs sgar dha ram sa la 7rgyal ba don gyi bdag po'i stu mdun du ched bcar gyis tshe ring dam chos la mi 'o/ lnga tsam gyi ring ya mtshan 284

byes 'byor sgo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/can gyi rmi lam brtag pa rim bstan rnams yig thog tu phab pa shog grangs drug dang spo rong ser skya mi mang gi snyan zhu/ de bzhin bu chung bsod nams ro/na gru/ kyi sku dpar bcas phul nas snga phyi'i gnas tshul rgyu rkyen rnams yig ngag sanyis thosnag nas snyan seng zhus par/ 7rgyal ba rin sngo/ ches yig cha khag la gzigs zhib nan 11sa/ khyed snurar yig cha yag 11 'dug gra sgrig yag 11 byas nas slebs byung nga / yag po red ces dang / de nas bu chung gi 'dra par la sazigs nas/ phru gu khams ris dwangs po zhig 'dug sku gas bka' phebs rjes/yang srid kyi skor de ring ngas gang yang brjod thub kyi ma red/ de ring ngas brtag pa zhig byas/ de rjes las khungs brgyud khyed rang tsho la lan gsal sprad chog /ces bka' bzang phebs pa ltar gnangs nyin de rang sku sger drung che slo bzang sbyin pa lags brgyud sprul sku cadas 'dzin gyi phyag rtag/sa dang tshe mdud byin can bcas rgyu/la/rtsom pa po'i mchan/ 'dir gsal bshad byed rgyur bzhugs sgar du spo ro/nga ser skya mi 'thus bong gsal ltar gtan 'bebs byas kyang grwa tshe ring rdo rje lags bal yul nas thon khar sanam bskyod bal warware yig cha tshang min de nyin gyi gzim chung mjal khar mnyam bcar ma thub/ 'on te skabs der de snga nas rgyud stod dgon pa dbu 'byed mdzad sgor phebs pa'i bang dkar bu bsam grub dang bu ngag dbang rdo rje gnyis nas snyan seng zhus pa ltar mnyam bcar 'thus pa'i bka' grol phebs te khong tsho bzhis spo rong ser skya'i mi 'thus zhus/ga don tshan gsum pa/ phyi 'o/ 1983 lo'i sud sir gnyen 'phrad lta skor/285

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long de dus bal yul du yod pa'i spo rong pa rnams kyi gnas stangs phran bu yag tu phyin nas nga cho nam 'dzoms la 'jigs bral rin po che o rgyan sprul sku'i dargo na pa nas gdan zhus kyis spo rong pa'i rang bdag lha khang zhig tu dkon gnyer dang bcas zhabs zhu thub na zhes gros gleng yang yang yong gi sku da/ dpal 'byor gyi mthun rkyen ched sud si blo mo nga pa la 'brel ba byas na zhes bsam 'char byung ba'i mtha' ro/na der/ tshe ring dam chodas kyis bsam tshul bton par/ gus dkon gnyer ngag dbang ngo ma sud sir gnyen 'phrad dang bcas khyug tsam yong thub na dge mtshan che mthong dang lam bo na sdu/gas kho rang gis sbyin bdag don rgyu byas par brten 1983 lor nga sud sir skad btang nas zla ba gsum bsdad /de dus nga rang skyid po'ang byung la dgon pa'i don dag kyang chen po 'grub song /dre rong pa khyim tshang nyi shu za ma zin sku da rnams re re bzhin thug /de nas nyin gcig tshe ring dam chos dang spen pa lha la cha/'i khyo ga brgya dpon thub bstan lags zhu ba gnyis nas bo sa 'go blta na pa bzhin/ spo mo nga pa tshang ma mnyam 'dzoms bgyis sar rang sngo sa nas 'jigs bral rin lnga che dang spo rong dbo na pa'i gnas stangs nyag phra'i skor gsal bshad dang bcas mthun 'gyur po nga ba'i 'bod skul zhus 'bras/ dgon par mchod 'bul zhabs zhu'i dod spo ro/nga pa khyim tshang re nas lo rer sud sgor lnga bcu re dang / 'jigs bral rin po ches dbus cen mchod rnams o rgyan sprul sku rin po che'i dgon pa nas sger khang zhig tu gdan zhus kyis dkon gnyer 'dzugs rgyu bcas la lo lnga'i khang gla ji gnas sud si'i 286

byes 'byor spo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/sngo rong pas gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes thob pa bcas don chen 'grub song / de rjes tshe ring dang ngos gnyis gros bsdur gyis 7rgyal ba don gyi bdag po mchog la ra/ dgon gyi snga rjes bar gsum gyi lo rgyus dang da lta'i gnas stangs skor snyan sgri+o na zhu rgyu gal chen yin pa ma zad las 'gan zhig kyang yin par bsam nas/skabs 'phral de rang la brjod bya dang yig gzugs legs nyes sku gas la ma ltos ju ra 7gong sa masnumag la snyan zhu zhig kyang phul/ lo mang rjes mi'i lung par pha yul gcig pa yo lang zhig thengs dang po 3phrad dus tshang mas nga la dga' snang chen pos thug 'phrad la slebs byung / de dus gnas tshul khyad mtshar zhig byung ba 'dir brjod na bsam/ g.yag pa rdo je sa nga'i gnam gru'i lam gron sbyin bdag don gyi yin zhes rtsodar shor byas/ yin na'ang nga'i lam gron snga sa nas tshe ring gis sprad zin pa shes nas g.yag pa rdo rjes nga'i gdong la bltas nas/ khyed rang gi kha la so/ gcig kyang mi 'dug ces zhi tshab bsgar rgyu'i sbyin bdag don rgyu thag bcad song / de dus spo rong sku bag kun bzang byams pa lags sdugare sman khang zhig tu phyag las gnang gi sku/da par brten sku ngo'i snga sa nas nga'i sku tshab khe med chag yang gis bsgar rgyu gnang 3 dug /sdud tshab bsgar gla ji gnas ngas ma shes/ bal yul du log ran khar spo rong pa mang pos nga 'phrad par yong dus khong tshos nga'i so tshab dang gtsang sbra dod pa'i kha mdog la bltas nas/ khyod dkon gnyer ngag dbang gi bu yin pas zhes brnyas gtser byed pa dang 'brel ci 'phros mol 'phros skabs/ so tshab 287

'brog sde chen po sgo rong rgi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /bskar gla sud sgor chig stong gnas pa dang / de yang chag yang la brten nas ha cang gi khe ྅/ chags pa las de min phal cher ldab 'e/ga gnas pa shes rtogs byung / so tshab de rang bal yul du bskar na sud sgor nyis brgya skor las gnas kyi med stabs nga rang hang sangs shing dngul de phangs mkhan 'dra bo byas byung /da lta byed dus so tshab de spus dag cig bsgar 'dug /da bar lo ngo nyer lnga'i rjes kyang rang gi skyes so nang bzhin skyon med yod/2 bo dong mcho4ga sprul gyi rnam thar snying bsdus/(rdzong dkar chos sde'i grwa thub bstan ngag dbang gis bris/)༄༅༅/ /shin tu zhi ba'i nyams ldan lha mi'i gnyen/ /snang ba'i dgra la'ang ma yi bu bas byams/ /gdul bya'i khams kyi rjes 'gro chodas kyi tshul/ /ji snyed 'doms mdzad thub pa'i dbang por 'dud/ /rgya chen chos kyi spyan ldan rin po che/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan 'acirdon/ /yid 'a11ga rab mdzes dbyangs can dga' ba'i dpal/ /'jigs med grags pa'i zhabs la gus pas 'dud/ /de yang bo snga nga mchog sprul bstan 'dzin mthu stobs 'jigs bral mchodag ni phyi lo 1992 lo'i zla 2 tshes 7 nyin bal yul mchod rten gyi nye 'dabs su yab spe rong zla ba dar rgyas dang / yum rdzong dkar ba skal ba thong chos sgron gnyis kyi sras sku 'khrungs/ nye du dag 'dus te btsas ston lebs par byas/ byis pa'i skabs gyi mtshan la bsod nams snga/na grub tu 'asngo da cing 288

byes 'byor spo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/yab yum gnyis la sras wa gcig las med pa de yin/ phra ro/nga chos brgyud pa tshe ring dam chos lags su 1990 nas bzung lo lnga la rmi ltas ya mtshan byin zhig bstud mar mjal ba de dag lo re bzhin je bden je gsal du gyur thar/ yab yum gnyis la lo mang ring bu mo bzhi las bu ye nas ma 'khrungs stabs/ rus smyug bu zhig 'dod de dpal 'bar dge bshes rin po che la brtag nyu nga zhus 'bras su las galta ra 'bum dang / sprodam ma 'bum sogs bsags na bu zhig yong nges kyang / des khyim bdag mi 'dzin gsungs pa'i sbas ro/na skabs der rtogs ma thub kyang 'o/ grangs mang po'i rjes tshe ring dam chodas lags kyi rtags ltas dang rtse mthun byung ba la gzhigs na mngo na mkhyen lta bur gyur/ de bzhin ma yum mchodag la'ang snga rjes rmi ltas bzang po mang sngo byung ba'i gnad don rnams kyang lta gas thub pa byung / gnas tshul de dag tshe ring dam chos lags khrong nyid gcig bus 'gan brjid ma bzod nas bal yul khul spo rong dpal mo chos sdings dgon dang / dad ldan sgo rong mi mang rnams dang 'brel gtugs kyis blo bsdur lhag wa bgyis 'bras 1996 lor der 'kho da ser skya mi 'thus bzhi bzhugs sgar du 7bo nga sa mdzadag gi sku'i gam du ched bcar gyis byung rabs dag yig ngag gnyis brgyud zhib phra snyan sgron zhus rjes/ mabo na sngo nyid nas thugs smon brtag pa zab mo sa 'o/ na lnga la nye ba'i byis pa de bo thodang bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi skye sprul du ngos 'dzin 'khrul med mdzad/ 1997zla zha nang mchog sprul rin po che dang yab yum gnyis/ spo rong ser skya mi 289

'grog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /'thus bcas bzhugs sgar du mjal bcar 〈snag 7bo nga sa mchodag nas sprul sku'i dbu skra gtsug phud dgyes bzhes dang 'brel bstan 'dzin mthu stodabs 'jigs bral du mtshan gso/la mdzad cing / sprul sku mchodag rgyun par 'jam dbyangs kyi balha da pa dang gzungs sngags gang mang gsog 'don dgos gal che thog rgyal bstan spyi dang / bye brag bo dong gi bstan pa rin po cher thos bsam slob gnyer lhod med byed dbo sa kyi thugs smon mtshams sbyor dang bcas bka' yig spyi phebs byung / lo der bal yul dpal mo chos sdings dgon du khri ston mdzad sgo rgyas pa zhig dang de rjes skud sir gdan zhus mdzad sgo mdor bsdus shig bskyangs/ phyi 'o/ 1999 'o/ra gnas mchodag dod rje gdan du 7bo nga sa mchog gi sku mdun nas dge tshul gyi bslab sdom macadas/ mchodag sprul rin wa che gsan bsam slob gnyer 'phyug med dgos pa gal gnad che skor spo rong pa ser skya yongs nas dbo ngas tshul nan po byung don/ bal yul khul kho ra yug sogs gang cir gnas bab tshad ldan ma mngon pas/ sku gshegs tshe ring dam chos lags mchog nas gna' dus sngo/ snga nga paṇa chen 'jigs bral ༷rmegs las rnam rgyal mchog gung thang gi chos sde'am rdzong chos kyi spradab dpon du mnga' gsol mdzad pa skustegs dmigs bsal gyi 'brel ba skusnad khar/ ma〈snag sprul 'di pa'i 'khrungs yul sogs gang ci'i gnas bab kyis sngon 'gro'i gsan bsam mdzad yul dang /gzigs skyodang jo nga chodas nas gnang gal che don skabs de'i mkhan rin 〈sna che thub bstan brtson 'grus dang ngo mjal nan zhus mdzad cing / gzhi rtsa de skor spo 290

byes 'byor spo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/rong yul dgon gnyis thad nas kyang 7gong sa skyabs mabo na chen lnga ra bka' slob zhus lan du/ de ga'i blo mos ltar rdzong chos su phebs na 'thus rgyur bka' bzang ) phebs byung 'phral yab yum gnyis dang / spo rong ser skya 'thus mi bcas ched bcar gyi sa rin lnga che rdzong chos su phebs rgyu dang / gsan bsam mdzad phyogs gang thad gnas khang mtshon gang cir mthun sbyor yong ba'i re zhus ltar don sman gyis/ phyi lo 2000 zla 8 tshes 3 ste yul wā rā ṇa sīr ston pa bde bar gshegs pas bden bzhi'i tshul las brtsams te chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa dang snga bskor ba'i dus tshigs khyad par can dang bsnyun chos zhugs mdzad pa dang / rin wa che mchodag thodas bsam sgom gsum dang 'chad rtsodad rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas mnyam med thub pa'i bstan pa rin lnga che 'dzin skyodang spel ba'i rten 'brel gyi lha mo legs par phye/ de nas bzung rdzong chos slob dpon zur pa dge slong byams pa baX da pa lags bshes gnyen du bsten te nyer mkhorware chos spyod dang / rgyan 'jug rnam 'grel rtsa ba sogs thugs 'dzin dang / yi ge 'bri klog mtshon brda sgod sum rtags/ bsngus grwa blo rtags rnams 'khrid sbyong legs par bslabs/ gsan tho zur gsal ltar snga rjes 7bo nga sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog dang / dpal sa skya gong ma/ 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rin po che/ 7skyabs rje 'khrul zhig rin snga che so/gas tshad ldan bla ma dag gi drung nas thun mosgong dang thun mortong ma yin pa'i zab 'khrid dbang lung man ngag du ma mnos/7gong sa mchog nas sa rār mtshan nyid slob grwa'i dge bshes pad+ma rdo rje lags 2

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /bal yul sngo rong dgon pa'i dbu 'dzin du 'gan dkris gnang don/ phyi lo 2004 zla 2 tshes 3 nyin rin sngo che mchodag sa rār lha ba zhugs gnang sku da kyang sku na phra ba dang / de gar skya ser zung 'brel gyi gnas bab la brten lo de'i zla ba 12 tshes 18 nyin rdzong chos su phyir phebs mdzad/ 7gong sa don gyi bdag po'i bka' dgongs bzhin phyi 'o/ 2006 zla 1 tshes 25gza' skar 'phrod sbyor dge ba'i nyin ser byes mnga' ris khang tshan du chos zhugs dang 'brel ser byes mkhan zur dge bshes byams pa theg mchog lags yongs 'acirdon bgres pa dang / dge bshes ngag dbang sangs rgyas lags yongs 'dzin gachodan par mnga' gasku la thog da lta gus rtag brtson pas maro/ rgyud gzhung lugs rgya mtshoro slobo bzhin bcas kyi rnam thar snying bsdus su phyi 'o/ 2007zla 3 par bkad da//3 spo rong rje dbon gyi skor snga phyi'i lo rgyus/(spo phro nga rje dbon sku bag nam mkha' kun bzang byams pas bris/ )rtsom pa po'i mchan/ 'di nas lan mang 'bod skul zhus rjes skud sir gzhis 'khod 'tsho bzhugs spo grodang rje dbon nam mkha' kun bzang byams pa lags nas gsham gsal 'bri rtsom dang sku par gsar snying bcu gsum bcas bstsal ba 'bri rtsom ji ma ji bzhin bkod 4/ra༅༅/ /spo rong rje dbon gyi snga phyi'i yong stangs lo rgyus zhib pa rgyus can nyams cartong can chosas bris pa gnang ba las lhag pa phran nas 'bri ba'i spobs pa

byes 'byor sgo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/sdul rung / skabs der phran spo rong du 'byor stangs kyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus cig dgos gsungs pa ltar gsham gsal nas mkhyen lta gas sku nga rgyur/ la stod treka dkar rdzong kho ngas spo rong rje dbon 'di bzhin chodas rgyal gyi gdung brgyud du grags par brten/ rgyal sngo rgyal phran lta bu byas te rje dawa na la bod gzhung nas rim bzhi'i go gnas 4lo5 te lha sar gtan bzhugs ma dgos par/ 7gong sa sbyabs mabo na chen po mchodag lugs gnyis thugs 'gan bskyed bzhes bka' drin tshe skabs kyis mtshon mdzad chen khag la rten 'byung legs 'bul zhu bar bcar rgyu ma galta gas rtag bcar ma dgos pa dmigs bsal 455 'dug kyang / spo rong rje dawa na nam mkha' ngag dbang 'jigs med la sras mo ma gtogs sras ma byung bar gdung brgyud chad par brten/ ༷ rong chab 'bangs rnams sems tshabs chen pos spo rong spyi khyab gnyer pa zla ba dar rgyas lha sar bcar nas sgo rong 'tsho 'dzin rtsis dalnga na lung shar gyi sras rtsis dasnga na lha klu la mi drag gzhung zhabs kyi bu brgyud 'os 'gab ji dge'i dgongs bskor bka' bsdur zhus te 'tshol zhib skabs 'os babs 'dod blo khengs pa zhig ma byung stabs re zhig de mur lus/de rjes slar yang spyi gnyer zla ba dar rgyas lha bcar dang 'brel go mag skor yab gzhis lha klur ji dge'i dgongs bskor bka' slob zhu skabs/ phran yang lo son bzhin par brten yab gzhis lha klus nga'i ༷༅na mched chung cadas de len 'gab dbo ngas bsdur gnang ba ltar phan tshun tshang mas mo sa mthun/ spo rong rje dbon gyi bu tshab bo mag gcig 'thus su phran len rgyu thugs mos byung ba dang

'grog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /chabs cig mtshams 'dir gsal bshad thung tsam zhu na/ gcen lha klu sras kyi yab rtsis dawa na lung shar gyi sku mched gzhon pa la stod mkhar rta 'or pa'i mna' mar gajo nga gnang gis sras mo zhig spo mo nga rje dbon ngag dbang 'jigs med kyi thugs mdun du bsu bzhes gnang stabs/ rtsis dawa na lha klu sras zhang por brten spo rong gi 'tsho 'dzin du zhu stangs de ltar lags shing / rtsis dpon lung shar gyi lcam nga'i a ma lags bstan 'dzin sgrol dkar la rtsis dpon lung yar gyis masnuman yab yum gcig pa'i sras sros drug byung yod pa'i thog /de rjes a ma bstan 'dzin sgrol dkar lags dang sku srung mda' dpon yab gzhis sa / thog sras bkra shis snga/na grub gnyis 'dus pa las phran/ phyi 'o/ 1936 lor lha sar skyes pa bcas rtsis dawa na lha klu sras dang skyed ma gcig pa'i spun mched du nges shing / rje dawa na gyi bo mag tu nang dodan gtan 'khel zin yang / sdo phra nga 'di bzhin dbo na sde dang gzhis 'awa ga rgya che ba bcas gzhung sa chen por rten gnas rjes 'brel gyi gzhung 'bab sgrub 'bul zhu dbo sa so/gas snga phyi'i lo rgyus zhib 'khod/ 7rgyal blon mtshan 'kheged kyi 7snyan zhu phul bar gzhis 'bros gang cir sngar spos bzhin 'dzin skyong dang 'brel da nas bzung spo rong so rma/sa la gzhung zhabs sras rnam pa'i go gnas bstsal song na/ gzhis byes gang saṃ ra gzhung zhabs spyi 'gre'i zhabs 'degs zhu dgos pa'i bka' bzang 'go mchan bstsal thon bzhin slo nga chang rten 'brel skabs gnyen dpang dbus mda' kun bzang rtse dang / rtsis dasngo na rnam sras gling pa gnyis nas gnang zhing phyi lo 1951294

byes 'byor spo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/lor rtsis khang las khungs su drung 'khor spyi 'gre'i zhabs sdod zhus/de nas phyi 'o/ 1948 'o/ra gnas skabs dasprodangs zhus kyis rgya gar du dbyin yig slob sbyong byed par bskyod nas 1951 lo mjug tu lha sar phyir zhig gis sngar mo la dang mthun pa'i chang sa'i rten 'brel dacadas gzhi byed par phyi lo 1952 'o/ra gzhis bskor dbo ngas zhus kyis spo rong du bskyodad de lo gsum sdod ring zhing 'brog mi ser 'khyer dman rnams la lta rtog 'tsho 'dzin gang thub byas/ rgyal khab tu bcar te gzhung zhabs sras rnam pas zhabs cadad /gus/ phyi lo 1957 lo mjug tu stod mnga' ris rtsa hreng rdzong sdod bsko bzhag stsal bzhin snga 'phros rtsis len du lnga tshab btang 'thus snyan seng bka' 'khrol sa gnas su ngo tshab ched galta nga byas/ phyi 'o/ 1958 'o/ra spyi nor 7gong sa chen po mchog gdan sa 'bras se dga' gsum la mtshan rtags mdzad sgo'i chibs zhabs su spyi mtshungs bcar dbo sa mo gas kyis lha sar 'bo ra nas lo mjug tu lha sa nas thon te spo zodang du 'dre ra skabs phran gzhung zhabs nas thos mar 'drodar bar brten rang khongs mi mang rnams nas dga' bsu'i sne len zab rgyas byas byu nga ba bzhin de ga'i mur dus cho da gang 'tshams song zhing /skabs der rgya mi'i byed babs blo g.yeng sku da spos la brten rlung 'phrin chung ngu zhig mnyam 'khyer sku/da stabs lha sar zing 'khrugs langs pa de nas shes rtogs byung ste rang sa rang srung thabs kyi gra sgrig ang gsar gyis sdod skabs nyin gcig rgya gar rlung 'phrin brgyud srid blon ne+e ru mchodag nas 7bo nga sa 7skyabs 295

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me+e long /mgon chen sngo/ rgya gar sa mtshams su chibs bsgyur gnang grub pa dang / rgya sarngo gzhung nas dga' bsu zhu bzhin du yod na sa mtshams nas sngo da mi skyabs bcol ji 'byedar shar gtong dgos pa'i khyab bsgrags gnang ba dang phyogs mtshungs 7bo nga sa skyabs masku na chen sngo sa kyang rgya gar sa thog chibs sgyur grub zin pa 'i bka' slob mo gas bstsal bar brten de nas bzung rgya gar khyodags su 'gro rgyu'i bsam masbyasgo 'khor nas/ nang mi zla gras tshang mar gsang rgya byas te stod mnga' ris rtsa hreng rdzong la 'gro rgyu yin tshul gyis stod phyogs su bskyod skabs nang mi lam rogs rnams la dus tshod 'di 'drar brten lam zhor gnas rten rtsa chen glo chu mig brgya rtsa mjal na gang legs yong rgyu zhes brjod nas glo smon thang brgyud gnas skor la 'gro ba'i zol gyis de gar 'byor mtshams zla gras rogs/ mi rnams la phran mnyam du sdod dang / nang la phyir log ji bye da 'dod mos byed bcug ste de'i khongs nas gcig ma gtogs tshang ma phyir 'o/ga gis de gar sdong skabs/ sgyu dang cadad kyi sa mtshams la bod mi skyabs bathodal la ro/gas phan gang thub zhus pa dang / de rjes glo sme na thang sa mtshams su rgya mi 'byor nas sdod blo sa ma bzod par bal yul rgyal sa ka ṭha man ḍūr yong skabs phran nas dbyin skad phran bu shes babs kyis bal yul don gcod nas skad sgyur du yong da'os phebs pa bzhin bcar te skad sgyur zhu yul bod mir rogs ram gnang mtham rgyal spyi'i rgya gram dmar po'i las khungs der skad sgyur zhus nas sdod skabs/rgya gram dmar sngotsware sku tshab nas khyed rang ne+e pa li yin pas zhes bka' 'dri sanang

byes 'byor spo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/ngon phran bod pa yin zhus par khyed rang bod pa yin na nga tsho ra skad sgyur zhig la rno /nga thub tshe gang legs yong nges gsungs te phran skad sgyur du sdod dgos u tshus// nan sngo/ gnang bar brten khas len mi zhu mthu med byung ste zla ba bcu gcig tsam ring las 'gan gang sar dka' ngal 'dzems med zhus nas sde da skabs/rgya gram dmar wa'i dbu 'dzin nas sud sir bod mi nyi shu cangalnga tsam gzhis chags su bal yul nas gtong gtan 'khel te 'dems bsgrugs skabs lung pa cha rgyus tshed par mo nga 'bo 'dod gtan nas mi byed pas/ 'phral phugs gang sar dge sbyo na gsal bshad nan gtan byas te phran mnyam du yong rgyu'i khas len bya dgos zer ba ltar rgya gram dmar po'i skyel sgrol skad sgyur dang chabs cig de don 'gro rgyu byas te zla gcig rjes phran bal yul la phyir 'o/ga bya rgyu nyag gcig yin rung / bsde yul ga zhung nas phyi rgyal gyi kha la gzigs te phyir log 'gro rgyu'i wi sa ma sanang stabs mtha' ma sud sir mi sdod ka med byung zhing / rang re'i sud 'byor sazhis mi rnams nas spyi nor 7sku nga sa chen 14 mchog gi bka' dgongs zab mo sding dbus su bcangs te yul mir mthun lam gang zab 'dodad chung chog shes dang 'brel bzo grwa'i sbyin bdag so so'i 'dod mthun dka' ngal dang len gyi sgo nas bod spyi'i mtshan la 'degs thub pa'i byas rjes gzengs su thon pa bzhag sku da cing / de rjes sud si gzhung nas bod mi chig stodang tham pa skyabs bcol du bzhis rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang nas/ deng skabs bod mi sum stong drug brgya stodar rlo da pa bcas/297

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /7bonang sa skyabs masku/na chen wa'i thugs rjes sud sir mnyam 'byor mi tshe bzang mthar 'khyol ba'i bka' drin dran dgos pa bcas kyi lo rgyus su/ sgo rong kun bzang byams pa nas bris/(200na phyi zla 4 tshes 29 'khyodar )4 gzhis byes gnyis su tshudang chodar nga'i mi tshe/(btsan byol bod mi mang spyi zur spo rong rgan chen pa dbang phyug rdo rjes bris/)༄༅༅/ /me tog gangs la phog pa'i lha skal 'phags mchog thugs rje chen wa 'i gdul zhing / 'dzam gling sa yi yang thog bod gangs can ljongs kyi nub phyogs/ bal bod sa sbrel du 'khod pa'i bdag gi pha yul/ 'brog sde chen po spo rong rnyi /'dzam gling nang 'gro ba mi'i chags yul ches mtho gras rgya mtsho nas malnga tshad mi ṭar 8000 brgal zhing 'dzam gling nang grags can gyi gangs ri'i khongs nas/ shi sha sbang ma'am sgyu lha rgan chen gyi nye 'dabs su rje mi la'i gnas nge rtse 'dod yon rdzong gi 'khris kyi grong 'khyer ser lung zhes par/ khyim ming rgon chen pa gnyer pa zla ba ro/na grub/ ma 'chi med sgro la ma gnyis la bu phrug bcu 'khrungs pa'i kho ngas nas bdun pa dbang phyug rdo rje bdag phyi 'o/ 1942 lor skyes/ rgan chen pa zhes grong ming sgyu gas tshul ni bdag gi spo sngo dam pas the ra lung yul gyi rgan po gnang bas na rgan chen dang / de rjes sgo rong tsho brgyad kyi gnyer pa'am spyi khyab kyi thugs 'gan bzhes pas gnyer pa zhes thogs/298

byesa'abyor sgo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/spo phra nga gi chags yul shin tu malnga bas so nam zhing las kyi thon 'bras 'byu rigs dang sngo tshal/ shing tog sogs smin thub kyi med stabs 'tsho las gnag lug sems can la brten dgos pas thon skyed sha mar phyur gsum dang sha tshil bal pags mo gas las med/ snga dus nas 'byu rigs sku gas dbo sa mkho gzhan rnams yul gru gzhan nas sgrub dbo sa kyi gnas stangs khag sngo sku da pa der deng dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i nang 'gyur baX da chen wa zhig thebs pa'i re ba byas kyang / phyi lo 2006 lor nged rang bod du gnas mjal dang gnyen 'phrad gcig cogs khyug tsam bskyod dus ser lung gis gtsos pa'i the rong khul gyi gnas stangs ni gna' dus rang 'jags lta bu las yar rgyas kyi ngo bo bsngags su 'os pa zhig ye nas ma rnyed/ de lta bu'i rjes lus thebs par rgyu mtshan mang po zhig yod rung / gtso bo ni lo ngo lnga bcu'i ring deng dus dang mthun pa'i shes yon slob lho nga gi bo skabs ma thob par lus pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin par mngon/ de bzhin mang tshangags la 'aX da bsten dang sman bcadas kyi mthun rkyen shin tu zhan pas na phran dbang rdor khyim tshang nas ser lung dang be rtse grong khyer sogs la khyab pa'i sman khang stabs bde zhig la/ bde ldan sman khang zhes ming btags pa zhig mo gas skyor byed thub pa'i bo skabs kyang sgyu ba par sprod sems 'kho la/shes yon/ snga dus su spo rong tsho brgyad dang shel dkar mnga' zhabs/ sman phur bcas sa khul rgya khyodan mi chung bar bka' drin can gyi mkhas dbang dam pa 299

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me+e long /ku ra dge rgan nam/ mtshan gzhan la dkar leb drung yig zhu bar dge phyag mang wa byung ba'i nang nas nged kyi pa lags mchog wa da yig gi sdeb sbyor dang sum rtags sogs la mkhas pa'i gras shig la brten sku/ skurware bu phrug rnams dang spo rong khul gyi phru gu ga'an mang por bod yig /nang chos/ dkar rtsis bcas slong 'khrid gnang sku da/ gus pa bdag la'ang bod yig dang nang chodas sdudags dmigs bsal chodab 'khrid gnang ba'i bka' drin de ring rjes dran zhu/ rang lo bcu bzhir khang dkar zhang lnga dam pa tshe brtan dbang phyug lags nas thugs brtse dor med kyis nged la shes sku na dang malnga nga thos nyams khyodang gi bo skabs lnga ba ched lha sa ra mnyam 'khrid gnang ba'i bka' drin la brten nas kho bo bdag spyi snu gas nang gang ci'i thad la rjes lus ma thebs tsam dang de 'phral bod du dus 'gyur rjes 'a/sa smon bzang po'i btsan byol la 'byor/ bzhugs sgar du sdod ring bco brgyad khri chen mchog gi drung nas rtags 'jug dang bla ti rin po che'i drung snyan ngasabartse ba rin wa che'i drung nas bshes springs 'khrid bcas thodab/ de rjes a rir 'byor rjes 7gong sa mchog gis dbus sa dge dka' rnying ris su ma chad pa 'i bla ma dge bshes mang watware drung nas bod kyi nang chos bka' dbang mo gas mang wa thodab pa'i bsod nams bsags/ skal bzang thodab pa dang da ni chos phyogs kyi bya ba kho nar bsnyungan khul yin/dmag 'khrug 'og nas thar pa/ phyi lo 1959 lor lha sar dus zing dmag 'khrug gi nang nged rang tshud kyang skabs der mchog gsum thugs rje dang 300

byes 'byor slo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/tshe sngon las dbang gis drag po'i mtshon cadag nas thar tsam gyi bde bar 'kho da kyang / nged kyi pa lags dam pa dang / zhang lags dam pa gnyis nyes med bsgu na 'jag gis/ pa lags dam pa 'o gcig tsam rjes blo da grol gyis btsan dre la lu phebs/ zhang lags dam pa mi 'o/ nyi shu sgo ra btson 'jug rjes mthar phyi 'o/ 1980 'o/ra bce na khang nas glod grol gyis btsan byol du phebs te bskyar du zhal mjal thub pa'i dga' sgo bsam brjod las 'das pa thob/ bod du dus 'gyur dmag 'khrug ma byung sngon khang dkar zhang tshe brtan dbang phyug lags dam ji nyid ྅ rong tsho brgyad kyi spyi khyab dang shel dkar mnga' zhabs kyi gtso drag las 'gan gcig lha gas bzhes bzhin par brten skabs der wa da kyi rgyal sa lha sar la stod shel dkar rdzong khongs chab 'bangs mi ser gyi bde don dang 'brel ba'i zhu gtugs las lha/na la ngal ba khyad bsad kyis bca' bzhugs gnang bzhin pa'i skabs red/btsan khyodal gyi mi tshe/ phyi 'o/ 1959 'o/ra ngo da gangs can gyi snod bcud la yid skyo'i don rkyen tshabs chen phog pa'i dza drag gi gnas tshul la brten nas sangs can bod kyi dbu khrid spyi nor 7bo nga sa skyabs mgon tā la'i bla ma mchog mi yul rgya gar nang btsan khyodal la phebs rjes/ wa da mi gang 'tshams zhig sngon bsags las dbang bzang snga ra brten nas rgyal ba'i rjes su 'brangs thub pa'i spru+ongs nged kyi khyim tshang nang mi gang 'tshams btsan byol du 'dre ra/skabs der ྅/da phrug na gzhon rnams la chodab bskyodad dang / rgan gras rnams 301

'brog sde chen po skyo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /rgya gar ku lu khul du lam bakhro'i 'tsho las go sgrig bka' drin bskyangs pa bcas kyi gnas stangs der/ slo bur gangs khrod ri mtshams su 'byor ba'i bod mi rnams yul lung gsar pa'i gnam gshis dang zas sbyor bo mas gshis sogs 'a'o/da min gyi nad mnar dang 'chi rkyen/ lus la ngal ba/ sems la sdug bsngal so/gas dran pa tsam gyis mig chu cadar dbo sa gnas stangs de'i skabs/ rang nyid 'o/ na phran bu yar mo na la brten slob bskyodad bo skabs ma thodab kyang sems shugs ma chag par mkhas dbang mthar phyin bha bus mdzad pa'i lhan cadad shan sbyar gyi tshig mdzod der 'thams te nyin mtshan snying rus bgyis pa'i don 'bras su yul mi'i mnyam skad brda 'aX da tsam byung ba la brten/ khyug tsam ring dz+nya shod du rgya gar gyi za khang zhig gi lag gasku ga tu nyar/ de dus nyi mo za khang gi las gasku/ga dang mtshan la bod pa'i za khang zhig gi sgo rgyab tu nyal bcug pa'i gnas stangs der/ nged kyi lus por lhan skyes shig gis tshang bcas te gzugs bcud phran tsam las med pa de'ang bgo sha thebs 'acad ba'i yid skyod ba'i ngang tshul der sems shugs ma chag par ngal ba khyad bsad kyis dmigs yul bzang wa sgrub par ngang rgyun dgos snyam nas sdod pa'i skabs der/ mi ring bar rang gzhung nang srid lhan khang nas ldi lir bod mi na gzhon kha shas la spyi tshogs zhabs zhu'i slob sbyong sprodad rgyu'i 'char gzhi zhig thon pa'i mi 'gro'i khongs nged kyang 'ad/thodan byung bas na kho bo'i mdun lam phye/ldi li nas slob sbyong thon rjes bod mi skyabs bcol ba'i 'phrod bsten dang sman 302

byes 'byor spo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/bcos ched/ bzhugs sgar du sku/ngas grags/ ḍi ga krar nag sngo zhes pa'i 'gan 3ོsa skor skyod sman khang zhig ched 'dzugs gan nga bar nged rang bcas lo mnyam pho rga/sgyur lnga em rje'i las rogs su bzhes khongs nged rang la skad sgyur dang sman s+t+rod/ nad g.yog gang 'gab kyi las 'gan sprad pa zhabs zhu hur thag zhus/phyi lo 2006 'o/ra nged rang pha yul du sman khang zhig rgyu sbyodar zhus yod rngu/ der lta skor la bskyod dus/ nged rang gi mi lo lnga bcu'i sngon gyi mi tshe de dran gso shugs chen zhig thebs pa dang / nged tsho'i dus la bod mi gar yod sar gnas spo bzhin sbra gur zhig gi nang nas sman bakhyodas kyi las la brtson yang /sad kyi bde ldan sman khang gi sman zhabs pa bu mo byang chub sgrol mas khang pa'i nang nas sman bcos byed kyi yod pa de tsam gyi khyad las ma mngo na/a rir btsan khyodal gnyis pa/ btsan khyodal gzhung gi bka' drin las phyi lo 1967 lo ra bod phrug dar ma gang 'tshams shig a rir shing gakhyodad 'tsho las smu gtong 'char khongs nged kyang 'dam thodan gyis go skabs bzang ngo thob a rir 'byor 'phral las 'gan gang 'khris la ngo lkog gasku jo la spangs pa'i gzhung bzang gis las sha'i 'khur 'gan bsgrubs pa dang / zhar du rang la dbo sa pa'i slob sbyong la'ang mu mthud 'bad brtson bgyis 'bras sbyin bdag gi ngos nas nged smu bdag rkyen mtshon byed 'brel yod bachod grwa zhig gi 'gan 'dzin du bsko bzhag byung ba der lo mang zhabs zhu hur thag gis da cha rgan yol du gyur pa bcas mi tshe bzang mthar 'khyedal bzhin pa 'di'ang mchog gsum byin mthu las yin par 303

'brog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /sems/ rang nyid la lto gos kyi dka' ngal med pa'i go skabs bzang po de bod mi'i rtsa don la phan ched phyi rgyal bar 'brel lam bzos te bod don skor ngo spyod dang gsal bshad/ rgya gar dzeged mi'i gzhis chags khag nang glo nad kyis mtshon dka' ngal nang lhangs pa rnams la sman bcos rogs skyor gang nus/ de rjes a ri gzhung gis bod mi chig stodang bzhes skabs rang nyid gnas yul sar bod mi 50 tsam la sbyin bdag dang las ka thabs 'chosal byed phrogags sogs zhabs sdo/ nisgo dman 'argam jo/ba/cadad mi mang gi spyi 'thus zhabs zhu/ btsan dre la wa da gzhung gi bca' khrims dgongs dodan byang a rir gnas bzhugs bod mi rnams la spyi 'thus gcig bi zhabs stegs thob thang yod pa ltar/ bod mi mang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i spyi 'thus 'os 'dems la nged rang byang a ri'i bod pa'i spyi 'thus su 'dems thon byung ba skal bzang du gyur/ skabs der rang 'khris las 'gan zhu sgo spyi dang sgos su da lta'i bca' khrims nang lugs ma mthun gyi khrims rtsa ya mtshan can zhig sku da pa de bsgyur bcos gtong thabs su 'bad pa shugs cher bgyis pa'i khul yang grub 'bras snga na du ma 'khyodal/ lugs ma mthun gyi khrims rtsa de gang nga ma zhe na/ bdam bya 'dems byed kyi khrims gzhi'i nang la lar chodal kha dang chos lugs gnyis ga'i thob thang yin zhes 'os thengs gnyis 'phen chog pa/cithob thang de red/ skabs der gcung slo bzang chos 'phel yang dbus gtsangaspyi 'thus su bdam thon gyis gcen gcung gnyis lhan du bod mi mang gi spyi 'thus 304

byes 'byor spo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/las 'gan sgrub bzhin pa de rgan chen khyim tshang gi skal bzang du gyur/'brog pa spo rong pa'i mdzad bzang / mi yul lung phyogs gang sar btsan byo94 la gyar ba'i 'brog pa sgo rong pa rnams kyang dka' sdug chen po'i nang lhangs pa bod mi spyi mtshungs su gyur rung / ngal ba khyad bsad kyis so so'i 'tsho ba'i mdun lam sra brtan bzo rgyu kho nar mgo bo rma g.yengs par rim pas mi rabs kyi las 'gan 'thus shor du ma btang bar 'brog sde spo rong du mes dus dar ba'i bo dong paṇa chen 'jigs bral chen po'i gdan sa dpal mo chos sdings dang de dang 'brel ba'i mche'i sku gsung thugs rten so/gas la rgan gachodan bar gsum tshang mas snga phyi da gsum du phyar gru mnyam 'degs kyis zhabs zhu hur thag zhus 'bras/ da cha bal yul mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi 'khris su yid dbang 'phrog pa 'i dgon pa zhig gsar bzhengs mo da pa ma zad/ de'i nang dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga/ bcur nye bar 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang / thos bsam sgom gsum gyi mthun rkyen sgrub thub pa ni 'grog pa spo rong pa lha sde mi sde nyams bzang du gyur pa dang /de bzhin gzhis su'ang 'dzam gling yul gru gang sar khyab pa'i spo rong pa rnams nas byis pa na gachodan la smin pa'i slob grwa/ chos dad la smin pa'i dgon pa dang ma ṇi lag skor/ 'aX da bsten la smin pa'i sman khang dang sngo tshal 'debs las sogs la mo gas skyodar mi dman tsam zhu thub pa ni dga' sems 'kho la ba'i rang bzhin du gyur/ mdod smad mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis/ skyid la sdug pa'i 'jig rten mi yul 'di/ /shi yang phyi mig lta ba'i re ba yi/ /skye bo 305

'grog sde chen po hro rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /thams cad rang gi byas rjes tsam/ /shul du lus pa 'bad pa ngang gis bya/ /zhes dang / yang spyod 'jug las/ 'gro ba thams cad ngan 'gro las/ /sgrol ba byed pa'i spyi stegs yin/ /'gro ba'i nyon mongs gdung sel ba'i/ /sems kyi zla ba shar ba yin/ gsungs pa ltar bo dong mchog sprul rin po che gang nyid 'gro ba mi yi gzugs su phebs pa ni rang cag gdul bya'i bsod nams su gyur/ gang byon pa'i tshul ni spyir rang re lha sde mi sde'i dad dam la lhad kyi dri mas ma gos pa dang / lhag par snyigs dus nyam nga'i dus 'dir rang dbang gi gnas shig tu byedan pa'i dbo sa pa gzigs pa so/gas ni spyir skyes bu dam pa'i chodas nyid yin na rang rer zhal mjal thub pa skal bzang du gyur/ mthar rgad po'i smon lam snyan bskul 'di gasku la rgyur/ mchog sprul sku tshe skal brgyar brtan/ /thos bsam lha ma la mthil phyin malnga da/ /phyi nang rig gnas kun gnyer nas/ /nyer gcig dus kyi gdul bya la/ /gang la gang ston 'phrin las skyongs/ /lhag par gzhis su ches mang ba'i/ /skyabs med mgon med 'gro rnams la/ /thugs kyis 'dzin pas ma dor bar/ /'di dang phyi ma'i duḥkha las/ /grol ba'i lam sne 'dren mdzad nas/ /mthar thug rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi sar/ /shar rer 'khrid malnga da bla ma mkhyen/ /kun mkhyen skru nga chen pa'i zhal lnga'i spyodan lam 'di'ang zhu/ gdul bya 'jig rten gang yod dus/ /chos sku'i dbyings la/ ma g.yol bar/ longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul pa'i sku'i/ /'gro ba'i don gnyis rgyun mi chad/ /ces bdag gis sman/306

byes 'byor spo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/mtha' don/ 'dzam gling hril po chung ngu 'di'i nang rang nyid la mi lus rin po che thob/ tshe gang 'dir mi 'dod bzhin mi yul du gyar dgos dang mi yul gyi skyid sdug dang tsha grang la khyodang go mas ngang mi tshe bzang mthar 'bo bzhin pa 'i gnas stangs 'dir rgad sngo bdag la da ni bsam pa chos dang byed las gzhan phan kho na las med snyam zhing / de snga nas kyang gzhan phan mi dman tsam zhus khrul dang slad kyang 'kho sa dpag zhu sgo 'o/sa kyang yin/ mthar 'di phyi'i skyabs gnas dam pa 7gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren rgyal dbang sku 'phreng bcu bzhi pa ngag dbang blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya masnu mchodag sku tshe zhabs pad brtan cing gang gi bzhed dodan lhan gyis 'grub pa'i smon lam dang / zhar du/ bdag gi pha dam pa/zla ba don grub dang ma 'chi med sgro la ma/ zhang khang dkar tshe brtan dbang phyugagrogs sprod khang tshe ring chodas 'phel dam pa bcas kyi gzhan phan gyi lam stodan bka' drin dran zhing smon tshig bzang wa 'dis mjug bsdoms byacod/ /bdag ni sems can thams cad la/ /yid bzhin nor bu las lhag pa'i/ /don mchog sgrub pa'i bsam pa yis/ /rtag tu gces par 'dzin pa shog/5 yang yang gi dri bar gsal bshad/nged nas spo rong dang bo dong sogs kyi skor phyi rgyal nyams zhib par skad sgyur dang / zhar zhor rang nyid nas kyang do snang gis ngag rgyun gyi lo rgyus dang yig rnying bdag gnyer la brtson khul skabs/ do snang can mang po zhig nas bo dong 307

'brog sde chen po spo rong rgi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me 'o/nga /chos rgyun dang spo rong rje dbon sogs kyi skor dri ba mang po gtong myong mchis/ pas skabs der lan 'debs thub pa dang ma thub je mang zhig byung zhing da lam thugs snang can rnams la dmigs te yang yang gi dri ba de tshor gang 'jo na gsal bshad cig zhu bar 'dodad na skabs 'gar snu ra ba'ang yong srid pas dgongs gasdungal/1 spa rong rje dbon dang 'jigs bral chen ngo dus mnyam yin min skar/'jigs bral chen sngo/ zhing gshegs rjes bo dong gi bstan pa nam mkha'i mtshan can dzad rong rje dbon rim byon gyis bskyangs pa'i lo rgyus kha gsal yod rung /da sku da bo dong gsung rnam dang de min bo dong dang 'brel ba'i yig rnying khag nang rje nyid dang skabs de'i chos rgyal du bkur ba spo rong rje dbon dbar gyi 'brel ba'i skor cang mi gsal bar dri ba mang tsam mchis/ 'e rgyus kyi byung rabs la gzhigs na/ lha mo nga du 'bur ba'i gdung rabs kyi rgyal phran thog ma de dus rabs bcu bzhi ba'i snga dus su la stod lho bdag si tu chos kyi rin chen (/340 /404 yas mas ) gyi skabs yin pa ma zad lha bdag nyid brgyud spo rong gi rgyal phran tshugs par malnga na/ 'jigs bral chen dze (/375 /45/) dgung lo so lngar phebs dus ( 1410) sngo rong chos sdings su nyid kyi gdan sa dpal mo 〉〉sa sdings phyag btab par grags/ de bzhin brag dkar ba rig 'dzin choslo kyi dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i 'bur ba'i gdung rabs nang 'bur ba'i gdung rabs gsum pa khro rgyal 'bum la ((sras kho cad shi ma dang / gcung gnyis te 308

byes 'byor spo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/ sku mched gsum byung / gcung po gcig gtsang smad bkra shis lhan por gangs can mgon po ngur smrig 'chang ba bdun gyi dang po rgyal ba dge 'dun grub kyi spyan ma/cir sku chodas mdzad nya ces gsal bas/ rje dge 'dun grub dang 'jigs sprul chen sngo phe bas dus mtshungs/ rje dge 'dun grub pas dpal mo chodas sdings su zhabs bcags te 'jigs bral chen 1stu) drung nas chodas gsan/ 'jigs bral chen pos kyang rje nyid kyi mkhyen pa'i rgya la shin tu smon te thams cad mkhyen pa zhes pa'i mtshan gnas gasdusal ba'i yongs grags 'o( rgyus la gzhigs na 'jigs bral chen po dang 'bur ba'i gdung rabs bzhi ba/ khro bo shi ma/ dus mtshungs ji ra mngon/ yang 'bur ba'i gdung rabs nang / ((deng sang rje dbon zhes mtshan bsnyad pa 'di ji ltar zhe na/ 'jigs bral chen po'i snag gi dbon mor gyur pa zhig spyan ras gzigs sprul nam mkha' shod rje'i skabs tsam du 'bur ba mi'i rje bo dag gi yum du gyur ba de phyin rje btsun phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba nyid kyi snag dbon du song bas rje dbon zhes su grags pa 'di byung ste/ dper mtshon na/ bod chen 'dir bla chen rnams kyi sku mched dang sku tshar gtogs pa rnams la rje dbon zhes brjod pa bzhin no/gnyi /zhes gsal bas rje dbon nam mkha' rdo rje ni spo rong gdung rabs lnga pa nam mkha' rin chen gyi zhang po yin par gsal/ gong gsal sogs dus cigags la gzhigs na/ 'jigs bral chen po dang spo rong du 'bur ba'i gdung rabs gyi stod cha dus mnyam yin pa gdon mi za/ (rgya cadad tshig mdzod chen morware nang snag da bon zhes pa ni sru morware bu'am 309

'brog sde chen po slo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /sring mo'i bu la 'jug par bshad ) lo rgyus phal che'i nang lho bdag si tu chos kyi rin chen gyis 'jigs bral chen por bla mar bkur zhing chos sku na zhus pa'i 'o/ rgyus kha gsal mchis pa dang / 'jigs bral chen po'i rjes wa ro/nga gi bstan pa dzad rong rje dawa na na rim gyis bskyangs pa'i lo rgyus kha gsal mchis kyang 'jigs bral chen po nyid dang skabs de'i rje dbon lha ra nang mi gsal ba'i rgyu mtshan skabs 'dir zhu snumad ma thig/da gdan sa dpal mo chos sdings dang bsam sdings rdo rje phag mo'i stodar/ thams cad mkhyen pa 'chi med 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i bo dong chos 'byung gsal byed sgron me las/ ((rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyal tshab gyi sgu da paṇa 'dzin pa rje btsun chodas kyi sgron me dang / dpal 'chi med grub pa gnyis nyi zhes dang / yang ((phag mo dge stsodang ma'i thugs kyi sprul pa/ rje btsun chos kyi sgron me dang / dpal 'kho ra 'o/ sdom pa'i sprul pa dpal ldan 'chi med sgrub pa la rang gi rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur ba ste /gnyi zhes pa nas mnga' ris chos rgyal gyi sras mo/ rje btsun chos kyi sgron me'am rdo rje phag mo sku thog dang po (la las rdo rje phag mo sku sngo ga gsum pa bathe da mkhan bzhed sredal gnyis 'dug ) ni 'jigs bral chen po'i thugs sras kyi gathong bor gyur te rje nyid kyi rjes rdo rje phag mo rim byon nas bod ljongs stod smad bar gsum du bo gong gi bstan pa la mdzad pa rgya cher bskyangs pa'i phyag rjes mang du mchis/sgo rong pa mi rabs gong ma'i dran thog la dpal mo chos sdings dang rdo rje 310
