byes 'byor po rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba thag mo'i dbar gyi 'brel lam snga dus shig nas nyams te phyis su ngag rgyun cam du gyur par bshad/ dgung lo 75 phebs pa'i grwa chos grags kyis dran thog be+e/ tsho((dngo sa 'brel byas na 'jigs bral chen po'i rjes bo dong bstan pa'i dbu bla mtho shos bsam sdings rdo rje phag mor bkur ba dang / rdo rje phag mo'i chung srid nam phebs kyi khri 'don mdzad sbed grub ma thag dpal mo chos sdings su 'jigs bral chen po'i sku 'dra 'jigs bral nga 'dra ma mchod mjal la phebs srol yod red/ nga tsho'i spo lags tshos skabs rdo rje phag mo chos sdings su phebs myong yod red ces go myong / nga tsho'i dus thog la bsam sdings rdo rje phag mo zhes pa mtshan jo sa pa tsam las zhal ras mjal myong med/ga ces brjod/bo wa nga khyodags las rnam rgyal gyi gsung rnam ngag dbang ma zhes pa mchen zhig yod par grags kyang da bar gzhis byes gang du'ang ma rnyed/ bo dong gi chos rgyun snga dus shig nas ches nyams khar rjes su nyams zhib kyis bstan ba〉〉sa mdzad po re zung byung ba tshos kyang bo dong dang jo nang gnyis 'dzol ba sogs kyi rkyen pas da yod grags chen lo rgyus 'ga'i nang go 'o1ga tshabs chen shor bas kyang bo lugs nyams rgud kyi rkye na du gyur sku da pa ni deng gi nyams zhib mkhas pa chorware spyan lam du mchis/3 spo rong rje dbon nam mkha' dpal bzang dang mi dbang pho lha bsod nams stobs rgyal gyi skor /'di'i skor rgyas bshad me lug dbus gtsang sde gzar skor le'u zur du yod 311

'grog sde chen po hro rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /pa nas lta gas nges kyang rags tsam gleng na/ 'bur ba'i gdung rabs las spo mo nga rje dawa na nam mkha' dpal bzang gis ((me lug ( 1727) dbus gtsang sde gzar gyi skabs 7mi dbang 'o/ lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyal stod khyedags su dmag bskul bar drodan dus rta dmag brgya phrag lhag pa mo gas snga phyir zhabs 'degs yang dag par sgrub pa'i bdag rkyen du gtan tshigs she bam rim can 37pa zhing thugs gasdigags zhin tu che/nyi zhes pa dang / zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan gyis mdzad pa'i ((bod kyi srid don rgyal rabs gnyi nang me lus dbus gtsang sde gzar skor/ ((de nas spo rong du dbon rigs a ngos dang blangs kyis rta dmag brgya skor dang / khong rang na chodad smin yang zhabs rjes su bcar/nyi zhes 'khod pa las skabs de'i rje dbon nam mkha' dpal bzang nyid dgung 'e/ bgres son du phebs par gzhigs na rje dbon nam mkha' dpa la bzang gi 'dzin skyodang (1665 yas mas nas 1740 yas mas ) yin par snang / spo rong rje dasngo na sku ngas k+shi khongs nas rje dbon nam mkha' dpa zhwa bzang ni ((dpa' mdzangs brtul 'o/da che zhing blo gros kyi dkyil yangs pa 'jis rten gyi dgra thabs la yang mkhas pas spo snga nga pa'i 'dzin dbang sa kho ngas stod smad bar gsum rgya che ba yang 'di nyid kyi sku ring la byung bar grags gyi zhes dang / 'di'i gong du ((rje dbon skya'i rigs rnams phal cher sngon srol 'bro// pa'i cha lugs ral pa can bathodas med de ka yod par snang /nyi de rjes bod bzhung dga' ldan pho brang nas she bam rim ba455 la gzhigs te gzhung lugs dasngo na chas 312

byes 'byor sgo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/gyon 'go tshugs par mngon/ dus 'gyur skabs spo rong sku bag kun bzang byams pa lags la sras rnam pa'i kho ngas rim bzhi'i bo gnas mcho na pa'i na bzar so/ chen dang dbu la spa lcog /chibs rtar snying 'dom sogs kyis brgyan pa yod/ spo rong pa'i ngag rgyun mtshar gtam la lpo rong rje dbon 'am bu zhes pa 'is gis sde pa gzhung nas phur pa gar rgyag gi sa zhus par grags pa 'di rje dbon 3di nyid kyi rnam thar las mtshar gtam du 'phros pa min nam snyam /4 bo dong chos rgyun dang cos srung bkra shis 'od 'bar gyi skor/m+bhi tshogs nang lha srung bsten phyogs kyi gleng gzhi nas 'phros te spo mo nga pa gachodan skyes mi nyung ba zhig nas rang dbo na gyi srung ma chos srung bkra shis 'od 'bar skor la do snang chen pos dri ba dang bcas lo rgyus shes 'dod byed kyi yod na/rags tsam le tshan snga ma zhig tu 'khod mo da kyang 'dir shel dkar chos sde ra yod pa'i chos srung chen po'i rnam gzhag gi phyag dpe gzhir bzhag sbud tsam gleng rgyur/sngon tshe rgya gar rdo rje gdan du slob dpon chen pos bka' yis bsgos shing chos lugs ris med kyi bstan srung du bskul ba/ 'phrin las kyi lha mthu rtsal che la dngos grub myur phyoḍal gyi bdag po/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du mgo na po klu sgrub dang grub 11ba lwa ba dmar po 〈snags paṇa chen du ma'i bka' srung / rgya gar rdo rje gdan dang phul+la hā ri sogs kyi gnas bdag /paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pas lnga dong e'i srung mar mnga' gasku la zhing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung 313

'grog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long / bar bka' balha mdzad pa dang / grub thob 'dar phyar ba ru ba rin chen bzang sngo sa kyang gdan sa brag ram gnyer du gtad cing bstan pa srung bar bka' bsde mdzad pa/ phyis su dpang lo chen 14sa rgya bal gnyis bsdoms lan bdun phebs pa'i skabs rgya gar nas dpang lo chen 16) rjes su 'brangs nas 'phrin las tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i srung mar dgongs te bod kha ba'i ljongs su spyan drangs pa'i chos srung 'di nyid rgyud sde gang dang gang gi khungs la brten nas byung tshul bshad pa ra ((chos srung chen po dpal ldan bkra shis 'od 'bar zhi drag gi rnam gzhag ba da pa rab gsal me 'o/nga zhes bya ba bzhugs sku /gnyi /zhes bal yul shel dkar chos sde ra bzhugs pa'i chodas srung bkra shis 'od 'bar 'khe ra bcas kyi rnam ga zhus nang / ((lha chen tshogs kyi bdag po 'di ni sngon tshe bskal pa grangs med pa nas/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa yin te sgrub thag shin tu nyecad/ /'es tshogs bdag gi snying po'i gzungs las gsungs pa ltar/ gang bi sprul/ sa'i 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang / de'i sprul pa lha chen tshogs kyi bdas rjo 'i sku'i rnam 'gyur dang / sprul pa mang du yod pa'i nang nas/ chos bdas nga kro shis 'od 'bar zhi ba nor du sgrub pa ni lha chen chodags kyi bdag po'i 'phrin 'a sa kyi sprul pa yin par lang 'gro lo tsā ba dkon mchodag 'byung gnas dang gter chen chos kyi rgyal po rat+na gling pa/ dpang ston mkhas pa'i dbang po blo bo sa brngan ri sogs kyi ྅kyi'i skye ba rim par brgyud pa'i mkhas grub chen po 'jam dpa 'a dbyangs chos kyi rje bkra shis rgya mtshos bzhed cing /nyi zhes dang / 'di re 314

byes 'byor spo rong pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar gyi 'phreng ba/zhi drag gnyis las/ bstod bskul yig rnying bkra shis dge mtshan las/ ((zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod sku gas/ /'phrin las sna tshogs skrub pa'i phyir/ khyed kyi sku yi rnam 'gyur ni/ /gcig tu ma nges sna chodags stodan/ /zhes pa'i nang tshan/ zhi ba kher rkyang ston pa la/ /phal cher bzhin bzang skyes pa'i gzugs/dung mdog zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /ber dmar dar gyi gying thod can/ /stag ral gzig shubs sogs kyis spras/ /phyag g.yas dar dmar ru mtshon 'phyar/sde brgyad dmag dpung dgra la 'gyed/ /g.yon pas yid bzhin nor bu bsnams/sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol/ /rin chen sga srab la sku gas pa'i/ /rgyan gyis spras pa'i rta mchog 'di/ /shugs chen be+eḍūr+ya yi mdog /glog ltar 'khyug pa'i steng na bzhugs/ /lha klu btsan dang gnod sbyin sogs/ /'kho ra mang 'bum sde pho nyar 'gyed/nyinyi /ces pa dang / cos srung drag po mthu ru sgrub pa'i byung tshul ni/ chos srung drag wa 'di bzhin tshogs bdag spre'u'i gdong can gyi rgyud nas bstan pa'i lha zhig yin cing / 'di nyid kyi sku'i rnam 'gyur mtha' yas kyang mdor bsdus na/ ((zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod sogs/ /'phrin las sna tshogs sgrub pa'i phyir/ khyed kyi sku yi rnam 'gyur ni/ /gcig tu ma nges sna tshogs ston/ /res 'ga' khro chen brngams pa'i zhal/ /la lar rab sgeg glang po'i gdong / /res 'ga' khro gtum seng ge'i zhal/ /la lar rab khros spre'u'i gdong / /zhal gyi rnam 'gyur ji bzhin du/ /sku mdog phyag dar phyag mtshan dang / /na bza' rgyan dang cha lugs sku gas/ /rnam 'gyur sna dza gas ci ra 315

'grog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /yang stodan/ /mig dang rig byed phyag sogs kyis/ /g.yul las rgyal byed ru dar da nga / /mtshon gyi bye brag du ma dang / sgrub po skyod pa'i rdzas mchog dang / rizhes sogs gsal/ zhi drag gnyis nas shel dkar chodas sde'i srung ma ni chos srung zhi ba'i ngo bo/ bzhin ras bzang zhing skyes bu'i gzugs/ /dung mdog zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /chibs su chibs rta sngon po chibs/ /zhes pa 'di yin/ spo rong dpal mo chos sdings kyi srung ma ni drag po'i ngo bo/ rab sri+o spre'u'i gdong can bzhin ras dmar mdangs can pa 'di yin/ lo rgyus rgyas pa gzigs 'dod na gong gsal chos srung rnam gzhag rab gsal gzigs pa zhu /5 dgongs su gsol/ sku nga gsal yang yang gi dri bar lan 'debs/ zhes pa'i le tshan 'di dag rang ngos nas nag 'gros su bkod 'dod med par lan cis phyir 'then bgyis kyang / lo rgyus 'di la thugs snang can gus kyi dga' nye mang sngo/ zhig nas dgongs 'char gnang sngo na/ lo rgyus 'di bod yig nang bris pa dang deng dus rang re'i spyi cho gas kyi gshis khams dang gnas stangs la gzhigs na / yang yang gi dri bar lan 'debs zer ba'i le tshan 'di bkod cha dge mtshan che mthong gi phan sku na mang wa 'dren par shes rmongs bdag gis tam bshad bgyis / par mi 'gyur ram snyam pa'i gce ngas sems dor thabs med pa zhig bcang gin la gang gsung par mos te rang 'jas/sa bzhag dgos byung bas nor 'khrul ngas ham bshad lta bur gyur par mthol lo bshags/316
